    export type RowKind = "closed" | "hours" | "same";
    export interface DateRow {
      /** React key and id seed; stable across edits. */
      readonly key: string;
      /** `""` until picked. */
      readonly date: string;
      readonly kind: RowKind;
      /** The weekday a "Same as" row copies (0 = Sunday). */
      readonly sameAs: number;
      /** The hours a Special hours or Same as row writes. */
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      /**
       * The weekday `services` were copied from while the Manager has not edited them, so a new date
       * can replace them; absent once edited (their hours are then theirs).
       */
      readonly seededFor?: number;
      /** This row's message for guests; the shared one wins while `shareMessage` is on. */
      readonly message: string;
      /** What the date is, when the sheet opened on it (a holiday's name); shown in the row's legend. */
      readonly name?: string;
    }
    export interface AddDatesForm {
      readonly rows: readonly DateRow[];
      readonly shareMessage: boolean;
      readonly sharedMessage: string;
    }
    export type RowField = "dateMissing" | "date" | "hours" | "message";
    export const rowFieldId = (rowKey: string, field: "date" | "hours" | "message" | "same"): string =>
      `add-date-${rowKey}-${field}`;
    export const emptyRow = (key: string, date: string, name?: string): DateRow => ({
      key,
      date,
      kind: "closed",
      sameAs: date ? weekdayIndexOf(date) : 0,
      services: [],
      message: "",
      ...(name ? { name } : {}),
    });
    function hasOwnHours(config: AvailabilityConfig, date: string): boolean {
      return config.dateRules.some(
        (r) =>
          r.kind === "special_hours" &&
          r.seriesId == null &&
          r.startsOn <= date &&
          (r.endsOn ?? date) >= date &&
          (r.repeat == null || r.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    export function validateRows(
      form: AddDatesForm,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      today: string
    ): { readonly key: string; readonly field: RowField } | null {
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (const row of form.rows) {
        if (row.date === "") return { key: row.key, field: "dateMissing" };
        if (
          row.date < today ||
          seen.has(row.date) ||
          (row.kind !== "closed" && hasOwnHours(config, row.date))
        ) {
          return { key: row.key, field: "date" };
        }
        seen.add(row.date);
        // The closure command saves a rule against the venue's existing services only.
        const unknown = row.services.some((s) => s.venueServiceId === null);
        if (row.kind !== "closed" && (row.services.length === 0 || unknown)) {
          return { key: row.key, field: "hours" };
        }
        if (messageOf(form, row).length > GUEST_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH) {
          return { key: row.key, field: "message" };
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    export function ruleItems(
      form: AddDatesForm,
      today: string,
      idFor: (rowKey: string) => string
    ): { readonly rowKey: string; readonly rule: DateRule }[] {
      return form.rows.flatMap((row) => {
        const message = messageOf(form, row);
        const rule =
          row.kind === "closed"
            ? buildCloseRule(
                {
                  what: { kind: "venue" },
                  when: { kind: "date", date: row.date },
                  fromMinute: null,
                  staffNote: "",
                  guestMessage: message,
                },
                idFor(row.key),
                today
              )
            : hoursRule(row, idFor(row.key), message);
        return rule ? [{ rowKey: row.key, rule }] : [];
      });
    }
    function hoursRule(row: DateRow, id: string, message: string): DateRule {
      const services: SpecialHoursService[] = row.services.map((s) => ({
        venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId!, // validateRows refuses a row with a new service
        opensAt: s.opensAt,
        lastSeatingAt: s.lastSeatingAt,
        closesAt: s.closesAt,
        seating: s.seating,
        bookingTypes: [...s.bookingTypes],
      }));
      return {
        id,
        kind: "special_hours",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: row.date,
        endsOn: row.date,
        payload: { version: 1, services },
        ...(message ? { guestMessage: message } : {}),
      };
    }
    export function regularServices(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      weekday: number,
      today: string
    ): DraftService[] {
      let date = today;
      while (weekdayIndexOf(date) !== weekday) date = addDays(date, 1);
      const regular = { ...config, dateRules: [] };
      const day = resolveDay({ timezone, config: regular }, date);
      return seedServices(regular, day, { kind: "date", date });
    }
    export function combineImpacts(impacts: readonly ClosureImpact[]): ClosureImpact {
      const sum = (pick: (i: ClosureImpact) => number) =>
        impacts.reduce((total, i) => total + pick(i), 0);
      return {
        reservations: sum((i) => i.reservations),
        covers: sum((i) => i.covers),
        depositsHeld: sum((i) => i.depositsHeld),
        groups: impacts
          .flatMap((i) => i.groups)
          .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.groupKey.localeCompare(b.groupKey)),
      };
    }
    export function decisionsFor(
      impacts: readonly ClosureImpact[],
      choices: ChoiceMap
    ): ClosureDecision[][] {
      return impacts.map((impact) => toDecisions(impact.groups, choices));
    }
    export function saveLabelParts(
      dates: number,
      counts: OutcomeCounts
    ): { dates: number; parts: { action: ClosureAction; count: number }[] } {
      const actions = ["cancel", "move", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"] as const;
      return {
        dates,
        parts: actions
          .filter((a) => counts[a] > 0)
          .map((action) => ({ action, count: counts[action] })),
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/also-apply.ts">
    export interface AlsoApplyTarget {
      readonly scheduleId: string;
      readonly scheduleName: string;
    }
    export interface AlsoApplyOption {
      readonly venueServiceId: string;
      readonly serviceName: string;
      readonly targets: readonly AlsoApplyTarget[];
    }
    export type AlsoApplyPicks = Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>;
    function changedSourceRows(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      edit: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      sourceScheduleId: string
    ): ScheduleService[] {
      const stored = new Map(config.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      return (edit.upsert.scheduleServices ?? []).filter((row) => {
        const was = stored.get(row.id);
        return (
          row.scheduleId === sourceScheduleId &&
          was !== undefined &&
          was.scheduleId === sourceScheduleId &&
          timesOf(was) !== timesOf(row)
        );
      });
    }
    export function alsoApplyOptions(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      edit: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      sourceScheduleId: string,
      serviceDate: string
    ): AlsoApplyOption[] {
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((v) => [v.id, v.name]));
      return changedSourceRows(config, edit, sourceScheduleId).flatMap((row) => {
        const targets = compareRows(config, row.venueServiceId, serviceDate)
          .filter((r) => r.scheduleId !== sourceScheduleId)
          .map((r) => ({ scheduleId: r.scheduleId, scheduleName: r.scheduleName }));
        return targets.length === 0
          ? []
          : [
              {
                venueServiceId: row.venueServiceId,
                serviceName: names.get(row.venueServiceId) ?? row.venueServiceId,
                targets,
              },
            ];
      });
    }
    export function pruneAlsoApply(
      options: readonly AlsoApplyOption[],
      picks: AlsoApplyPicks
    ): AlsoApplyPicks {
      return Object.fromEntries(
        options.flatMap((o) => {
          const offered = new Set(o.targets.map((t) => t.scheduleId));
          const kept = (picks[o.venueServiceId] ?? []).filter((id) => offered.has(id));
          return kept.length > 0 ? [[o.venueServiceId, kept] as const] : [];
        })
      );
    }
    export function alsoApplyScheduleIds(
      options: readonly AlsoApplyOption[],
      picks: AlsoApplyPicks
    ): string[] {
      return [...new Set(Object.values(pruneAlsoApply(options, picks)).flat())];
    }
    export function buildAlsoApplyChanges(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      edit: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      sourceScheduleId: string,
      picks: AlsoApplyPicks,
      serviceDate: string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const options = alsoApplyOptions(config, edit, sourceScheduleId, serviceDate);
      const wanted = pruneAlsoApply(options, picks);
      const stored = new Map(config.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      const source = new Map(
        changedSourceRows(config, edit, sourceScheduleId).map((r) => [r.venueServiceId, r])
      );
      const extra = Object.entries(wanted).flatMap(([venueServiceId, scheduleIds]) => {
        const to = source.get(venueServiceId);
        const was = to ? stored.get(to.id) : undefined;
        if (!to || !was) return [];
        const moved = Object.fromEntries(
          TIME_FIELDS.filter((f) => to[f] !== was[f]).map((f) => [f, to[f]])
        );
        return config.scheduleServices
          .filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === venueServiceId && scheduleIds.includes(s.scheduleId))
          .map((s) => ({ ...s, ...moved }));
      });
      if (extra.length === 0) return edit;
      return {
        ...edit,
        upsert: {
          ...edit.upsert,
          scheduleServices: [...(edit.upsert.scheduleServices ?? []), ...extra],
        },
      };
    }
    export function alsoApplyChangedSince(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      after: AvailabilityConfig,
      picks: AlsoApplyPicks
    ): { changed: string[]; removed: string[] } {
      const rowOf = (config: AvailabilityConfig, vs: string, scheduleId: string) =>
        config.scheduleServices.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === vs && s.scheduleId === scheduleId);
      const live = (config: AvailabilityConfig, scheduleId: string) =>
        config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId && !s.archivedAt);
      const changed: string[] = [];
      const removed: string[] = [];
      for (const [vs, scheduleIds] of Object.entries(picks)) {
        for (const scheduleId of scheduleIds) {
          const was = rowOf(before, vs, scheduleId);
          const name = (live(before, scheduleId) ?? before.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId))
            ?.name;
          if (!was || name === undefined) continue;
          const now = rowOf(after, vs, scheduleId);
          if (!now || !live(after, scheduleId)) removed.push(name);
          else if (JSON.stringify(was) !== JSON.stringify(now)) changed.push(name);
        }
      }
      return { changed: [...new Set(changed)], removed: [...new Set(removed)] };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/availability-address.ts">
    export const isTodaysPage = (pathname: string): boolean =>
      pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "").toLowerCase() === TODAYS_PAGE;
    export type CloseTarget =
      | { readonly kind: "venue" }
      | { readonly kind: "tonight" }
      | { readonly kind: "date"; readonly date: string }
      | { readonly kind: "range"; readonly from: string; readonly to: string }
      | { readonly kind: "dates"; readonly dates: readonly string[] }
      | { readonly kind: "section"; readonly sectionId: string };
    type AvailabilityView =
      | { readonly view: "hub" }
      | { readonly view: "hours"; readonly service?: string }
      | { readonly view: "seasonal"; readonly screen?: "new" | "compare" }
      | { readonly view: "seasonal"; readonly screen: "edit"; readonly scheduleId: string }
      | { readonly view: "specialDates" }
      | { readonly view: "closures" }
      | {
          readonly view: "calendar";
          readonly calendarView?: "month" | "week";
          readonly date?: string;
        }
      | { readonly view: "bookingRules" }
      | { readonly view: "history" };
    export type AvailabilityTarget = AvailabilityView & {
      readonly close?: CloseTarget;
      readonly pause?: boolean;
      readonly from?: "setup";
    };
    export const AVAILABILITY_TABS = ["calendar", "special", "schedules"] as const;
    export type AvailabilityTab = (typeof AVAILABILITY_TABS)[number];
    export interface AvailabilityEntry {
      readonly tab?: AvailabilityTab;
      readonly closeSection?: string;
      /** Opens the schedule editor on Schedules, seeded from the regular week (Add a schedule…). */
      readonly action?: "addSchedule";
      /** Opens that day's drawer on the calendar (`YYYY-MM-DD`, a real day). */
      readonly date?: string;
      readonly from?: "setup";
    }
    export function parseAvailabilityEntry(search: string | URLSearchParams): AvailabilityEntry {
      const params = typeof search === "string" ? new URLSearchParams(search) : search;
      const tab = params.get("tab");
      const closeSection = params.get("closeSection");
      const date = params.get("date");
      return {
        ...(isTab(tab) && { tab }),
        ...(closeSection && { closeSection }),
        ...(params.get("action") === "addSchedule" && { action: "addSchedule" as const }),
        ...(date !== null && isDate(date) && { date }),
        ...(params.get("from") === "setup" && { from: "setup" as const }),
      };
    }
    export const readHoursService = (location: { readonly search: string }): string | null =>
      new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("service") || null;
    export const isBookingRulesPage = (pathname: string): boolean =>
      pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "").toLowerCase() === BOOKING_RULES;
    export const isHistoryPage = (pathname: string): boolean =>
      pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "").toLowerCase() === HISTORY;
    function closeParam(target: CloseTarget): string {
      switch (target.kind) {
        case "venue":
        case "tonight":
          return target.kind;
        case "date":
          return target.date;
        case "range":
          return `${target.from}${RANGE_SEPARATOR}${target.to}`;
        case "dates":
          return `${DATES_PREFIX}${target.dates.join(",")}`;
        case "section":
          return `${SECTION_PREFIX}${target.sectionId}`;
      }
    }
    type DialogRequest = { readonly close: CloseTarget } | { readonly pause: true } | null;
    function setDialog(params: URLSearchParams, dialog: DialogRequest): void {
      params.delete("close");
      params.delete("pause");
      if (dialog && "close" in dialog) params.set("close", closeParam(dialog.close));
      else if (dialog) params.set("pause", "1");
    }
    function setOverlay(params: URLSearchParams, target: AvailabilityTarget): void {
      setDialog(params, target.close ? { close: target.close } : target.pause ? { pause: true } : null);
      if (target.from) params.set("from", target.from);
    }
    export function availabilityPath(target: AvailabilityTarget): string {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      const ownPath = OWN_PATHS[target.view];
      if (ownPath) {
        if (target.view === "hours" && target.service) params.set("service", target.service);
        setOverlay(params, target);
        return withSearch(ownPath, params);
      }
      // A date names the calendar by itself (today's page opens Calendar for it), so it needs no tab.
      const date =
        target.view === "calendar" && target.date && isDate(target.date) ? target.date : null;
      const tab = PAGE_TAB[target.view];
      if (tab && !date) params.set("tab", tab);
      if (target.view === "seasonal" && target.screen === "new") params.set("action", "addSchedule");
      if (date) params.set("date", date);
      setOverlay(params, target);
      return withSearch(TODAYS_PAGE, params);
    }
    export function dialogSearch(search: string, dialog: DialogRequest): string {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(search);
      setDialog(params, dialog);
      const query = queryOf(params);
      return query ? `?${query}` : "";
    }
    function parseDates(listed: readonly string[]): CloseTarget | null {
      if (listed.length > MAX_CLOSE_DATES || !listed.every(isDate)) return null;
      const dates = [...new Set(listed)].sort();
      return dates.length === 1 ? { kind: "date", date: dates[0]! } : { kind: "dates", dates };
    }
    function parseRange(value: string): CloseTarget | null {
      const [from, to, ...rest] = value.split(RANGE_SEPARATOR);
      if (from === undefined || to === undefined || rest.length > 0) return null;
      if (!isDate(from) || !isDate(to) || from > to) return null;
      return from === to ? { kind: "date", date: from } : { kind: "range", from, to };
    }
    function parseCloseTarget(value: string | null): CloseTarget | null {
      if (!value) return null;
      if (value === "venue" || value === "tonight") return { kind: value };
      if (isDate(value)) return { kind: "date", date: value };
      if (value.startsWith(SECTION_PREFIX)) {
        const sectionId = value.slice(SECTION_PREFIX.length);
        return sectionId ? { kind: "section", sectionId } : null;
      }
      if (value.startsWith(DATES_PREFIX))
        return parseDates(value.slice(DATES_PREFIX.length).split(","));
      return parseRange(value);
    }
    export interface AvailabilityAddress {
      /** `null` when there is no close target, or it does not parse: no dialog. */
      readonly close: CloseTarget | null;
      readonly pause: boolean;
      readonly from: "setup" | null;
    }
    export function readAvailabilityAddress(location: {
      readonly search: string;
    }): AvailabilityAddress {
      const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      return {
        close: parseCloseTarget(params.get("close")),
        pause: params.get("pause") === "1",
        from: params.get("from") === "setup" ? "setup" : null,
      };
    }
    export function legacyRedirect(search: string): string | null {
      const entry = parseAvailabilityEntry(search);
      if (!entry.tab && !entry.action && !entry.closeSection) return null;
      const view: AvailabilityView = entry.action
        ? { view: "seasonal", screen: "new" }
        : entry.tab
          ? TAB_VIEW[entry.tab]
          : { view: "hub" };
      return availabilityPath({
        ...view,
        ...(entry.closeSection && {
          close: { kind: "section" as const, sectionId: entry.closeSection },
        }),
        ...(entry.from && { from: entry.from }),
      });
    }

    export interface BookingRulesForm {
      readonly daysAhead: string;
      readonly noticeHours: string;
      readonly largestParty: string;
    }
    export type BookingRulesField = keyof BookingRulesForm;
    export const UNSET_LARGEST_PARTY = 8;
    export function toBookingRulesForm(settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined): BookingRulesForm {
      return {
        daysAhead: text(settings?.maxAdvanceBooking),
        noticeHours: text(settings?.minAdvanceBooking),
        largestParty: text(settings?.maxPartySize),
      };
    }
    export function invalidBookingRules(form: BookingRulesForm): readonly BookingRulesField[] {
      return (Object.keys(LIMITS) as BookingRulesField[]).filter((field) => {
        const raw = form[field].trim();
        if (raw === "") return false;
        const n = Number(raw);
        const { min, max } = LIMITS[field];
        return !Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max;
      });
    }
    export function withBookingRules(
      settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined,
      form: BookingRulesForm
    ): VenueSettings {
      const {
        maxAdvanceBooking: _a,
        minAdvanceBooking: _b,
        maxPartySize: _c,
        ...rest
      } = settings ?? {};
      const set = (key: string, raw: string) => (raw.trim() === "" ? {} : { [key]: Number(raw) });
      return {
        ...rest,
        ...set("maxAdvanceBooking", form.daysAhead),
        ...set("minAdvanceBooking", form.noticeHours),
        ...set("maxPartySize", form.largestParty),
      };
    }
    export interface BookingRulesValues {
      readonly daysAhead: number | null;
      readonly noticeHours: number | null;
      readonly largestParty: number | null;
    }
    export function bookingRulesText(rules: BookingRulesValues, t: TFunction): string {
      return [
        rules.daysAhead !== null && t("setup.hub.rules.daysAhead", { count: rules.daysAhead }),
        rules.noticeHours !== null && t("setup.hub.rules.noticeHours", { count: rules.noticeHours }),
        rules.largestParty !== null && t("setup.hub.rules.largestParty", { count: rules.largestParty }),
      ]
        .filter((part): part is string => part !== false)
        .join(" · ");
    }
    export function bookingRulesOf(settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined): BookingRulesValues {
      const num = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === "number" ? value : null);
      return {
        daysAhead: num(settings?.maxAdvanceBooking),
        noticeHours: num(settings?.minAdvanceBooking),
        largestParty: num(settings?.maxPartySize),
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/calendar-dates.ts">
    export type CalendarView = "month" | "week";
    export const WEEK_STARTS_ON = 1;
    function daysSinceMonday(date: string): number {
      return (weekdayIndexOf(date) + 6) % 7;
    }
    function daysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
      return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
    }
    export function visibleDates(view: CalendarView, anchor: string): string[] {
      const first = view === "week" ? anchor : `${anchor.slice(0, 8)}01`;
      const start = addDays(first, -daysSinceMonday(first));
      let end =
        view === "week"
          ? anchor
          : `${anchor.slice(0, 8)}${daysInMonth(Number(anchor.slice(0, 4)), Number(anchor.slice(5, 7)))}`;
      end = addDays(end, 6 - daysSinceMonday(end));
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = start; d <= end; d = addDays(d, 1)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function shiftAnchor(view: CalendarView, anchor: string, direction: 1 | -1): string {
      if (view === "week") return addDays(anchor, 7 * direction);
      const monthIndex = Number(anchor.slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(anchor.slice(5, 7)) - 1 + direction;
      const year = Math.floor(monthIndex / 12);
      const month = (monthIndex % 12) + 1;
      const day = Math.min(Number(anchor.slice(8, 10)), daysInMonth(year, month));
      return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/change-summary-text.ts">
    type Change = Parameters<typeof describeChange>[0];
    function tonightText(detail: AvailabilityChangeDetail, t: TFunction): string | null {
      switch (detail.code) {
        case "tonight_pause_online":
          return t("availability.history.summary.tonightPauseOnline");
        case "tonight_close_early":
          return t("availability.history.summary.tonightCloseEarly");
        case "tonight_stop_window":
          return t("availability.history.summary.tonightStopWindow");
        case "tonight_ended":
          return t("availability.history.summary.tonightEnded");
        case "tonight_block_tables":
          return isCount(detail.tables)
            ? t("availability.history.summary.tonightBlockTables", { count: detail.tables })
            : null;
        case "tonight_pacing":
          return isCount(detail.covers)
            ? t("availability.history.summary.tonightPacing", { count: detail.covers })
            : null;
        default:
          return null;
      }
    }
    function closureText(
      detail: AvailabilityChangeDetail,
      format: VenueFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ): string | null {
      const { code, startsOn, cancelled, moved, kept } = detail;
      if (!CLOSURE_CODES.has(code) || !startsOn) return null;
      const when = whenOf(startsOn, detail.endsOn, format, t);
      if (detail.code === "closure_reopened") {
        return when ? t("availability.history.entry.reopened", { when }) : null;
      }
      if (!isCount(cancelled) || !isCount(moved) || !isCount(kept)) return null;
      return t(
        detail.code === "close_early_saved"
          ? "availability.history.entry.closedEarly"
          : "availability.history.entry.closed",
        { when, outcome: outcomeText({ cancelled, moved, kept }, format, t) }
      );
    }
    function regularWeekText(
      detail: AvailabilityChangeDetail,
      format: VenueFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ): string | null {
      const { startsOn, weekdays } = detail;
      if (!startsOn || !weekdays || weekdays.length === 0) return null;
      const days = weekdaySummary(weekdays, format, t);
      return t("availability.history.summary.regularWeekChanged", {
        from: format.formatCalendarDate(startsOn, { month: "short", day: "numeric" }),
        days,
      });
    }
    function detailText(
      detail: AvailabilityChangeDetail,
      format: VenueFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ): string | null {
      const { added, changed, removed } = detail;
      const text =
        detail.code === "config_saved"
          ? isCount(added) && isCount(changed) && isCount(removed)
            ? t("availability.history.summary.configSaved", { added, changed, removed })
            : null
          : detail.code === "regular_week_changed"
            ? regularWeekText(detail, format, t)
            : detail.code.startsWith("tonight_")
              ? tonightText(detail, t)
              : closureText(detail, format, t);
      return text !== null && detail.reverted
        ? t("availability.history.summary.reverted", { summary: text })
        : text;
    }
    export function changeSummaryText(change: Change, format: VenueFormat, t: TFunction): string {
      const coded = change.detail ? detailText(change.detail, format, t) : null;
      return coded ?? describeChange(change, format, t) ?? change.summary;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/change-week-draft.ts">
    function serviceKey(service: ServiceDraft) {
      const keptKey = (times: DraftTimes) => (times.kept ? optionsKey(times.kept) : null);
      return JSON.stringify([
        nameKey(service),
        service.opens,
        service.lastSeating,
        service.closes,
        sorted(service.days),
        service.blocks.map((b) => [sorted(b.days), b.opens, b.lastSeating, b.closes, keptKey(b)]),
        keptKey(service),
      ]);
    }
    export function weekKey(draft: QuickSetupDraft): string {
      return JSON.stringify([sorted(draft.days), draft.services.map(serviceKey)]);
    }
    function daySignatures(draft: QuickSetupDraft): string[] {
      let n = 0;
      const config = draftToConfig(draft, () => `edit-${++n}`);
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((v) => [v.id, v.name.trim().toLowerCase()]));
      const week = decodeWeek(config.scheduleServices, coveredDays(draft));
      return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, day) =>
        JSON.stringify(
          week
            .flatMap((service) => {
              const hours = service.days[day];
              return hours
                ? [
                    [
                      names.get(service.venueServiceId),
                      hours.opensAt,
                      hours.lastSeatingAt,
                      hours.closesAt,
                    ],
                  ]
                : [];
            })
            .sort()
        )
      );
    }
    export function editedWeekday(before: QuickSetupDraft, after: QuickSetupDraft): number | null {
      const was = daySignatures(before);
      const now = daySignatures(after);
      return WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER.find((day) => was[day] !== now[day]) ?? null;
    }
    interface ReapplyInput {
      /** The week the draft was opened on. */
      readonly base: QuickSetupDraft;
      /** The week as the Manager has it now. */
      readonly draft: QuickSetupDraft;
      /** The regular week in the version that won. */
      readonly latest: QuickSetupDraft;
    }
    export function reapplyWeek({ base, draft, latest }: ReapplyInput): QuickSetupDraft {
      const baseBy = new Map(base.services.map((s) => [nameKey(s), s]));
      const draftBy = new Map(draft.services.map((s) => [nameKey(s), s]));
      const kept = latest.services.flatMap((row): ServiceDraft[] => {
        const was = baseBy.get(nameKey(row));
        const mine = draftBy.get(nameKey(row));
        if (was && !mine) return [];
        if (!was || !mine || serviceKey(was) === serviceKey(mine)) return [row];
        return [{ ...mine, id: row.id }];
      });
      const latestNames = new Set(latest.services.map(nameKey));
      const added = draft.services.filter(
        (s) => !baseBy.has(nameKey(s)) && !latestNames.has(nameKey(s))
      );
      const days =
        JSON.stringify(sorted(base.days)) === JSON.stringify(sorted(draft.days))
          ? latest.days
          : draft.days;
      return { days, services: [...kept, ...added] };
    }
    export interface OutsideSchedule {
      readonly name: string;
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
    }
    export function outsideSchedules(config: AvailabilityConfig): OutsideSchedule[] {
      return config.schedules
        .filter((s) => !s.archivedAt && s.kind !== "regular")
        .flatMap((s) => {
          const days = new Set(
            config.assignments
              .filter((a) => a.scheduleId === s.id && a.startsOn == null && a.endsOn == null)
              .flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)
          );
          return days.size > 0 ? [{ name: s.name, weekdays: [...days].sort((a, b) => a - b) }] : [];
        });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/clock-minutes.ts">
    export function toClock(minute: number): string {
      const wrapped = minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }
    export function openFromClock(clock: string): number {
      const [hh = "0", mm = "0"] = clock.split(":");
      return Number(hh) * 60 + Number(mm);
    }
    export function closeFromClock(clock: string, opensAt: number): number {
      const minute = openFromClock(clock);
      return minute <= opensAt ? minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY : minute;
    }
    export function lastSeatingFromClock(clock: string, opensAt: number): number {
      const minute = openFromClock(clock);
      return minute < opensAt ? minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY : minute;
    }

    export interface CloseDialogStart {
      readonly initialDate: string | null;
      readonly initialDates?: readonly string[];
      readonly initialRange?: { readonly from: string; readonly to: string };
      readonly initialSectionId?: string;
      readonly startTonight?: boolean;
    }
    export function closeDialogStart(target: CloseTarget): CloseDialogStart {
      switch (target.kind) {
        case "venue":
          return { initialDate: null };
        case "tonight":
          return { initialDate: null, startTonight: true };
        case "date":
          return { initialDate: target.date };
        case "range":
          return { initialDate: null, initialRange: { from: target.from, to: target.to } };
        case "dates":
          return { initialDate: null, initialDates: target.dates };
        case "section":
          return { initialDate: null, initialSectionId: target.sectionId };
      }
    }
    export function closeTargetForDates(dates: readonly string[]): CloseTarget {
      return dates.length === 1 ? { kind: "date", date: dates[0]! } : { kind: "dates", dates };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/close-draft.ts">
    export type BookingChannel = "online" | "phone" | "waitlist";
    export type CloseWhat =
      | { readonly kind: "venue" }
      | { readonly kind: "service"; readonly serviceId: string }
      /** One floor-plan section: its tables as they are when the closure is saved, and then as they move (ADR-032). */
      | { readonly kind: "section"; readonly sectionId: string }
      | { readonly kind: "booking"; readonly types: readonly BookingChannel[] };
    export type CloseWhen =
      | { readonly kind: "tonight" }
      | { readonly kind: "date"; readonly date: string }
      /** Several picked dates, ascending: stored as one single-date closure each (#7981). */
      | { readonly kind: "dates"; readonly dates: readonly string[] }
      | { readonly kind: "range"; readonly from: string; readonly to: string }
      | {
          readonly kind: "repeats";
          readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
          readonly from: string;
          readonly to: string;
        }
      | { readonly kind: "until-reopen"; readonly from: string };
    export interface CloseForm {
      readonly what: CloseWhat;
      readonly when: CloseWhen;
      /** Minute of the service day the closure starts; `null` closes all day. */
      readonly fromMinute: number | null;
      readonly staffNote: string;
      readonly guestMessage: string;
    }
    export type CloseField = "what" | "when" | "guestMessage";
    export interface GroupChoice {
      readonly action?: ClosureAction;
      readonly acknowledged: boolean;
    }
    export type ChoiceMap = Readonly<Record<string, GroupChoice>>;
    export type OutcomeCounts = Readonly<Record<ClosureAction, number>>;
    interface Span {
      readonly startsOn: string;
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      readonly weekdays?: readonly number[];
    }
    function spanOf(when: CloseWhen, today: string): Span {
      switch (when.kind) {
        case "tonight":
          return { startsOn: today, endsOn: today };
        case "date":
          return { startsOn: when.date, endsOn: when.date };
        case "dates":
          return { startsOn: when.dates[0] ?? "", endsOn: when.dates.at(-1) ?? "" };
        case "range":
          return { startsOn: when.from, endsOn: when.to };
        case "repeats":
          return { startsOn: when.from, endsOn: when.to, weekdays: when.weekdays };
        case "until-reopen":
          return { startsOn: when.from, endsOn: null };
      }
    }
    function whatIsComplete(what: CloseWhat): boolean {
      if (what.kind === "service") return what.serviceId !== "";
      if (what.kind === "section") return what.sectionId !== "";
      if (what.kind === "booking") return what.types.length > 0;
      return true;
    }
    function whenIsComplete(when: CloseWhen, today: string): boolean {
      if (when.kind === "dates") return when.dates.length <= MAX_CLOSURE_BATCH && when.dates.length > 0;
      const span = spanOf(when, today);
      if (span.startsOn === "") return false;
      if (span.endsOn !== null && (span.endsOn === "" || span.endsOn < span.startsOn)) return false;
      // A repeat with no day picked, or none in its range, would save and close nothing.
      return guestDateOf(when, today) !== null;
    }
    export function validateClose(form: CloseForm, today: string): CloseField | null {
      if (!whatIsComplete(form.what)) return "what";
      if (!whenIsComplete(form.when, today)) return "when";
      if (form.guestMessage.trim().length > GUEST_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH) return "guestMessage";
      return null;
    }
    export const closeFieldId = (field: CloseField) => `close-field-${field}`;
    export const closeWhenId = (when: CloseWhen, days: boolean) =>
      (when.kind === "repeats" && when.from !== "" && when.to >= when.from) === days
        ? closeFieldId("when")
        : undefined;
    export function focusCloseField(field: CloseField) {
      const target = document.getElementById(closeFieldId(field));
      (target?.querySelector("input") ?? target)?.focus();
    }
    export const stepTwoNoteId = "close-step-two-note";
    export function stepTwoNote(ready: boolean, t: TFunction): string {
      const irreversible = t("availability.close.step2.irreversible");
      return ready ? irreversible : `${t("availability.close.step2.blocked")} ${irreversible}`;
    }
    function targetOf(what: CloseWhat) {
      switch (what.kind) {
        case "venue":
          return { targetKind: "venue" as const };
        case "service":
          return { targetKind: "service" as const, venueServiceId: what.serviceId };
        case "section":
          return { targetKind: "tables" as const, sectionId: what.sectionId, tableIds: [] };
        case "booking":
          return { targetKind: "booking" as const, bookingTypes: [...what.types] };
      }
    }
    type SectionMembership = ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>;
    export function buildCloseRule(
      form: CloseForm,
      id: string,
      today: string,
      membership: SectionMembership = new Map()
    ): DateRule | null {
      if (validateClose(form, today) !== null || form.when.kind === "dates") return null;
      const span = spanOf(form.when, today);
      const note = form.staffNote.trim();
      const message = form.guestMessage.trim();
      const rule: DateRule = {
        id,
        kind: "closure",
        ...targetOf(form.what),
        startsOn: span.startsOn,
        endsOn: span.endsOn,
        ...(span.weekdays ? { repeat: { version: 1 as const, weekdays: [...span.weekdays] } } : {}),
        window:
          form.fromMinute === null
            ? null
            : { version: 1 as const, from: form.fromMinute, to: END_OF_SERVICE_DAY },
        ...(note ? { staffNote: note } : {}),
        ...(message ? { guestMessage: message } : {}),
      };
      return expandSectionRules([rule], membership)[0] ?? null;
    }
    export function buildCloseRules(
      form: CloseForm,
      idFor: (date: string) => string,
      today: string,
      membership: SectionMembership = new Map()
    ): readonly DateRule[] {
      if (form.when.kind !== "dates") {
        const rule = buildCloseRule(form, idFor(firstDateOf(form.when, today)), today, membership);
        return rule ? [rule] : [];
      }
      return form.when.dates.flatMap((date) => {
        const rule = buildCloseRule(
          { ...form, when: { kind: "date", date } },
          idFor(date),
          today,
          membership
        );
        return rule ? [rule] : [];
      });
    }
    export function toggleDate(dates: readonly string[], date: string): readonly string[] {
      return dates.includes(date) ? dates.filter((d) => d !== date) : [...dates, date].sort();
    }
    type ClosureSpan = Pick<DateRule, "startsOn" | "endsOn" | "repeat">;
    export function firstDateOf(when: CloseWhen, today: string): string {
      return spanOf(when, today).startsOn;
    }
    export function guestDateOf(when: CloseWhen, today: string): string | null {
      const { startsOn, endsOn, weekdays } = spanOf(when, today);
      if (!weekdays || !startsOn) return startsOn;
      const repeat = { version: 1 as const, weekdays: [...weekdays] };
      return firstOccurrenceOnOrAfter({ startsOn, endsOn, repeat }, startsOn);
    }
    export function closedDates(closure: ClosureSpan): readonly string[] {
      const first = firstOccurrenceOnOrAfter(closure, closure.startsOn);
      if (first === null) return [];
      const last = closure.endsOn ?? addDays(first, CLOSED_DATES_SCAN_DAYS);
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let date = first, n = 0; date <= last && n <= CLOSED_DATES_SCAN_DAYS; n += 1) {
        if (closure.repeat == null || closure.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date))) {
          dates.push(date);
        }
        date = addDays(date, 1);
      }
      return dates;
    }
    export function replacedSpecialDate(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      closure: ClosureSpan
    ): string | null {
      const replaced = closedDates(closure).find((date) =>
        activeRules(rules, date).some((r) => r.kind === "special_hours")
      );
      return replaced ?? null;
    }
    function distinctDays(config: AvailabilityConfig, dates: readonly string[]): readonly string[] {
      const kinds = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const date of dates) {
        const season = config.assignments.filter(
          (a) => (a.startsOn ?? date) <= date && date <= (a.endsOn ?? date)
        );
        const ids = [...season, ...activeRules(config.dateRules, date)].map((row) => row.id);
        kinds.set(`${weekdayIndexOf(date)}:${ids.join()}`, date);
      }
      return [...kinds.values()];
    }
    function servicesOn(config: AvailabilityConfig, timezone: string, dates: readonly string[]) {
      return distinctDays(config, dates).flatMap(
        (date) => resolveDay({ timezone, config }, date).services
      );
    }
    export function startMinutes(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      dates: readonly string[],
      keep: number | null,
      nowMinute?: number
    ): readonly number[] {
      const services = servicesOn(config, timezone, dates);
      const hasHours = services.length > 0;
      const firstOpen = services.reduce((min, s) => Math.min(min, s.opensAt), MINUTES_PER_DAY);
      const opening = hasHours ? floorToHalfHour(firstOpen) : 0;
      const afterNow = nowMinute === undefined ? 0 : floorToHalfHour(nowMinute) + HALF_HOUR;
      // Starting at the close itself closes nothing, so the last option is the half hour before it.
      const stop = Math.min(hasHours ? lastCloseOf(services) : MINUTES_PER_DAY, END_OF_SERVICE_DAY);
      const options: number[] = [];
      for (let m = Math.max(opening, afterNow); m < stop; m += HALF_HOUR) {
        options.push(m);
      }
      return keep !== null && !options.includes(keep)
        ? [...options, keep].sort((a, b) => a - b)
        : options;
    }
    function overnightFloor(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      dates: readonly string[]
    ): number {
      const services = servicesOn(config, timezone, dates);
      if (lastCloseOf(services) <= MINUTES_PER_DAY) return 0;
      return floorToHalfHour(services.reduce((min, s) => Math.min(min, s.opensAt), MINUTES_PER_DAY));
    }
    export function settleStartMinute(
      prev: CloseForm,
      next: CloseForm,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      today: string
    ): CloseForm {
      if (next.when === prev.when || next.fromMinute === null) return next;
      if (!whenIsComplete(next.when, today)) return next;
      const { startsOn, endsOn, weekdays } = spanOf(next.when, today);
      const repeat = weekdays ? { version: 1 as const, weekdays: [...weekdays] } : null;
      const dates =
        next.when.kind === "dates" ? next.when.dates : closedDates({ startsOn, endsOn, repeat });
      return next.fromMinute < overnightFloor(config, timezone, dates)
        ? { ...next, fromMinute: null }
        : next;
    }
    export function willHaveStepTwo(
      groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[],
      givenBack: ClosureImpact["givenBack"]
    ): boolean {
      return groups.length > 0 || Boolean(givenBack);
    }
    function whatOf(series: DateRule): CloseWhat {
      if (series.targetKind === "service" && series.venueServiceId) {
        return { kind: "service", serviceId: series.venueServiceId };
      }
      if (series.targetKind === "tables" && series.sectionId) {
        return { kind: "section", sectionId: series.sectionId };
      }
      if (series.targetKind === "booking" && series.bookingTypes?.length) {
        return { kind: "booking", types: [...series.bookingTypes] };
      }
      return { kind: "venue" };
    }
    export function isEditableClosure(rule: DateRule): boolean {
      return (
        rule.kind === "closure" &&
        rule.repeat == null &&
        rule.seriesId == null &&
        (rule.targetKind === "venue" ||
          (rule.targetKind === "service" && !!rule.venueServiceId) ||
          (rule.targetKind === "tables" && !!rule.sectionId) ||
          (rule.targetKind === "booking" && !!rule.bookingTypes?.length)) &&
        (rule.window == null || rule.window.to === END_OF_SERVICE_DAY)
      );
    }
    export function closureForm(rule: DateRule): CloseForm {
      const when: CloseWhen =
        rule.endsOn == null
          ? { kind: "until-reopen", from: rule.startsOn }
          : rule.endsOn === rule.startsOn
            ? { kind: "date", date: rule.startsOn }
            : { kind: "range", from: rule.startsOn, to: rule.endsOn };
      return {
        what: whatOf(rule),
        when,
        fromMinute: rule.window?.from ?? null,
        staffNote: rule.staffNote ?? "",
        guestMessage: rule.guestMessage ?? "",
      };
    }
    export function editAlongside(rule: DateRule): ClosureAlongside {
      return { upsert: [], remove: [rule.id], replaces: rule };
    }
    export function seriesForm(series: DateRule, date: string): CloseForm {
      return {
        what: whatOf(series),
        when: { kind: "date", date },
        fromMinute: series.window?.from ?? null,
        staffNote: "",
        guestMessage: "",
      };
    }
    export function inSeries(rule: DateRule | null, series: DateRule | undefined): DateRule | null {
      if (!rule || !series) return rule;
      return { ...rule, seriesId: series.id, endsOn: rule.startsOn, repeat: null };
    }
    export function sameRequest(a: CloseForm, b: CloseForm): boolean {
      const key = (f: CloseForm) => JSON.stringify([f.what, f.when, f.fromMinute]);
      return key(a) === key(b);
    }
    export function actionsFor(kind: ClosureImpactKind): readonly ClosureAction[] {
      return kind === "shortened"
        ? ["cancel", "move", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"]
        : ["cancel", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"];
    }
    export function unmovable(group: ClosureImpactGroup): ClosureImpactReservation[] {
      return group.reservations.filter((r) => r.proposedStart === null);
    }
    export function decisionsReady(groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[], choices: ChoiceMap): boolean {
      return groups.every((g) => {
        const choice = choices[g.groupKey];
        if (choice?.action === "move" && unmovable(g).length > 0) return false;
        return choice?.action !== undefined && (choice.action !== "keep_silent" || choice.acknowledged);
      });
    }
    export function withoutChoicesFor(
      groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[],
      choices: ChoiceMap,
      reservationIds: readonly string[]
    ): ChoiceMap {
      const ids = new Set(reservationIds);
      const dropped = new Set(
        groups.filter((g) => g.reservations.some((r) => ids.has(r.id))).map((g) => g.groupKey)
      );
      return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(choices).filter(([key]) => !dropped.has(key)));
    }
    export function toDecisions(
      groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[],
      choices: ChoiceMap
    ): ClosureDecision[] {
      return groups.flatMap((g) => {
        const action = choices[g.groupKey]?.action;
        if (action === undefined) return [];
        const reservationIds = g.reservations.map((r) => r.id);
        return [
          action === "keep_silent"
            ? { groupKey: g.groupKey, action, acknowledged: true, reservationIds }
            : { groupKey: g.groupKey, action, reservationIds },
        ];
      });
    }
    export function outcomeCounts(
      groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[],
      choices: ChoiceMap
    ): OutcomeCounts {
      const counts: Record<ClosureAction, number> = {
        cancel: 0,
        move: 0,
        keep_notify: 0,
        keep_silent: 0,
      };
      for (const g of groups) {
        const action = choices[g.groupKey]?.action;
        if (action !== undefined) counts[action] += g.reservations.length;
      }
      return counts;
    }
    export function isUrgent(
      closure: {
        readonly startsOn: string;
        readonly endsOn?: string | null;
        readonly repeat?: { readonly weekdays: readonly number[] } | null;
        readonly fromMinute: number | null;
      },
      today: string,
      nowMinute: number
    ): boolean {
      const startsOn = firstOccurrenceOnOrAfter(closure, today);
      if (startsOn === null) return false;
      // Two or more days out is never within 6 hours, whatever the time now.
      if (startsOn > addDays(today, 1)) return false;
      const startMinute = (startsOn === today ? 0 : MINUTES_PER_DAY) + (closure.fromMinute ?? 0);
      return startMinute - nowMinute <= URGENT_WITHIN_MINUTES;
    }
    export function isPauseInForce(
      rule: DateRule,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      today: string,
      nowMinute: number
    ): boolean {
      if (!rule.window || rule.window.from <= nowMinute) return true;
      const yesterdayMinute = nowMinute + MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      if (
        rule.startsOn < today &&
        rule.window.from <= yesterdayMinute &&
        yesterdayMinute < lastCloseOf(resolveDay({ timezone, config }, addDays(today, -1)).services)
      ) {
        return true;
      }
      const isWindowedOnlineClosure = (r: DateRule) =>
        r.kind === "closure" &&
        r.targetKind === "booking" &&
        (r.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("online") &&
        r.window != null;
      const without = {
        ...config,
        dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => !isWindowedOnlineClosure(r)),
      };
      return (
        onlineSeatingLeft(without, timezone, today, nowMinute) &&
        !onlineSeatingLeft(config, timezone, today, nowMinute)
      );
    }
    export function shownOnlinePause(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      today: string,
      nowMinute: number
    ): DateRule | null {
      const pauses = config.dateRules.filter(
        (r) =>
          r.kind === "closure" &&
          r.targetKind === "booking" &&
          (r.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("online") &&
          r.startsOn <= today &&
          (r.endsOn === null || r.endsOn === undefined) &&
          !r.repeat
      );
      const earliest = [...pauses].sort((a, b) => (a.window?.from ?? 0) - (b.window?.from ?? 0))[0];
      return (
        pauses.find((r) => isPauseInForce(r, config, timezone, today, nowMinute)) ?? earliest ?? null
      );
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/close-text.ts">
    export interface CloseToastDraft {
      readonly form: CloseForm;
      /** The first date the closure covers (a repeat's From date may not be one of its days). */
      readonly date: string;
      /** How many closures were saved: more than one for Several dates. */
      readonly count: number;
      /** The chosen service's or section's name, when What is one. */
      readonly name: string | undefined;
    }
    function pausedChannels(types: readonly BookingChannel[], t: TFunction): string {
      const online = types.includes("online");
      const phone = types.includes("phone");
      const waitlist = types.includes("waitlist");
      if (online && phone && waitlist) return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.all");
      if (online && phone) return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.online_phone");
      if (online && waitlist) return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.online_waitlist");
      if (phone && waitlist) return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.phone_waitlist");
      if (phone) return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.phone");
      if (waitlist) return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.waitlist");
      return t("availability.close.toast.pausedChannels.online");
    }
    type CloseFormat = Pick<VenueFormat, "formatCalendarDate" | "formatLocalTime" | "locale">;
    function whenPhrase(
      when: CloseWhen,
      timed: boolean,
      firstDate: string,
      t: TFunction,
      format: CloseFormat
    ): string {
      const day = (date: string) => format.formatCalendarDate(date, SHORT_DATE);
      switch (when.kind) {
        case "tonight":
          return timed
            ? t("availability.close.toast.whenTimed.tonight")
            : t("availability.close.toast.when.date", { date: day(firstDate) });
        case "date":
        case "dates":
          return t("availability.close.toast.when.date", { date: day(firstDate) });
        case "range":
          return t(
            timed ? "availability.close.toast.whenTimed.range" : "availability.close.toast.when.range",
            { from: day(when.from), to: day(when.to) }
          );
        case "repeats": {
          const last =
            closedDates({
              startsOn: when.from,
              endsOn: when.to,
              repeat: { version: 1, weekdays: [...when.weekdays] },
            }).at(-1) ?? when.to;
          // One occurrence is a date, not a series.
          if (last === firstDate) return t("availability.close.toast.when.date", { date: day(last) });
          const [only, ...more] = when.weekdays;
          const days =
            only !== undefined && more.length === 0
              ? format.formatCalendarDate(addDays(SUNDAY, only), { weekday: "long" })
              : weekdaySummary(when.weekdays, format, t);
          return t("availability.close.toast.when.repeats", {
            days,
            from: day(firstDate),
            to: day(last),
          });
        }
        case "until-reopen":
          return t(
            timed
              ? "availability.close.toast.whenTimed.untilReopen"
              : "availability.close.toast.when.untilReopen",
            { date: day(when.from) }
          );
      }
    }
    export function closeIncompleteText(form: CloseForm, t: TFunction): string | null {
      const { when } = form;
      switch (when.kind) {
        case "tonight":
          return null;
        case "date":
          return when.date === "" ? t("availability.close.button.chooseDate") : null;
        case "dates":
          return when.dates.length === 0 ? t("availability.close.button.chooseDates") : null;
        case "until-reopen":
          return when.from === "" ? t("availability.close.button.chooseDate") : null;
        case "range":
          if (when.from === "") return t("availability.close.button.chooseDate");
          return when.to === "" || when.to < when.from
            ? t("availability.close.button.chooseEnd")
            : null;
        case "repeats": {
          if (when.from === "") return t("availability.close.button.chooseDate");
          const endMissing = when.to === "" || when.to < when.from;
          if (when.weekdays.length === 0) {
            return t(
              endMissing
                ? "availability.close.button.chooseDaysAndEnd"
                : "availability.close.button.chooseDays"
            );
          }
          if (endMissing) return t("availability.close.button.chooseEnd");
          // Days chosen, but none of them falls between From and To: nothing would close.
          return closedDates({
            startsOn: when.from,
            endsOn: when.to,
            repeat: { version: 1, weekdays: [...when.weekdays] },
          }).length === 0
            ? t("availability.close.button.chooseDays")
            : null;
        }
      }
    }
    export function closeButtonText(
      draft: { readonly form: CloseForm; readonly date: string; readonly name: string | undefined },
      t: TFunction,
      format: CloseFormat
    ): string {
      const { form, name } = draft;
      const incomplete = closeIncompleteText(form, t);
      if (incomplete !== null) return incomplete;
      const { when } = form;
      const tonight = when.kind === "tonight";
      const oneDay = tonight || when.kind === "date";
      const date = format.formatCalendarDate(draft.date, SHORT_DATE);
      if (form.fromMinute !== null) {
        const time = minuteText(form.fromMinute, t, format);
        if (oneDay) {
          if (name) {
            return tonight
              ? t("availability.close.button.closeTargetFromTonight", { target: name, time })
              : t("availability.close.button.closeTargetFrom", { target: name, time, date });
          }
          return tonight
            ? t("availability.close.button.closeFromTonight", { time })
            : t("availability.close.button.closeFrom", { time, date });
        }
        const phrase = whenPhrase(when, true, draft.date, t, format);
        return name
          ? t("availability.close.button.closeTargetFromWhen", { target: name, time, when: phrase })
          : t("availability.close.button.closeFromWhen", { time, when: phrase });
      }
      if (oneDay) {
        return name
          ? t("availability.close.button.closeTarget", { target: name, date })
          : t("availability.close.button.close", { date });
      }
      const phrase = whenPhrase(when, false, draft.date, t, format);
      return name
        ? t("availability.close.button.closeTargetWhen", { target: name, when: phrase })
        : t("availability.close.button.closeWhen", { when: phrase });
    }
    export type ToastOutcome = Readonly<
      Record<"cancel" | "move" | "keep_notify" | "keep_silent", number>
    >;
    export function closeToastText(
      draft: CloseToastDraft,
      outcome: ToastOutcome,
      t: TFunction,
      format: CloseFormat
    ): string {
      const { form, count, name } = draft;
      const { what, when } = form;
    
      const base = (): string => {
        if (when.kind === "dates") {
          if (what.kind === "booking")
            return t("availability.close.toast.manyBookingPaused", { count });
          return name
            ? t("availability.close.toast.serviceClosedMany", { name, count })
            : t("availability.close.toast.many", { count });
        }
        const timed = form.fromMinute !== null;
        const time = form.fromMinute === null ? "" : minuteText(form.fromMinute, t, format);
        const phrase = whenPhrase(when, timed, draft.date, t, format);
        if (what.kind === "booking") {
          // The pause entry's own sentence: online booking, until the Manager reopens it.
          if (
            !timed &&
            when.kind === "until-reopen" &&
            what.types.length === 1 &&
            what.types[0] === "online"
          ) {
            return t("availability.close.toast.paused");
          }
          const channels = pausedChannels(what.types, t);
          return timed
            ? t("availability.close.toast.bookingPausedFrom", { channels, time, when: phrase })
            : t("availability.close.toast.bookingPaused", { channels, when: phrase });
        }
        if (name) {
          return timed
            ? t("availability.close.toast.namedClosedFrom", { name, time, when: phrase })
            : t("availability.close.toast.namedClosed", { name, when: phrase });
        }
        return timed
          ? t("availability.close.toast.closedFrom", { time, when: phrase })
          : t("availability.close.toast.closed", { when: phrase });
      };
    
      const sentence = base();
      const outcomes = OUTCOME_ORDER.filter((key) => outcome[key] > 0)
        .map((key) => t(`availability.close.toast.outcome.${key}`, { count: outcome[key] }))
        .join(" · ");
      return outcomes === ""
        ? sentence
        : t("availability.close.toast.withOutcomes", { text: sentence, outcomes });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/closed-all-day.ts">
    export const closedAllDay = (day: ResolvedDay): boolean =>
      day.services.length === 0 &&
      day.explanation.some((layer) => layer.kind === "closure" && !layer.window);

  <file path="src/components/availability/closure-band.ts">
    type Closure = AvailabilityDaySummary["closures"][number];
    export interface ClosureBandText {
      readonly key: string;
      /** Visible text: "Closed 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM". */
      readonly text: string;
      /** Spoken in a cell's name: "closed 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM". */
      readonly name: string;
    }
    export function minuteText(
      minute: number,
      t: TFunction,
      format: Pick<VenueFormat, "formatLocalTime">
    ): string {
      const wrapped = minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      const time = format.formatLocalTime(`${hh}:${mm}`);
      return minute >= MINUTES_PER_DAY ? t("availability.calendar.nextDay", { time }) : time;
    }
    export function closureEndText(minute: number, t: TFunction, format: VenueFormat): string {
      return minute >= 2 * MINUTES_PER_DAY
        ? t("availability.calendar.untilClose")
        : minuteText(minute, t, format);
    }
    export function isWholeDay(closure: Pick<Closure, "from" | "to">): boolean {
      return closure.from === 0 && closure.to >= 2 * MINUTES_PER_DAY;
    }
    interface Copy {
      allDay: (t: TFunction) => readonly [text: string, name: string];
      band: (t: TFunction, v: { from: string; to: string }) => readonly [text: string, name: string];
    }
    type ChannelSuffix = "" | (typeof CHANNEL_SUFFIX)[keyof typeof CHANNEL_SUFFIX];
    function channelSuffix(closure: Closure): ChannelSuffix {
      const [only, ...rest] = closure.bookingTypes ?? [];
      return only && rest.length === 0 ? CHANNEL_SUFFIX[only] : "";
    }
    function bookingCopy(suffix: ChannelSuffix): Copy {
      return {
        allDay: (t) => [
          t(`availability.calendar.bookingOff${suffix}AllDay`),
          t(`availability.calendar.bookingOff${suffix}AllDayName`),
        ],
        band: (t, v) => [
          t(`availability.calendar.bookingOff${suffix}Band`, v),
          t(`availability.calendar.bookingOff${suffix}BandName`, v),
        ],
      };
    }
    function sectionCopy(name: string): Copy {
      return {
        allDay: (t) => [
          t("availability.calendar.sectionClosedAllDay", { section: name }),
          t("availability.calendar.sectionClosedAllDayName", { section: name }),
        ],
        band: (t, v) => [
          t("availability.calendar.sectionClosedBand", { section: name, ...v }),
          t("availability.calendar.sectionClosedBandName", { section: name, ...v }),
        ],
      };
    }
    export function closureBandText(
      closure: Closure,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat,
      sectionNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): ClosureBandText {
      const section =
        closure.targetKind === "tables" && closure.sectionId
          ? sectionNames?.get(closure.sectionId)
          : undefined;
      const copy =
        closure.targetKind === "booking"
          ? bookingCopy(channelSuffix(closure))
          : section !== undefined
            ? sectionCopy(section)
            : COPY[closure.targetKind];
      if (isWholeDay(closure)) {
        const [text, name] = copy.allDay(t);
        return { key: closure.ruleId, text, name };
      }
      const [text, name] = copy.band(t, {
        from: minuteText(closure.from, t, format),
        to: closureEndText(closure.to, t, format),
      });
      return { key: closure.ruleId, text, name };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/closure-overlap-text.ts">
    function targetText(by: ClosedByRule, services: readonly VenueService[], t: TFunction): string {
      switch (by.targetKind) {
        case "venue":
          return t("availability.close.what.venue");
        case "service":
          return (
            services.find((s) => s.id === by.venueServiceId)?.name ??
            t("availability.closureOverlap.service")
          );
        case "booking":
          return t("availability.closureOverlap.booking", {
            channels: (by.bookingTypes ?? [])
              .map((c) => t(`availability.close.what.channel.${c}`))
              .join(", "),
          });
        default:
          return t("availability.closureOverlap.tables");
      }
    }
    function spanText(by: ClosedByRule, t: TFunction, format: VenueFormat): string | null {
      const date = (d: string) => format.formatCalendarDate(d, DATE_FORMAT);
      const from = date(by.startsOn);
      const span =
        by.endsOn == null
          ? t("availabilitySpecial.untilReopened", { from })
          : by.endsOn === by.startsOn
            ? null
            : t("availabilitySpecial.range", { from, to: date(by.endsOn) });
      if (by.repeat == null) return span;
      const days = by.repeat.weekdays.map((d) =>
        format.formatCalendarDate(addDays(SUNDAY, d), { weekday: "long" })
      );
      return t("availabilitySpecial.reopen.subjectRepeat", {
        days: new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(days),
        span: span ?? from,
      });
    }
    function closureText(
      by: ClosedByRule,
      services: readonly VenueService[],
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const from = by.window
        ? t("availability.close.window.from", { time: minuteText(by.window.from, t, format) })
        : null;
      return [targetText(by, services, t), from, spanText(by, t, format)]
        .filter((part) => part !== null)
        .join(SEPARATOR);
    }
    function datesText(dates: readonly string[], t: TFunction, format: VenueFormat): string {
      const named = dates.slice(0, DATES_NAMED).map((d) => format.formatCalendarDate(d, DATE_FORMAT));
      const rest = dates.length - named.length;
      return rest === 0
        ? new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(named)
        : t("availability.closureOverlap.moreDates", { dates: named.join(", "), count: rest });
    }
    export function overlapLines(
      overlap: ClosureOverlap,
      kind: "already" | "stays",
      services: readonly VenueService[],
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): readonly string[] {
      return overlap.by.map((by) =>
        t(`availability.closureOverlap.${kind}`, {
          dates: datesText(by.dates, t, format),
          closure: closureText(by, services, t, format),
        })
      );
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/closures-list.ts">
    export type ClosureFacts = Pick<
      HubClosure,
      "target" | "startsOn" | "endsOn" | "weekdays" | "window"
    >;
    export interface SkippedDate {
      readonly skipId: string;
      readonly date: string;
    }
    export interface ClosureListRow extends ClosureFacts {
      readonly group: "now" | "upcoming";
      readonly ruleId: string;
      /**
       * In `now`, the service date it is in force on: today, or yesterday while that service runs past
       * midnight. In `upcoming`, the next date it closes; `null` when every date it has left is skipped
       * or replaced by a one-date edit.
       */
      readonly on: string | null;
      /** An online-only booking closure that does not repeat: it is resumed, not reopened. */
      readonly pause: boolean;
      /** Whether the Close form can say everything this closure says (`isEditableClosure`). */
      readonly editable: boolean;
      /** The series this row is a one-date edit of; `null` for a closure in its own right. */
      readonly seriesId: string | null;
      /** For a repeating closure in its own right: the dates skipped out of it, from today on. */
      readonly series: { readonly skipped: readonly SkippedDate[] } | null;
      /** `null` when the closure touched no booking, or while the counts are not known. */
      readonly outcomes: ClosureSummary | null;
      /** Refunds failed or still pending. */
      readonly refundsOpen: number;
    }
    export type EarlierReason = "ended" | "removed" | "tonight";
    export interface EarlierClosureRow {
      readonly group: "earlier";
      readonly ruleId: string;
      readonly reason: EarlierReason;
      /** What it closed and when, for `ended`; `null` for `removed` and `tonight`. */
      readonly closure: ClosureFacts | null;
      readonly outcomes: ClosureSummary;
      readonly refundsOpen: number;
    }
    export interface ClosuresList {
      /** A pause first, then the closure that started soonest. */
      readonly now: readonly ClosureListRow[];
      /** By the next date each closes, then the time of day it starts; one with no date left is last. */
      readonly upcoming: readonly ClosureListRow[];
      /** Ended closures, most recently ended first; then tonight changes and rules that are gone. */
      readonly earlier: readonly EarlierClosureRow[];
    }
    export interface ClosuresListInput extends ClosuresRowInput {
      /** Outcome counts per rule (`useClosureSummaries`); `null` while they load or after they fail. */
      readonly summaries: readonly ClosureSummary[] | null;
    }
    function factsOf(rule: ClosureRule, clock: Clock): ClosureFacts {
      return {
        target: targetOf(rule, clock),
        startsOn: rule.startsOn,
        endsOn: rule.endsOn ?? null,
        weekdays: rule.repeat?.weekdays ?? null,
        window: rule.window ? { from: rule.window.from, to: rule.window.to } : null,
      };
    }
    function forceDate(
      rule: ClosureRule,
      clock: Clock,
      hubPause: HubOnlinePause | null
    ): string | null {
      // A stop made for tonight (`source: "tonight"`) is no closure, so then none is the hub's pause.
      const namedByHub =
        hubPause?.source === "closure" && hubPause.inForce && hubPause.ruleId === rule.id;
      const partOfTodayLeft = rule.window == null || clock.nowMinute < rule.window.to;
      return namedByHub && partOfTodayLeft ? clock.today : inForceOn(rule, clock);
    }
    type Placed =
      | { readonly group: "now"; readonly on: string }
      | { readonly group: "upcoming"; readonly on: string | null }
      | { readonly group: "ended" };
    function place(rule: ClosureRule, clock: Clock, hubPause: HubOnlinePause | null): Placed {
      const inForce = forceDate(rule, clock, hubPause);
      if (inForce !== null) return { group: "now", on: inForce };
      const next = waitingOn(rule, clock);
      if (next !== null) return { group: "upcoming", on: next };
      // A date of its own is left, but a skip or a one-date edit replaces each one.
      const ownDateLeft = waitingOn(rule, { ...clock, rules: [] }) !== null;
      return ownDateLeft ? { group: "upcoming", on: null } : { group: "ended" };
    }
    function skippedOf(rule: ClosureRule, clock: Clock): readonly SkippedDate[] {
      return skipRows(clock.rules, rule.id)
        .filter((skip) => skip.startsOn >= clock.today)
        .map((skip) => ({ skipId: skip.id, date: skip.startsOn }));
    }
    function rowOf(
      rule: ClosureRule,
      placed: Exclude<Placed, { group: "ended" }>,
      clock: Clock,
      outcomes: ClosureSummary | null
    ): ClosureListRow {
      return {
        group: placed.group,
        ruleId: rule.id,
        on: placed.on,
        ...factsOf(rule, clock),
        pause: isOnlinePause(rule),
        editable: isEditableClosure(rule),
        seriesId: rule.seriesId ?? null,
        series: isSeries(rule) ? { skipped: skippedOf(rule, clock) } : null,
        outcomes,
        refundsOpen: refundsOpenOf(outcomes),
      };
    }
    function byNextDate(a: ClosureListRow, b: ClosureListRow): number {
      if (a.on === null || b.on === null) return Number(a.on === null) - Number(b.on === null);
      return (
        a.on.localeCompare(b.on) ||
        (a.window?.from ?? 0) - (b.window?.from ?? 0) ||
        a.ruleId.localeCompare(b.ruleId)
      );
    }
    function earlierRows(
      summaries: readonly ClosureSummary[],
      ended: readonly ClosureRule[],
      listed: ReadonlySet<string>,
      clock: Clock
    ): EarlierClosureRow[] {
      const open = summaries.filter((s) => refundsOpenOf(s) > 0 && !listed.has(s.ruleId));
      const rowFor = (
        outcomes: ClosureSummary,
        reason: EarlierReason,
        closure: ClosureFacts | null
      ): EarlierClosureRow => ({
        group: "earlier",
        ruleId: outcomes.ruleId,
        reason,
        closure,
        outcomes,
        refundsOpen: refundsOpenOf(outcomes),
      });
      const lastDate = (rule: ClosureRule) => rule.endsOn ?? rule.startsOn;
      const known = [...ended]
        .sort((a, b) => lastDate(b).localeCompare(lastDate(a)) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
        .flatMap((rule) => {
          const outcomes = open.find((s) => s.ruleId === rule.id);
          return outcomes ? [rowFor(outcomes, "ended", factsOf(rule, clock))] : [];
        });
      const endedIds = new Set(ended.map((rule) => rule.id));
      // Refunds for a rule of another kind that still stands (special hours) are not a closure's.
      const rest = open.flatMap((s) => {
        if (endedIds.has(s.ruleId)) return [];
        const rule = clock.rules.find((r) => r.id === s.ruleId);
        if (rule === undefined) return [rowFor(s, "removed", null)];
        return rule.kind === "tonight" ? [rowFor(s, "tonight", null)] : [];
      });
      return [...known, ...rest];
    }
    export function closuresList(input: ClosuresListInput): ClosuresList {
      const clock = clockOf(input);
      const { summaries } = input;
      const hubPause = onlinePause(clock);
      const placed = clock.rules
        .filter(isClosure)
        .map((rule) => ({ rule, placed: place(rule, clock, hubPause) }));
      const rows = placed.flatMap(({ rule, placed: at }) =>
        at.group === "ended"
          ? []
          : [rowOf(rule, at, clock, summaries?.find((s) => s.ruleId === rule.id) ?? null)]
      );
      const ended = placed.flatMap(({ rule, placed: at }) => (at.group === "ended" ? [rule] : []));
      const listed = new Set(rows.map((row) => row.ruleId));
      return {
        now: rows.filter((row) => row.group === "now").sort(byNow),
        upcoming: rows.filter((row) => row.group === "upcoming").sort(byNextDate),
        earlier: earlierRows(summaries ?? [], ended, listed, clock),
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/compare-changes.ts">
    type Hours = Pick<
      ScheduleService,
      "opensAt" | "lastSeatingAt" | "closesAt" | "seating" | "bookingTypes"
    >;
    export interface CompareRow extends Hours {
      readonly scheduleServiceId: string;
      readonly scheduleId: string;
      readonly scheduleName: string;
      /** The row has its own days or different hours on some days; the hours above are its base hours. */
      readonly different: boolean;
    }
    function runs(config: AvailabilityConfig, row: ScheduleService): boolean {
      return scheduleDays(config, row.scheduleId, true).some((day) => hoursOn(row, day) !== null);
    }
    export function compareServiceOptions(config: AvailabilityConfig, serviceDate: string) {
      const live = liveScheduleIds(config, serviceDate);
      return config.venueServices
        .filter((v) => !v.archivedAt)
        .filter(
          (v) =>
            config.scheduleServices.filter(
              (s) => s.venueServiceId === v.id && live.has(s.scheduleId) && runs(config, s)
            ).length > 1
        )
        .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position);
    }
    export function compareRows(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      venueServiceId: string,
      serviceDate: string
    ): CompareRow[] {
      const names = new Map(visibleSchedules(config, serviceDate).map((s) => [s.id, s.name]));
      return config.scheduleServices
        .filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === venueServiceId && names.has(s.scheduleId))
        .filter((s) => runs(config, s))
        .map((s) => ({
          scheduleServiceId: s.id,
          scheduleId: s.scheduleId,
          scheduleName: names.get(s.scheduleId) ?? s.scheduleId,
          opensAt: s.opensAt,
          lastSeatingAt: s.lastSeatingAt,
          closesAt: s.closesAt,
          seating: s.seating,
          bookingTypes: s.bookingTypes,
          different: s.weekdays.length > 0 || s.dayHours.sets.length > 0,
        }));
    }
    export function changedRows(config: AvailabilityConfig, rows: readonly CompareRow[]): CompareRow[] {
      const stored = new Map(config.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      return rows.filter((r) => {
        const was = stored.get(r.scheduleServiceId);
        return was !== undefined && hoursOf(was) !== hoursOf(r);
      });
    }
    export function rowsChangedSince(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      after: AvailabilityConfig,
      edits: readonly CompareRow[]
    ): string[] {
      const was = new Map(before.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      const now = new Map(after.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      return edits
        .filter((e) => {
          const old = was.get(e.scheduleServiceId);
          const next = now.get(e.scheduleServiceId);
          return old !== undefined && next !== undefined && hoursOf(old) !== hoursOf(next);
        })
        .map((e) => e.scheduleName);
    }
    export function rowsRemovedSince(
      after: AvailabilityConfig,
      edits: readonly CompareRow[],
      serviceDate: string
    ): string[] {
      const now = compareRowsById(after, serviceDate);
      return edits.filter((e) => !now.has(e.scheduleServiceId)).map((e) => e.scheduleName);
    }
    export function reapplyEdits(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      after: AvailabilityConfig,
      edits: readonly CompareRow[],
      serviceDate: string
    ): Record<string, CompareRow> {
      const was = new Map(before.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      const latest = compareRowsById(after, serviceDate);
      const entries = edits.flatMap((e) => {
        const old = was.get(e.scheduleServiceId);
        const next = latest.get(e.scheduleServiceId);
        if (!old || !next) return [];
        const mine = HOURS_FIELDS.filter((f) => !sameValue(old[f], e[f]));
        const merged = { ...next, ...Object.fromEntries(mine.map((f) => [f, e[f]])) } as CompareRow;
        return [[e.scheduleServiceId, merged] as const];
      });
      return Object.fromEntries(entries);
    }
    function compareRowsById(config: AvailabilityConfig, serviceDate: string): Map<string, CompareRow> {
      const rows = config.venueServices.flatMap((v) => compareRows(config, v.id, serviceDate));
      return new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.scheduleServiceId, r]));
    }
    export function buildCompareChanges(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      rows: readonly CompareRow[]
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const stored = new Map(config.scheduleServices.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      const scheduleServices = changedRows(config, rows).map((r) => ({
        ...stored.get(r.scheduleServiceId)!,
        opensAt: r.opensAt,
        lastSeatingAt: r.lastSeatingAt,
        closesAt: r.closesAt,
        seating: r.seating,
        bookingTypes: [...r.bookingTypes],
      }));
      return { upsert: scheduleServices.length > 0 ? { scheduleServices } : {}, remove: {} };
    }
