  <file path="src/components/availability/conflict-problem.ts">
    export type Conflict =
      /** Someone saved first; `winningChange` is `null` when the server recorded none. */
      | { readonly code: "version-conflict"; readonly winningChange: AvailabilityChangeSummary | null }
      /** This attempt id already committed (a response was lost). */
      | { readonly code: "closure-exists" };
    export function availabilityProblemOf(error: unknown): AvailabilityConfigProblem | null {
      const details = (error as { problemDetails?: unknown } | null)?.problemDetails;
      const problem = AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema.safeParse(details);
      return problem.success ? problem.data : null;
    }
    export function isDecisionRequired(error: unknown): boolean {
      return availabilityProblemOf(error)?.code === "decision-required";
    }
    export function conflictOf(error: unknown): Conflict | null {
      const problem = availabilityProblemOf(error);
      if (problem?.code === "version-conflict") {
        return { code: "version-conflict", winningChange: problem.winningChange ?? null };
      }
      return problem?.code === "closure-exists" ? { code: "closure-exists" } : null;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/conflict-review.ts">
    export interface ScheduleChangeSince {
      /** The schedule no longer exists (deleted or archived). */
      readonly gone: boolean;
      /** Another schedule now holds this one's place (a newer regular week); its name. */
      readonly replacedBy: string | null;
      readonly renamedTo: string | null;
      /** Service names. */
      readonly added: readonly string[];
      readonly removed: readonly string[];
      readonly changed: readonly string[];
    }
    function rowsByService(config: AvailabilityConfig, scheduleId: string) {
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((v) => [v.id, v.name]));
      const days = scheduleDays(config, scheduleId, true);
      return new Map(
        config.scheduleServices
          .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId)
          .map((s) => ({ row: s, week: weekOfRow(s, days) }))
          .filter(({ week }) => week.some((hours) => hours !== null))
          .map((v) => [
            v.row.venueServiceId,
            { ...v, name: names.get(v.row.venueServiceId) ?? v.row.venueServiceId },
          ])
      );
    }
    export function scheduleChangesSince(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      after: AvailabilityConfig,
      scheduleId: string,
      latestId: string = scheduleId
    ): ScheduleChangeSince {
      const was = before.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId);
      const now = after.schedules.find((s) => s.id === latestId && !s.archivedAt);
      if (!now) {
        return { gone: true, replacedBy: null, renamedTo: null, added: [], removed: [], changed: [] };
      }
      const old = rowsByService(before, scheduleId);
      const next = rowsByService(after, latestId);
      return {
        gone: false,
        replacedBy: latestId !== scheduleId ? now.name : null,
        renamedTo: latestId === scheduleId && was && was.name !== now.name ? now.name : null,
        added: [...next].filter(([id]) => !old.has(id)).map(([, v]) => v.name),
        removed: [...old].filter(([id]) => !next.has(id)).map(([, v]) => v.name),
        changed: [...next]
          .filter(([id, v]) => {
            const prior = old.get(id);
            return prior !== undefined && !same(prior.week, v.week);
          })
          .map(([, v]) => v.name),
      };
    }
    interface ReapplyInput {
      /** The rows the draft was seeded from. */
      readonly base: readonly DraftService[];
      /** The rows as the Manager has them now. */
      readonly draft: readonly DraftService[];
      /** The schedule's rows in the version that won. */
      readonly latest: readonly DraftService[];
    }
    export function reapplyDraft({ base, draft, latest }: ReapplyInput): DraftService[] {
      const baseById = new Map(base.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const draftById = new Map(draft.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const kept = latest.flatMap((row) => {
        const was = baseById.get(row.venueServiceId);
        const mine = draftById.get(row.venueServiceId);
        if (was && !mine) return []; // the Manager removed it
        if (!was || !mine) return [row]; // the colleague's, or nothing of the Manager's to apply
        const edited = HOURS_FIELDS.filter((f) => !same(was[f], mine[f]));
        return [{ ...row, ...Object.fromEntries(edited.map((f) => [f, mine[f]])) } as DraftService];
      });
      const added = draft.filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === null || !baseById.has(s.venueServiceId));
      const fresh = added.filter(
        (s) => s.venueServiceId === null || !latest.some((l) => l.venueServiceId === s.venueServiceId)
      );
      return [...kept, ...fresh];
    }

    export function singleDateChangeCount(config: AvailabilityConfig, weekday: number): number {
      return config.dateRules.filter(
        (r) =>
          r.kind === "special_hours" &&
          r.targetKind === "venue" &&
          r.endsOn === r.startsOn &&
          r.repeat == null &&
          r.window == null &&
          r.seriesId == null &&
          weekdayIndexOf(r.startsOn) === weekday
      ).length;
    }

    type Service = ResolvedDay["services"][number];
    export function sameHoursAs(source: ResolvedDay, target: ResolvedDay): boolean {
      const keys = (day: ResolvedDay) => day.services.map(serviceKey).sort();
      const a = keys(source);
      const b = keys(target);
      return a.length === b.length && a.every((key, i) => key === b[i]);
    }
    export function thisWeekTargets(input: {
      readonly date: string;
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
      readonly today: string;
    }): { dates: string[]; past: number[] } {
      const { date, weekdays, today } = input;
      const monday = addDays(date, -((weekdayIndexOf(date) + 6) % 7));
      const dates: string[] = [];
      const past: number[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) {
        const day = addDays(monday, i);
        const weekday = weekdayIndexOf(day);
        if (day === date || !weekdays.includes(weekday)) continue;
        if (day < today) past.push(weekday);
        else dates.push(day);
      }
      return { dates, past };
    }
    export function buildCopySingleDates(input: {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly source: ResolvedDay;
      readonly date: string;
      readonly dates: readonly string[];
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, source, date, dates, makeId } = input;
      return buildDraftChanges({
        config,
        scope: { kind: "dates", dates },
        services: seedServices(config, source, { kind: "date", date }),
        makeId,
      });
    }
    export function splitCopyTargets(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      source: ResolvedDay,
      dates: readonly string[]
    ): { changed: string[]; same: string[]; closed: string[] } {
      const result = { changed: [] as string[], same: [] as string[], closed: [] as string[] };
      for (const date of dates) {
        const target = resolveDay({ timezone, config }, date);
        if (closedAllDay(target)) result.closed.push(date);
        else if (sameHoursAs(source, target)) result.same.push(date);
        else result.changed.push(date);
      }
      return result;
    }
    export function regularSameWeekdays(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      source: ResolvedDay,
      weekdays: readonly number[],
      from: string
    ): number[] {
      const regular = config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt);
      const week = {
        timezone,
        config: {
          ...config,
          dateRules: [],
          assignments: config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === regular?.id),
        },
      };
      return weekdays.filter((weekday) => {
        const first = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(from, i)).find(
          (d) => weekdayIndexOf(d) === weekday
        )!;
        return sameHoursAs(source, resolveDay(week, first));
      });
    }
    function withCoveredDays(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      weekdays: readonly number[],
      makeId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      const regular = config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt);
      if (!regular) return config;
      const covered = new Set(
        config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === regular.id).flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)
      );
      const missing = weekdays.filter((weekday) => !covered.has(weekday));
      if (missing.length === 0) return config;
      const precedence = Math.max(0, ...config.assignments.map((a) => a.precedence));
      return {
        ...config,
        assignments: [
          ...config.assignments,
          { id: makeId(), scheduleId: regular.id, weekdays: missing, precedence },
        ],
      };
    }
    export function copyWeekDraft(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      source: ResolvedDay,
      date: string,
      weekdays: readonly number[],
      makeId: () => string
    ): QuickSetupDraft {
      const services = seedServices(config, source, { kind: "date", date });
      const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
      const next = weekdays.reduce(
        (current, weekday) =>
          applyChanges(
            current,
            buildDraftChanges({
              config: current,
              scope: { kind: "regularWeekday", weekday },
              services,
              makeId,
            }),
            nowIso
          ),
        withCoveredDays(config, weekdays, makeId)
      );
      return draftFromConfig(next, makeId);
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/day-summary.ts">
    export interface ServiceLineText {
      readonly key: string;
      /** "Lunch 11:00 AM–3:00 PM, last seating 2:30 PM": the one service-time wording. */
      readonly text: string;
    }
    export function scheduleNameText(name: string, t: TFunction): string {
      return name === SEEDED_REGULAR_WEEK ? t("availabilitySchedules.regularMarker") : name;
    }
    export function dayLabelText(label: string, t: TFunction): string {
      switch (label) {
        case "Closed":
          return t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.closed");
        case "Special hours":
          return t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.specialHours");
        case "Open":
          return t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.open");
        default:
          return scheduleNameText(label, t);
      }
    }
    export type DayTone = "closed" | "special";
    export interface DayPresentation {
      /** The day's label in the viewer's language. */
      readonly label: string | null;
      readonly tone: DayTone | null;
      readonly bands: readonly ClosureBandText[];
      /**
       * Month view's one line about the services: their names ("Lunch · Dinner"), or "2 services"
       * from an older API that sends no service lines. `null` in week view, which lists each service.
       */
      readonly servicesSummary: string | null;
      /** One line per service, first to last bookable time; only populated when `detailed`. */
      readonly services: readonly ServiceLineText[];
      readonly onlineOff: boolean;
      /** The spoken details after the date: "Special hours, 2 services, closed 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM". */
      readonly accessibleDetails: string;
      /** The button's accessible name: "Friday, October 30: …". */
      readonly accessibleName: string;
    }
    function serviceLineText(
      service: DaySummaryService,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): ServiceLineText {
      return {
        key: service.venueServiceId,
        text: namedServiceHoursText(service.name, service, { t, format }),
      };
    }
    export function presentDay(
      date: string,
      fullSummary: AvailabilityDaySummary | undefined,
      detailed: boolean,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat,
      service?: ServiceFilter | null,
      sectionNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): DayPresentation {
      const summary = fullSummary && service ? filterDaySummary(fullSummary, service.id) : fullSummary;
      const notRunningName =
        service && fullSummary && fullSummary.serviceCount > 0 && summary?.serviceCount === 0
          ? service.name
          : null;
      const bands = (summary?.closures ?? []).map((c) => closureBandText(c, t, format, sectionNames));
      const services = detailed
        ? (summary?.services ?? []).map((s) => serviceLineText(s, t, format))
        : [];
      // Month names the services, which says more than a count in the same space: a Monday with only
      // Lunch reads apart from a Friday with Lunch · Dinner. Week lists each one, so says neither; an
      // older API that sends no service lines gets the count instead.
      const showCount =
        summary !== undefined &&
        summary.services === undefined &&
        (detailed || summary.serviceCount >= 2);
      const countText = showCount
        ? t("availability.calendar.services", { count: summary.serviceCount })
        : null;
      const monthNames = detailed ? [] : (summary?.services?.map((s) => s.name) ?? []);
      const servicesSummary = countText ?? (monthNames.length > 0 ? monthNames.join(" · ") : null);
      // A whole-day pause that names online already says so; saying it twice reads as two facts.
      // The band names a channel only when it is the single one paused (closure-band.ts channelSuffix).
      const bandNamesOnline = (summary?.closures ?? []).some(
        (c) =>
          c.targetKind === "booking" &&
          isWholeDay(c) &&
          c.bookingTypes?.length === 1 &&
          c.bookingTypes[0] === "online"
      );
      const onlineOff = summary !== undefined && !summary.bookingOpen.online && !bandNamesOnline;
    
      const label = notRunningName
        ? t("availability.calendar.serviceNotRunning", { name: notRunningName })
        : summary
          ? dayLabelText(summary.label, t)
          : null;
      const parts = summary
        ? [
            label,
            // Each name its own phrase: a screen reader would read the dot.
            ...(countText ? [countText] : monthNames),
            ...bands.map((b) => b.name),
            ...services.map((s) => s.text),
            ...(onlineOff ? [t("availability.calendar.onlineOffName")] : []),
          ]
        : [t("availability.calendar.loadingDay")];
      const accessibleDetails = parts.join(", ");
      const fullDate = format.formatCalendarDate(date, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
      });
      return {
        label,
        // The service's own en-US labels, as dayLabelText reads them.
        tone:
          notRunningName !== null || summary?.label === "Closed"
            ? "closed"
            : summary?.label === "Special hours"
              ? "special"
              : null,
        bands,
        servicesSummary,
        services,
        onlineOff,
        accessibleDetails,
        accessibleName: t("availability.calendar.cellName", {
          date: fullDate,
          details: accessibleDetails,
        }),
      };
    }
    export interface DayDifference {
      /** The chip's text, in the viewer's language: "Closed", "Lunch closed", "Weeknights". */
      readonly chip: string;
      /** Further differences the chip does not name ("+1"). */
      readonly more: number;
    }
    function pausedChannels(
      day: AvailabilityDaySummary
    ): ReadonlySet<(typeof BOOKING_CHANNELS)[number]> {
      const paused = new Set(BOOKING_CHANNELS.filter((channel) => !day.bookingOpen[channel]));
      for (const closure of day.closures) {
        if (closure.targetKind !== "booking") continue;
        for (const channel of closure.bookingTypes ?? BOOKING_CHANNELS) paused.add(channel);
      }
      return paused;
    }
    function pausedChip(paused: ReadonlySet<(typeof BOOKING_CHANNELS)[number]>, t: TFunction): string {
      const [only] = [...paused];
      if (paused.size === 1 && only === "online") return t("availability.calendar.chip.onlinePaused");
      if (paused.size === 1 && only === "phone") return t("availability.calendar.chip.phonePaused");
      if (paused.size === 1 && only === "waitlist")
        return t("availability.calendar.chip.waitlistPaused");
      return t("availability.calendar.chip.bookingPaused");
    }
    export function dayDifferences(
      day: AvailabilityDaySummary,
      regularScheduleId: string | null,
      sectionNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string> | undefined,
      t: TFunction,
      serviceNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): readonly string[] {
      const found: string[] = [];
      const closures = day.closures;
      const wholeDayVenue = closures.some((c) => c.targetKind === "venue" && isWholeDay(c));
      // A weekday the regular week has no hours on reads "Closed" with no schedule and no closure: it
      // is the regular week, not a difference. Any real closure, or another schedule's closed day, is one.
      const regularClosed = day.label === "Closed" && !day.scheduleId && closures.length === 0;
      if ((day.label === "Closed" && !regularClosed) || wholeDayVenue)
        found.push(t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.closed"));
    
      const serviceIds = new Set<string>();
      const serviceChips: string[] = [];
      for (const c of closures) {
        if (c.targetKind !== "service") continue;
        const key = c.venueServiceId ?? "";
        if (serviceIds.has(key)) continue;
        serviceIds.add(key);
        const name =
          day.services?.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === c.venueServiceId)?.name ??
          (c.venueServiceId === undefined ? undefined : serviceNames?.get(c.venueServiceId));
        serviceChips.push(
          name === undefined
            ? t("availability.calendar.chip.serviceClosedUnnamed")
            : t("availability.calendar.chip.serviceClosed", { service: name })
        );
      }
      found.push(...serviceChips);
    
      const sectionIds = new Set<string>();
      let otherClosure = false;
      for (const c of closures) {
        if (c.targetKind === "venue") {
          if (!isWholeDay(c)) otherClosure = true;
        } else if (c.targetKind === "tables") {
          const section = c.sectionId === undefined ? undefined : sectionNames?.get(c.sectionId);
          if (section === undefined) otherClosure = true;
          else if (!sectionIds.has(c.sectionId ?? "")) {
            sectionIds.add(c.sectionId ?? "");
            found.push(t("availability.calendar.chip.sectionClosed", { section }));
          }
        }
      }
    
      // A closed day takes no bookings by nature: its channels being off is not a further difference.
      const closedDay = day.label === "Closed" || wholeDayVenue;
      const paused = pausedChannels(day);
      if (paused.size > 0 && !closedDay) found.push(pausedChip(paused, t));
    
      if (day.label === "Special hours" || otherClosure) {
        found.push(t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.specialHours"));
      }
    
      // A day from an older API sends no schedule id: it differs only by a name that is not the seeded regular week's.
      const scheduleDiffers =
        day.scheduleId === undefined
          ? scheduleNameText(day.label, t) !== t("availabilitySchedules.regularMarker")
          : day.scheduleId !== null &&
            regularScheduleId !== null &&
            day.scheduleId !== regularScheduleId;
      const namesSchedule = !["Closed", "Special hours", "Open"].includes(day.label);
      if (scheduleDiffers && namesSchedule) found.push(scheduleNameText(day.label, t));
      return found;
    }
    export function toDifference(found: readonly string[]): DayDifference | null {
      const [chip, ...rest] = found;
      return chip === undefined ? null : { chip, more: rest.length };
    }
    function weekdayIndex(date: string): number {
      const [y = 0, m = 1, d = 1] = date.split("-").map(Number);
      return (new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
    }
    function weekdaysText(dates: readonly string[], format: VenueFormat): string {
      const byIndex = new Map(dates.map((d) => [weekdayIndex(d), d]));
      const indexes = [...byIndex.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const name = (index: number) =>
        format.formatCalendarDate(byIndex.get(index) ?? "", { weekday: "short" });
      const first = indexes[0];
      const last = indexes.at(-1);
      if (first === undefined || last === undefined) return "";
      if (indexes.length === 1) return name(first);
      const consecutive = last - first === indexes.length - 1;
      return consecutive ? `${name(first)}–${name(last)}` : indexes.map(name).join(", ");
    }
    export interface MonthLegend {
      /** "This month:", or the whole line "This month: your regular week" when nothing differs. */
      readonly heading: string;
      /** One entry per chip in use: "Weeknights · Mon–Thu", "Lunch closed · 1 day". */
      readonly items: readonly string[];
    }
    export function monthLegend(
      cells: readonly { readonly date: string; readonly differences: readonly string[] }[],
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): MonthLegend {
      const inUse = new Set<string>();
      for (const { differences } of cells) {
        const [chip] = differences;
        if (chip !== undefined) inUse.add(chip);
      }
      if (inUse.size === 0) return { heading: t("availability.calendar.legend.regular"), items: [] };
    
      const weekKey = (date: string) => {
        const [y = 0, m = 1, d = 1] = date.split("-").map(Number);
        return Math.floor((Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d) / 86_400_000 - weekdayIndex(date)) / 7);
      };
      const items = [...inUse].map((chip) => {
        const having = cells.filter((c) => c.differences.includes(chip)).map((c) => c.date);
        const weekdays = new Set(having.map(weekdayIndex));
        const weekly =
          new Set(having.map(weekKey)).size >= 2 &&
          cells
            .filter(({ date }) => weekdays.has(weekdayIndex(date)))
            .every(({ differences }) => differences.includes(chip));
        return weekly
          ? t("availability.calendar.legend.weekdays", {
              label: chip,
              days: weekdaysText(having, format),
            })
          : t("availability.calendar.legend.days", { label: chip, count: having.length });
      });
      return { heading: t("availability.calendar.legend.thisMonth"), items };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/describe-change.ts">
    export function whenOf(
      from: string | null | undefined,
      to: string | null | undefined,
      format: VenueFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ): string | null {
      if (!from) return null;
      const start = format.formatCalendarDate(from, DAY);
      if (!to) return t("availability.history.entry.onward", { from: start });
      if (to === from) return start;
      return t("availability.history.entry.range", {
        from: start,
        to: format.formatCalendarDate(to, DAY),
      });
    }
    export function outcomeText(
      outcome: Pick<AvailabilityChangeOutcome, "cancelled" | "moved" | "kept">,
      format: VenueFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ) {
      const parts = [
        outcome.cancelled > 0
          ? t("availability.history.entry.cancelled", { count: outcome.cancelled })
          : null,
        outcome.moved > 0 ? t("availability.history.entry.moved", { count: outcome.moved }) : null,
        outcome.kept > 0 ? t("availability.history.entry.kept", { count: outcome.kept }) : null,
      ].filter((p): p is string => p !== null);
      if (parts.length === 0) return t("availability.history.entry.none");
      return new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { style: "long", type: "conjunction" }).format(parts);
    }
    export function describeChange(
      entry: AvailabilityChangeSummary &
        Partial<Pick<AvailabilityChangeEntry, "outcome" | "affectedFrom" | "affectedTo">>,
      format: VenueFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ): string | null {
      const { outcome } = entry;
      // The rule's own dates when recorded: the audit range also spans rows a series edit touched.
      const own = outcome?.startsOn != null;
      const when = whenOf(
        own ? outcome.startsOn : entry.affectedFrom,
        own ? outcome.endsOn : entry.affectedTo,
        format,
        t
      );
      if (!when) return null;
      if (entry.kind === "reopen") return t("availability.history.entry.reopened", { when });
      if (entry.kind !== "closure" || !outcome) return null;
      return t(
        outcome.closeEarly
          ? "availability.history.entry.closedEarly"
          : "availability.history.entry.closed",
        { when, outcome: outcomeText(outcome, format, t) }
      );
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/draft-changes.ts">
    export type EditScope =
      | { readonly kind: "date"; readonly date: string }
      /** Every weekday of `from`, from `from` until `until` (`null`: until changed again). */
      | { readonly kind: "weekday"; readonly from: string; readonly until: string | null }
      | { readonly kind: "schedule"; readonly scheduleId: string }
      /** One weekday of the live regular week, in place: no schedule or assignment is made (ux.md F2 1). */
      | { readonly kind: "regularWeekday"; readonly weekday: number }
      /** Exactly these dates, picked in the multi-select bar (ux.md F-MS). */
      | { readonly kind: "dates"; readonly dates: readonly string[] }
      /** A range or repeating special-hours rule, from `from` on ("following") or whole ("all"). */
      | {
          readonly kind: "rule";
          readonly ruleId: string;
          readonly mode: SeriesScope;
          readonly from: string;
        };
    export function overnightHintDate(
      scope: EditScope,
      date: string,
      dates: readonly string[]
    ): string | undefined {
      if (scope.kind === "date" || scope.kind === "weekday" || scope.kind === "regularWeekday") {
        return date;
      }
      if (scope.kind === "rule" && dates.length === 1) return date;
      return undefined;
    }
    export interface DraftService {
      /** React key; stable across edits. */
      readonly key: string;
      /** `null` for a service the venue has not had before; `name` then names it. */
      readonly venueServiceId: string | null;
      /** The stored schedule-service row this edits, in a schedule scope. */
      readonly scheduleServiceId: string | null;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
      readonly seating: Seating;
      readonly bookingTypes: readonly ("online" | "phone")[];
    }
    type SeedService = Pick<
      DraftService,
      "opensAt" | "lastSeatingAt" | "closesAt" | "seating" | "bookingTypes"
    >;
    function hoursRuleOf(config: AvailabilityConfig, ruleId: string): SpecialHoursRule | undefined {
      return config.dateRules.find(
        (r): r is SpecialHoursRule => r.id === ruleId && r.kind === "special_hours"
      );
    }
    export function seedServices(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      day: Pick<ResolvedDaySummary, "services">,
      scope: EditScope
    ): DraftService[] {
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((v) => [v.id, v.name]));
      if (scope.kind === "rule") {
        return [...(hoursRuleOf(config, scope.ruleId)?.payload.services ?? [])]
          .sort((a, b) => a.opensAt - b.opensAt)
          .map((s) => ({
            ...hoursOf(s),
            key: s.venueServiceId,
            venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
            scheduleServiceId: null,
            name: names.get(s.venueServiceId) ?? s.venueServiceId,
          }));
      }
      if (scope.kind === "regularWeekday") {
        const week = liveRegularWeek(config);
        const venueServices = new Map(config.venueServices.map((v) => [v.id, v]));
        return week
          ? servicesOn(week.rows, venueServices, scope.weekday).map((s) => ({
              ...hoursOf(s),
              key: s.venueServiceId,
              venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
              scheduleServiceId: s.scheduleServiceId,
              name: s.name,
            }))
          : [];
      }
      if (scope.kind !== "schedule") {
        return day.services.map((s) => ({
          ...hoursOf(s),
          key: s.venueServiceId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          scheduleServiceId: null,
          name: s.name,
        }));
      }
      return config.scheduleServices
        .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scope.scheduleId)
        .sort((a, b) => a.opensAt - b.opensAt)
        .map((s) => ({
          ...hoursOf(s),
          key: s.venueServiceId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          scheduleServiceId: s.id,
          name: names.get(s.venueServiceId) ?? s.venueServiceId,
        }));
    }
    export function servicesEqual(a: readonly DraftService[], b: readonly DraftService[]): boolean {
      return comparable(a) === comparable(b);
    }
    interface BuildInput {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly scope: EditScope;
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      /** Ids for rows this draft creates. */
      readonly makeId: () => string;
      /**
       * Dates left out of a dates save: under "Keep theirs" the ones with their own hours change,
       * since the server treats a changed rule as incoming and would overwrite it.
       */
      readonly leaveOut?: readonly string[];
      /** Today on the venue clock: a rule edit's "All dates" starts here, so past dates keep their hours. */
      readonly today?: string;
      /** The config the draft was seeded from; a schedule save removes only rows it contained. */
      readonly baseline?: AvailabilityConfig;
    }
    function ownDateRule(config: AvailabilityConfig, date: string): DateRule | undefined {
      return config.dateRules.find(
        (r) =>
          r.kind === "special_hours" &&
          r.targetKind === "venue" &&
          r.startsOn === date &&
          r.endsOn === date &&
          r.repeat == null &&
          r.window == null &&
          r.seriesId == null &&
          r.bookingTypes == null &&
          r.venueServiceId == null
      );
    }
    function specialHoursRule(base: Partial<DateRule>, id: string, services: SpecialHoursService[]) {
      return {
        ...base,
        id,
        kind: "special_hours",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: base.startsOn ?? "",
        payload: { version: 1, services },
      } as DateRule;
    }
    function dateRule(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      date: string,
      services: SpecialHoursService[],
      makeId: () => string
    ): DateRule {
      const own = ownDateRule(config, date);
      return specialHoursRule(own ?? { startsOn: date, endsOn: date }, own?.id ?? makeId(), services);
    }
    function scheduleServiceRows(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      scheduleId: string,
      services: readonly (DraftService & { venueServiceId: string })[],
      makeId: () => string,
      baseline?: AvailabilityConfig
    ): { upsert: ScheduleService[]; removed: string[] } {
      const stored = config.scheduleServices.filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId);
      const kept = new Set(services.map((s) => s.venueServiceId));
      // Only rows the draft started with can be ones the Manager removed. A row that appeared since
      // (a colleague's new service) was never in front of them, so a save must not delete it.
      const seen = baseline && new Set(baseline.scheduleServices.map((s) => s.id));
      return {
        upsert: services.map((s) => {
          const id =
            s.scheduleServiceId ??
            stored.find((row) => row.venueServiceId === s.venueServiceId)?.id ??
            makeId();
          // These rows carry a service's base hours only: its own days and different hours stay as stored.
          const was = stored.find((row) => row.id === id);
          return {
            ...hoursOf(s),
            bookingTypes: [...s.bookingTypes],
            weekdays: was?.weekdays ?? [],
            dayHours: was?.dayHours ?? { version: 1 as const, sets: [] },
            id,
            scheduleId,
            venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          };
        }),
        removed: stored
          .filter((s) => !kept.has(s.venueServiceId) && (!seen || seen.has(s.id)))
          .map((s) => s.id),
      };
    }
    function liveRegularWeek(config: AvailabilityConfig) {
      const schedule = config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt);
      if (!schedule) return null;
      return {
        schedule,
        rows: config.scheduleServices.filter((s) => s.scheduleId === schedule.id),
        covered: [
          ...new Set(
            config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === schedule.id).flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)
          ),
        ],
      };
    }
    export function usualHours(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      venueServiceId: string
    ): SeedService | undefined {
      const live = new Set(config.schedules.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => s.id));
      const row =
        liveRegularWeek(config)?.rows.find((r) => r.venueServiceId === venueServiceId) ??
        config.scheduleServices.find(
          (r) => r.venueServiceId === venueServiceId && live.has(r.scheduleId)
        );
      return row ? hoursOf(row) : undefined;
    }
    function regularWeekdayRows(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      weekday: number,
      services: readonly (DraftService & { venueServiceId: string })[],
      makeId: () => string
    ): { upsert: ScheduleService[]; removed: string[] } {
      const week = liveRegularWeek(config);
      if (!week) return { upsert: [], removed: [] };
      const edited = new Map(services.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const hoursFor = (s: DraftService): ServiceHours => ({
        ...hoursOf(s),
        bookingTypes: [...s.bookingTypes],
      });
      const decoded = decodeWeek(week.rows, week.covered);
      const replaced: ServiceWeek[] = [
        ...decoded.map((service) => {
          const mine = edited.get(service.venueServiceId);
          return {
            venueServiceId: service.venueServiceId,
            days: service.days.map((hours, day) =>
              day === weekday ? (mine ? hoursFor(mine) : null) : hours
            ),
          };
        }),
        ...services
          .filter((s) => !decoded.some((d) => d.venueServiceId === s.venueServiceId))
          .map((s) => ({
            venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
            days: Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, day) => (day === weekday ? hoursFor(s) : null)),
          })),
      ];
      const encoded = encodeWeek(replaced, week.covered);
      const stored = new Map(week.rows.map((row) => [row.venueServiceId, row]));
      return {
        upsert: encoded.flatMap((row): ScheduleService[] => {
          const was = stored.get(row.venueServiceId);
          if (was && rowKey(was) === rowKey(row)) return [];
          return [{ ...row, id: was?.id ?? makeId(), scheduleId: week.schedule.id }];
        }),
        removed: week.rows
          .filter((row) => !encoded.some((e) => e.venueServiceId === row.venueServiceId))
          .map((row) => row.id),
      };
    }
    export function buildDraftChanges(input: BuildInput): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, scope, makeId } = input;
      const nextPosition = Math.max(-1, ...config.venueServices.map((v) => v.position)) + 1;
      const created = input.services
        .filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === null)
        .map((s, i) => ({ id: makeId(), name: s.name, position: nextPosition + i }));
      let createdAt = 0;
      const services = input.services.map((s) => ({
        ...s,
        venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId ?? created[createdAt++]!.id,
      }));
      const venueServices = created.length > 0 ? { venueServices: created } : {};
    
      if (scope.kind === "regularWeekday") {
        const { upsert, removed } = regularWeekdayRows(config, scope.weekday, services, makeId);
        return {
          upsert: { ...venueServices, ...(upsert.length > 0 ? { scheduleServices: upsert } : {}) },
          remove: removed.length > 0 ? { scheduleServices: removed } : {},
        };
      }
      if (scope.kind === "schedule") {
        const { upsert, removed } = scheduleServiceRows(
          config,
          scope.scheduleId,
          services,
          makeId,
          input.baseline
        );
        return {
          upsert: { ...venueServices, scheduleServices: upsert },
          remove: removed.length > 0 ? { scheduleServices: removed } : {},
        };
      }
    
      const payload: SpecialHoursService[] = services.map((s) => ({
        ...hoursOf(s),
        bookingTypes: [...s.bookingTypes],
        venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
      }));
      if (scope.kind === "rule") {
        const rule = hoursRuleOf(config, scope.ruleId);
        if (!rule) return { upsert: venueServices, remove: {} };
        const changes = editHoursRule(
          rule,
          scope.mode,
          scope.from,
          { version: 1, services: payload },
          makeId,
          input.today
        );
        return { upsert: { ...venueServices, ...changes.upsert }, remove: {} };
      }
      if (scope.kind === "dates" || scope.kind === "date") {
        const picked = scope.kind === "date" ? [scope.date] : scope.dates;
        const skipped = new Set(input.leaveOut ?? []);
        const singles = picked.filter((d) => !skipped.has(d));
        const dateRules = singles.map((d) => dateRule(config, d, payload, makeId));
        return { upsert: { ...venueServices, dateRules }, remove: {} };
      }
      // A rule from a past day would rewrite hours that already happened: start it today instead.
      const startsOn = input.today !== undefined && input.today > scope.from ? input.today : scope.from;
      const rule = specialHoursRule(
        {
          startsOn,
          endsOn: scope.until,
          repeat: { version: 1, weekdays: [weekdayIndexOf(scope.from)] },
        },
        makeId(),
        payload
      );
      return { upsert: { ...venueServices, dateRules: [rule] }, remove: {} };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/editor-open.ts">
    function emit() {
      for (const listener of listeners) listener();
    }
    export function markEditorOpen(): () => void {
      openCount += 1;
      emit();
      let released = false;
      return () => {
        if (released) return;
        released = true;
        openCount -= 1;
        emit();
      };
    }
    export const isEditorOpen = (): boolean => openCount > 0;
    function subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    }
    export const useEditorOpen = (): boolean => useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, isEditorOpen);
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/holiday-decisions.ts">
    export const HOLIDAY_HORIZON_DAYS = 365;
    export type HolidayState =
      | { readonly kind: "undecided" }
      | { readonly kind: "closed"; readonly ruleId: string }
      | { readonly kind: "openAsUsual" }
      | { readonly kind: "specialHours"; readonly ruleId: string }
      /** A rule this flow does not own covers the date. */
      | { readonly kind: "other" };
    export interface DecidedHoliday extends Holiday {
      readonly state: HolidayState;
    }
    function covers(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.kind !== "tonight" &&
        rule.kind !== "skip" &&
        rule.startsOn <= date &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || rule.endsOn >= date) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    function isOwnedOneDate(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.targetKind === "venue" &&
        rule.startsOn === date &&
        rule.endsOn === date &&
        rule.repeat == null &&
        rule.seriesId == null
      );
    }
    function classify(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      decided: ReadonlySet<string>,
      date: string
    ): HolidayState {
      const skipped = new Set(
        rules
          .filter((r) => r.kind === "skip" && r.seriesId != null && r.startsOn <= date)
          .filter((r) => (r.endsOn ?? r.startsOn) >= date)
          .map((r) => r.seriesId)
      );
      // A series skipped on this date does not cover it: the skip is not a decision either.
      const covering = rules.filter((r) => covers(r, date) && !skipped.has(r.id));
      const closed = covering.find(
        (r) => r.kind === "closure" && r.window == null && isOwnedOneDate(r, date)
      );
      if (closed) return { kind: "closed", ruleId: closed.id };
      const special = covering.find((r) => r.kind === "special_hours" && isOwnedOneDate(r, date));
      if (special) return { kind: "specialHours", ruleId: special.id };
      // A covering rule outranks the open mark: the mark means "no change to the hours", and it
      // never reopens a day another rule shuts.
      if (covering.length > 0) return { kind: "other" };
      return decided.has(date) ? { kind: "openAsUsual" } : { kind: "undecided" };
    }
    export function holidayStates(
      country: HolidayCountry,
      today: string,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      decisions: readonly HolidayDecision[]
    ): DecidedHoliday[] {
      const end = addDays(today, HOLIDAY_HORIZON_DAYS);
      const year = Number(today.slice(0, 4));
      const decided = new Set(decisions.map((d) => d.serviceDate));
      return [...holidaysIn(country, year), ...holidaysIn(country, year + 1)]
        .filter((h) => h.date >= today && h.date <= end)
        .map((h) => ({ ...h, state: classify(config.dateRules, decided, h.date) }));
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/holidays.ts">
    export type HolidayCountry = "US" | "CA" | "MX";
    export type HolidayId =
      | "newYearsDay"
      | "constitutionDay"
      | "valentinesDay"
      | "benitoJuarez"
      | "holyThursday"
      | "goodFriday"
      | "easter"
      | "workersDay"
      | "mothersDay"
      | "fathersDay"
      | "juneteenth"
      | "victoriaDay"
      | "memorialDay"
      | "canadaDay"
      | "independenceDay"
      | "laborDay"
      | "thanksgiving"
      | "dayOfTheDead"
      | "revolutionDay"
      | "christmasEve"
      | "christmasDay"
      | "boxingDay"
      | "newYearsEve";
    export interface Holiday {
      readonly id: HolidayId;
      readonly date: string;
    }
    function nthWeekday(year: number, month: number, weekday: number, n: number): string {
      if (n > 0) {
        const first = iso(year, month, 1);
        return addDays(first, ((weekday - weekdayIndexOf(first) + 7) % 7) + (n - 1) * 7);
      }
      const last = addDays(iso(month === 12 ? year + 1 : year, month === 12 ? 1 : month + 1, 1), -1);
      return addDays(last, -((weekdayIndexOf(last) - weekday + 7) % 7) + (n + 1) * 7);
    }
    function easterSunday(year: number): string {
      const a = year % 19;
      const b = Math.floor(year / 100);
      const c = year % 100;
      const d = Math.floor(b / 4);
      const e = b % 4;
      const f = Math.floor((b + 8) / 25);
      const g = Math.floor((b - f + 1) / 3);
      const h = (19 * a + b - d - g + 15) % 30;
      const i = Math.floor(c / 4);
      const k = c % 4;
      const l = (32 + 2 * e + 2 * i - h - k) % 7;
      const m = Math.floor((a + 11 * h + 22 * l) / 451);
      const month = Math.floor((h + l - 7 * m + 114) / 31);
      const day = ((h + l - 7 * m + 114) % 31) + 1;
      return iso(year, month, day);
    }
    export function holidaysIn(country: HolidayCountry, year: number): Holiday[] {
      const easter = easterSunday(year);
      const at = (id: HolidayId, date: string): Holiday => ({ id, date });
      const common = [
        at("newYearsDay", iso(year, 1, 1)),
        at("valentinesDay", iso(year, 2, 14)),
        at("easter", easter),
        // Third Sunday of June in all three countries.
        at("fathersDay", nthWeekday(year, 6, SUNDAY, 3)),
        at("christmasEve", iso(year, 12, 24)),
        at("christmasDay", iso(year, 12, 25)),
        at("newYearsEve", iso(year, 12, 31)),
      ];
      const own: Record<HolidayCountry, Holiday[]> = {
        US: [
          at("mothersDay", nthWeekday(year, 5, SUNDAY, 2)),
          at("memorialDay", nthWeekday(year, 5, MONDAY, -1)),
          at("juneteenth", iso(year, 6, 19)),
          at("independenceDay", iso(year, 7, 4)),
          at("laborDay", nthWeekday(year, 9, MONDAY, 1)),
          at("thanksgiving", nthWeekday(year, 11, THURSDAY, 4)),
        ],
        CA: [
          at("goodFriday", addDays(easter, -2)),
          at("mothersDay", nthWeekday(year, 5, SUNDAY, 2)),
          // The Monday before May 25.
          at("victoriaDay", addDays(iso(year, 5, 24), -((weekdayIndexOf(iso(year, 5, 24)) + 6) % 7))),
          at("canadaDay", iso(year, 7, 1)),
          at("laborDay", nthWeekday(year, 9, MONDAY, 1)),
          at("thanksgiving", nthWeekday(year, 10, MONDAY, 2)),
          at("boxingDay", iso(year, 12, 26)),
        ],
        MX: [
          at("constitutionDay", nthWeekday(year, 2, MONDAY, 1)),
          at("benitoJuarez", nthWeekday(year, 3, MONDAY, 3)),
          at("holyThursday", addDays(easter, -3)),
          at("goodFriday", addDays(easter, -2)),
          at("workersDay", iso(year, 5, 1)),
          at("mothersDay", iso(year, 5, 10)),
          at("independenceDay", iso(year, 9, 16)),
          at("dayOfTheDead", iso(year, 11, 2)),
          at("revolutionDay", nthWeekday(year, 11, MONDAY, 3)),
        ],
      };
      return [...common, ...own[country]].sort((x, y) => x.date.localeCompare(y.date));
    }
    export function holidaysWithin(
      country: HolidayCountry,
      today: string,
      days: number = CLOSE_CHIP_DAYS
    ): Holiday[] {
      const end = addDays(today, days);
      const year = Number(today.slice(0, 4));
      return [...holidaysIn(country, year), ...holidaysIn(country, year + 1)].filter(
        (h) => h.date >= today && h.date <= end
      );
    }
    export function holidayCountry(
      addressCountry: string | undefined,
      locale: string
    ): HolidayCountry | null {
      const code = (addressCountry ?? locale.split("-")[1] ?? "").toUpperCase();
      return COUNTRIES.find((c) => c === code) ?? null;
    }
    export const USUALLY_CLOSED: ReadonlySet<HolidayId> = new Set([
      "thanksgiving",
      "christmasDay",
      "newYearsDay",
    ]);
  </file>

    export function focusHubRowOnReturn(testId: string): void {

    }

    export interface LayerRuleActionsProps {

  <file path="src/components/availability/layer-text.ts">
    function upperFirst(text: string, locale: string): string {
      return `${text.charAt(0).toLocaleUpperCase(locale)}${text.slice(1)}`;
    }
    function bookingTypesText(
      types: NonNullable<LayerTarget["bookingTypes"]>,
      t: TFunction,
      locale: string
    ): string {
      const names = types.map((type) => t(BOOKING_TYPE_NAME[type]));
      return new Intl.ListFormat(locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(names);
    }
    function targetText(
      target: LayerTarget,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat,
      sectionNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): string {
      switch (target.kind) {
        case "venue":
          return t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.closed");
        case "service":
          return t("availability.drawer.layer.serviceClosed", {
            name: target.serviceName ?? t("availability.drawer.layer.serviceFallback"),
          });
        case "booking":
          return upperFirst(
            t("availability.drawer.layer.bookingClosed", {
              types: bookingTypesText(target.bookingTypes ?? [], t, format.locale),
            }),
            format.locale
          );
        case "tables": {
          const section = target.sectionId ? sectionNames?.get(target.sectionId) : undefined;
          return section !== undefined
            ? t("availability.drawer.layer.sectionClosed", { name: section })
            : t("availability.drawer.layer.tablesBlocked");
        }
      }
    }
    function seriesText(
      series: LayerSeries,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat,
      sectionNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): string {
      const days = series.weekdays?.map((d) => t(WEEKDAY_NAME[d] ?? WEEKDAY_NAME[0])).join(", ");
      const range = `${series.startsOn} – ${series.endsOn ?? t("availability.drawer.layer.untilReopened")}`;
      return [targetText(series.target, t, format, sectionNames), days, range]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" · ");
    }
    function hoursText(hours: NonNullable<Layer["hours"]>, t: TFunction, format: VenueFormat): string {
      return hours.length === 0
        ? t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.closed")
        : hours
            .map((s) =>
              t("availability.drawer.layer.serviceHours", {
                name: s.name,
                from: minuteText(s.opensAt, t, format),
                to: minuteText(s.closesAt, t, format),
              })
            )
            .join(", ");
    }
    function tonightText(
      tonight: NonNullable<Layer["tonight"]>,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      if ("closeAt" in tonight) {
        return t("availability.drawer.layer.closesAt", {
          time: minuteText(tonight.closeAt, t, format),
          count: clockHour(tonight.closeAt),
        });
      }
      if ("stop" in tonight) {
        return t("availability.drawer.layer.stopped", {
          from: minuteText(tonight.stop.from, t, format),
          to: minuteText(tonight.stop.to, t, format),
        });
      }
      return t("availability.drawer.layer.pacing", { count: tonight.pacingCovers });
    }
    export function layerLabelText(
      layer: Layer,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat,
      sectionNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): string {
      switch (layer.kind) {
        case "schedule":
          return layer.scheduleName !== undefined
            ? scheduleNameText(layer.scheduleName, t)
            : layer.label;
        case "use_schedule":
          return layer.scheduleName !== undefined
            ? t("availability.drawer.layer.useSchedule", {
                name: scheduleNameText(layer.scheduleName, t),
              })
            : layer.label;
        case "special_hours":
          return t("availability.calendar.dayLabel.specialHours");
        case "skip":
          return layer.skippedFrom
            ? t("availability.drawer.layer.skippedFrom", {
                series: seriesText(layer.skippedFrom, t, format, sectionNames),
              })
            : t("availability.drawer.layer.skippedDate");
        case "closure":
          return layer.target ? targetText(layer.target, t, format, sectionNames) : layer.label;
        case "tonight":
          return t("availability.drawer.layer.tonight");
      }
    }
    export function layerEffectText(layer: Layer, t: TFunction, format: VenueFormat): string {
      switch (layer.kind) {
        case "skip":
          return t("availability.drawer.layer.bookableAsUsual");
        case "closure":
          if (!layer.target) return layer.effect;
          return layer.window
            ? t("availability.drawer.layer.window", {
                from: minuteText(layer.window.from, t, format),
                to: closureEndText(layer.window.to, t, format),
              })
            : t("availability.drawer.layer.allDay");
        case "tonight":
          return layer.tonight ? tonightText(layer.tonight, t, format) : layer.effect;
        default:
          return layer.hours ? hoursText(layer.hours, t, format) : layer.effect;
      }
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/online-seatings.ts">
    function seatingMinutes({ opensAt, lastSeatingAt, closesAt, seating }: ResolvedService): number[] {
      const bookable = (m: number) => m >= opensAt && m <= lastSeatingAt && m < closesAt;
      if ("fixed" in seating) return seating.fixed.filter(bookable);
      const count = Math.floor((lastSeatingAt - opensAt) / seating.interval) + 1;
      return Array.from(
        { length: Math.max(count, 0) },
        (_, k) => opensAt + k * seating.interval
      ).filter(bookable);
    }
    function closesOnline(band: ResolvedClosure, minute: number, venueServiceId: string): boolean {
      if (minute < band.from || minute >= band.to) return false;
      if (band.targetKind === "venue") return true;
      if (band.targetKind === "service") return band.venueServiceId === venueServiceId;
      return band.targetKind === "booking" && (band.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("online");
    }
    export function onlineSeatingLeft(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      date: string,
      nowMinute: number
    ): boolean {
      const day = resolveDay({ timezone, config }, date);
      if (!day.bookingOpen.online) return false;
      return day.services.some(
        (service) =>
          service.bookingTypes.includes("online") &&
          seatingMinutes(service).some(
            (minute) =>
              minute >= nowMinute &&
              !day.closures.some((band) => closesOnline(band, minute, service.venueServiceId))
          )
      );
    }
  </file>

        typeof state === "object" &&
        state !== null &&
        "openedFrom" in state &&
        state.openedFrom === "hub"
      );
    }

    export function outcomeSummary(counts: OutcomeCounts, t: TFunction): string {
      return (["cancel", "move", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"] as const)
        .filter((a) => counts[a] > 0)
        .map((a) => t(`availability.close.button.part.${a}`, { count: counts[a] }))
        .join(" · ");
    }
    export function outcomeLabel(counts: OutcomeCounts, t: TFunction): string {
      const parts = (["cancel", "move", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"] as const)
        .filter((a) => counts[a] > 0)
        .map((a) => ({ a, count: counts[a] }));
      // Nothing chosen yet: ask for a choice rather than render an empty "Close · ".
      if (parts.length === 0) return t("availability.close.button.choose");
      if (parts.length === 1) {
        const [only] = parts;
        return t(`availability.close.button.${only!.a}`, { count: only!.count });
      }
      return t("availability.close.button.mixed", {
        parts: parts
          .map((p) => t(`availability.close.button.part.${p.a}`, { count: p.count }))
          .join(" · "),
      });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/pause-online-draft.ts">
    export type PauseChoice = "tonight" | "untilResume" | "untilDate";
    export const PAUSE_CHOICES: readonly PauseChoice[] = ["tonight", "untilResume", "untilDate"];
    export interface PauseDraft {
      readonly choice: PauseChoice;
      /** The last date paused, for `untilDate`; empty until it is picked, and unread otherwise. */
      readonly until: string;
      readonly guestMessage: string;
    }
    function pauseOnlineForm(draft: PauseDraft, today: string): CloseForm {
      const { choice } = draft;
      return {
        what: { kind: "booking", types: ["online"] },
        when:
          choice === "tonight"
            ? { kind: "tonight" }
            : choice === "untilResume"
              ? { kind: "until-reopen", from: today }
              : { kind: "range", from: today, to: draft.until },
        fromMinute: null,
        staffNote: "",
        guestMessage: draft.guestMessage,
      };
    }
    export function pauseUntilMax(today: string): string {
      return addDays(today, MAX_SPAN_DAYS);
    }
    export function pauseOnlineProblem(
      draft: PauseDraft,
      today: string
    ): "until" | "guestMessage" | null {
      if (draft.choice === "untilDate" && draft.until > pauseUntilMax(today)) return "until";
      const problem = validateClose(pauseOnlineForm(draft, today), today);
      // A pause always says what it pauses, so the only other problem is its dates.
      return problem === null || problem === "guestMessage" ? problem : "until";
    }
    export function pauseOnlineRule(draft: PauseDraft, id: string, today: string): DateRule | null {
      if (pauseOnlineProblem(draft, today) !== null) return null;
      return buildCloseRule(pauseOnlineForm(draft, today), id, today);
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/period.ts">
    export function periodLabel(
      view: CalendarView,
      anchor: string,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      if (view === "month") {
        return format.formatCalendarDate(anchor, { month: "long", year: "numeric" });
      }
      const week = visibleDates("week", anchor);
      return t("availability.toolbar.range", {
        from: format.formatCalendarDate(week[0] ?? anchor, { month: "short", day: "numeric" }),
        to: format.formatCalendarDate(week[6] ?? anchor, {
          month: "short",
          day: "numeric",
          year: "numeric",
        }),
      });
    }
    export function weekSummary(
      anchor: string,
      days: readonly AvailabilityDaySummary[] | undefined,
      t: TFunction,
      service?: ServiceFilter | null
    ): string | null {
      const week = new Set(visibleDates("week", anchor));
      const loaded = (filterDays(days, service ?? null) ?? []).filter((d) => week.has(d.serviceDate));
      if (loaded.length === 0) return null;
      // A whole-day venue closure already empties `serviceCount`; booking, service and tables
      // closures leave the day open.
      const open = loaded.filter((d) => d.serviceCount > 0);
      const closures = new Set(loaded.flatMap((d) => d.closures.map((c) => c.ruleId)));
      const onlineOff = open.filter((d) => !d.bookingOpen.online).length;
      const online =
        onlineOff === open.length ? "onlineOff" : onlineOff === 0 ? "onlineOn" : "onlinePartial";
      const parts = [
        t("availability.weekSummary.open", { count: open.length }),
        // "0 closures" is a fact nobody needs: the line names closures only when there are some.
        ...(closures.size > 0
          ? [t("availability.weekSummary.closures", { count: closures.size })]
          : []),
        t(`availability.weekSummary.${online}`),
      ];
      return service
        ? t("availability.weekSummary.lineForService", {
            service: service.name,
            parts: parts.join(" · "),
          })
        : t("availability.weekSummary.line", { parts: parts.join(" · ") });
    }

    export const EVERY_DAY = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
    export function draftService(

  <file path="src/components/availability/quick-setup-draft.ts">
    export type KeptHours = Pick<ServiceHours, "seating" | "bookingTypes">;
    export interface DraftTimes extends LinkedTimes {
      /**
       * The stored seating and booking types of these hours (`draftFromConfig`), so a set's own are
       * not overwritten by the base's. Absent on hours the form made: they take the service's stored
       * ones (`draftToConfig`'s `keptOf`), or quick setup's defaults.
       */
      readonly kept?: KeptHours;
    }
    export interface HoursBlock extends DraftTimes {
      readonly id: string;
      /** Stored weekday indexes, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. */
      readonly days: readonly number[];
      /**
       * Which of its seating and booking types the block had unlike its service's when the service's
       * was changed (`setServiceKept`): it keeps those through later changes, even one that brings
       * the service to the same value on the way to another. Form state only; never saved.
       */
      readonly ownKept?: { readonly seating: boolean; readonly bookingTypes: boolean };
    }
    export interface ServiceDraft extends DraftTimes {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name: string;
      /** `null` follows the shared {@link QuickSetupDraft.days}. */
      readonly days: readonly number[] | null;
      readonly blocks: readonly HoursBlock[];
      /**
       * Set when a name chip moved the service off its preset times to follow the others (Late
       * after Dinner), with the times it gave; while they are untouched a change of days re-places it.
       */
      readonly autoPlaced?: {
        readonly preset: ServicePresetId;
        readonly opens: string;
        readonly closes: string;
      };
    }
    export interface QuickSetupDraft {
      readonly services: readonly ServiceDraft[];
      /** Shared days, for the services that follow them. Stored weekday indexes, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. */
      readonly days: readonly number[];
    }
    export const SERVICE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 40;
    export const WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0];
    export const WEEKDAY_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    export const WEEKEND_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [6, 0];
    export const FRIDAY_SATURDAY_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [5, 6];
    export const SERVICE_PRESETS = {
      lunch: { opens: "11:30", closes: "14:30" },
      brunch: { opens: "10:00", closes: "14:00" },
      dinner: { opens: "17:00", closes: "22:00" },
      late: { opens: "22:00", closes: "01:00" },
    } as const;
    export type ServicePresetId = keyof typeof SERVICE_PRESETS;
    export const SERVICE_PRESET_IDS = Object.keys(SERVICE_PRESETS) as ServicePresetId[];
    export function emptyService(id: string): ServiceDraft {
      return {
        id,
        name: "",
        opens: null,
        lastSeating: null,
        closes: null,
        lastSeatingLinked: true,
        days: null,
        blocks: [],
      };
    }
    export function emptyDraft(firstServiceId: string): QuickSetupDraft {
      return { services: [emptyService(firstServiceId)], days: [] };
    }
    export function applyPreset(service: ServiceDraft, preset: ServicePresetId, name: string) {
      const { opens, closes } = SERVICE_PRESETS[preset];
      return {
        ...service,
        name,
        opens,
        closes,
        lastSeating: autoLastSeating(closes, opens),
        lastSeatingLinked: true,
      };
    }
    export function replaceService(draft: QuickSetupDraft, next: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupDraft {
      return { ...draft, services: draft.services.map((s) => (s.id === next.id ? next : s)) };
    }
    export function toggleDayIn(days: readonly number[], day: number): readonly number[] {
      return days.includes(day) ? days.filter((d) => d !== day) : [...days, day];
    }
    function keepDays<T extends { readonly days: readonly number[] }>(
      blocks: readonly T[],
      allowed: readonly number[]
    ): T[] {
      return blocks.map((block) => ({
        ...block,
        days: block.days.filter((day) => allowed.includes(day)),
      }));
    }
    export function setServiceDays(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      days: readonly number[] | null,
      sharedDays: readonly number[]
    ): ServiceDraft {
      return { ...service, days, blocks: keepDays(service.blocks, days ?? sharedDays) };
    }
    export function setSharedDays(draft: QuickSetupDraft, days: readonly number[]): QuickSetupDraft {
      return {
        ...draft,
        days,
        services: draft.services.map((service) =>
          service.days === null ? { ...service, blocks: keepDays(service.blocks, days) } : service
        ),
      };
    }
    export function addBlock(service: ServiceDraft, id: string): ServiceDraft {
      const { opens, lastSeating, closes, lastSeatingLinked, kept } = service;
      const block: HoursBlock = {
        id,
        days: [],
        opens,
        lastSeating,
        closes,
        lastSeatingLinked,
        ...(kept ? { kept } : {}),
      };
      return { ...service, blocks: [...service.blocks, block] };
    }
    export function replaceBlock(service: ServiceDraft, next: HoursBlock): ServiceDraft {
      return { ...service, blocks: service.blocks.map((b) => (b.id === next.id ? next : b)) };
    }
    export function removeBlock(service: ServiceDraft, blockId: string): ServiceDraft {
      return { ...service, blocks: service.blocks.filter((b) => b.id !== blockId) };
    }
    export interface BlockDayToggle {
      readonly service: ServiceDraft;
      /** The day was in another block and moved out of it. */
      readonly moved: boolean;
      /** Blocks the move left with no day; they are gone from `service`. */
      readonly removed: readonly HoursBlock[];
    }
    export function toggleBlockDay(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      blockId: string,
      day: number
    ): BlockDayToggle {
      const target = service.blocks.find((b) => b.id === blockId);
      if (!target) return { service, moved: false, removed: [] };
      if (target.days.includes(day)) {
        const next = { ...target, days: toggleDayIn(target.days, day) };
        return { service: replaceBlock(service, next), moved: false, removed: [] };
      }
      const moved = service.blocks.some((b) => b.id !== blockId && b.days.includes(day));
      const removed = service.blocks.filter((b) => b.id !== blockId && b.days.join() === String(day));
      const blocks = service.blocks.flatMap((b): HoursBlock[] => {
        if (b.id === blockId) return [{ ...b, days: [...b.days, day] }];
        if (!b.days.includes(day)) return [b];
        return removed.includes(b) ? [] : [{ ...b, days: b.days.filter((d) => d !== day) }];
      });
      return { service: { ...service, blocks }, moved, removed };
    }
    export function setBlockDays(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      blockId: string,
      days: readonly number[],
      offered: readonly number[]
    ): BlockDayToggle {
      const wanted = days.filter((day) => offered.includes(day));
      const others = service.blocks.filter((b) => b.id !== blockId);
      const removed = others.filter(
        (b) => b.days.length > 0 && b.days.every((day) => wanted.includes(day))
      );
      const moved = others.some((b) => b.days.some((day) => wanted.includes(day)));
      const blocks = service.blocks.flatMap((b): HoursBlock[] => {
        if (b.id === blockId) return [{ ...b, days: wanted }];
        return removed.includes(b)
          ? []
          : [{ ...b, days: b.days.filter((day) => !wanted.includes(day)) }];
      });
      return { service: { ...service, blocks }, moved, removed };
    }
    export interface ServiceMinutes {
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
    }
    export function minutesOf(
      service: Pick<DraftTimes, "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes">
    ): ServiceMinutes | null {
      if (service.opens === null || service.lastSeating === null || service.closes === null)
        return null;
      const opensAt = toMinutes(service.opens);
      const afterOpen = (hhmm: string, strict: boolean) => {
        const m = toMinutes(hhmm);
        return strict
          ? m <= opensAt
            ? m + MINUTES_PER_DAY
            : m
          : m < opensAt
            ? m + MINUTES_PER_DAY
            : m;
      };
      return {
        opensAt,
        closesAt: afterOpen(service.closes, true),
        lastSeatingAt: afterOpen(service.lastSeating, false),
      };
    }
    export function effectiveDays(draft: QuickSetupDraft, service: ServiceDraft): readonly number[] {
      return service.days ?? draft.days;
    }
    export function coveredDays(draft: QuickSetupDraft): number[] {
      const days =
        draft.services.length === 0
          ? draft.days
          : draft.services.flatMap((service) => effectiveDays(draft, service));
      return [...new Set(days)].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    }
    export const DEFAULT_KEPT: KeptHours = {
      seating: { version: 1, interval: SEATING_INTERVAL_MINUTES },
      bookingTypes: ["online", "phone"],
    };
    function hoursOf(m: ServiceMinutes, kept: KeptHours | undefined): ServiceHours {
      return { ...m, ...(kept ?? DEFAULT_KEPT) };
    }
    function weekOf(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      service: ServiceDraft,
      m: ServiceMinutes,
      keptOf: KeptHours | undefined
    ) {
      const running = new Set(effectiveDays(draft, service));
      const base = hoursOf(m, service.kept ?? keptOf);
      // A day in two blocks (the form moves it out of the first) takes the last block's hours.
      const blocks = service.blocks
        .flatMap((block) => {
          const bm = minutesOf(block);
          return bm ? [{ days: block.days, hours: hoursOf(bm, block.kept ?? keptOf) }] : [];
        })
        .reverse();
      return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, day) =>
        running.has(day) ? (blocks.find((b) => b.days.includes(day))?.hours ?? base) : null
      );
    }
    export function draftToConfig(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      newId: () => string,
      existing?: {
        regularScheduleId?: string;
        venueServiceIds?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
        /** The days the rows are encoded over, when the schedule's use is fixed apart from the draft. */
        coveredDays?: readonly number[];
        /** Per venue service id, the seating and booking types hours the draft carries none for take. */
        keptOf?: Readonly<Record<string, KeptHours>>;
      }
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      const scheduleId = existing?.regularScheduleId ?? newId();
      const schedule: Schedule = {
        id: scheduleId,
        name: "Regular week",
        kind: "regular",
        isRegular: true,
      };
      const venueServices: VenueService[] = [];
      const week: ServiceWeek[] = [];
      draft.services.forEach((service, position) => {
        const m = minutesOf(service);
        if (m === null) return;
        const name = service.name.trim();
        const venueServiceId = existing?.venueServiceIds?.[name.toLowerCase()] ?? newId();
        venueServices.push({ id: venueServiceId, name, position });
        week.push({
          venueServiceId,
          days: weekOf(draft, service, m, existing?.keptOf?.[venueServiceId]),
        });
      });
      const covered = existing?.coveredDays ?? coveredDays(draft);
      const scheduleServices: ScheduleService[] = encodeWeek(week, covered).map((row) => ({
        id: newId(),
        scheduleId,
        ...row,
      }));
      const assignment: ScheduleAssignment = {
        id: newId(),
        scheduleId,
        weekdays: [...covered],
        precedence: 0,
      };
      return {
        schedules: [schedule],
        venueServices,
        scheduleServices,
        assignments: [assignment],
        dateRules: [],
      };
    }
    function clockTimes(hours: ServiceHours): DraftTimes {
      const opens = toClock(hours.opensAt);
      const closes = toClock(hours.closesAt);
      const lastSeating = toClock(hours.lastSeatingAt);
      return {
        opens,
        lastSeating,
        closes,
        lastSeatingLinked: lastSeating === autoLastSeating(closes, opens),
        kept: { seating: hours.seating, bookingTypes: hours.bookingTypes },
      };
    }
    export function scheduleDays(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      scheduleId: string,
      anyDay = false
    ): number[] {
      const assigned = [
        ...new Set(
          config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId).flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)
        ),
      ].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      return assigned.length === 0 && anyDay ? [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] : assigned;
    }
    export function draftFromConfig(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      newId: () => string,
      scheduleId?: string
    ): QuickSetupDraft {
      const regular = scheduleId
        ? config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId)
        : config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular);
      if (!regular) return emptyDraft(newId());
      const covered = scheduleDays(config, regular.id, scheduleId !== undefined);
      const rows = config.scheduleServices.filter((row) => row.scheduleId === regular.id);
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((vs) => [vs.id, vs]));
      const positionOf = (id: string) => names.get(id)?.position ?? 0;
      const week = [...decodeWeek(rows, covered)].sort(
        (a, b) => positionOf(a.venueServiceId) - positionOf(b.venueServiceId)
      );
      const services = encodeWeek(week, covered).flatMap((row): ServiceDraft[] => {
        const venueService = names.get(row.venueServiceId);
        const running = week.find((w) => w.venueServiceId === row.venueServiceId);
        if (!venueService || !running) return [];
        const days = WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER.filter((day) => running.days[day] !== null);
        return [
          {
            ...clockTimes(row),
            id: newId(),
            name: venueService.name,
            days: days.length === covered.length ? null : days,
            blocks: row.dayHours.sets.map((set) => ({
              ...clockTimes(set),
              id: newId(),
              days: set.weekdays,
            })),
          },
        ];
      });
      return services.length === 0 ? emptyDraft(newId()) : { services, days: covered };
    }
    export function draftToChanges(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      stored: AvailabilityConfig,
      newId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const regular = stored.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular);
      const venueServiceIds = Object.fromEntries(
        stored.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => [s.name.toLowerCase(), s.id])
      );
      const next = draftToConfig(draft, newId, {
        ...(regular ? { regularScheduleId: regular.id } : {}),
        venueServiceIds,
      });
      const scheduleId = next.schedules[0]?.id;
      const storedServiceIds = new Set(stored.venueServices.map((s) => s.id));
      return {
        upsert: {
          schedules: next.schedules,
          venueServices: next.venueServices.filter((s) => !storedServiceIds.has(s.id)),
          scheduleServices: next.scheduleServices,
          assignments: next.assignments,
        },
        remove: {
          scheduleServices: stored.scheduleServices
            .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId)
            .map((s) => s.id),
          assignments: stored.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId).map((a) => a.id),
        },
      };
    }
    export interface OperatingHoursValidationErrors {
      readonly global?: string;
      readonly days?: Readonly<Partial<Record<keyof OperatingHours, string>>>;
    }
    export function validateQuickSetupHours(
      hours: OperatingHours,
      t: TFunction = localeRuntime.i18n.t
    ): OperatingHoursValidationErrors | null {
      return Object.keys(hours).length === 0 ? { global: t("onboarding.hours.atLeastOne") } : null;
    }
    export function draftToLegacyHours(draft: QuickSetupDraft): OperatingHours {
      let n = 0;
      const projected = projectLegacyOperatingHours(draftToConfig(draft, () => `wizard-${++n}`));
      const hours: OperatingHours = {};
      for (const [day, value] of Object.entries(projected)) {
        if (!value.closed)
          hours[day as keyof OperatingHours] = { open: value.open, close: value.close };
      }
      return hours;
    }
    export function draftFromLegacyHours(hours: OperatingHours, serviceId: string): QuickSetupDraft {
      const order = [
        "sunday",
        "monday",
        "tuesday",
        "wednesday",
        "thursday",
        "friday",
        "saturday",
      ] as const;
      const open = order.flatMap((day, index) => {
        const value = hours[day];
        return value && !value.closed ? [{ index, value }] : [];
      });
      const first = open[0]?.value;
      if (!first) return emptyDraft(serviceId);
      return {
        services: [
          {
            ...emptyService(serviceId),
            opens: first.open,
            closes: first.close,
            lastSeating: autoLastSeating(first.close, first.open),
          },
        ],
        days: open.map((o) => o.index),
      };
    }

    export const QuickSetupIdScopeContext = createContext(DEFAULT_SCOPE);
    export function quickSetupFieldId(
      serviceId: string | null,
      field: QuickSetupField | "days",
      blockId?: string,
      scope: string = DEFAULT_SCOPE
    ) {
      if (serviceId === null) return `${scope}-days`;
      return `${quickSetupRowScope(serviceId, blockId, scope)}-${field}`;
    }
    function quickSetupRowScope(serviceId: string, blockId?: string, scope: string = DEFAULT_SCOPE) {
      return `${scope}-${serviceId}${blockId === undefined ? "" : `-${blockId}`}`;
    }
    export function useQuickSetupRowScope() {
      const scope = use(QuickSetupIdScopeContext);
      return (serviceId: string, blockId?: string) => quickSetupRowScope(serviceId, blockId, scope);
    }
    export function useQuickSetupFieldId() {
      const scope = use(QuickSetupIdScopeContext);
      return useCallback(
        (serviceId: string | null, field: QuickSetupField | "days", blockId?: string) =>
          quickSetupFieldId(serviceId, field, blockId, scope),
        [scope]
      );

        [scope]
      );

    export function focusFirstInvalid(issues: readonly QuickSetupIssue[], scope: string) {

        .getElementById(quickSetupFieldId(first.serviceId, first.field, first.blockId, scope))
        ?.focus();

    export function issuesFor(

  <file path="src/components/availability/quick-setup-line.ts">
    export type LineFormat = Pick<VenueFormat, "formatCalendarDate" | "formatLocalTime" | "locale">;
    export interface ServiceLineText {
      /** The service's name, else "Service N" by position. */
      readonly name: string;
      /** "11:30 AM–3:00 PM · Every day · other hours Fri, Sat"; the parts that are known. */
      readonly summary: string;
    }
    export function serviceLineText(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      format: LineFormat,
      t: TFunction
    ): ServiceLineText {
      const index = draft.services.findIndex((s) => s.id === service.id);
      const name =
        service.name.trim() || t("availability.quickSetup.serviceN", { n: Math.max(index, 0) + 1 });
      const parts: string[] = [];
      if (service.opens !== null && service.closes !== null) {
        const wraps = toMinutes(service.closes) <= toMinutes(service.opens);
        const range = `${format.formatLocalTime(service.opens)}–${format.formatLocalTime(service.closes)}`;
        parts.push(wraps ? `${range} ${t("availability.quickSetup.line.nextDay")}` : range);
      }
      // The form's own "Every day" reads as a sentence start; the shared summary's reads mid-sentence.
      const dayText = (list: readonly number[]) =>
        list.length === 7
          ? t("availability.quickSetup.shortcuts.everyDay")
          : weekdaySummary(list, format, t);
      const days = effectiveDays(draft, service);
      if (days.length > 0) parts.push(dayText(days));
      const otherDays = WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER.filter((day) =>
        service.blocks.some((block) => block.days.includes(day))
      );
      if (otherDays.length > 0) {
        parts.push(
          t("availability.quickSetup.line.otherHours", { days: weekdaySummary(otherDays, format, t) })
        );
      }
      return {
        name,
        summary: parts.join(" · "),
      };
    }
