  <file path="src/components/availability/quick-setup-options.ts">
    export function shownKept(times: Pick<DraftTimes, "kept">, stored?: KeptHours): KeptHours {
      return times.kept ?? stored ?? DEFAULT_KEPT;
    }
    function settled(next: KeptHours, held: readonly (KeptHours | undefined)[]): KeptHours {
      const known = held.filter((kept) => kept !== undefined);
      return {
        seating: known.find((kept) => sameSeating(kept.seating, next.seating))?.seating ?? next.seating,
        bookingTypes:
          known.find((kept) => sameBookingTypes(kept.bookingTypes, next.bookingTypes))?.bookingTypes ??
          next.bookingTypes,
      };
    }
    export function setServiceKept(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      next: KeptHours,
      stored?: KeptHours
    ): ServiceDraft {
      const was = shownKept(service, stored);
      const kept = settled(next, [stored, was]);
      return {
        ...service,
        kept,
        blocks: service.blocks.map((block) => followService(block, { was, kept, stored })),
      };
    }
    function followService(
      block: HoursBlock,
      change: { readonly was: KeptHours; readonly kept: KeptHours; readonly stored?: KeptHours }
    ): HoursBlock {
      const own = shownKept(block, change.stored);
      // A value the block had unlike its service's stays the block's for good: without the mark, a
      // service changed to that value and then to another would take the block along.
      const ownKept = {
        seating: block.ownKept?.seating === true || !sameSeating(own.seating, change.was.seating),
        bookingTypes:
          block.ownKept?.bookingTypes === true ||
          !sameBookingTypes(own.bookingTypes, change.was.bookingTypes),
      };
      return {
        ...block,
        ownKept,
        kept: {
          seating: ownKept.seating ? own.seating : change.kept.seating,
          bookingTypes: ownKept.bookingTypes ? own.bookingTypes : change.kept.bookingTypes,
        },
      };
    }
    export function keepsOwnSettings(service: KeptHours, block: KeptHours): boolean {
      return (
        !sameSeating(service.seating, block.seating) ||
        !sameBookingTypes(service.bookingTypes, block.bookingTypes)
      );
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/quick-setup-placement.ts">
    function lengthOf(opens: string, closes: string): number {
      const length = toMinutes(closes) - toMinutes(opens);
      return length > 0 ? length : length + MINUTES_PER_DAY;
    }
    function isClear(draft: QuickSetupDraft, candidate: ServiceDraft): boolean {
      const days = effectiveDays(draft, candidate);
      const sharing = draft.services.filter(
        (s) =>
          s.id !== candidate.id &&
          minutesOf(s) !== null &&
          effectiveDays(draft, s).some((d) => days.includes(d))
      );
      const named = (s: ServiceDraft): ServiceDraft => ({ ...s, name: "service" });
      const issues = validateDraft({
        ...draft,
        services: [...sharing.map(named), named(candidate)],
      });
      return !issues.some((i) => i.code === "overlap" || i.code === "span_too_long");
    }
    export function placePreset(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      serviceId: string,
      preset: ServicePresetId,
      name: string
    ): ServiceDraft {
      const { autoPlaced: _previous, ...service } =
        draft.services.find((s) => s.id === serviceId) ?? emptyService(serviceId);
      const defaults = applyPreset(service, preset, name);
      if (preset !== "late" || isClear(draft, defaults)) return defaults;
      const days = effectiveDays(draft, service);
      const closes = draft.services
        .filter((s) => s.id !== serviceId)
        .flatMap((s) => {
          const minutes = minutesOf(s);
          return minutes !== null && effectiveDays(draft, s).some((d) => days.includes(d))
            ? [minutes.closesAt]
            : [];
        });
      if (closes.length === 0) return defaults;
      const start = Math.max(...closes);
      if (start >= MINUTES_PER_DAY) return defaults;
      const own = SERVICE_PRESETS[preset];
      const end = start + lengthOf(own.opens, own.closes);
      const placed = {
        ...defaults,
        opens: toClock(start),
        closes: toClock(end),
        lastSeating: autoLastSeating(toClock(end), toClock(start)),
      };
      return isClear(draft, placed)
        ? { ...placed, autoPlaced: { preset, opens: placed.opens, closes: placed.closes } }
        : defaults;
    }
    export function setDaysAndReplace(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      service: ServiceDraft,
      days: readonly number[] | null
    ): ServiceDraft {
      const next = setServiceDays(service, days, draft.days);
      const placed = service.autoPlaced;
      if (!placed || service.opens !== placed.opens || service.closes !== placed.closes) return next;
      return placePreset(replaceService(draft, next), next.id, placed.preset, next.name);
    }
    export type OverlapDayShortcut = "weekdays" | "weekends" | "fridaySaturday";
    export function overlapDayFix(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      serviceId: string
    ): { readonly shortcut: OverlapDayShortcut; readonly days: readonly number[] } | null {
      const service = draft.services.find((s) => s.id === serviceId);
      if (!service) return null;
      const current = effectiveDays(draft, service);
      for (const { id, days } of DAY_FIX_SHORTCUTS) {
        if (days.length >= current.length || !days.every((day) => current.includes(day))) continue;
        const next = setServiceDays(service, days, draft.days);
        if (isClear(draft, next)) return { shortcut: id, days };
      }
      return null;
    }
    export function moveServiceStart(service: ServiceDraft, opensAt: number): ServiceDraft {
      if (service.opens === null || service.closes === null) return service;
      const closes = toClock(opensAt + lengthOf(service.opens, service.closes));
      const opens = toClock(opensAt);
      const shift = opensAt - toMinutes(service.opens);
      const lastSeating = service.lastSeatingLinked
        ? autoLastSeating(closes, opens)
        : service.lastSeating === null
          ? null
          : toClock(toMinutes(service.lastSeating) + shift);
      return { ...service, opens, closes, lastSeating };
    }
    export function firstClearStart(draft: QuickSetupDraft, serviceId: string): number | null {
      const service = draft.services.find((s) => s.id === serviceId);
      if (!service || service.opens === null || service.closes === null) return null;
      for (let from = toMinutes(service.opens); from < MINUTES_PER_DAY; from += START_STEP_MINUTES) {
        if (isClear(draft, moveServiceStart(service, from))) return from;
      }
      return null;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/quick-setup-validate.ts">
    export type QuickSetupField = "name" | "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes";
    export type QuickSetupIssueCode =
      | "name_required"
      | "name_too_long"
      | "time_required"
      | "close_after_open"
      | "last_seating_after_close"
      | "span_too_long"
      | "legacy_closed_day"
      | "overlap"
      | "days_required"
      | "block_days_required"
      | "days_outside_use";
    export interface QuickSetupIssue {
      /** `null` for the whole card (the shared days). */
      readonly serviceId: string | null;
      /** Set when the problem is inside one of the service's different-hours blocks. */
      readonly blockId?: string;
      readonly field: QuickSetupField | "days";
      readonly code: QuickSetupIssueCode;
      /** `overlap` on some weekdays only: the weekday (0 = Sunday) and the service it overlaps. */
      readonly weekday?: number;
      readonly otherServiceId?: string;
      /** An overlap said again on the other service's row (`overlapsAgainst`); it offers no fix there. */
      readonly mirrored?: true;
    }
    interface IssueOwner {
      readonly serviceId: string;
      readonly blockId?: string;
    }
    function missingTimes(times: DraftTimes, owner: IssueOwner): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      return TIME_FIELDS.filter(([key]) => times[key] === null).map(([, field]): QuickSetupIssue => ({
        ...owner,
        field,
        code: "time_required",
      }));
    }
    function completenessIssues(service: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const owner = { serviceId: service.id };
      const name = service.name.trim();
      const unnamed: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        name === ""
          ? [{ ...owner, field: "name", code: "name_required" }]
          : name.length > SERVICE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH
            ? [{ ...owner, field: "name", code: "name_too_long" }]
            : [];
      return [...unnamed, ...missingTimes(service, owner)];
    }
    function orderIssues(times: DraftTimes, m: ServiceMinutes, owner: IssueOwner): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const at = (field: QuickSetupField, code: QuickSetupIssueCode): QuickSetupIssue => ({
        ...owner,
        field,
        code,
      });
      if (times.opens === times.closes) return [at("closes", "close_after_open")];
      return m.lastSeatingAt > m.closesAt ? [at("lastSeating", "last_seating_after_close")] : [];
    }
    function timesIssues(times: DraftTimes, owner: IssueOwner): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const missing = missingTimes(times, owner);
      const minutes = minutesOf(times);
      return missing.length > 0 || minutes === null ? missing : orderIssues(times, minutes, owner);
    }
    function serviceIssues(service: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const missing = completenessIssues(service);
      const minutes = minutesOf(service);
      const times =
        missing.length > 0 || minutes === null
          ? missing
          : orderIssues(service, minutes, { serviceId: service.id });
      const days: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        service.days !== null && service.days.length === 0
          ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "days", code: "days_required" }]
          : [];
      const blocks = service.blocks.flatMap((block): QuickSetupIssue[] => {
        const owner = { serviceId: service.id, blockId: block.id };
        const blockDays: QuickSetupIssue[] =
          block.days.length === 0 ? [{ ...owner, field: "days", code: "block_days_required" }] : [];
        return [...timesIssues(block, owner), ...blockDays];
      });
      return [...times, ...days, ...blocks];
    }
    export function validateDraft(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      options: { readonly legacyReader?: boolean; readonly within?: readonly number[] } = {}
    ): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      // `within`: the days an edited schedule is used on. Rows are stored over those days only, so a
      // service whose own days are all outside would be dropped and its stored row deleted.
      const outside: QuickSetupIssue[] = draft.services.flatMap((service) =>
        options.within &&
        service.days !== null &&
        service.days.length > 0 &&
        service.days.every((day) => !options.within?.includes(day))
          ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "days" as const, code: "days_outside_use" as const }]
          : []
      );
      const perService = [...draft.services.flatMap(serviceIssues), ...outside];
      // The shared days are needed only while a service follows them.
      const followsShared = draft.services.length === 0 || draft.services.some((s) => s.days === null);
      const daysIssue: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        followsShared && draft.days.length === 0
          ? [{ serviceId: null, field: "days", code: "days_required" }]
          : [];
      if (perService.length > 0) return [...perService, ...daysIssue];
    
      let n = 0;
      const config = draftToConfig(draft, () => `check-${++n}`);
      const serviceByVenueService = new Map(
        config.venueServices.map((vs) => [vs.id, draft.services[vs.position]])
      );
      const serviceAt = (path: string) => {
        const row = config.scheduleServices[Number(/scheduleServices\[(\d+)\]/.exec(path)?.[1])];
        return row ? serviceByVenueService.get(row.venueServiceId) : undefined;
      };
      const overlaps = validateConfig(config)
        .filter((issue) => issue.code === "overlap")
        .flatMap((issue): QuickSetupIssue[] => {
          const service = serviceAt(issue.path);
          if (!service) return [];
          const other = issue.otherPath === undefined ? undefined : serviceAt(issue.otherPath);
          const { weekday } = issue;
          const block =
            weekday === undefined ? undefined : service.blocks.find((b) => b.days.includes(weekday));
          return [
            {
              serviceId: service.id,
              ...(block ? { blockId: block.id } : {}),
              field: "opens",
              code: "overlap",
              ...(weekday !== undefined ? { weekday } : {}),
              ...(other ? { otherServiceId: other.id } : {}),
            },
          ];
        });
      return [...overlaps, ...spanIssues(draft, options.legacyReader === true), ...daysIssue];
    }
    export function overlapsAgainst(
      issues: readonly QuickSetupIssue[],
      serviceId: string
    ): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      return issues.flatMap(({ blockId: _block, ...issue }) =>
        issue.code === "overlap" && issue.otherServiceId === serviceId && issue.serviceId !== null
          ? [{ ...issue, serviceId, otherServiceId: issue.serviceId, mirrored: true as const }]
          : []
      );
    }
    export function serviceLabel(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      id: string | null | undefined,
      t: TFunction
    ): string {
      const index = draft.services.findIndex((s) => s.id === id);
      return (
        draft.services[index]?.name.trim() || t("availability.quickSetup.serviceN", { n: index + 1 })
      );
    }
    export function issueMessage(
      issue: QuickSetupIssue,
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      t: TFunction,
      weekdayName: (weekday: number) => string
    ): string {
      const nameOf = (id: string | null | undefined) => serviceLabel(draft, id, t);
      if (issue.code === "overlap" && issue.weekday !== undefined) {
        return t("availability.quickSetup.issues.overlap_on", {
          service: nameOf(issue.serviceId),
          other: nameOf(issue.otherServiceId),
          day: weekdayName(issue.weekday),
        });
      }
      if (issue.code === "days_required" && issue.serviceId !== null) {
        return t("availability.quickSetup.issues.days_required_service", {
          service: nameOf(issue.serviceId),
        });
      }
      return t(`availability.quickSetup.issues.${issue.code}`);
    }
    export function previewOverlapReason(
      issues: readonly QuickSetupIssue[],
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      t: TFunction,
      weekdayName: (weekday: number) => string
    ): string | null {
      if (issues.length === 0 || issues.some((i) => i.code !== "overlap")) return null;
      const first = issues[0];
      return first ? issueMessage(first, draft, t, weekdayName) : null;
    }
    function spanIssues(draft: QuickSetupDraft, legacyReader: boolean): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const read = normalizeLegacyHours(draftToLegacyHours(draft));
      const tooLong =
        read.ok &&
        WEEKDAYS.some((day) =>
          read.hours.weekly[day].some(
            (w) => w.wrapped === true && w.close - w.open > MAX_PAST_MIDNIGHT_SPAN
          )
        );
      const code: QuickSetupIssueCode | null = tooLong
        ? "span_too_long"
        : legacyReader && read.ok && hasClosedDay(draft, read.hours)
          ? "legacy_closed_day"
          : null;
      if (code === null) return [];
      const latest = draft.services.reduce<{ id: string; closesAt: number } | null>((acc, s) => {
        const m = minutesOf(s);
        return m && (!acc || m.closesAt > acc.closesAt) ? { id: s.id, closesAt: m.closesAt } : acc;
      }, null);
      return latest ? [{ serviceId: latest.id, field: "closes", code }] : [];
    }
    function hasClosedDay(draft: QuickSetupDraft, hours: LegacyHours): boolean {
      let n = 0;
      const built = buildLegacyConfig({ hours, today: "1970-01-01", newId: () => `legacy-${++n}` });
      if (!built.ok) return false;
      const open = new Set(built.config.assignments.flatMap((a) => a.weekdays));
      return coveredDays(draft).some((day) => !open.has(day));
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/regular-week-line.ts">
    export interface LineHours {
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
    }
    export interface HoursChange extends LineHours {
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
    }
    export interface RegularWeekLineService extends LineHours {
      readonly venueServiceId: string;
      readonly name: string;
      /** Every weekday the service runs, Monday first. */
      readonly days: readonly number[];
      /** Where its hours differ from its base hours, in the order the engine stores the sets. */
      readonly changes: readonly HoursChange[];
    }
    export interface RegularWeekLine {
      readonly services: readonly RegularWeekLineService[];
      /** Every service runs the same days with the same hours: no Details disclosure. */
      readonly uniform: boolean;
    }
    function inForce(config: AvailabilityConfig, today: string) {
      const live = config.schedules.filter((s) => s.kind === "regular" && !s.archivedAt);
      const running = config.assignments
        .filter(
          (a) =>
            live.some((s) => s.id === a.scheduleId) &&
            (a.startsOn == null || a.startsOn <= today) &&
            (a.endsOn == null || a.endsOn >= today)
        )
        .sort((a, b) => b.precedence - a.precedence)[0];
      return (
        live.find((s) => s.id === running?.scheduleId) ??
        config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt)
      );
    }
    export function regularWeekLine(config: AvailabilityConfig, today: string): RegularWeekLine {
      const schedule = inForce(config, today);
      if (!schedule) return NONE;
      const covered = [
        ...new Set(
          config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === schedule.id).flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)
        ),
      ];
      const rows = config.scheduleServices.filter((r) => r.scheduleId === schedule.id);
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((vs) => [vs.id, vs.name]));
      const canonical = encodeWeek(decodeWeek(rows, covered), covered);
    
      const services = canonical.flatMap((row): RegularWeekLineService[] => {
        const week = decodeWeek([row], covered)[0];
        const name = names.get(row.venueServiceId);
        if (!week || name === undefined) return [];
        return [
          {
            venueServiceId: row.venueServiceId,
            name,
            opensAt: row.opensAt,
            lastSeatingAt: row.lastSeatingAt,
            closesAt: row.closesAt,
            days: WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER.filter((day) => week.days[day] !== null),
            changes: row.dayHours.sets
              .filter(
                (set) =>
                  set.opensAt !== row.opensAt ||
                  set.lastSeatingAt !== row.lastSeatingAt ||
                  set.closesAt !== row.closesAt
              )
              .map((set) => ({
                weekdays: WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER.filter((day) => set.weekdays.includes(day)),
                opensAt: set.opensAt,
                lastSeatingAt: set.lastSeatingAt,
                closesAt: set.closesAt,
              })),
          },
        ];
      });
      const first = services[0]?.days.join();
      const uniform = services.every((s) => s.changes.length === 0 && s.days.join() === first);
      return { services, uniform };
    }
    export interface UpcomingRegularWeek {
      /** The first day the change is in force. */
      readonly startsOn: string;
      /** Its last day for a period; `null` when it becomes the regular week. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      /** The line as it will read on `startsOn`. */
      readonly line: RegularWeekLine;
    }
    export function upcomingRegularWeek(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      today: string
    ): UpcomingRegularWeek | null {
      const live = new Set(
        config.schedules.filter((s) => s.kind === "regular" && !s.archivedAt).map((s) => s.id)
      );
      const next = config.assignments
        .filter((a) => live.has(a.scheduleId) && a.startsOn != null && a.startsOn > today)
        .sort((a, b) => a.startsOn!.localeCompare(b.startsOn!))[0];
      if (!next?.startsOn) return null;
      const line = regularWeekLine(config, next.startsOn);
      return line.services.length === 0
        ? null
        : { startsOn: next.startsOn, endsOn: next.endsOn ?? null, line };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/removal-diff.ts">
    type Channel = keyof BookingOpen;
    export type RemovalChange =
      | { kind: "serviceOpens"; name: string; opensAt: number; closesAt: number }
      | { kind: "serviceCloses"; name: string }
      | { kind: "opensAtChanges"; name: string; minute: number }
      | { kind: "closesAtChanges"; name: string; minute: number; later: boolean }
      | { kind: "lastSeatingChanges"; name: string; minute: number }
      | { kind: "closureLifted"; closure: ResolvedClosure; serviceName?: string }
      | { kind: "closureApplies"; closure: ResolvedClosure }
      | { kind: "bookingOn"; channel: Channel }
      | { kind: "bookingOff"; channel: Channel }
      | { kind: "pacingLifted" }
      | { kind: "pacingSet"; covers: number };
    function serviceChanges(
      current: readonly ResolvedService[],
      removed: readonly ResolvedService[]
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      const now = new Map(current.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const then = new Map(removed.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const opening = removed
        .filter((s) => !now.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .map((s): RemovalChange => ({
          kind: "serviceOpens",
          name: s.name,
          opensAt: s.opensAt,
          closesAt: s.closesAt,
        }));
      const closing = current
        .filter((s) => !then.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .map((s): RemovalChange => ({ kind: "serviceCloses", name: s.name }));
      const adjusted = removed.flatMap((after): RemovalChange[] => {
        const before = now.get(after.venueServiceId);
        if (!before) return [];
        return [
          ...(before.opensAt !== after.opensAt
            ? [{ kind: "opensAtChanges" as const, name: after.name, minute: after.opensAt }]
            : []),
          ...(before.closesAt !== after.closesAt
            ? [
                {
                  kind: "closesAtChanges" as const,
                  name: after.name,
                  minute: after.closesAt,
                  later: after.closesAt > before.closesAt,
                },
              ]
            : []),
          ...(before.lastSeatingAt !== after.lastSeatingAt
            ? [
                {
                  kind: "lastSeatingChanges" as const,
                  name: after.name,
                  minute: after.lastSeatingAt,
                },
              ]
            : []),
        ];
      });
      return [...opening, ...closing, ...adjusted];
    }
    function closureChanges(
      current: readonly ResolvedClosure[],
      removed: readonly ResolvedClosure[],
      services: readonly ResolvedService[]
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      const nameOf = (c: ResolvedClosure) =>
        c.targetKind === "service"
          ? services.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === c.venueServiceId)?.name
          : undefined;
      // A whole-day closure of services or booking channels already shows up as those changes.
      const worthSaying = (c: ResolvedClosure) => !isWholeDay(c) || c.targetKind === "tables";
      return [
        ...current
          .filter((c) => !removed.some((r) => sameClosure(r, c)) && worthSaying(c))
          .map((closure): RemovalChange => ({
            kind: "closureLifted",
            closure,
            serviceName: nameOf(closure),
          })),
        ...removed
          .filter((c) => !current.some((r) => sameClosure(r, c)) && worthSaying(c))
          .map((closure): RemovalChange => ({ kind: "closureApplies", closure })),
      ];
    }
    function bookingChanges(current: BookingOpen, removed: BookingOpen): RemovalChange[] {
      return CHANNELS.flatMap((channel): RemovalChange[] => {
        if (current[channel] === removed[channel]) return [];
        return [{ kind: removed[channel] ? "bookingOn" : "bookingOff", channel }];
      });
    }
    function pacingChanges(current: ResolvedDaySummary, removed: ResolvedDaySummary): RemovalChange[] {
      if (current.pacingCovers === removed.pacingCovers) return [];
      return removed.pacingCovers === undefined
        ? [{ kind: "pacingLifted" }]
        : [{ kind: "pacingSet", covers: removed.pacingCovers }];
    }
    export function diffRemoval(
      current: ResolvedDaySummary,
      removed: ResolvedDaySummary
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      return [
        ...serviceChanges(current.services, removed.services),
        ...closureChanges(current.closures, removed.closures, current.services),
        ...bookingChanges(current.bookingOpen, removed.bookingOpen),
        ...pacingChanges(current, removed),
      ];
    }
    function liftedText(
      change: Extract<RemovalChange, { kind: "closureLifted" }>,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const { closure } = change;
      if (isWholeDay(closure)) return t("availability.drawer.removal.reopensAllDay");
      const range = {
        from: minuteText(closure.from, t, format),
        to: closureEndText(closure.to, t, format),
      };
      if (closure.targetKind === "booking") {
        const channels = (closure.bookingTypes ?? []).map((c) =>
          t(`availability.drawer.removal.channel.${c}`)
        );
        return t("availability.drawer.removal.channelBackOn", {
          ...range,
          channels: new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(channels),
        });
      }
      if (closure.targetKind === "service" && change.serviceName) {
        return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceReopens", { ...range, name: change.serviceName });
      }
      return t("availability.drawer.removal.reopens", range);
    }
    export function removalChangeText(
      change: RemovalChange,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const at = (minute: number) => minuteText(minute, t, format);
      switch (change.kind) {
        case "serviceOpens":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceOpens", {
            name: change.name,
            from: at(change.opensAt),
            to: at(change.closesAt),
          });
        case "serviceCloses":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceCloses", { name: change.name });
        case "opensAtChanges":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.opensAt", {
            name: change.name,
            time: at(change.minute),
            count: clockHour(change.minute),
          });
        case "closesAtChanges":
          return t(
            change.later
              ? "availability.drawer.removal.closesLater"
              : "availability.drawer.removal.closesEarlier",
            { name: change.name, time: at(change.minute), count: clockHour(change.minute) }
          );
        case "lastSeatingChanges":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.lastSeating", {
            name: change.name,
            time: at(change.minute),
            count: clockHour(change.minute),
          });
        case "closureLifted":
          return liftedText(change, t, format);
        case "closureApplies":
          return isWholeDay(change.closure)
            ? t("availability.calendar.closedAllDayName")
            : t("availability.drawer.removal.closes", {
                from: at(change.closure.from),
                to: closureEndText(change.closure.to, t, format),
              });
        case "bookingOn":
          return t(`availability.drawer.removal.bookingOn.${change.channel}`);
        case "bookingOff":
          return t(`availability.drawer.removal.bookingOff.${change.channel}`);
        case "pacingLifted":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.pacingLifted");
        case "pacingSet":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.pacingSet", { covers: change.covers });
      }
    }

    export function revertErrorText(error: unknown, t: TFunction): string {
      const code = error instanceof ApiClientError ? error.problemDetails.code : undefined;
      const known = REVERT_CODES.find((c) => c === code);
      return known ? t(`availability.undo.errors.${known}`) : describeApiError(error).detail;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/rule-subjects.ts">
    export const DATE_FORMAT = { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" } as const;
    export function rangeLabel(rule: SpecialDateRule, format: VenueFormat, t: TFunction): string {
      const from = format.formatCalendarDate(rule.startsOn, DATE_FORMAT);
      if (rule.endsOn == null) {
        // Hours are not "reopened": an open-ended hours rule just runs from its start on.
        return t(
          rule.kind === "closure" ? "availabilitySpecial.untilReopened" : "availabilitySpecial.fromOn",
          { from }
        );
      }
      if (rule.endsOn === rule.startsOn) return from;
      return t("availabilitySpecial.range", {
        from,
        to: format.formatCalendarDate(rule.endsOn, DATE_FORMAT),
      });
    }
    function weekdayList(rule: SpecialDateRule, format: VenueFormat): string {
      const days = (rule.repeat?.weekdays ?? []).map((d) =>
        format.formatCalendarDate(addDays(SUNDAY, d), { weekday: "long" })
      );
      return new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(days);
    }
    export function rowTitle(rule: SpecialDateRule, format: VenueFormat, t: TFunction): string {
      if (rule.repeat == null) return rangeLabel(rule, format, t);
      const days = weekdayList(rule, format);
      const short = { month: "short", day: "numeric" } as const;
      const from = format.formatCalendarDate(rule.startsOn, short);
      return rule.endsOn == null
        ? t("availabilitySpecial.repeatFrom", { days, from })
        : t("availabilitySpecial.repeatRange", {
            days,
            from,
            to: format.formatCalendarDate(rule.endsOn, short),
          });
    }
    export function hoursSubject(rule: SpecialDateRule, format: VenueFormat, t: TFunction): string {
      if (rule.repeat != null) {
        return t("availabilitySpecial.hours.subjectRepeat", { days: weekdayList(rule, format) });
      }
      return t("availabilitySpecial.hours.subjectDates", { dates: rangeLabel(rule, format, t) });
    }
    export function closureSubject(rule: SpecialDateRule, format: VenueFormat, t: TFunction): string {
      const from = format.formatCalendarDate(rule.startsOn, DATE_FORMAT);
      const span =
        rule.endsOn == null
          ? t("availabilitySpecial.reopen.fromOn", { from })
          : rule.endsOn === rule.startsOn
            ? from
            : t("availabilitySpecial.range", {
                from,
                to: format.formatCalendarDate(rule.endsOn, DATE_FORMAT),
              });
      if (rule.repeat != null) {
        return t("availabilitySpecial.reopen.subjectRepeat", {
          days: weekdayList(rule, format),
          span,
        });
      }
      return rule.endsOn == null ? t("availabilitySpecial.reopen.subjectOpen", { from }) : span;
    }
    export type ClosureKind =
      | { readonly kind: "venue" }
      | { readonly kind: "section"; readonly section: string }
      | { readonly kind: "booking"; readonly channels: NonNullable<SpecialDateRule["bookingTypes"]> };
    export function closureKindOf(
      rule: SpecialDateRule,
      sectionNames?: ReadonlyMap<string, string>
    ): ClosureKind {
      const channels = rule.bookingTypes ?? [];
      if (rule.targetKind === "booking" && channels.length > 0) {
        return { kind: "booking", channels };
      }
      const section =
        rule.targetKind === "tables" && rule.sectionId ? sectionNames?.get(rule.sectionId) : undefined;
      return section !== undefined ? { kind: "section", section } : { kind: "venue" };
    }

    export interface ScheduleUsagePeriod {
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
      /** `YYYY-MM-DD`; `null` when the assignment has no start. */
      readonly startsOn: string | null;
      /** `YYYY-MM-DD`; `null` when the assignment has no end. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
    }
    export type ScheduleUsage =
      | { readonly kind: "unused" }
      | { readonly kind: "rules"; readonly count: number }
      | { readonly kind: "periods"; readonly periods: readonly ScheduleUsagePeriod[] };
    export function scheduleUsage(config: AvailabilityConfig, scheduleId: string): ScheduleUsage {
      const uses = config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId);
      if (uses.length === 0) {
        const count = config.dateRules.filter(
          (r) => r.kind === "use_schedule" && r.useScheduleId === scheduleId
        ).length;
        return count > 0 ? { kind: "rules", count } : { kind: "unused" };
      }
      return {
        kind: "periods",
        periods: uses.map((a) => ({
          weekdays: a.weekdays,
          startsOn: a.startsOn || null,
          endsOn: a.endsOn || null,
        })),
      };
    }
    export function upcomingRules(rules: readonly DateRule[], today: string): DateRule[] {
      return rules
        .filter((r) => r.kind === "closure" || r.kind === "special_hours")
        .filter((r) => r.endsOn == null || r.endsOn >= today)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          a.startsOn === b.startsOn ? a.id.localeCompare(b.id) : a.startsOn < b.startsOn ? -1 : 1
        );
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/schedule-changes.ts">
    export interface UseOn {
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
      readonly startsOn?: string | null;
      readonly endsOn?: string | null;
    }
    export type Winner = "new" | "existing";
    export function weekdayRuns(weekdays: readonly number[]): [number, number][] {
      const positions = MONDAY_FIRST.flatMap((d, i) => (weekdays.includes(d) ? [i] : []));
      const runs: [number, number][] = [];
      let start = -1;
      positions.forEach((p, i) => {
        if (start < 0) start = p;
        if (positions[i + 1] !== p + 1) {
          runs.push([MONDAY_FIRST[start]!, MONDAY_FIRST[p]!]);
          start = -1;
        }
      });
      return runs;
    }
    export function isScheduleUnused(config: AvailabilityConfig, scheduleId: string): boolean {
      const schedule = config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId);
      if (!schedule || schedule.isRegular) return false;
      return (
        !config.assignments.some((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId) &&
        !config.dateRules.some((r) => r.kind === "use_schedule" && r.useScheduleId === scheduleId)
      );
    }
    export function buildDeleteScheduleChanges(scheduleId: string): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      return { upsert: {}, remove: { schedules: [scheduleId] } };
    }
    export type ScheduleSaveBlock =
      | "conflict"
      | "startRequired"
      | "endBeforeStart"
      | "nameRequired"
      | "servicesRequired"
      | "serviceNameRequired"
      | "replacesRegularWeek";
    export function scheduleSaveBlock(draft: {
      readonly conflicted: boolean;
      readonly name: string;
      /** A draft whose rows are quick-setup services has no `venueServiceId`; its own issues name them. */
      readonly services: readonly { readonly name: string; readonly venueServiceId?: string | null }[];
      readonly startsOn: string | null;
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      readonly startRequired?: boolean;
      /** False for a change with no end date: it is the regular week itself and is named by nothing. */
      readonly nameRequired?: boolean;
      /** A new schedule would take the regular week over for good (`replacesRegularWeek`). */
      readonly replacesRegularWeek?: boolean;
    }): ScheduleSaveBlock | null {
      const { startsOn, endsOn, services } = draft;
      if (draft.conflicted) return "conflict";
      if (draft.startRequired && !startsOn) return "startRequired";
      if (startsOn && endsOn && endsOn < startsOn) return "endBeforeStart";
      if (draft.nameRequired !== false && draft.name.trim() === "") return "nameRequired";
      if (services.length === 0) return "servicesRequired";
      if (services.some((s) => s.venueServiceId === null && !s.name.trim())) {
        return "serviceNameRequired";
      }
      if (draft.replacesRegularWeek) return "replacesRegularWeek";
      return null;
    }
    function regularWeekdays(config: AvailabilityConfig, today: string): number[] {
      const regular = new Set(
        liveSchedules(config)
          .filter((s) => s.kind === "regular")
          .map((s) => s.id)
      );
      return [
        ...new Set(
          config.assignments
            .filter((a) => regular.has(a.scheduleId) && (a.endsOn == null || a.endsOn >= today))
            .flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)
        ),
      ];
    }
    export function replacesRegularWeek(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      useOn: UseOn,
      today: string
    ): boolean {
      if (useOn.endsOn != null || useOn.weekdays.length === 0) return false;
      const days = regularWeekdays(config, today);
      return days.length > 0 && days.every((day) => useOn.weekdays.includes(day));
    }
    function meets(a: UseOn, b: UseOn): boolean {
      const shared = a.weekdays.filter((d) => b.weekdays.includes(d));
      if (shared.length === 0) return false;
      const from = [a.startsOn, b.startsOn]
        .filter((d): d is string => d != null)
        .sort()
        .at(-1);
      const to = [a.endsOn, b.endsOn].filter((d): d is string => d != null).sort()[0];
      if (from == null && to == null) return true;
      if (from != null && to != null && from > to) return false;
      // Open ends are unbounded; a week of the common range holds every weekday it can.
      const lo = from ?? addDays(to!, -6);
      const hi = to ?? addDays(from!, 6);
      for (let d = lo, n = 0; d <= hi && n < 7; d = addDays(d, 1), n += 1) {
        if (shared.includes(weekdayIndexOf(d))) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    function rankedAssignments(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      ignoreScheduleId?: string
    ): ScheduleAssignment[] {
      const live = new Set(
        liveSchedules(config)
          .filter((s) => !s.isRegular)
          .map((s) => s.id)
      );
      return config.assignments
        .filter((a) => live.has(a.scheduleId) && a.scheduleId !== ignoreScheduleId)
        .sort((a, b) => a.precedence - b.precedence);
    }
    export function overlappingSchedules(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      useOn: UseOn,
      ignoreScheduleId?: string
    ): Schedule[] {
      const ids = new Set(
        rankedAssignments(config, ignoreScheduleId)
          .filter((a) => meets(a, useOn))
          .map((a) => a.scheduleId)
      );
      return liveSchedules(config).filter((s) => ids.has(s.id));
    }
    function placeAssignment(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      mine: ScheduleAssignment,
      winner: Winner
    ): ScheduleAssignment[] {
      const existing = rankedAssignments(config);
      const lowestMeeting = existing.findIndex((a) => meets(a, mine));
      const at = winner === "existing" && lowestMeeting >= 0 ? lowestMeeting : existing.length;
      const order = [...existing.slice(0, at), mine, ...existing.slice(at)];
      return order
        .map((a, i) => ({ ...a, precedence: i + 1 }))
        .filter(
          (a) =>
            a.id === mine.id ||
            a.precedence !== config.assignments.find((x) => x.id === a.id)?.precedence
        );
    }
    function mergeChanges(
      a: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      b: AvailabilityConfigChanges
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const tables = [
        "schedules",
        "venueServices",
        "scheduleServices",
        "assignments",
        "dateRules",
      ] as const;
      const join = <T>(x: T[] | undefined, y: T[] | undefined) => [...(x ?? []), ...(y ?? [])];
      const pick = <K extends "upsert" | "remove">(side: K) =>
        Object.fromEntries(
          tables.flatMap((t) => {
            const rows = join<unknown>(
              (a[side] as Record<string, unknown[] | undefined>)[t],
              (b[side] as Record<string, unknown[] | undefined>)[t]
            );
            return rows.length > 0 ? [[t, rows]] : [];
          })
        );
      return { upsert: pick("upsert"), remove: pick("remove") } as AvailabilityConfigChanges;
    }
    interface NewScheduleInput {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly name: string;
      /** The new schedule's services as the editor holds them; a copy is seeded from the source. */
      readonly draft: QuickSetupDraft;
      readonly useOn: UseOn;
      readonly winner: Winner;
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }
    export function buildNewScheduleChanges(input: NewScheduleInput): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, name, useOn, winner, makeId } = input;
      const scheduleId = makeId();
      const schedule: Schedule = { id: scheduleId, name, kind: "alternate", isRegular: false };
      const rows = scheduleRowChanges({
        config,
        draft: input.draft,
        scheduleId,
        covered: coveredDays(input.draft),
        makeId,
      });
      const assignments =
        useOn.weekdays.length === 0
          ? []
          : placeAssignment(
              config,
              {
                id: makeId(),
                scheduleId,
                weekdays: [...useOn.weekdays].sort((x, y) => x - y),
                startsOn: useOn.startsOn ?? null,
                endsOn: useOn.endsOn ?? null,
                precedence: 0,
              },
              winner
            );
      return mergeChanges(rows, {
        upsert: { schedules: [schedule], ...(assignments.length > 0 ? { assignments } : {}) },
        remove: {},
      });
    }
    interface RegularWeekInput {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      /** The period's name; a change with no end is the regular week itself and is named by nothing. */
      readonly name: string;
      /** The week as the editor holds it: services with their days and different-hours blocks. */
      readonly draft: QuickSetupDraft;
      readonly startsOn: string;
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      readonly winner: Winner;
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }
    export function buildRegularWeekChanges(input: RegularWeekInput): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, draft, startsOn, endsOn, makeId } = input;
      const venueServiceIds = Object.fromEntries(
        config.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => [s.name.toLowerCase(), s.id])
      );
      const live = liveSchedules(config).find((s) => s.isRegular);
      const week = draftToConfig(draft, makeId, {
        venueServiceIds,
        keptOf: keptOf(config, live?.id),
      });
      const storedServiceIds = new Set(config.venueServices.map((s) => s.id));
      const created = week.venueServices.filter((s) => !storedServiceIds.has(s.id));
      const [built] = week.schedules;
      const [covering] = week.assignments;
      if (!built || !covering) return { upsert: {}, remove: {} };
      const { scheduleServices } = week;
      const rows = {
        upsert: {
          ...(created.length > 0 ? { venueServices: created } : {}),
          scheduleServices,
        },
        remove: {},
      };
    
      if (endsOn !== null) {
        const schedule: Schedule = { ...built, name: input.name, kind: "alternate", isRegular: false };
        const assignments = placeAssignment(config, { ...covering, startsOn, endsOn }, input.winner);
        return mergeChanges(rows, { upsert: { schedules: [schedule], assignments }, remove: {} });
      }
    
      const oldAssignments = config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === live?.id);
      const dropped = oldAssignments.filter((a) => a.startsOn != null && a.startsOn >= startsOn);
      const truncated = oldAssignments
        .filter((a) => !dropped.includes(a) && (a.endsOn == null || a.endsOn >= startsOn))
        .map((a) => ({ ...a, endsOn: addDays(startsOn, -1) }));
      // The new week sits at 0, so every dated schedule must rank above it to keep winning its days
      // (legacy venues store every assignment at 0, which would tie).
      const renumbered = rankedAssignments(config)
        .map((a, i) => ({ ...a, precedence: i + 1 }))
        .filter((a) => a.precedence !== config.assignments.find((x) => x.id === a.id)?.precedence);
      return mergeChanges(rows, {
        upsert: {
          schedules: [built, ...(live ? [{ ...live, isRegular: false }] : [])],
          assignments: [{ ...covering, startsOn, endsOn: null }, ...truncated, ...renumbered],
        },
        remove: { assignments: dropped.map((a) => a.id) },
      });
    }
    export function buildEditScheduleChanges(input: {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly scheduleId: string;
      readonly name: string;
      /** The schedule's services as the editor holds them: days and different-hours blocks. */
      readonly draft: QuickSetupDraft;
      readonly makeId: () => string;
      /** The config the drawer was seeded from, so a save removes only rows the Manager saw. */
      readonly baseline: AvailabilityConfig;
    }): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, scheduleId, name, makeId } = input;
      // An edit keeps the schedule's use, so its rows are encoded over the days it is assigned to.
      const rows = scheduleRowChanges({
        config,
        draft: input.draft,
        scheduleId,
        covered: scheduleDays(config, scheduleId, true),
        makeId,
        baseline: input.baseline,
      });
      const stored = config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId);
      const rename = stored && stored.name !== name ? { schedules: [{ ...stored, name }] } : {};
      return mergeChanges(rows, { upsert: rename, remove: {} });
    }
    function keptOf(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      scheduleId: string | undefined
    ): Record<string, KeptHours> {
      return Object.fromEntries(
        config.scheduleServices
          .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId)
          .map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, { seating: s.seating, bookingTypes: s.bookingTypes }])
      );
    }
    export function storedKeptByName(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      scheduleId: string | "regular" | undefined
    ): Readonly<Record<string, KeptHours>> {
      const id =
        scheduleId === "regular" ? liveSchedules(config).find((s) => s.isRegular)?.id : scheduleId;
      if (id === undefined) return {};
      const kept = keptOf(config, id);
      return Object.fromEntries(
        config.venueServices
          .filter((s) => !s.archivedAt)
          .flatMap((s) => {
            const stored = kept[s.id];
            // Keyed as the saves key `venueServiceIds`: the stored name, lower-cased, not trimmed.
            return stored ? [[s.name.toLowerCase(), stored] as const] : [];
          })
      );
    }
    function scheduleRowChanges(input: {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly draft: QuickSetupDraft;
      readonly scheduleId: string;
      readonly covered: readonly number[];
      readonly makeId: () => string;
      readonly baseline?: AvailabilityConfig;
    }): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, draft, scheduleId, covered, makeId } = input;
      const venueServiceIds = Object.fromEntries(
        config.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => [s.name.toLowerCase(), s.id])
      );
      const stored = config.scheduleServices.filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId);
      const week = draftToConfig(draft, makeId, {
        venueServiceIds,
        coveredDays: covered,
        keptOf: keptOf(config, scheduleId),
      });
      const storedServiceIds = new Set(config.venueServices.map((s) => s.id));
      const created = week.venueServices.filter((s) => !storedServiceIds.has(s.id));
      const was = new Map(stored.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const scheduleServices = week.scheduleServices.map((row) => ({
        ...row,
        scheduleId,
        id: was.get(row.venueServiceId)?.id ?? row.id,
      }));
      const kept = new Set(scheduleServices.map((s) => s.venueServiceId));
      const stillStored = new Set(stored.map((s) => s.id));
      const seen = (input.baseline?.scheduleServices ?? stored).filter(
        (s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId && stillStored.has(s.id)
      );
      const removed = seen.filter((s) => !kept.has(s.venueServiceId)).map((s) => s.id);
      return {
        upsert: {
          ...(created.length > 0 ? { venueServices: created } : {}),
          scheduleServices,
        },
        remove: removed.length > 0 ? { scheduleServices: removed } : {},
      };
    }
    export function datesOfUse(useOn: UseOn, today: string): string[] {
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS; i += 1) {
        const d = addDays(today, i);
        if (useOn.endsOn != null && d > useOn.endsOn) break;
        if (
          (useOn.startsOn == null || d >= useOn.startsOn) &&
          useOn.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(d))
        ) {
          dates.push(d);
        }
      }
      return dates;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/scope-dates.ts">
    export const SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS = 366;
    interface ScopeContext {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly timezone: string;
      /** Today on the venue clock. */
      readonly today: string;
    }
    function eachDate(from: string, to: string, step: number): string[] {
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, step)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function scopeDates(scope: EditScope, context: ScopeContext): string[] {
      if (scope.kind === "date") return [scope.date];
      if (scope.kind === "dates") return [...scope.dates];
      if (scope.kind === "weekday") {
        const horizon = addDays(scope.from, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
        const last = scope.until !== null && scope.until < horizon ? scope.until : horizon;
        // A past Friday is history, not part of the edit: count from the venue's today.
        return eachDate(scope.from, last, 7).filter((d) => d >= context.today);
      }
      if (scope.kind === "rule") {
        const rule = context.config.dateRules.find((r) => r.id === scope.ruleId);
        if (!rule) return [];
        // A past date is not edited: "all dates" reaches the rule's dates still ahead.
        const first = scope.mode === "following" ? scope.from : maxDate(rule.startsOn, context.today);
        const horizon = addDays(first, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
        const last = rule.endsOn != null && rule.endsOn < horizon ? rule.endsOn : horizon;
        return eachDate(first, last, 1).filter((d) => coversDate(rule, d));
      }
      const week = {
        timezone: context.timezone,
        config: { ...context.config, dateRules: [] },
      };
      if (scope.kind === "regularWeekday") {
        // The dates the live regular week runs on that weekday: later versions and schedules of the
        // Manager's own keep their dates, which this edit does not reach.
        const live = context.config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt)?.id;
        const first = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(context.today, i)).find(
          (d) => weekdayIndexOf(d) === scope.weekday
        )!;
        return eachDate(first, addDays(context.today, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1), 7).filter(
          (d) => live !== undefined && resolveDay(week, d).scheduleId === live
        );
      }
      return eachDate(context.today, addDays(context.today, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1), 1).filter(
        (d) => resolveDay(week, d).scheduleId === scope.scheduleId
      );
    }
    export function scheduleReach(scheduleId: string, context: ScopeContext): string[] {
      const horizon = addDays(context.today, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
      const viaRules = context.config.dateRules
        .filter((r) => r.kind === "use_schedule" && r.useScheduleId === scheduleId)
        .flatMap((rule) => {
          const last = rule.endsOn != null && rule.endsOn < horizon ? rule.endsOn : horizon;
          return eachDate(maxDate(rule.startsOn, context.today), last, 1).filter((d) =>
            coversDate(rule, d)
          );
        });
      const all = [...scopeDates({ kind: "schedule", scheduleId }, context), ...viaRules];
      return [...new Set(all)].sort();
    }
    export function coversDate(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.startsOn <= date &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || date <= rule.endsOn) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    export function ownChangeDates(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      dates: readonly string[],
      ignoreRuleId: string | null
    ): string[] {
      const skipped = new Set(
        config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind === "skip").map((r) => `${r.seriesId}@${r.startsOn}`)
      );
      const rules = config.dateRules.filter((r) => isHoursRule(r) && r.id !== ignoreRuleId);
      return dates.filter((date) =>
        rules.some((rule) => coversDate(rule, date) && !skipped.has(`${rule.id}@${date}`))
      );
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/scope-switch.ts">
    export type ParkedEdit =
      | { readonly base: DraftService; readonly draft: DraftService | null }
      | { readonly base: null; readonly draft: DraftService };
    interface SwitchInput {
      /** The rows the draft started from, in the scope it leaves. */
      readonly baseline: readonly DraftService[];
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      readonly parked: readonly ParkedEdit[];
      /** The rows of the scope it lands in. */
      readonly seed: DraftService[];
    }
    export interface Switched {
      readonly services: DraftService[];
      readonly baseline: DraftService[];
      readonly parked: ParkedEdit[];
      /** Services the new scope lacks, whose edits or removals are held rather than saved. */
      readonly unsaved: string[];
      /** Services the new scope already has with these hours: the ones just set change nothing there. */
      readonly overridden: string[];
    }
    export const parkedName = (p: ParkedEdit) => (p.base === null ? p.draft : (p.draft ?? p.base)).name;
    export function keepParked(
      parked: readonly ParkedEdit[],
      services: readonly DraftService[],
      baseline: readonly DraftService[]
    ): ParkedEdit[] {
      return parked.filter((p) => {
        const inView = findRow(services, holdId(p)) !== undefined;
        return isInViewHold(p, baseline) ? inView : !inView;
      });
    }
    function untouched(p: ParkedEdit, input: SwitchInput) {
      const was = findRow(input.baseline, holdId(p));
      const now = findRow(input.services, holdId(p));
      return was !== undefined && now !== undefined && same(was, now);
    }
    function restorable(p: ParkedEdit, seed: readonly DraftService[]) {
      const there = findRow(seed, holdId(p));
      return p.base === null ? there === undefined : there !== undefined && same(there, p.base);
    }
    type HeldLine = "overridden" | "unsaved" | null;
    function heldLine(p: ParkedEdit, seed: readonly DraftService[]): HeldLine {
      const there = findRow(seed, holdId(p));
      if (p.base === null) return there !== undefined && !same(there, p.draft) ? "overridden" : null;
      if (there === undefined || p.draft === null) return "unsaved";
      const [landed] = reapplyDraft({ base: [p.base], draft: [p.draft], latest: [there] });
      return landed !== undefined && same(there, landed) ? "overridden" : "unsaved";
    }
    function restoreHolds(input: SwitchInput, restored: readonly ParkedEdit[]) {
      return restored.reduce(
        (rows, p) =>
          p.base === null
            ? {
                baseline: rows.baseline.filter((r) => r.venueServiceId !== p.draft.venueServiceId),
                services: [
                  ...rows.services.filter((r) => r.venueServiceId !== p.draft.venueServiceId),
                  p.draft,
                ],
              }
            : {
                baseline: withRow(rows.baseline, holdId(p), p.base),
                services: withRow(rows.services, holdId(p), p.draft ?? p.base),
              },
        { baseline: [...input.baseline], services: [...input.services] }
      );
    }
    export function switchScope(input: SwitchInput): Switched {
      const { seed } = input;
      const seedById = new Map(seed.map((r) => [r.venueServiceId, r]));
      const holds = input.parked.filter((p) => isInViewHold(p, input.baseline));
      const parked = input.parked.filter((p) => !holds.includes(p));
    
      // A hold on a row the draft has not touched comes back when its origin returns; one that is not
      // the origin travels on. A touched one is let go: its row is the Manager's now.
      const restored = holds.filter((p) => untouched(p, input) && restorable(p, seed));
      const carried = holds.filter((p) => untouched(p, input) && !restored.includes(p));
      const { baseline, services } = restoreHolds(input, restored);
    
      const ids = (rows: readonly DraftService[]) => new Set(rows.map((r) => r.venueServiceId));
      const baselineIds = ids(baseline);
      const serviceIds = ids(services);
      // Edits parked earlier rejoin the draft, so a scope that has the service takes them up again.
      const base = [
        ...baseline,
        ...parked.flatMap((p) => (p.base && !baselineIds.has(p.base.venueServiceId) ? [p.base] : [])),
      ];
      const draft = [
        ...services,
        ...parked.flatMap((p) => (p.draft && !serviceIds.has(p.draft.venueServiceId) ? [p.draft] : [])),
      ];
      const draftIds = ids(draft);
      const baseById = new Map(base.map((r) => [r.venueServiceId, r]));
    
      const edits = draft.flatMap((d) => {
        const was = baseById.get(d.venueServiceId);
        return d.venueServiceId !== null && was && !same(was, d) && !seedById.has(d.venueServiceId)
          ? [{ base: was, draft: d }]
          : [];
      });
      // A removal of a row the new scope has no row for is held too: it would not otherwise survive
      // the trip back, where the row is seeded afresh.
      const removals = base.flatMap((b) =>
        b.venueServiceId !== null && !draftIds.has(b.venueServiceId) && !seedById.has(b.venueServiceId)
          ? [{ base: b, draft: null }]
          : []
      );
      // Hours added for a service the new scope already has are not used there. They are held, so the
      // scope they were set in gets them back, and named when they differ from what the new scope has.
      const adds = draft.flatMap((d) =>
        d.venueServiceId !== null && !baseById.has(d.venueServiceId) && seedById.has(d.venueServiceId)
          ? [{ base: null, draft: d }]
          : []
      );
      const merged = reapplyDraft({ base, draft, latest: seed });
      // An edit that leaves the row equal to what the new scope has changes nothing there, so it is
      // named and held. Judged on the row as it lands, since the Manager's other fields give way to the
      // new scope's.
      const matched = draft.flatMap((d) => {
        const there = findRow(seed, d.venueServiceId);
        const was = baseById.get(d.venueServiceId);
        const landed = findRow(merged, d.venueServiceId);
        return there && was && landed && !same(was, d) && same(there, landed)
          ? [{ base: was, draft: d }]
          : [];
      });
    
      // Every hold the Manager's hours are not used by is named: those just made, any carried on from
      // an earlier switch, and any let go because the Manager touched that row since.
      const lost = holds.filter((p) => !untouched(p, input));
      const lines = [...adds, ...matched, ...carried].map((p) => ({ p, line: heldLine(p, seed) }));
      const named = (kind: HeldLine) => lines.filter((l) => l.line === kind).map((l) => l.p);
    
      return {
        services: merged,
        baseline: seed,
        parked: [...edits, ...removals, ...adds, ...matched, ...carried],
        unsaved: [...new Set([...edits, ...removals, ...lost, ...named("unsaved")].map(parkedName))],
        overridden: [...new Set(named("overridden").map(parkedName))],
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/section-membership.ts">
    export function sectionMembership(
      tables: readonly Pick<Table, "id" | "sectionId">[]
    ): ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]> {
      const membership = new Map<string, string[]>();
      for (const { id, sectionId } of tables) {
        if (!sectionId) continue;
        membership.set(sectionId, [...(membership.get(sectionId) ?? []), id]);
      }
      return membership;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/selection-actions.ts">
    export function ownSingleDateRules(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      dates: readonly string[]
    ): DateRule[] {
      const picked = new Set(dates);
      return config.dateRules.filter(
        (r) =>
          (r.kind === "special_hours" || r.kind === "use_schedule") &&
          r.targetKind === "venue" &&
          r.endsOn === r.startsOn &&
          picked.has(r.startsOn) &&
          r.repeat == null &&
          r.window == null &&
          r.seriesId == null &&
          r.bookingTypes == null &&
          r.venueServiceId == null
      );
    }
    export function buildClearChanges(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      dates: readonly string[]
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      return { upsert: {}, remove: removal(ownSingleDateRules(config, dates)) };
    }
    export function buildUseScheduleChanges(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      dates: readonly string[],
      scheduleId: string,
      makeId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const dateRules: DateRule[] = dates.map((date) => ({
        id: makeId(),
        kind: "use_schedule",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: date,
        endsOn: date,
        useScheduleId: scheduleId,
      }));
      return {
        upsert: { dateRules },
        remove: removal(ownSingleDateRules(config, dates)),
      };
    }
    export function buildUseDayHoursChanges(input: {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      readonly dates: readonly string[];
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, services, dates, makeId } = input;
      const own = ownSingleDateRules(config, dates);
      const ownIds = new Set(own.map((r) => r.id));
      // Hand the builder a config without the old rules so it writes fresh ones, then remove those.
      const stripped = { ...config, dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => !ownIds.has(r.id)) };
      const built = buildDraftChanges({
        config: stripped,
        scope: { kind: "dates", dates },
        services,
        makeId,
      });
      return { upsert: built.upsert, remove: removal(own) };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/selection-hours.ts">
    function hoursSignature(day: ResolvedDay): string {
      return JSON.stringify(
        day.services.map((s) => [
          s.venueServiceId,
          s.opensAt,
          s.lastSeatingAt,
          s.closesAt,
          s.seating,
          s.bookingTypes,
        ])
      );
    }
    export function pickHoursSource(
      dates: readonly string[],
      resolve: (date: string) => ResolvedDay
    ): { readonly date: string | null; readonly differs: boolean } {
      const days = dates.map((date) => ({ date, day: resolve(date) }));
      const source = days.find((d) => d.day.services.length > 0) ?? days[0];
      if (!source) return { date: null, differs: false };
      const wanted = hoursSignature(source.day);
      return {
        date: source.date,
        differs: days.some((d) => hoursSignature(d.day) !== wanted),
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/selection.ts">
    export function normalizeDates(dates: readonly string[]): string[] {
      return [...new Set(dates)].sort();
    }
    export function dateRange(a: string, b: string): string[] {
      const [from, to] = a <= b ? [a, b] : [b, a];
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function futureDates(dates: readonly string[], today: string): string[] {
      return dates.filter((d) => d >= today);
    }
    export function toggleDate(selection: readonly string[], date: string): string[] {
      return selection.includes(date)
        ? selection.filter((d) => d !== date)
        : normalizeDates([...selection, date]);
    }
    export function columnDates(
      grid: readonly string[],
      column: number,
      view: CalendarView,
      anchor: string
    ): string[] {
      const month = anchor.slice(0, 7);
      return grid.filter((d, i) => i % 7 === column && (view === "week" || d.startsWith(month)));
    }
    export function weekdayDatesInMonth(anchor: string): string[] {
      const month = anchor.slice(0, 7);
      const weekday = weekdayIndexOf(anchor);
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = `${month}-01`; d.startsWith(month); d = addDays(d, 1)) {
        if (weekdayIndexOf(d) === weekday) dates.push(d);
      }
      return dates;
    }
    export function datesUsingSchedule(
      days: readonly { readonly serviceDate: string; readonly scheduleId: string | null }[],
      scheduleId: string
    ): string[] {
      return normalizeDates(days.filter((d) => d.scheduleId === scheduleId).map((d) => d.serviceDate));
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/series-edit.ts">
    export type SeriesScope = "following" | "all";
    export interface SeriesEdit {
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
      /** `null`: until reopened. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
    }
    export type SpecialHoursRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "special_hours" }>;
    export function isSeries(rule: DateRule): boolean {
      return rule.kind === "closure" && rule.repeat != null && rule.seriesId == null;
    }
    export function coversDate(series: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        series.startsOn <= date &&
        (series.endsOn == null || date <= series.endsOn) &&
        (series.repeat?.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)) ?? false)
      );
    }
    export function nextOccurrence(series: DateRule, from: string): string {
      const start = from > series.startsOn ? from : series.startsOn;
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) {
        const date = addDays(start, i);
        if (coversDate(series, date)) return date;
      }
      return series.startsOn;
    }
    export function sameRow(a: DateRule, b: DateRule): boolean {
      const key = (rule: DateRule) =>
        JSON.stringify(
          Object.entries({ ...rule, repeat: [...(rule.repeat?.weekdays ?? [])].sort((x, y) => x - y) })
            .filter(([, value]) => value != null)
            .sort(([x], [y]) => x.localeCompare(y))
        );
      return key(a) === key(b);
    }
    export function dateOverride(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      seriesId: string,
      date: string
    ): DateRule | undefined {
      return rules.find((r) => r.seriesId === seriesId && r.startsOn === date);
    }
    export function skipRows(rules: readonly DateRule[], seriesId: string): DateRule[] {
      return rules
        .filter((r) => r.kind === "skip" && r.seriesId === seriesId)
        .sort((a, b) => a.startsOn.localeCompare(b.startsOn));
    }
    export function skippedDates(rules: readonly DateRule[], seriesId: string): string[] {
      return skipRows(rules, seriesId).map((r) => r.startsOn);
    }
    export function restoreDate(skip: DateRule): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      return { upsert: {}, remove: { dateRules: [skip.id] } };
    }
    export function skipDate(
      series: DateRule,
      date: string,
      makeId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const skip: DateRule = {
        id: makeId(),
        kind: "skip",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: date,
        endsOn: date,
        seriesId: series.id,
      };
      return { upsert: { dateRules: [skip] }, remove: {} };
    }
    export function growsSeries(series: DateRule, edit: SeriesEdit): boolean {
      const had = series.repeat?.weekdays ?? [];
      const later = series.endsOn != null && (edit.endsOn == null || edit.endsOn > series.endsOn);
      return edit.weekdays.some((d) => !had.includes(d)) || later;
    }
    export function growthClosure(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      series: DateRule,
      scope: SeriesScope,
      date: string,
      edit: SeriesEdit,
      makeId: () => string
    ): { rule: DateRule; alongside: ClosureAlongside } {
      const from = scope === "all" || date <= series.startsOn ? series.startsOn : date;
      const rule: DateRule = { ...withEdit(series, edit), id: makeId(), startsOn: from };
      const removing = from === series.startsOn;
      // A removed series takes every child with it, even one dated before it starts: the server refuses
      // a removal that leaves a skip pointing at the series it removed.
      const moved = config.dateRules
        .filter((r) => r.seriesId === series.id && (removing || r.startsOn >= from))
        .map((r) => ({ ...r, seriesId: rule.id }));
      // `replaces` is the row this draft was built from; the server refuses if the stored one differs.
      if (removing) {
        return { rule, alongside: { upsert: moved, remove: [series.id], replaces: series } };
      }
      const ended: DateRule = { ...series, endsOn: addDays(from, -1) };
      return { rule, alongside: { upsert: [ended, ...moved], remove: [] } };
    }
    export function growthAttempt(
      plan: { readonly rule: DateRule; readonly alongside: ClosureAlongside },
      ruleId: string
    ): { rule: DateRule; alongside: ClosureAlongside } {
      return {
        rule: { ...plan.rule, id: ruleId },
        alongside: {
          ...plan.alongside,
          upsert: plan.alongside.upsert.map((r) =>
            r.seriesId === plan.rule.id ? { ...r, seriesId: ruleId } : r
          ),
        },
      };
    }
    export function editHoursRule(
      rule: SpecialHoursRule,
      scope: SeriesScope,
      date: string,
      payload: SpecialHoursRule["payload"],
      makeId: () => string,
      today = ""
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const edited: SpecialHoursRule = { ...rule, payload };
      // "All dates" reaches the dates still ahead: dates already past keep their hours.
      const from = scope === "all" ? (today > rule.startsOn ? today : rule.startsOn) : date;
      if (from <= rule.startsOn) {
        return { upsert: { dateRules: [edited] }, remove: {} };
      }
      const created: SpecialHoursRule = { ...edited, id: makeId(), startsOn: from };
      const ended: SpecialHoursRule = { ...rule, endsOn: addDays(from, -1) };
      return { upsert: { dateRules: [ended, created] }, remove: {} };
    }
    export function editSeriesDates(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      series: DateRule,
      scope: SeriesScope,
      date: string,
      edit: SeriesEdit,
      makeId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      if (scope === "all" || date <= series.startsOn) {
        return { upsert: { dateRules: [withEdit(series, edit)] }, remove: {} };
      }
      const created: DateRule = { ...withEdit(series, edit), id: makeId(), startsOn: date };
      const moved = config.dateRules
        .filter((r) => r.seriesId === series.id && r.startsOn >= date)
        .map((r) => ({ ...r, seriesId: created.id }));
      const ended: DateRule = { ...series, endsOn: addDays(date, -1) };
      return { upsert: { dateRules: [ended, created, ...moved] }, remove: {} };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/service-filter.ts">
    export interface ServiceFilter {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name: string;
    }
    export function filterableServices(config: AvailabilityConfig): readonly ServiceFilter[] {
      const active = [...config.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt)]
        .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
        .map((s) => ({ id: s.id, name: s.name }));
      return active.length >= 2 ? active : [];
    }
    export function resolveServiceFilter(
      services: readonly ServiceFilter[],
      chosenId: string | null
    ): ServiceFilter | null {
      return services.find((s) => s.id === chosenId) ?? null;
    }
    export function filterDaySummary(
      summary: AvailabilityDaySummary,
      serviceId: string
    ): AvailabilityDaySummary {
      if (summary.services === undefined) return summary;
      const services = summary.services.filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === serviceId);
      const closures = summary.closures.filter((c) => {
        // A service closure names its service: it belongs to that one alone, even on a day it
        // closes the service for good (the service is then gone from `services`).
        if (c.targetKind === "service" && c.venueServiceId !== undefined) {
          return c.venueServiceId === serviceId;
        }
        return services.some((s) => c.from < s.closesAt && c.to > s.opensAt);
      });
      return { ...summary, services, serviceCount: services.length, closures };
    }
    export function filterDays(
      days: readonly AvailabilityDaySummary[] | undefined,
      service: ServiceFilter | null
    ): readonly AvailabilityDaySummary[] | undefined {
      if (!days || !service) return days;
      return days.map((d) => filterDaySummary(d, service.id));
    }

    export interface ServiceTimes {
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
    }
    export interface ServiceHoursContext {
      readonly t: TFunction;
      readonly format: VenueFormat;
    }
    export function serviceHoursText(times: ServiceTimes, { t, format }: ServiceHoursContext): string {
      const range = t("availability.serviceHours.range", {
        open: minuteText(times.opensAt, t, format),
        close: minuteText(times.closesAt, t, format),
      });
      return times.lastSeatingAt === times.closesAt
        ? range
        : t("availability.serviceHours.withLastSeating", {
            range,
            last: minuteText(times.lastSeatingAt, t, format),
          });
    }
    export function serviceCloseChangeText(
      daysText: string,
      times: Pick<ServiceTimes, "closesAt" | "lastSeatingAt">,
      { t, format }: ServiceHoursContext
    ): string {
      const close = minuteText(times.closesAt, t, format);
      return times.lastSeatingAt === times.closesAt
        ? t("availability.serviceHours.closeChange", { days: daysText, close })
        : t("availability.serviceHours.closeChangeWithLastSeating", {
            days: daysText,
            close,
            last: minuteText(times.lastSeatingAt, t, format),
          });
    }
    export function namedServiceHoursText(
      name: string,
      times: ServiceTimes,
      ctx: ServiceHoursContext
    ): string {
      return ctx.t("availability.serviceHours.named", { name, hours: serviceHoursText(times, ctx) });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/special-dates.ts">
    export type SpecialDatesFilter = "all" | "closures" | "special_hours" | "repeating" | "past";
    export type SpecialDateRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "closure" | "special_hours" }>;
    export interface SpecialDateRow {
      readonly rule: SpecialDateRule;
      readonly past: boolean;
    }
    export function specialDateRows(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      today: string,
      filter: SpecialDatesFilter
    ): SpecialDateRow[] {
      const rows = rules
        .filter(isSpecialDate)
        .map((rule) => ({ rule, past: isPast(rule, today) }))
        .filter((row) => matches(row, filter));
      const byStart = (a: SpecialDateRow, b: SpecialDateRow) =>
        a.rule.startsOn.localeCompare(b.rule.startsOn);
      return [...rows].sort(filter === "past" ? (a, b) => byStart(b, a) : byStart);
    }
    export function hoursEditDate(rule: DateRule, today: string): string | null {
      if (rule.repeat != null) {
        // `nextOccurrence` falls back to the rule's start when nothing is covered ahead.
        const next = nextOccurrence(rule, today);
        return next >= today && coversDate(rule, next) ? next : null;
      }
      return rule.startsOn > today ? rule.startsOn : today;
    }
    export const coversManyDates = (rule: DateRule): boolean =>
      rule.repeat != null || rule.endsOn !== rule.startsOn;
    export function refundFailureLabel(
      failure: RefundFailure,
      formatMoney: (cents: number, currency: string) => string,
      unnamed: string
    ): string {
      const name = failure.guestName ?? unnamed;
      return failure.amountCents == null || failure.currency == null
        ? name
        : `${name} (${formatMoney(failure.amountCents, failure.currency)})`;
    }
    export function orphanRefundRules(
      summaries: readonly ClosureSummary[],
      listedRuleIds: readonly string[]
    ): ClosureSummary[] {
      return summaries.filter(
        (s) => s.refundFailed + s.refundPending > 0 && !listedRuleIds.includes(s.ruleId)
      );
    }
