  <file path="src/components/availability/step-two-refusal.ts">
    export type Refusal =
      /** A group's bookings changed since the Manager chose: the choices are void. */
      | { readonly kind: "groups-changed" }
      /** Someone saved first; `winningChange` is `null` when the server recorded none. */
      | { readonly kind: "version-conflict"; readonly winningChange: AvailabilityChangeSummary | null }
      /**
       * "Move" was chosen and some bookings have no open time (or the time was taken since): the server
       * saved nothing and told no guest. `reservationIds` are the ones it could not move.
       */
      | { readonly kind: "move-unavailable"; readonly reservationIds: readonly string[] }
      /** This attempt already committed (a response was lost). */
      | { readonly kind: "closure-exists" }
      /**
       * `outcomeUnknown`: no answer the server stands behind (a lost response, a timeout, a 5xx from
       * something in front of it), so the save may have committed.
       */
      | {
          readonly kind: "other";
          readonly detail: string;
          readonly outcomeUnknown: boolean;
        };
    function moveUnavailableIds(error: unknown): readonly string[] | null {
      const problem = availabilityProblemOf(error);
      return problem?.code === "move-unavailable" ? (problem.reservationIds ?? []) : null;
    }
    export function refusalOf(error: unknown): Refusal {
      if (isDecisionRequired(error)) return { kind: "groups-changed" };
      const stuck = moveUnavailableIds(error);
      if (stuck) return { kind: "move-unavailable", reservationIds: stuck };
      const conflict = conflictOf(error);
      if (conflict?.code === "version-conflict") {
        return { kind: "version-conflict", winningChange: conflict.winningChange };
      }
      if (conflict?.code === "closure-exists") return { kind: "closure-exists" };
      const { category, detail } = describeApiError(error);
      return { kind: "other", detail, outcomeUnknown: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.has(category) };
    }
    export function mayHaveSaved(refusal: Refusal): boolean {
      return refusal.kind === "closure-exists" || (refusal.kind === "other" && refusal.outcomeUnknown);
    }
    export interface RefusalContext {
      readonly groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[];
      readonly format: Pick<VenueFormat, "formatTime" | "formatCalendarDate" | "formatInstant">;
    }
    function moveUnavailableText(
      ids: readonly string[],
      t: TFunction,
      context: RefusalContext | undefined
    ): string {
      const known = new Map(
        (context?.groups ?? []).flatMap((g) => g.reservations.map((r) => [r.id, { g, r }] as const))
      );
      const named = ids.flatMap((id) => {
        const found = known.get(id);
        if (!found || !context) return [];
        const { g, r } = found;
        return [
          t("availability.close.moveUnavailableBooking", {
            name: r.guestName ?? t("availability.close.step2.guestUnnamed"),
            date: context.format.formatCalendarDate(g.date, {
              weekday: "short",
              month: "short",
              day: "numeric",
            }),
            time: context.format.formatTime(r.startTime),
            count: clockHourOfInstant(r.startTime, context.format),
          }),
        ];
      });
      const shown = named.slice(0, MOVE_NAMED_MAX);
      const more = named.length - shown.length;
      // Bookings no longer in the list cannot be named; say how many rather than naming nobody.
      const bookings =
        named.length === 0
          ? t("availability.close.moveUnavailableCount", { count: ids.length })
          : [
              ...shown,
              ...(more > 0 ? [t("availability.close.moveUnavailableMore", { count: more })] : []),
            ].join("; ");
      return t("availability.close.moveUnavailable", { count: Math.max(ids.length, 1), bookings });
    }
    export function refusalText(refusal: Refusal, t: TFunction, context?: RefusalContext): string {
      switch (refusal.kind) {
        case "move-unavailable":
          return moveUnavailableText(refusal.reservationIds, t, context);
        case "groups-changed":
          return t("availability.close.groupsChanged");
        case "version-conflict":
          return t("availability.close.versionConflict");
        case "closure-exists":
          return t("availability.close.alreadySaved");
        case "other":
          // The house sentences do not say this save may have gone through; this one does.
          return refusal.outcomeUnknown ? t("availability.close.maybeSaved") : refusal.detail;
      }
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/stranded-revert.ts">
    function emit() {
      for (const listener of listeners) listener();
    }
    function subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    }
    export function registerStrandedRevertHost(venueId: string): () => void {
      hostVenues = [...hostVenues, venueId];
      let released = false;
      return () => {
        if (released) return;
        released = true;
        const at = hostVenues.indexOf(venueId);
        hostVenues = hostVenues.filter((_, i) => i !== at);
        // A list shown for the venue the host left (or for a page that has gone) is not for the next.
        if (shown.length > 0) {
          shown = [];
          emit();
        }
      };
    }
    export function dismissStrandedRevert() {
      shown = [];
      emit();
    }
    export const useStrandedRevert = (): readonly StrandedReservation[] =>
      useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => shown);
    function strandedReservations(error: unknown): readonly StrandedReservation[] {
      const problem = availabilityProblemOf(error);
      return problem?.code === "stranded-bookings" ? (problem.reservations ?? []) : [];
    }
    interface ToastInput {
      readonly title: string;
      readonly variant: "error";
      readonly duration: number;
    }
    export function reportRevertFailure(
      error: unknown,
      t: TFunction,
      toast: (input: ToastInput) => unknown,
      venueId: string
    ) {
      const reservations = strandedReservations(error);
      if (reservations.length > 0 && hostVenues.includes(venueId)) {
        shown = reservations;
        emit();
        return;
      }
      toast({ title: revertErrorText(error, t), variant: "error", duration: 8000 });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/suggest-name.ts">
    export type Season = "spring" | "summer" | "autumn" | "winter";
    export type NameSuggestion =
      | { readonly kind: "season"; readonly season: Season }
      | { readonly kind: "from"; readonly from: string }
      | { readonly kind: "range"; readonly from: string; readonly to: string };
    export function suggestName(startsOn: string | null, endsOn: string | null): NameSuggestion | null {
      if (!startsOn) return null;
      if (!endsOn) return { kind: "from", from: startsOn };
      if (days(startsOn, endsOn) > SEASON_MAX_DAYS)
        return { kind: "range", from: startsOn, to: endsOn };
      const season = SEASON_OF_MONTH[Number(startsOn.slice(5, 7)) - 1];
      return { kind: "season", season: season ?? "winter" };
    }

    function counter(prefix: string) {
      let n = 0;
      return () => `${prefix}-${++n}`;
    }
    function later(draft: QuickSetupDraft): QuickSetupDraft {
      return {
        ...draft,
        services: draft.services.map((s) =>
          s.name === "Dinner"
            ? { ...s, lastSeating: "21:30", closes: "22:30", lastSeatingLinked: false }
            : s
        ),
      };
    }
    export function saveRegularWeek(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      startsOn: string,
      prefix = "new"
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      let n = 0;
      const live = draftFromConfig(config, () => `draft-${++n}`);
      return applyChanges(
        config,
        buildRegularWeekChanges({
          config,
          name: "",
          draft: later(live),
          startsOn,
          endsOn: null,
          winner: "new",
          makeId: counter(prefix),
        }),
        SAVED_AT
      );
    }
    export function supersededWeekOf(config: AvailabilityConfig) {
      const week = config.schedules.find((s) => s.kind === "regular" && !s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt);
      if (!week) throw new Error("no superseded regular week in this config");
      return week;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/superseded-schedules.ts">
    export function isSupersededRegularWeek(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      schedule: Schedule,
      serviceDate: string
    ): boolean {
      if (schedule.archivedAt || schedule.isRegular || schedule.kind !== "regular") return false;
      // An open end (`null`) runs on with no last day, so it always reaches the service date.
      const reaches = (endsOn: string | null | undefined) => endsOn == null || endsOn >= serviceDate;
      return (
        !config.assignments.some((a) => a.scheduleId === schedule.id && reaches(a.endsOn)) &&
        !config.dateRules.some(
          (r) => r.kind === "use_schedule" && r.useScheduleId === schedule.id && reaches(r.endsOn)
        )
      );
    }
    export function visibleSchedules(config: AvailabilityConfig, serviceDate: string): Schedule[] {
      return config.schedules.filter(
        (s) => !s.archivedAt && !isSupersededRegularWeek(config, s, serviceDate)
      );
    }

    type Format = Pick<VenueFormat, "formatLocalTime">;
    type PausedSet =
      BookingChannel | "online_phone" | "online_waitlist" | "phone_waitlist" | "online_phone_waitlist";
    function channelSet(channels: readonly BookingChannel[]): PausedSet {
      return CHANNEL_ORDER.filter((channel) => channels.includes(channel)).join("_") as PausedSet;
    }
    function pausedText(
      item: Extract<TodayItem, { kind: "paused" }>,
      t: TFunction,
      format: Format
    ): string {
      const set = channelSet(item.channels);
      return item.from === null
        ? t(`availability.today.paused.${set}`)
        : t(`availability.today.pausedFrom.${set}`, { time: minuteText(item.from, t, format) });
    }
    export function todayItemText(item: TodayItem, t: TFunction, format: Format): string {
      switch (item.kind) {
        case "serviceClosed":
          return t("availability.today.serviceClosed", { name: item.name });
        case "closingEarly":
          return item.name === null
            ? t("availability.today.closingEarly", { time: minuteText(item.at, t, format) })
            : t("availability.today.closingEarlyNamed", {
                name: item.name,
                time: minuteText(item.at, t, format),
              });
        case "closedBetween": {
          const range = { from: minuteText(item.from, t, format), to: minuteText(item.to, t, format) };
          return item.name === null
            ? t("availability.today.closedBetween", range)
            : t("availability.today.targetClosedBetween", { name: item.name, ...range });
        }
        case "paused":
          return pausedText(item, t, format);
        case "pausedBetween":
          return t(`availability.today.pausedBetween.${channelSet(item.channels)}`, {
            from: minuteText(item.from, t, format),
            to: minuteText(item.to, t, format),
          });
        case "tonight":
          return tonightChipText(item.change, t, format);
      }
    }
    export function hoursText(model: TodayLineModel, t: TFunction, format: Format): string {
      if (model.closed) return t("availability.today.closed");
      return model.hours
        .map((h) =>
          t("availability.today.hours", {
            name: h.name,
            from: minuteText(h.opensAt, t, format),
            to: minuteText(h.closesAt, t, format),
          })
        )
        .join(" · ");
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/today-line.ts">
    type Closure = AvailabilityDaySummary["closures"][number];
    type DayService = NonNullable<AvailabilityDaySummary["services"]>[number];
    export type BookingChannel = NonNullable<DateRule["bookingTypes"]>[number];
    export type TodayItem =
      | { readonly kind: "serviceClosed"; readonly name: string }
      | { readonly kind: "closingEarly"; readonly at: number; readonly name: string | null }
      | {
          readonly kind: "closedBetween";
          readonly name: string | null;
          readonly from: number;
          readonly to: number;
        }
      | {
          readonly kind: "paused";
          readonly channels: readonly BookingChannel[];
          readonly from: number | null;
        }
      | {
          readonly kind: "pausedBetween";
          readonly channels: readonly BookingChannel[];
          readonly from: number;
          readonly to: number;
        }
      | { readonly kind: "tonight"; readonly change: TonightChange };
    export interface TodayLineModel {
      readonly serviceDate: string;
      /** No service is open that day. */
      readonly closed: boolean;
      readonly hours: readonly { name: string; opensAt: number; closesAt: number }[];
      readonly items: readonly TodayItem[];
    }
    export interface TodayLineInput {
      readonly serviceDate: string;
      readonly summary: AvailabilityDaySummary;
      /** All the venue's date rules: Tonight rules for the day become items. */
      readonly rules: readonly DateRule[];
      readonly now: Date;
      /** `venueServiceId` to name. */
      readonly serviceNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
      readonly sectionNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
      /** The online-pause banner is up, so the line does not say it again. */
      readonly bannerShowsOnline: boolean;
    }
    interface Ranked {
      readonly rank: number;
      readonly item: TodayItem;
    }
    function reachesClose(band: Closure, closesAt: number): boolean {
      return band.to >= closesAt;
    }
    function closureItem(
      band: Closure,
      names: Pick<TodayLineInput, "serviceNames" | "sectionNames">,
      services: readonly DayService[],
      span: { opensAt: number; closesAt: number }
    ): Ranked | null {
      if (band.targetKind === "venue") {
        // A whole-day venue band is handled as a closed day by the caller.
        return reachesClose(band, span.closesAt)
          ? { rank: RANK.venueEarly, item: { kind: "closingEarly", at: band.from, name: null } }
          : {
              rank: RANK.closedBetween,
              item: { kind: "closedBetween", name: null, from: band.from, to: band.to },
            };
      }
      if (band.targetKind === "booking") {
        const channels = band.bookingTypes ?? [];
        if (channels.length === 0) return null;
        if (!reachesClose(band, span.closesAt)) {
          return {
            rank: RANK.pausedBetween,
            item: { kind: "pausedBetween", channels, from: band.from, to: band.to },
          };
        }
        return {
          rank: RANK.paused,
          item: {
            kind: "paused",
            channels,
            from: band.from > span.opensAt ? band.from : null,
          },
        };
      }
      const own = band.venueServiceId
        ? services.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === band.venueServiceId)
        : undefined;
      const name =
        band.targetKind === "service"
          ? ((band.venueServiceId ? names.serviceNames.get(band.venueServiceId) : undefined) ??
            own?.name)
          : band.sectionId
            ? names.sectionNames.get(band.sectionId)
            : undefined;
      if (name === undefined) return null;
      // A service reads against its own hours; a section against the whole day's. A service the
      // day does not list either ran no hours today (a from-time or bounded band says nothing) or
      // was closed whole-day by the engine, so only a whole-day band names it.
      const against = band.targetKind === "service" && own ? own : span;
      if (
        band.targetKind === "service" &&
        !own &&
        !(band.from <= span.opensAt && band.to >= span.closesAt)
      ) {
        return null;
      }
      if (!reachesClose(band, against.closesAt)) {
        return {
          rank: RANK.closedBetween,
          item: { kind: "closedBetween", name, from: band.from, to: band.to },
        };
      }
      if (band.from <= against.opensAt)
        return { rank: RANK.serviceClosed, item: { kind: "serviceClosed", name } };
      return { rank: RANK.namedEarly, item: { kind: "closingEarly", at: band.from, name } };
    }
    function isWholeDayServiceBand(band: Closure, services: readonly DayService[]): boolean {
      if (band.targetKind !== "service") return false;
      const own = services.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === band.venueServiceId);
      return own !== undefined && band.from <= own.opensAt && band.to >= own.closesAt;
    }
    export function todayLine(input: TodayLineInput): TodayLineModel {
      const { serviceDate, summary, rules, now, bannerShowsOnline } = input;
      // A closure band is classified only with its rule in hand: the day and the config refetch
      // separately, so a band can arrive before its rule (a Tonight stop or pause just applied) and
      // would read as a closure for a moment. An old API sends no services to read the bands against.
      const ruleKinds = new Map(rules.map((r) => [r.id, r.kind]));
      const bands =
        summary.services === undefined
          ? []
          : summary.closures.filter((band) => {
              const kind = ruleKinds.get(band.ruleId);
              return kind !== undefined && kind !== "tonight";
            });
      const services = summary.services ?? [];
      const span = {
        opensAt: services.length ? Math.min(...services.map((s) => s.opensAt)) : 0,
        closesAt: services.length ? Math.max(...services.map((s) => s.closesAt)) : 0,
      };
      const venueClosed = bands.some(
        (band) => band.targetKind === "venue" && band.from <= span.opensAt && band.to >= span.closesAt
      );
      const hours = services
        .filter((s) => !bands.some((band) => isWholeDayServiceBand(band, [s])))
        .map(({ name, opensAt, closesAt }) => ({ name, opensAt, closesAt }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.opensAt - b.opensAt);
      const closed =
        venueClosed ||
        summary.label === CLOSED_LABEL ||
        (summary.services !== undefined ? hours.length === 0 : summary.serviceCount === 0);
    
      const fromClosures: readonly Ranked[] = closed
        ? []
        : bands.flatMap((band) => {
            const ranked = closureItem(band, input, services, span);
            if (ranked === null) return [];
            const { item } = ranked;
            if ((item.kind !== "paused" && item.kind !== "pausedBetween") || !bannerShowsOnline) {
              return [ranked];
            }
            const channels = item.channels.filter((channel) => channel !== "online");
            return channels.length > 0 ? [{ rank: ranked.rank, item: { ...item, channels } }] : [];
          });
      const fromTonight: readonly Ranked[] = activeTonightChanges(rules, serviceDate, now)
        .filter((change) => !(bannerShowsOnline && change.kind === "pause_online"))
        .map((change) => ({ rank: RANK.tonight, item: { kind: "tonight", change } }));
    
      return {
        serviceDate,
        closed,
        hours: closed ? [] : hours,
        items: [...fromClosures, ...fromTonight].sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank).map((r) => r.item),
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/tonight-state.ts">
    export type TonightChange =
      | { readonly ruleId: string; readonly kind: "pause_online" }
      | { readonly ruleId: string; readonly kind: "close_early"; readonly closeAt: number }
      | {
          readonly ruleId: string;
          readonly kind: "stop_window";
          readonly from: number;
          readonly to: number;
        }
      | {
          readonly ruleId: string;
          readonly kind: "block_tables";
          readonly tableCount: number;
          readonly from: number;
          readonly to: number;
        }
      | { readonly ruleId: string; readonly kind: "pacing"; readonly covers: number };
    type TonightRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "tonight" }>;
    function describe(rule: TonightRule): TonightChange | null {
      const ruleId = rule.id;
      const { payload } = rule;
      if ("closeAt" in payload) return { ruleId, kind: "close_early", closeAt: payload.closeAt };
      if ("pacing" in payload) return { ruleId, kind: "pacing", covers: payload.pacing.covers };
      if (rule.targetKind === "booking") return { ruleId, kind: "pause_online" };
      if (rule.targetKind === "tables") {
        return {
          ruleId,
          kind: "block_tables",
          tableCount: rule.tableIds?.length ?? 0,
          from: payload.stop.from,
          to: payload.stop.to,
        };
      }
      return { ruleId, kind: "stop_window", from: payload.stop.from, to: payload.stop.to };
    }
    export function tonightTimeMinutes(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      serviceDate: string
    ): readonly number[] {
      const { services } = resolveDay(
        {
          timezone,
          config: { ...config, dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind !== "tonight") },
        },
        serviceDate
      );
      const first = services.length ? Math.min(...services.map((s) => s.opensAt)) : 0;
      const last = services.length
        ? Math.max(...services.map((s) => s.closesAt))
        : FALLBACK_LAST_MINUTE;
      const start = Math.floor(first / STEP_MINUTES) * STEP_MINUTES;
      const end = Math.min(MAX_MINUTE, last);
      return Array.from(
        { length: Math.max(0, Math.floor((end - start) / STEP_MINUTES)) + 1 },
        (_, i) => start + i * STEP_MINUTES
      );
    }
    export interface TonightDefaults {
      readonly closeAt: number;
      readonly stopFrom: number;
      readonly stopTo: number;
    }
    function nearestAtOrBefore(options: readonly number[], target: number): number {
      const before = options.filter((m) => m <= target);
      return before.length ? before[before.length - 1]! : options[options.length - 1]!;
    }
    export function tonightDefaults(options: readonly number[]): TonightDefaults {
      const closeAt = nearestAtOrBefore(options, DEFAULT_CLOSE_AT);
      const fromChoices = options.slice(0, -1);
      const stopFrom = nearestAtOrBefore(fromChoices.length ? fromChoices : options, DEFAULT_STOP_FROM);
      const after = options.filter((m) => m > stopFrom);
      const stopTo = after.find((m) => m >= DEFAULT_STOP_TO) ?? after[0] ?? stopFrom;
      return { closeAt, stopFrom, stopTo };
    }
    export function activeTonightChanges(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      today: string,
      now: Date
    ): readonly TonightChange[] {
      return rules.flatMap((rule) => {
        if (rule.kind !== "tonight" || rule.startsOn !== today) return [];
        if (rule.expiresAt && new Date(rule.expiresAt).getTime() <= now.getTime()) return [];
        const change = describe(rule);
        return change ? [change] : [];
      });
    }
    export function tonightChipText(
      change: TonightChange,
      t: TFunction,
      format: Pick<VenueFormat, "formatLocalTime">
    ): string {
      switch (change.kind) {
        case "pause_online":
          return t("availability.tonight.chip.pause");
        case "close_early":
          return t("availability.tonight.chip.closeEarly", {
            time: minuteText(change.closeAt, t, format),
          });
        case "stop_window":
          return t("availability.tonight.chip.stopWindow", {
            from: minuteText(change.from, t, format),
            to: minuteText(change.to, t, format),
          });
        case "block_tables":
          // The server stores "rest of tonight" as 0 to the two-day maximum.
          if (change.to >= MAX_MINUTE) {
            return change.from === 0
              ? t("availability.tonight.chip.blocked", { count: change.tableCount })
              : t("availability.tonight.chip.blockedFrom", {
                  count: change.tableCount,
                  from: minuteText(change.from, t, format),
                });
          }
          return t("availability.tonight.chip.blockedWindow", {
            count: change.tableCount,
            from: minuteText(change.from, t, format),
            to: minuteText(change.to, t, format),
          });
        case "pacing":
          return t("availability.tonight.chip.pacing", { count: change.covers });
      }
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/use-conflict-review.ts">
    interface Baseline {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly version: number;
      /** The schedule the draft's rows were seeded from, fixed when the drawer opened. */
      readonly scheduleId: string | undefined;
    }
    export type ConflictReviewKind = "edit" | "regularWeek" | "draft";
    export interface ConflictReview {
      readonly kind: ConflictReviewKind;
      /** The refetch has landed; until then there is nothing to compare with. */
      readonly loaded: boolean;
      readonly changes: ScheduleChangeSince;
    }
    interface Input {
      readonly kind: ConflictReviewKind;
      readonly state: AvailabilityConfigState;
      /**
       * The schedule whose rows the draft starts from, as the latest state has it (the regular week
       * can move to another schedule); none for a draft with nothing to compare. The drawer reads
       * it once, when it opens, and keeps that as where its rows came from.
       */
      readonly scheduleId: string | undefined;
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      /** The name field is a rename of `scheduleId` (edit), not the name of a new schedule. */
      readonly name: string | null;
      readonly conflicted: boolean;
      readonly clearConflict: () => void;
      /**
       * Replaces the draft with the answer the Manager chose. `baseline` is the version the draft was
       * opened on, for a draft that is not made of `DraftService` rows and merges itself.
       */
      readonly apply: (next: {
        services: DraftService[];
        name: string | null;
        baseline: AvailabilityConfig;
        /** The Manager chose the winning version as it is, not their changes on top of it. */
        discarded: boolean;
      }) => void;
      /** Starts the whole draft again (name, dates and all) from these rows; for non-edit drafts. */
      readonly startOver: (services: DraftService[]) => void;
      /** The schedule is gone, so there is nothing left to edit. */
      readonly onGone: () => void;
    }
    export function useConflictReview(input: Input) {
      const { kind, state, services, name, conflicted } = input;
      const [baseline, setBaseline] = useState<Baseline>(() => ({
        config: state.config,
        version: state.version,
        scheduleId: input.scheduleId,
      }));
      const pinned = baseline.scheduleId;
      const latestId = kind === "regularWeek" ? input.scheduleId : pinned;
      const nameIn = (config: AvailabilityConfig) =>
        config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === pinned)?.name ?? "";
    
      const baselineServices = rowsOf(baseline.config, pinned);
      const loaded = state.version !== baseline.version;
      const compared =
        conflicted && loaded && kind !== "draft" && pinned && latestId
          ? scheduleChangesSince(baseline.config, state.config, pinned, latestId)
          : NO_CHANGES;
      // A new regular week saves a new schedule, so a missing regular week is not a dead end.
      const changes = kind === "regularWeek" ? { ...compared, gone: false } : compared;
      const review: ConflictReview | null = conflicted ? { kind, loaded, changes } : null;
    
      const rebase = () =>
        setBaseline({ config: state.config, version: state.version, scheduleId: input.scheduleId });
      const settle = (next: () => void) => {
        rebase();
        next();
        input.clearConflict();
      };
      const latestRows = () => rowsOf(state.config, kind === "draft" ? pinned : latestId);
    
      return {
        baseline: baseline.config,
        /** The version a save is checked against: the one the draft was built from. */
        baselineVersion: baseline.version,
        baselineServices,
        baselineName: nameIn(baseline.config),
        review,
        /** The winning version with only the Manager's own changes on top. */
        reapply: () =>
          settle(() => {
            if (kind === "draft") return; // a new schedule depends on nothing that moved
            const latest = latestId && !changes.gone ? rowsOf(state.config, latestId) : null;
            input.apply({
              services: latest
                ? reapplyDraft({ base: baselineServices, draft: services, latest })
                : [...services],
              name: name === null || name !== nameIn(baseline.config) ? name : nameIn(state.config),
              baseline: baseline.config,
              discarded: false,
            });
          }),
        /** The winning version as it is; the draft is dropped. */
        discard: () => {
          if (kind === "edit") {
            if (changes.gone) input.onGone();
            else
              settle(() =>
                input.apply({
                  services: latestRows(),
                  name: name === null ? null : nameIn(state.config),
                  baseline: baseline.config,
                  discarded: true,
                })
              );
            return;
          }
          settle(() => input.startOver(latestRows()));
        },
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/use-discard-guard.ts">
    export function useDiscardGuard<T>(apply: (next: T) => void, derivedDirty?: boolean) {
      const [reported, setDirty] = useState(false);
      const [pending, setPending] = useState<{ readonly next: T } | null>(null);
      const dirty = derivedDirty ?? reported;
    
      /** Moves on now, with the draft gone: after a save, or once it has been thrown away. */
      const release = (next: T) => {
        setDirty(false);
        setPending(null);
        apply(next);
      };
    
      return {
        dirty,
        setDirty,
        pending,
        request: (next: T) => (dirty ? setPending({ next }) : apply(next)),
        release,
        keepEditing: () => setPending(null),
        confirmDiscard: () => {
          if (pending) release(pending.next);
        },
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-held-for.ts">
    export function useHeldFor(active: boolean, ms: number): boolean {
      const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(false);
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!active) return undefined;
        const timer = setTimeout(() => setElapsed(true), ms);
        return () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          setElapsed(false);
        };
      }, [active, ms]);
      return active && elapsed;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-hold-focus.ts">
    export type HoldWayOut = "banner" | "reload" | null;
    export function useHoldFocus(wayOut: HoldWayOut) {
      const editorRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const bannerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const reloadRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
      const hasFocusRef = useRef(false);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!hasFocusRef.current) return;
        hasFocusRef.current = false;
        if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body) return;
        const landing = wayOut === "banner" ? bannerRef : wayOut === "reload" ? reloadRef : editorRef;
        landing.current?.querySelector("button")?.focus();
      }, [wayOut]);
    
      // A click counts too: Safari does not focus a button it clicks.
      const claim = useCallback(() => {
        hasFocusRef.current = true;
      }, []);
      const track = useMemo(
        () => ({
          onFocus: claim,
          onClick: claim,
          onBlur: (event: FocusEvent) => {
            if (event.relatedTarget) hasFocusRef.current = false;
          },
        }),
        [claim]
      );
    
      return { editorRef, bannerRef, reloadRef, track };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/use-holiday-decision.ts">
    export type HolidayChoice = "closed" | "openAsUsual" | "specialHours";
    export interface NamedHoliday extends DecidedHoliday {
      readonly name: string;
      readonly dateLabel: string;
    }
    export interface HolidayLineStatus {
      readonly phase: "saving" | "failed";
      /** The choice being saved, or the one a Retry repeats. */
      readonly to: HolidayChoice;
    }
    export interface HolidaySheetRequest {
      /** Runs once the sheet's rows are saved, not if it is cancelled. */
      readonly afterSaved?: () => Promise<void>;
      /** The sheet closed, saved or not: the lines are live again. */
      readonly onSettled: () => void;
    }
    export interface HolidayFlow {
      /** Close dates through the closure path. */
      readonly onClose: (
        rows: readonly PlannedDate[],
        title: string,
        request: HolidaySheetRequest
      ) => void;
      /** Special hours for one date through the same sheet. */
      readonly onSpecialHours: (row: PlannedDate, request: HolidaySheetRequest) => void;
      /** Reopen a closure; `then` runs once it is reopened, not if cancelled. */
      readonly onReopen: (ruleId: string, then: () => void) => void;
      /** The rule's own edit, for a date that already has special hours. */
      readonly onEditHours: (date: string) => void;
    }
    export interface UseHolidayDecisionOptions {
      readonly venueId: string;
      readonly state: AvailabilityConfigState;
      readonly onStale: () => void;
      readonly flow: HolidayFlow;
      /** An Open as usual was saved: the line has left the list, so the panel keeps focus. */
      readonly onDecided: () => void;
    }
    export function useHolidayDecision(options: UseHolidayDecisionOptions) {
      const { venueId, state, onStale, flow, onDecided } = options;
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const { toast } = useToast();
      const api = useApiClient();
      const set = useSetHolidayDecision();
      const clear = useClearHolidayDecision();
      const saveConfig = useSaveAvailabilityConfig();
      const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, HolidayLineStatus>>(() => new Map());
      const setStatus = (date: string, status: HolidayLineStatus | null) =>
        setStatuses((prev) => {
          const next = new Map(prev);
          if (status === null) next.delete(date);
          else next.set(date, status);
          return next;
        });
    
      const removeRule = (ruleId: string, version: number) =>
        saveConfig.mutateAsync({
          venueId,
          body: {
            expectedVersion: version,
            changes: { upsert: {}, remove: { dateRules: [ruleId] } },
            scopeConflicts: "keep",
          },
        });
    
      /** Runs `steps` as one save of `date`: saving, then settled or failed. Resolves true when saved. */
      const run = async (
        date: string,
        to: HolidayChoice,
        steps: () => Promise<void>
      ): Promise<boolean> => {
        setStatus(date, { phase: "saving", to });
        try {
          await steps();
          setStatus(date, null);
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          if (availabilityProblemOf(error)?.code === "version-conflict") onStale();
          setStatus(date, { phase: "failed", to });
          return false;
        }
      };
    
      const openAsUsual = async (holiday: NamedHoliday): Promise<void> => {
        const { state: from } = holiday;
        const saved = await run(holiday.date, "openAsUsual", async () => {
          // What was there goes first: if this fails nothing changed.
          if (from.kind === "specialHours") await removeRule(from.ruleId, state.version);
          await set.mutateAsync({ venueId, serviceDate: holiday.date, decision: "open_as_usual" });
        });
        if (!saved) return;
        onDecided();
        toast({
          title: t("availabilitySpecial.holidays.openAsUsualToast", { name: holiday.name }),
          // A removed special-hours rule has its own History entry; only the mark can be taken back.
          ...(from.kind === "specialHours"
            ? {}
            : {
                action: {
                  label: t("availability.undo.action"),
                  onClick: () =>
                    void clear.mutateAsync({ venueId, serviceDate: holiday.date }).catch(() => {
                      // The mark stays: the line still reads Open as usual, which is true.
                    }),
                },
              }),
        });
      };
    
      /**
       * After a closure or special hours is saved: the open mark, old hours or closure it replaces are
       * outranked (or, for the closure, reopened through its own dialog, which can be cancelled).
       */
      const tidyAfter = (holiday: NamedHoliday) => async (): Promise<void> => {
        const { state: from } = holiday;
        // Best effort: the new rule outranks all of them, so a failure here leaves the line right.
        if (from.kind === "openAsUsual") {
          await clear.mutateAsync({ venueId, serviceDate: holiday.date }).catch(() => undefined);
        }
        if (from.kind === "closed") flow.onReopen(from.ruleId, () => undefined);
        if (from.kind === "specialHours") {
          try {
            const fresh = await api.availability.getConfig(venueId);
            await removeRule(from.ruleId, fresh.version);
          } catch {
            // The closure outranks the old hours; nothing is wrong on screen.
          }
        }
      };
    
      /** Presses `to` on `holiday`: a save, or the sheet or dialog that makes it. */
      const decide = (holiday: NamedHoliday, to: HolidayChoice): void => {
        const { state: from } = holiday;
        if (to === from.kind) {
          if (to === "specialHours") flow.onEditHours(holiday.date);
          return;
        }
        if (to === "openAsUsual") {
          if (from.kind === "closed") {
            flow.onReopen(
              from.ruleId,
              () => void openAsUsual({ ...holiday, state: { kind: "undecided" } })
            );
          } else {
            void openAsUsual(holiday);
          }
          return;
        }
        const row = plannedOf(holiday, to === "closed" ? "closed" : "hours");
        // The sheet is the save: the line is saving until it closes, and nothing else is pressed.
        setStatus(holiday.date, { phase: "saving", to });
        const request: HolidaySheetRequest = {
          ...(from.kind === "undecided" ? {} : { afterSaved: tidyAfter(holiday) }),
          onSettled: () => setStatus(holiday.date, null),
        };
        if (to === "closed") {
          const names = `${holiday.name}, ${holiday.dateLabel}`;
          flow.onClose([row], t("availabilitySpecial.holidays.closedToast", { names }), request);
        } else {
          flow.onSpecialHours(row, request);
        }
      };
    
      /** Closes several holidays in one sheet: every one of them is saving until it closes. */
      const closeMany = (holidays: readonly NamedHoliday[], title: string): void => {
        for (const h of holidays) setStatus(h.date, { phase: "saving", to: "closed" });
        flow.onClose(
          holidays.map((h) => plannedOf(h, "closed")),
          title,
          { onSettled: () => holidays.forEach((h) => setStatus(h.date, null)) }
        );
      };
    
      const retry = (holiday: NamedHoliday): void => {
        const to = statuses.get(holiday.date)?.to;
        if (to) decide(holiday, to);
      };
    
      const busy = [...statuses.values()].some((s) => s.phase === "saving");
      return { statuses, busy, decide, closeMany, retry };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-holidays.ts">
    function addressCountry(profile: unknown): string | undefined {
      if (typeof profile !== "object" || profile === null) return undefined;
      const address = (profile as { address?: unknown }).address;
      if (typeof address !== "object" || address === null) return undefined;
      const country = (address as { country?: unknown }).country;
      return typeof country === "string" ? country : undefined;
    }
    export function useHolidayCountry(): HolidayCountry | null {
      const format = useVenueFormat();
      const venue = useOptionalVenue()?.selectedVenue;
      return holidayCountry(addressCountry(venue?.settings?.["profile"]), format.locale);
    }
    export function useHolidayNames(dates: readonly string[]): ReadonlyMap<string, string> {
      const country = useHolidayCountry();
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      return useMemo(() => {
        if (!country || dates.length === 0) return new Map();
        const shown = new Set(dates);
        const years = [...new Set(dates.map((d) => Number(d.slice(0, 4))))];
        return new Map(
          years
            .flatMap((year) => holidaysIn(country, year))
            .filter((h) => shown.has(h.date))
            .map((h) => [h.date, t(`availabilitySpecial.holidays.name.${h.id}`)])
        );
      }, [country, dates, t]);
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-refused-press.ts">
    export interface RefusedPressOptions {
      /** Reveal every problem: a refused save validates the whole form. */
      readonly onRefused?: () => void;
      /** Moves focus to the first problem. Called once the refusal has rendered, so the problem is there. */
      readonly focusFirstProblem: () => void;
    }
    export function useRefusedPress(options: RefusedPressOptions) {
      const { onRefused } = options;
      // Counts refusals, so each one moves focus once and a plain re-render moves none.
      const [refusals, setRefusals] = useState(0);
      const focusProblem = useEffectEvent(options.focusFirstProblem);
      useEffect(() => {
        if (refusals > 0) focusProblem();
      }, [refusals]);
      const refuse = () => {
        onRefused?.();
        setRefusals((n) => n + 1);
      };
      return { refuse, refusals };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-regular-hours-draft.ts">
    export interface RegularHoursDraftInput {
      readonly venueId: string;
      readonly state: AvailabilityConfigState;
      /** Today on the venue clock: Starting begins here, and no earlier date can be picked. */
      readonly today: string;
      readonly onStale: () => void;
      readonly offerUndo: (title: string, saved: AvailabilityConfigSaveResult) => void;
      /** Saved from the save bar (not from the leave prompt, whose route change goes ahead itself). */
      readonly onSaved: (saved: AvailabilityConfigSaveResult) => void;
      /** The regular hours the draft is based on are gone and the Manager chose to discard. */
      readonly onDiscard: () => void;
    }
    export function useRegularHoursDraft(input: RegularHoursDraftInput) {
      const { venueId, state, today, onStale, offerUndo, onSaved, onDiscard } = input;
      const scopeId = useId();
      // The leave prompt's Save: its route change goes ahead by itself, so no return to the hub.
      const viaPrompt = useRef(false);
      const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);
      const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
      const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState(false);
      const edit = useRegularWeekEdit({
        venueId,
        state,
        onStale,
        defaultStart: today,
        offerUndo,
        onGone: onDiscard,
        onSaved: (saved) => {
          setDone(true);
          if (!viaPrompt.current) onSaved(saved);
        },
      });
      const { issues, block, blocked } = edit;
      const shown = revealed ? issues : issues.filter((issue) => issue.code !== "block_days_required");
      // Everything wrong is still unsaid: the preview and the bar stay quiet about it.
      const quiet = block === null && shown.length === 0 && issues.length > 0;
      // Refused for a problem in the form, not for a conflict or a missing service.
      const refused = blocked && block === null && issues.length > 0;
      const { refuse } = useRefusedPress({
        onRefused: () => setRevealed(true),
        focusFirstProblem: () => focusFirstInvalid(shown, scopeId),
      });
      const save = () => (refused ? refuse() : void edit.submit());
      const saveAndLeave = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
        if (blocked) {
          if (refused) refuse();
          return false;
        }
        // A saved draft keeps the guard mounted until the route change goes through (the page is gone
        // by then); a refused one keeps `unsaved`, so the guard is still there to answer.
        viaPrompt.current = true;
        setLeaving(true);
        const saved = await edit.submit();
        viaPrompt.current = false;
        if (!saved) setLeaving(false);
        return saved;
      };
      const leftBlock = (event: FocusEvent) => {
        const fieldset = (event.target as HTMLElement).closest("[data-hours-block]");
        if (fieldset && !fieldset.contains(event.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setRevealed(true);
      };
      const reach: SaveReach | null =
        edit.startsOn !== null && edit.startsOn !== today
          ? { kind: "from", date: edit.startText }
          : null;
      return {
        ...edit,
        scopeId,
        shown,
        quiet,
        hasProblem: refused && !quiet,
        // A reason that is not a field's problem (a conflict, no service left); those are the form's.
        blockedReason: block === null ? null : edit.blockedText,
        reach,
        unsaved: edit.dirty && !done,
        guarded: (edit.dirty && !done) || leaving,
        save,
        saveAndLeave,
        leftBlock,
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-regular-week-edit.ts">
    export interface RegularWeekEditInput {
      readonly venueId: string;
      readonly state: AvailabilityConfigState;
      readonly onStale: () => void;
      /** The change was saved (and Undo offered); the frame decides what happens next. */
      readonly onSaved?: (saved: AvailabilityConfigSaveResult) => void;
      /** The regular week the draft is based on is gone and the Manager chose to discard. */
      readonly onGone?: () => void;
      /**
       * Pins the start to this date: the Manager picks none, it never counts as an edit and a save
       * is never blocked for lack of one. There is then no end date either.
       */
      readonly fixedStart?: string;
      /** Replaces the saved regular week as the starting draft (it is dirty when it differs). */
      readonly initialDraft?: QuickSetupDraft;
      /** Starting, prefilled (Copy → Every week). The Manager can change it; it counts as an edit. */
      readonly initialStartsOn?: string;
      /**
       * Starting, until the Manager picks another date (Regular hours: today). It is not an edit;
       * another date is. There is no end date.
       */
      readonly defaultStart?: string;
      /** Offers Undo for the save; the frame's own (the layout's) when it outlives the editor. */
      readonly offerUndo?: (title: string, saved: AvailabilityConfigSaveResult) => void;
    }
    export function useRegularWeekEdit(input: RegularWeekEditInput) {
      const { venueId, state, onStale, onSaved, onGone, fixedStart, initialDraft, initialStartsOn } =
        input;
      const { defaultStart } = input;
      const { config } = state;
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const format = useVenueFormat();
      const dayName = useWeekdayName();
      const ownUndo = useAvailabilityUndo();
      const offerUndo = (title: string, saved: AvailabilityConfigSaveResult) =>
        input.offerUndo ? input.offerUndo(title, saved) : ownUndo({ venueId, saved, title });
      const saver = useScheduleSave(onStale);
    
      const regular = config.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt);
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState<QuickSetupDraft>(() => initialDraft ?? weekOf(config));
      /** The weekday the Manager touched last: the preview opens on it. */
      const [edited, setEdited] = useState<number | null>(null);
      const [pickedStart, setStartsOn] = useState<string | null>(initialStartsOn ?? null);
      const [pickedEnd, setEndsOn] = useState<string | null>(null);
      const [name, setName] = useState("");
      const [winner, setWinner] = useState<Winner>("new");
      const [conflictMode, setConflictMode] = useState<ScopeConflictMode>("keep");
    
      const pinned = fixedStart !== undefined;
      const startsOn = pinned ? fixedStart : (pickedStart ?? defaultStart ?? null);
      const endsOn = pinned ? null : pickedEnd;
      // A start is an edit when it was picked and differs from the one the frame starts on.
      const startEdited = !pinned && pickedStart !== null && pickedStart !== defaultStart;
    
      const edit = (next: QuickSetupDraft) => {
        setEdited((was) => editedWeekday(draft, next) ?? was);
        setDraft(next);
      };
    
      const review = useConflictReview({
        kind: "regularWeek",
        state,
        // The hook keeps the regular week the edit opened on, so a colleague's newer regular week
        // is compared with, not mistaken for, where these rows came from.
        scheduleId: regular?.id,
        // The week is merged below, by service name, with its days and blocks; the hook's own
        // per-row merge is for the schedule editors.
        services: [],
        name: null,
        conflicted: saver.conflicted,
        clearConflict: saver.clearConflict,
        apply: ({ baseline }) =>
          edit(reapplyWeek({ base: weekOf(baseline), draft, latest: weekOf(state.config) })),
        startOver: () => {
          setDraft(weekOf(state.config));
          setEdited(null);
          setName("");
          setStartsOn(null);
          setEndsOn(null);
          setWinner("new");
          setConflictMode("keep");
        },
        onGone: onGone ?? (() => undefined),
      });
      const baselineWeek = useMemo(() => weekOf(review.baseline), [review.baseline]);
      const dirty =
        name.trim() !== "" ||
        startEdited ||
        endsOn !== null ||
        weekKey(draft) !== weekKey(baselineWeek);
    
      const weekdays = useMemo(() => coveredDays(draft), [draft]);
      const dates = useMemo(
        () => (startsOn ? datesOfUse({ weekdays, startsOn, endsOn }, startsOn) : []),
        [weekdays, startsOn, endsOn]
      );
      const own = useMemo(() => ownChangeDates(config, dates, null), [config, dates]);
      const overlaps = useMemo(
        () =>
          startsOn && endsOn
            ? overlappingSchedules(config, { weekdays, startsOn, endsOn }).map((s) => s.name)
            : [],
        [config, weekdays, startsOn, endsOn]
      );
      const issues = useMemo(() => validateDraft(draft), [draft]);
      // What `buildRegularWeekChanges` falls back to per service name: the form shows the same.
      const storedKept = useMemo(() => storedKeptByName(config, "regular"), [config]);
      const outside = useMemo(() => outsideSchedules(config), [config]);
      const closedDays = baselineWeek.days.filter((day) => !weekdays.includes(day));
      const focusDate =
        edited === null ? undefined : dates.find((date) => weekdayIndexOf(date) === edited);
    
      const trimmed = name.trim();
      const block = scheduleSaveBlock({
        conflicted: saver.conflicted,
        name,
        services: draft.services,
        startsOn,
        endsOn,
        startRequired: !pinned,
        nameRequired: endsOn !== null,
      });
      const firstIssue = issues[0];
      const blockedText = block
        ? t(`availabilitySchedules.blocked.${block === "nameRequired" ? "nameRequiredPeriod" : block}`)
        : firstIssue
          ? issueMessage(firstIssue, draft, t, (day) => dayName(day))
          : null;
      const blocked = blockedText !== null;
      const previewChanges = useMemo(
        () =>
          blocked || !startsOn
            ? null
            : buildRegularWeekChanges({
                config,
                name: trimmed,
                draft,
                startsOn,
                endsOn,
                winner,
                makeId: previewIds(),
              }),
        [blocked, config, trimmed, draft, startsOn, endsOn, winner]
      );
      const startText = startsOn
        ? format.formatCalendarDate(startsOn, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })
        : "";
      const scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictMode = dates.length > 1 ? conflictMode : "replace";
    
      /** Saves the draft; `true` when it was saved (and Undo offered), `false` when it was not. */
      const submit = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
        if (!startsOn) return false;
        const changes = buildRegularWeekChanges({
          config,
          name: trimmed,
          draft,
          startsOn,
          endsOn,
          winner,
          makeId: () => crypto.randomUUID(),
        });
        // Checked against the version the draft was built from, so a change made since is a
        // conflict the Manager reviews, not something this save quietly rebases.
        const saved = await saver.save(venueId, state, changes, scopeConflicts, review.baselineVersion);
        if (!saved) return false;
        offerUndo(
          endsOn === null
            ? t("availabilitySchedules.regularWeek.savedWeek", { date: startText })
            : t("availabilitySchedules.regularWeek.saved", { name: trimmed, date: startText }),
          saved
        );
        onSaved?.(saved);
        return true;
      };
    
      return {
        draft,
        edit,
        startsOn,
        setStartsOn,
        endsOn,
        setEndsOn,
        name,
        setName,
        winner,
        setWinner,
        conflictMode,
        setConflictMode,
        saver,
        review,
        dirty,
        weekdays,
        dates,
        own,
        overlaps,
        issues,
        storedKept,
        outside,
        closedDays,
        focusDate,
        trimmed,
        block,
        blockedText,
        blocked,
        previewChanges,
        scopeConflicts,
        startText,
        submit,
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-reload-hold.ts">
    function emit() {
      for (const listener of listeners) listener();
    }
    function addSaveUnderWay(venueId: string, by: 1 | -1) {
      savesUnderWay.set(venueId, (savesUnderWay.get(venueId) ?? 0) + by);
      emit();
    }
    export async function trackOwnSave<T extends { readonly version: number }>(
      venueId: string,
      run: () => Promise<T>
    ): Promise<T> {
      addSaveUnderWay(venueId, 1);
      try {
        const result = await run();
        savedVersions.set(venueId, Math.max(savedVersions.get(venueId) ?? 0, result.version));
        return result;
      } finally {
        // A refused save moved nothing, so there is no version to wait for.
        addSaveUnderWay(venueId, -1);
      }
    }
    function subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => listeners.delete(listener);
    }
    export function useReloadHold(venueId: string | undefined, version: number | undefined) {
      const saving = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () =>
        venueId === undefined ? 0 : (savesUnderWay.get(venueId) ?? 0)
      );
      const saved = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () =>
        venueId === undefined ? 0 : (savedVersions.get(venueId) ?? 0)
      );
      const reloadDue = version !== undefined && saved > version;
      return { behind: saving > 0 || reloadDue, reloadDue };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-save-attempts.ts">
    export interface TriedAttempt {
      readonly key: string;
      readonly ruleIds: readonly string[];
      readonly dates: readonly string[];
      readonly summary: string;
    }
    export interface SaveAttemptsOptions {
      /** The first attempt's rule id, when the rule already has one (a Tonight close-early). */
      readonly firstRuleId?: string;
      /** Reloads the config: leaving after a save leaves the calendar stale otherwise. */
      readonly reload: () => void;
      readonly onLeave: () => void;
    }
    export function useSaveAttempts(rules: readonly DateRule[], options: SaveAttemptsOptions) {
      const { firstRuleId, reload, onLeave } = options;
      const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(() => newAttempt(firstRuleId));
      const [tried, setTried] = useState<readonly TriedAttempt[]>([]);
      const [failedSave, setFailedSave] = useState(false);
      const [maybeSaved, setMaybeSaved] = useState(false);
      const earlier = tried.find((a) => rules.some((r) => a.ruleIds.includes(r.id)));
    
      const finish = () => {
        if (tried.length > 0) reload();
        onLeave();
      };
      const guard = useDiscardGuard<null>(() => finish());
    
      const restart = (ruleId?: string) => {
        setAttempt(newAttempt(ruleId));
        setFailedSave(false);
      };
    
      return {
        ...attempt,
        tried,
        earlier,
        /** Some attempt got no definite answer. Later refusals do not settle it. */
        maybeSaved,
        restart,
        finish,
        setDirty: guard.setDirty,
        /** A choice or field moved from `before` to `after`: after a failure, that is a new attempt. */
        edited: (before: unknown, after: unknown) => {
          if (failedSave && JSON.stringify(before) !== JSON.stringify(after)) restart();
        },
        /**
         * Call before sending. One rule id can be sent more than once (a refused send keeps it, and
         * the Manager may then choose differently), and the send that commits is the last one.
         */
        record: (
          summary: string,
          ruleIds: readonly string[] = [attempt.ruleId],
          dates: readonly string[] = []
        ) => {
          const sent = { key: attempt.idempotencyKey, ruleIds, dates, summary };
          setTried((all) => [...all.filter((a) => a.key !== sent.key), sent]);
        },
        /** The save was refused, or lost: a changed request is now a new attempt, and leaving asks. */
        failed: (refusal: Refusal) => {
          setFailedSave(true);
          if (mayHaveSaved(refusal)) setMaybeSaved(true);
          guard.setDirty(true);
        },
        /** Escape during a save would close the dialog while the save still commits. */
        leave: (busy = false) => {
          if (busy) return;
          // Nothing to discard once it is saved: the question would be false.
          if (earlier) finish();
          else guard.request(null);
        },
        asking: guard.pending !== null,
        confirmLeave: guard.confirmDiscard,
        keepEditing: guard.keepEditing,
      };
    }
    export type SaveAttempts = ReturnType<typeof useSaveAttempts>;
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/use-schedule-save.ts">
    export interface SaveConflict {
      /** The change that won; `null` when the server recorded none. */
      readonly winningChange: AvailabilityChangeSummary | null;
      readonly changesSince?: ConflictChangesSince;
      /** The version the 409 reported, which Overwrite goes against; `null` from an older server. */
      readonly seen: number | null;
      /** An Overwrite met this one: the dialog was already open on an earlier change. */
      readonly again: boolean;
    }
    export function useScheduleSave(
      onStale: () => void,
      strandedKey:
        | "availabilitySchedules.stranded"
        | "availabilitySpecial.series.stranded"
        | "availabilitySpecial.rowStranded" = "availabilitySchedules.stranded"
    ) {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const { mutateAsync, isPending } = useSaveAvailabilityConfig();
      const [failure, setFailure] = useState<readonly string[]>([]);
      // The bookings behind a stranded refusal, listed beneath its message.
      const [stranded, setStranded] = useState<readonly StrandedReservation[]>([]);
      // A lost race. The draft was built from a version that is gone, so a form that edits rows
      // must show what changed and get an answer before it saves again.
      const [conflict, setConflict] = useState<SaveConflict | null>(null);
      // The last refusal answered an Overwrite, so it is said in the conflict dialog.
      const [overwriteRefused, setOverwriteRefused] = useState(false);
    
      const clearFailure = () => {
        setFailure([]);
        setStranded([]);
        setOverwriteRefused(false);
      };
    
      const reject = (error: unknown, overwrote: boolean) => {
        const problem = availabilityProblemOf(error);
        if (problem?.code === "version-conflict") {
          onStale();
          setConflict({
            winningChange: problem.winningChange ?? null,
            ...(problem.changesSince ? { changesSince: problem.changesSince } : {}),
            seen: problem.currentVersion ?? null,
            again: overwrote,
          });
          setFailure([t("availabilitySchedules.conflict")]);
          return;
        }
        setOverwriteRefused(overwrote);
        if (problem?.code === "invalid-config" && problem.issues?.length) {
          setFailure(problem.issues.map((i) => i.message));
        } else if (problem?.code === "stranded-bookings") {
          setFailure([t(strandedKey, { count: problem.reservations?.length ?? 0 })]);
          setStranded(problem.reservations ?? []);
        } else {
          setFailure([describeApiError(error).detail]);
        }
      };
    
      const send = async (
        venueId: string,
        body: {
          expectedVersion: number;
          changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges;
          scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictMode;
        },
        overwrote: boolean
      ): Promise<AvailabilityConfigSaveResult | null> => {
        clearFailure();
        try {
          return await mutateAsync({ venueId, body });
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error, overwrote);
          return null;
        }
      };
    
      /** Resolves the save result (truthy) when the change was saved, `null` when it was refused. */
      const save = (
        venueId: string,
        state: AvailabilityConfigState,
        changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
        scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictMode,
        /** The version the changes were built against, when that is not the latest `state`. */
        expectedVersion: number = state.version
      ): Promise<AvailabilityConfigSaveResult | null> =>
        send(venueId, { expectedVersion, changes, scopeConflicts }, false);
    
      /**
       * Saves over the change the conflict named: checked against the version the 409 reported, never
       * one read at click time, so a change the dialog did not show is another conflict.
       */
      const overwrite = async (
        venueId: string,
        changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
        scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictMode
      ): Promise<AvailabilityConfigSaveResult | null> => {
        const seen = conflict?.seen;
        if (seen === null || seen === undefined) return null;
        const saved = await send(venueId, { expectedVersion: seen, changes, scopeConflicts }, true);
        if (saved) setConflict(null);
        return saved;
      };
    
      return {
        save,
        overwrite,
        isPending,
        failure,
        stranded,
        conflict,
        conflicted: conflict !== null,
        /** Why the last Overwrite was refused, when it was not for a newer change. */
        overwriteFailure: overwriteRefused ? failure : [],
        clearFailure,
        /** The Manager has answered the conflict; the next save is against the version they saw. */
        clearConflict: () => {
          setConflict(null);
          clearFailure();
        },
      };
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/components/availability/use-winning-change-text.ts">
    type ChangeSummaryText = typeof changeSummaryText;
    function useChangeSummaryText(coded: boolean): ChangeSummaryText | null {
      const [text, setText] = useState<ChangeSummaryText | null>(null);
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!coded) return;
        let live = true;
        import("./change-summary-text.js").then(
          (m) => {
            if (live) setText(() => m.changeSummaryText);
          },
          () => undefined
        );
        return () => {
          live = false;
        };
      }, [coded]);
      return text;
    }
    export function useWinningChangeText(winningChange: AvailabilityChangeSummary | null): string {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const format = useVenueFormat();
      const { user } = useAuth();
      const worded = useChangeSummaryText(Boolean(winningChange?.detail));
      if (!winningChange) return t("availability.conflict.unknown");
      return t("availability.conflict.winning", {
        who:
          user?.id === winningChange.actorId
            ? t("availability.history.you")
            : t("availability.history.teammate"),
        summary: worded ? worded(winningChange, format, t) : winningChange.summary,
        when: format.formatInstant(winningChange.at, { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }),
      });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/useDateSelection.ts">
    export interface DateSelectionOptions {
      readonly selection: readonly string[];
      readonly onSelectionChange: (dates: string[]) => void;
      readonly onOpenDay: (date: string) => void;
      /** Select days is on: a plain click or tap picks, with no long press needed to start. */
      readonly selecting?: boolean;
      /**
       * A range drag is under way (`true`) or over (`false`). The page holds back anything that would
       * move the grid under the pointer until the drag ends.
       */
      readonly onDragChange?: (dragging: boolean) => void;
    }
    export interface DateGestureHandlers {
      readonly onClick: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
      readonly onMouseDown: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
      readonly onMouseEnter: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
      readonly onTouchStart: () => void;
      readonly onTouchMove: () => void;
      readonly onTouchEnd: (event: TouchEvent) => void;
      readonly onContextMenu: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
    }
    export function useDateSelection(options: DateSelectionOptions) {
      const { selection, onSelectionChange, onOpenDay, onDragChange, selecting = false } = options;
      const pivot = useRef<string | null>(null);
      const drag = useRef<{ from: string; moved: boolean } | null>(null);
      const suppressClick = useRef(false);
      const touchMode = useRef(false);
      const pressTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
      const pressed = useRef(false);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const endDrag = () => {
          if (drag.current?.moved) {
            // The click that follows a drag's mouseup fires synchronously; clear the flag after it.
            suppressClick.current = true;
            setTimeout(() => {
              suppressClick.current = false;
            }, 0);
            onDragChange?.(false);
          }
          drag.current = null;
        };
        window.addEventListener("mouseup", endDrag);
        // A release the window never sees (outside it, or after switching away) ends the drag too.
        window.addEventListener("blur", endDrag);
        return () => {
          window.removeEventListener("mouseup", endDrag);
          window.removeEventListener("blur", endDrag);
        };
      }, [onDragChange]);
    
      /** A drag whose mouseup was lost: what shows it was lost ends it, without any click to swallow. */
      const dropLostDrag = () => {
        if (drag.current?.moved) onDragChange?.(false);
        drag.current = null;
      };
    
      const clearTimer = () => {
        if (pressTimer.current) clearTimeout(pressTimer.current);
        pressTimer.current = null;
      };
    
      /** Select from `from` through `to`, keeping `from` as the pivot (Shift+Arrow, drag). */
      const extendSelection = (from: string, to: string) => {
        pivot.current = from;
        onSelectionChange(dateRange(from, to));
      };
    
      /** Add or remove one day, and make it the pivot a later Shift-click or Shift+Arrow grows from. */
      const toggleSelected = (date: string) => {
        pivot.current = date;
        onSelectionChange(toggleDate(selection, date));
      };
    
      const handlersFor = (date: string): DateGestureHandlers => ({
        onMouseDown: (event) => {
          dropLostDrag();
          if (event.button === 0 && !event.shiftKey && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) {
            drag.current = { from: date, moved: false };
          }
        },
        onMouseEnter: (event) => {
          if (event.buttons === 0) {
            dropLostDrag();
            return;
          }
          const d = drag.current;
          if (!d || (date === d.from && !d.moved)) return;
          if (!d.moved) onDragChange?.(true);
          d.moved = true;
          extendSelection(d.from, date);
        },
        onClick: (event) => {
          if (suppressClick.current) return;
          if (event.shiftKey) {
            onSelectionChange(dateRange(pivot.current ?? date, date));
          } else if (
            selecting ||
            event.ctrlKey ||
            event.metaKey ||
            (touchMode.current && selection.length > 0)
          ) {
            toggleSelected(date);
          } else {
            pivot.current = date;
            touchMode.current = false;
            onOpenDay(date);
          }
        },
        onTouchStart: () => {
          pressed.current = false;
          clearTimer();
          pressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
            pressed.current = true;
            touchMode.current = true;
            pivot.current = date;
            onSelectionChange(normalizeDates([...selection, date]));
          }, LONG_PRESS_MS);
        },
        onTouchMove: clearTimer,
        onTouchEnd: (event) => {
          clearTimer();
          // Swallow the click the browser synthesises after a long-press.
          if (pressed.current) event.preventDefault();
          pressed.current = false;
        },
        onContextMenu: (event) => {
          if (pressTimer.current || pressed.current) event.preventDefault();
        },
      });
    
      return { handlersFor, extendSelection, toggleSelected, pivot };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/weekday-summary.ts">
    export function weekdaySummary(
      weekdays: readonly number[],
      format: Pick<VenueFormat, "formatCalendarDate" | "locale">,
      t: TFunction
    ): string {
      if (weekdays.length === 7) return t("availabilitySchedules.everyDay");
      const name = (day: number) =>
        format.formatCalendarDate(addDays(SUNDAY, day), { weekday: "short" });
      return new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(
        weekdayRuns(weekdays).map(([a, b]) => (a === b ? name(a) : `${name(a)}–${name(b)}`))
      );
    }
  </file>
  </section>
  <section priority="medium" role="booking-widget">
  <file path="src/components/booking-widget/effectiveDepositPolicy.ts">
    export interface EffectiveDepositPolicyParams {
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null;
      venueSlug: string | undefined;
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined;
      guestIsRisky: boolean;
    }
    export function effectiveDepositPolicy({
      depositConfig,
      venueSlug,
      stripePublishableKey,
      guestIsRisky,
    }: EffectiveDepositPolicyParams): DepositConfig | null {
      if (!venueSlug || !stripePublishableKey || !depositConfig) return null;
      if (depositConfig.enabled) return depositConfig;
      return guestIsRisky ? depositConfig : null;
    }
    export function guestRiskMatters(
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null,
      venueSlug: string | undefined,
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return !depositConfig?.enabled && Boolean(venueSlug) && Boolean(stripePublishableKey);
    }
    export function provisionalDepositRequired(
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null,
      venueSlug: string | undefined,
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return (
        effectiveDepositPolicy({
          depositConfig,
          venueSlug,
          stripePublishableKey,
          guestIsRisky: false,
        }) !== null
      );
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/booking-widget/formatDepositCancellationTerms.ts">
    type FreeWindow = Extract<CancellationPolicyDescription, { kind: "free-window" }>;
    export function describeDepositCancellation(
      config: DepositConfig | null,
      partySize: number
    ): FreeWindow | null {
      if (!config || config.freeCancellationHours == null) return null;
      const description = describeCancellationPolicy({
        depositAmountCents: quoteDeposit(config, partySize),
        freeCancellationHours: config.freeCancellationHours,
        lateCancellationFeePercent: config.lateCancellationFeePercent,
        noShowFeePercent: config.noShowFeePercent,
      });
      return description.kind === "free-window" ? description : null;
    }
    export function useDepositCancellationTerms(
      config: DepositConfig | null,
      partySize: number
    ): string | null {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const { formatMoney } = useVenueFormat({
        ianaTimezone: "",
        currencyCode: config?.currency ?? "usd",
      });
      const terms = describeDepositCancellation(config, partySize);
      if (!terms) return null;
      return t("bookingWidget.cancellationTerms", {
        count: terms.freeHours,
        lateFeePercent: terms.lateFeePercent,
        lateFee: formatMoney(terms.lateFeeAmountCents),
        noShowFeePercent: terms.noShowFeePercent,
        noShowFee: formatMoney(terms.noShowFeeAmountCents),
      });
    }

  <file path="src/components/booking-widget/hasOperatingHours.ts">
    export function hasOperatingHours(operatingHours: OperatingHours | null | undefined): boolean {
      if (!operatingHours) return false;
      return DAYS.some((day) => {
        const schedule = operatingHours[day];
        return schedule != null && schedule.closed !== true;
      });
    }
