        jsonOk(route, {
          venue: { name: "E2E Test Bistro", slug: "e2e-test-bistro" },
          date: localDay(3),
          time: "19:00",
          partySize: 4,
          rsvps: [{ firstName: "Sam", status: "IN" }],
          status: "CONFIRMED",
        })
      );
    }
    async function mockMenus(page: Page): Promise<void> {
      const venues = JSON.parse(loadFixture("venues-list")) as { data: Array<{ id: string }> };
      const venueId = venues.data[0]?.id ?? "";
      const menus: StoredMenu[] = [];
      let seq = 0;
      const nextId = (prefix: string): string => `${prefix}_e2e_${++seq}`;
      const bodyOf = (route: Route): Record<string, unknown> => {
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          return parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object"
            ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)
            : {};
        } catch {
          return {};
        }
      };
      const summary = ({ sections: _sections, ...menu }: StoredMenu): Menu => menu;
      const notFound = (route: Route): Promise<void> =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 404,
          contentType: "application/problem+json",
          body: JSON.stringify(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "not found")),
        });
    
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/menus(\/|\?|$)/, (route) => {
        const method = route.request().method();
        const [menuId, kind, sectionId, itemsKind, itemId] = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname
          .replace(/^\/api\/v1\/menus\/?/, "")
          .split("/")
          .filter(Boolean);
        const body = bodyOf(route);
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
    
        if (menuId === undefined) {
          if (method === "GET") return jsonOk(route, menus.map(summary));
          if (method !== "POST") return route.fallback();
          const menu: StoredMenu = {
            description: null,
            status: "DRAFT",
            displayOrder: menus.length,
            ...(body as Pick<Menu, "name" | "slug"> & Partial<Menu>),
            id: nextId("menu"),
            venueId,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now,
            sections: [],
          };
          menus.push(menu);
          return route.fulfill({
            status: 201,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ data: summary(menu) }),
          });
        }
    
        const menu = menus.find((m) => m.id === menuId);
        if (!menu) return notFound(route);
    
        if (kind === undefined) {
          if (method === "GET") return jsonOk(route, menu);
          if (method !== "PATCH") return route.fallback();
          Object.assign(menu, body, { updatedAt: now });
          return jsonOk(route, summary(menu));
        }
        if (kind !== "sections") return route.fallback();
    
        if (sectionId === undefined) {
          if (method !== "POST") return route.fallback();
          const section: StoredSection = {
            displayOrder: menu.sections.length,
            ...(body as Pick<MenuSection, "name"> & Partial<MenuSection>),
            id: nextId("sec"),
            venueId,
            menuId: menu.id,
            items: [],
          };
          menu.sections.push(section);
          const { items: _items, ...created } = section;
          return route.fulfill({
            status: 201,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ data: created }),
          });
        }
    
        const section = menu.sections.find((s) => s.id === sectionId);
        if (!section) return notFound(route);
        if (itemsKind !== "items") return route.fallback();
    
        if (itemId === undefined) {
          if (method !== "POST") return route.fallback();
          const item: MenuItem = {
            description: null,
            status: "AVAILABLE",
            displayOrder: section.items.length,
            ...(body as Pick<MenuItem, "name" | "priceCents"> & Partial<MenuItem>),
            id: nextId("item"),
            venueId,
            sectionId: section.id,
          };
          section.items.push(item);
          return route.fulfill({
            status: 201,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ data: item }),
          });
        }
    
        const item = section.items.find((i) => i.id === itemId);
        if (!item) return notFound(route);
        if (method !== "PATCH") return route.fallback();
        Object.assign(item, body);
        return jsonOk(route, item);
      });
    
      // Guest routes: ACTIVE menus only, HIDDEN items withheld — the public projection.
      await page.route(/\/public\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/menus(\/[^/?]+)?(\?.*)?$/, (route) => {
        const menuSlug = new URL(route.request().url()).pathname.split("/")[6];
        const active = menus.filter((m) => m.status === "ACTIVE");
        if (menuSlug === undefined) {
          return jsonOk(
            route,
            active.map(({ id, name, slug, description, displayOrder }) => ({
              id,
              name,
              slug,
              description,
              displayOrder,
            }))
          );
        }
        const menu = active.find((m) => m.slug === menuSlug);
        if (!menu) return notFound(route);
        return jsonOk(route, {
          id: menu.id,
          name: menu.name,
          slug: menu.slug,
          description: menu.description,
          displayOrder: menu.displayOrder,
          currencyCode: "USD",
          sections: menu.sections.map((section) => ({
            id: section.id,
            name: section.name,
            displayOrder: section.displayOrder,
            items: section.items
              .filter((item) => item.status !== "HIDDEN")
              .map(({ id, name, description, priceCents, status, displayOrder }) => ({
                id,
                name,
                description,
                priceCents,
                status: status === "SOLD_OUT" ? ("SOLD_OUT" as const) : ("AVAILABLE" as const),
                displayOrder,
              })),
          })),
        });
      });
    }
    export type SseEventEntry = { type: string; data: unknown };
    export type SseMock = { setEvents: (events: readonly SseEventEntry[]) => void };
    export async function mockApi(page: Page): Promise<SseMock> {
      // Signal to QueryProvider to disable react-query retries so error states
      // (e.g. the dashboard 500 test) appear within the 5s E2E assertion window
      // instead of after the default 3x exponential backoff (~7s).
      await page.addInitScript(() => {
        (window as unknown as { __e2eNoRetry: boolean }).__e2eNoRetry = true;
      });
    
      // Pre-seed the persisted venue selection with the fixture venue so the app
      // boots with a selectedVenueId that resolves against the mocked venue list.
      // Without this, the first render after the venues query settles still has
      // selectedVenue === null (selection is reconciled in a later effect), which
      // reads as "no-venue" and fires DashboardLayout's sticky /onboarding
      // redirect before the reconcile effect runs — a race that bounced ~half the
      // suite onto the New Venue wizard (issue #3309). The underlying product
      // race still deserves an in-app fix; this only makes the harness
      // deterministic.
      const venuesFixture = JSON.parse(loadFixture("venues-list"));
      const seededVenueId: string = venuesFixture.data[0].id;
      await page.addInitScript((id) => {
        localStorage.setItem("mbe-hospitality-venue-id", id);
      }, seededVenueId);
    
      // Users
      await page.route("**/api/v1/users/me", (route) =>
        route.request().method() === "PATCH"
          ? jsonResponse(route, "user-me")
          : jsonResponse(route, "user-me")
      );
      await page.route("**/api/v1/users/me/preferences", (route) => jsonResponse(route, "user-me"));
      await page.route("**/api/v1/users?*", (route) => {
        const fixture = JSON.parse(loadFixture("user-me"));
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            data: [fixture.data],
            pagination: { page: 1, limit: 25, total: 1, totalPages: 1, hasNext: false, hasPrev: false },
          }),
        });
      });
    
      // Venues
      // Stateful create sequence (#4762): POST /api/v1/venues carries neither a
      // query string nor an id segment, so it is matched by neither the list
      // route below nor the id-segment route further down — it needs its own
      // handler. A single `let`, not an array: this wizard launches one venue
      // per E2E run. Layered onto the list route so a post-launch refetch (the
      // handoff in VenueOnboardingPage) sees the venue it just created.
      let createdVenue: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
      await page.route("**/api/v1/venues", (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "POST") return route.fallback();
        const venues = loadStaffVenues();
        let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
            body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
          }
        } catch {
          // no body — leave empty
        }
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        createdVenue = {
          ...venues.data[0],
          ...body,
          id: "ven_e2e_created",
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 201,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: createdVenue }),
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/venues?*", (route) => {
        const venues = loadStaffVenues();
        const allData = createdVenue ? [...venues.data, createdVenue] : venues.data;
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...venues,
            data: allData,
            pagination: { ...venues.pagination, total: allData.length },
          }),
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/venues/by-slug/*", (route) =>
        jsonOk(route, buildPublicVenueFixture())
      );
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        const method = route.request().method();
        const venues = loadStaffVenues();
        if (method === "POST" || method === "PATCH") {
          return jsonOk(route, { ...venues.data[0], updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
        return jsonOk(route, venues.data[0]);
      });
    
      // Settings → Team (#7510): GET returns a constant team (the viewer is a
      // Manager, plus an owner and one Host) so the Settings page renders the same
      // card every run; PATCHes echo the body back as the stored value.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/team(\/members\/[^/?]+)?$/, (route) => {
        const request = route.request();
        if (request.method() !== "PATCH") return jsonOk(route, buildVenueTeamFixture());
        const body = (request.postDataJSON() ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
        const memberSub = request.url().match(/\/members\/([^/?]+)$/)?.[1];
        return jsonOk(
          route,
          memberSub ? { userSub: decodeURIComponent(memberSub), role: body.role } : body
        );
      });
    
      // Availability drawer editing (#7515): a save that always lands (PUT answers the next version).
      // GETs fall back so the shared days/config mocks (#7616) answer them, whatever the
      // registration order.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/availability\/config$/, (route) =>
        route.request().method() === "PUT"
          ? jsonOk(route, { version: 1, changeId: "chg_e2e_001" })
          : route.fallback()
      );
      // Availability page (#7514): the calendar lists `?from&to` as one open
      // "Regular" day each (two services, no closures), and the drawer reads a
      // constant one-schedule config. Deterministic so the page renders the same
      // grid every run.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/availability\/days(\?|$)/, (route) => {
        const url = new URL(route.request().url());
        const from = url.searchParams.get("from");
        const to = url.searchParams.get("to");
        const data: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
        if (from && to) {
          // Civil-date stepping: the query's dates are service dates, not instants.
          const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
          const civil = (t: Date) =>
            `${t.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad(t.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad(t.getUTCDate())}`;
          for (let d = new Date(`${from}T00:00:00Z`); d <= new Date(`${to}T00:00:00Z`);) {
            data.push({
              serviceDate: civil(d),
              label: "Regular",
              scheduleId: "sch-regular",
              serviceCount: 2,
              closures: [],
              bookingOpen: { online: true, phone: true, waitlist: true },
            });
            d = new Date(d.getTime() + 86_400_000);
          }
        }
        return jsonOk(route, data);
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/availability\/config$/, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.fallback();
        return jsonOk(route, buildAvailabilityConfigFixture());
      });
    
      // Special dates tab (#7527): no closures have outcomes yet. Only GET; the Close dialog's POST
      // (and each spec's own stateful mock) falls through.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/closures$/, (route) =>
        route.request().method() === "GET" ? jsonOk(route, []) : route.fallback()
      );
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/closures\/[^/?]+\/call-list$/, (route) =>
        jsonOk(route, [])
      );
    
      // Holiday decisions ("open as usual"): none saved. Every /availability load asks for them, so
      // without a mock the request reaches the real service in CI with a made-up venue id (the CI run
      // showed the session-renew banner on pages that loaded it). Only GET; a spec's own stateful mock
      // (helpers/shared-config-mock.ts) is registered later and answers first.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/availability\/holiday-decisions(\?|$)/, (route) =>
        route.request().method() === "GET" ? jsonOk(route, []) : route.fallback()
      );
    
      // Venue Groups
      await page.route("**/api/v1/venues/groups*", (route) => emptyPaginated(route));
    
      // Tables
      // Stateful create sequence (#4762): POST /api/v1/tables (bare, no query,
      // no id segment) appends the new table to a per-context list — mirrors
      // the reservations/waitlist stateful stores below. Read by the Floor
      // Plans section's GET-by-id handler so the editor the wizard lands on
      // renders the tables Launch just created, not the static fixture.
      const createdTables: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
      // Per-context table-status store (#5023). PATCH /tables/:id/status writes here; the tables
      // list, the table-by-id route and every reservation's embedded `table` read through it, so a
      // party seated in one request reads OCCUPIED on the next refetch instead of the static fixture.
      const tableUpdates = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
    
      function allTables(): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
        const tables = JSON.parse(loadFixture("tables-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        };
        return [...tables.data, ...createdTables].map((table) => ({
          ...table,
          ...(tableUpdates.get(table.id as string) ?? {}),
        }));
      }
      await page.route("**/api/v1/tables", (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "POST") return route.fallback();
        const tables = JSON.parse(loadFixture("tables-list"));
        let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
            body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
          }
        } catch {
          // no body — leave empty
        }
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const newTable = {
          ...tables.data[0],
          ...body,
          id: `tbl_e2e_created_${createdTables.length + 1}`,
          status: "AVAILABLE",
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
        createdTables.push(newTable);
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 201,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: newTable }),
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/tables?*", (route) => {
        const tables = JSON.parse(loadFixture("tables-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
          pagination: Record<string, unknown>;
        };
        const allData = allTables();
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...tables,
            data: allData,
            pagination: { ...tables.pagination, total: allData.length },
          }),
        });
      });
      // PATCH /api/v1/tables/:id/status — stores the new status so later reads reflect it.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/tables\/[^/?]+\/status$/, (route) => {
        const id =
          route
            .request()
            .url()
            .replace(/\?.*$/, "")
            .replace(/\/status$/, "")
            .split("/")
            .pop() ?? "";
        let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
            body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
          }
        } catch {
          // no body — leave empty
        }
        if (typeof body.status === "string") {
          tableUpdates.set(id, { status: body.status, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
        const tables = allTables();
        return jsonOk(route, tables.find((table) => table.id === id) ?? { ...tables[0], id });
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/tables\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        const id = route.request().url().replace(/\?.*$/, "").split("/").pop() ?? "";
        const tables = allTables();
        return jsonOk(route, tables.find((table) => table.id === id) ?? tables[0]);
      });
    
      // Reservations
      // Per-context stateful store so post-mutation assertions (count +1, updated field)
      // reflect what the UI just created or edited.
      const extraReservations: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
      const reservationUpdates = new Map<string, Record<string, unknown>>();
    
      // Re-date fixtures to today — the timeline discards r.date !== selectedDate (today) client-side.
      // Fixture JSON uses a static past date; this transform makes reservations visible in E2E tests.
      // "Today" is the local calendar day (`localDay()`) — the twin of `src/utils/service-day.ts`
      // `deviceDate`, the clock the app filters on. A UTC slice rolls to tomorrow at 17:00
      // Pacific and emptied the grid for the whole evening service (A1 / P01).
      //
      // The clock is re-dated along with the day (#5275). Rewriting only the date *prefix* left the
      // fixture's `Z` suffix in place, while the grid positions blocks by browser-local hours
      // (`reservationLayout.ts` `start.getHours()`, window 11:00–23:00) — so an 18:00Z block landed
      // at left = −120 px in PST and −1200 px at UTC+5, off the grid in both. It failed as a pass:
      // a negatively positioned block still has a bounding box, so `toBeVisible()` stayed green.
      // Reading each fixture time as the *intended local wall clock* keeps both halves in one zone.
      function localizeFixtureTime(iso: unknown, day: string): string {
        return atLocal(String(iso).slice(11, 23), day); // "18:00:00.000" — the fixture's wall clock
      }
    
      function todayReservations(): string {
        const today = localDay();
        const fixture = JSON.parse(loadFixture("reservations-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
          pagination: unknown;
        };
        return JSON.stringify({
          ...fixture,
          data: fixture.data.map((r) => ({
            ...r,
            date: today,
            startTime: localizeFixtureTime(r.startTime, today),
            endTime: localizeFixtureTime(r.endTime, today),
          })),
        });
      }
    
      // Embed the store's view of a reservation's table once a PATCH has touched it (#5023).
      // Untouched reservations keep the fixture shape, embedded table or not; an unknown tableId
      // is left alone rather than given a partial `table` the client's schema would reject.
      function withTableStatus(r: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
        if (!tableUpdates.has(r.tableId as string)) return r;
        const table = allTables().find((t) => t.id === r.tableId);
        return table ? { ...r, table } : r;
      }
    
      // Stateful list: base fixture + walk-ins created this session + applied edits.
      function buildReservationsList(): string {
        const base = JSON.parse(todayReservations()) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
          pagination: Record<string, unknown>;
        };
        const allData = [...base.data, ...extraReservations].map((r) =>
          withTableStatus({ ...r, ...(reservationUpdates.get(r.id as string) ?? {}) })
        );
        return JSON.stringify({
          ...base,
          data: allData,
          pagination: { ...(base.pagination as Record<string, unknown>), total: allData.length },
        });
      }
    
      // Individual reservation — generic handler.
      // Negative lookahead excludes "walk-in" from this regex as a safety net.
      // Registered BEFORE the walk-in glob so walk-in wins LIFO (later = higher priority).
      //
      // Reads through `todayReservations()`, never the raw fixture (#5279 item 4): the list handler
      // re-dates every row, so a raw read made the detail disagree with the list it was opened from —
      // a 2026-05-17 date and an 18:00Z clock behind a block the grid had drawn on today. An
      // unrecognised id answers with the first row *carrying the requested id*, the way the
      // tables-by-id handler does, so the detail never claims to be a different reservation.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/reservations\/(?!walk-in)[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        const method = route.request().method();
        const id = route.request().url().replace(/\?.*$/, "").split("/").pop() ?? "";
        const reservations = JSON.parse(todayReservations()) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        };
        const baseItem = reservations.data.find((r) => r.id === id) ?? {
          ...reservations.data[0],
          id,
        };
        if (method === "DELETE") {
          return jsonOk(route, { ...baseItem, status: "CANCELLED" });
        }
        if (method === "PATCH") {
          let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
          try {
            const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
            if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
              body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
            }
          } catch {
            // no body — leave empty
          }
          const existing = reservationUpdates.get(id) ?? {};
          const merged = { ...existing, ...body };
          reservationUpdates.set(id, merged);
          return jsonOk(route, { ...baseItem, ...merged, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
        return jsonOk(route, { ...baseItem, ...(reservationUpdates.get(id) ?? {}) });
      });
    
      // Walk-in — registered after the generic regex above so LIFO gives it priority there; the
      // `me*` / `?*` globs below cannot match this path (`?` is a literal in Playwright globs).
      // POST /api/v1/reservations/walk-in adds the new reservation to the stateful store so the
      // subsequent GET /api/v1/reservations?* returns count+1.
      await page.route("**/api/v1/reservations/walk-in", (route) => {
        const fixture = JSON.parse(todayReservations()) as { data: Array<Record<string, unknown>> };
        let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
            body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
          }
        } catch {
          // no body — leave empty
        }
        const first = fixture.data[0] ?? {};
        const tableId = typeof body.tableId === "string" ? body.tableId : (first.tableId as string);
        // A picked returning guest arrives as `guestId`; the service answers with the linked guest's
        // summary, which the timeline block turns into its visit ordinal ("12th visit").
        const guests = JSON.parse(loadFixture("guests-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        };
        const linked =
          typeof body.guestId === "string" ? guests.data.find((g) => g.id === body.guestId) : undefined;
        const newRes: Record<string, unknown> = {
          ...first,
          ...body,
          id: `res_e2e_walkin_${Date.now()}`,
          status: "CONFIRMED",
          notes: "Walk-in",
          tableId,
          table: allTables().find((t) => t.id === tableId) ?? first.table,
          guest: linked
            ? { visitCount: linked.visitCount, communicationPreference: linked.communicationPreference }
            : null,
        };
        extraReservations.push(newRes);
        return jsonOk(route, newRes);
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/reservations/me*", (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "application/json", body: buildReservationsList() })
      );
      await page.route("**/api/v1/reservations?*", (route) =>
        route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "application/json", body: buildReservationsList() })
      );
    
      // Deposits — backs the dashboard's deposit-exposure stats
      // (useDashboardStatsQuery's DEPOSITS_QUERY_KEY). Two pending/held deposits
      // (depositAtRiskCount) plus one forfeited (noShowExposureCents), matching
      // the shape computeDepositStats expects.
      // `?reservationId=` is the details surface's single-deposit lookup (getByReservation), which
      // expects one deposit or null: these reservations have none.
      await page.route("**/api/v1/deposits?*", (route) =>
        jsonOk(
          route,
          new URL(route.request().url()).searchParams.has("reservationId")
            ? null
            : buildDepositsFixture(new Date())
        )
      );
    
      // Waitlist
      // Per-context stateful store, empty at session start (unlike reservations,
      // which layers on top of a base fixture). POST adds a "waiting" entry with
      // the next position; PUT .../seat|notify|cancel transitions it in place so
      // add -> list -> seat composes across requests instead of every call
      // returning the same static shape (the stateful-mock gap this class of
      // Playwright spec is meant to catch).
      const waitlistEntries: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
    
      function waitingEntries(): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
        return waitlistEntries
          .filter((e) => e.status === "waiting")
          .sort((a, b) => (a.position as number) - (b.position as number));
      }
    
      function buildWaitlistEntry(body: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        return {
          id: `wl_e2e_${Date.now()}`,
          venueId: body.venueId ?? "ven_e2e_001",
          partySize: body.partySize ?? 2,
          guestName: body.guestName ?? "Guest",
          guestPhone: body.guestPhone ?? "555-0100",
          position: waitingEntries().length + 1,
          estimatedWaitMinutes: 15,
          status: "waiting",
          notifiedAt: null,
          expiresAt: null,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
      }
    
      function updateWaitlistEntry(id: string, patch: Record<string, unknown>): unknown {
        const index = waitlistEntries.findIndex((e) => e.id === id);
        if (index === -1) return null;
        const updated = { ...waitlistEntries[index], ...patch, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        waitlistEntries[index] = updated;
        return updated;
      }
    
      function waitlistIdFromUrl(url: string, suffix: string): string {
        return (
          url
            .replace(/\?.*$/, "")
            .replace(new RegExp(`/${suffix}$`), "")
            .split("/")
            .pop() ?? ""
        );
      }
    
      await page.route("**/api/v1/waitlist?*", (route) => jsonOk(route, waitingEntries()));
      await page.route("**/api/v1/waitlist", (route) => {
        let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
            body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
          }
        } catch {
          // no body — leave empty
        }
        const entry = buildWaitlistEntry(body);
        waitlistEntries.push(entry);
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 201,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: entry }),
        });
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/waitlist\/[^/?]+\/seat$/, (route) => {
        const id = waitlistIdFromUrl(route.request().url(), "seat");
        return jsonOk(route, updateWaitlistEntry(id, { status: "seated" }));
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/waitlist\/[^/?]+\/notify$/, (route) => {
        const id = waitlistIdFromUrl(route.request().url(), "notify");
        return jsonOk(
          route,
          updateWaitlistEntry(id, { status: "notified", notifiedAt: new Date().toISOString() })
        );
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/waitlist\/[^/?]+\/cancel$/, (route) => {
        const id = waitlistIdFromUrl(route.request().url(), "cancel");
        return jsonOk(route, updateWaitlistEntry(id, { status: "cancelled" }));
      });
    
      // Guests
      // Filter search results by the `query` URL param so empty-search assertions work.
      // With no query (or empty query), return the full fixture unfiltered.
      await page.route("**/api/v1/guests/search*", (route) => {
        const urlObj = new URL(route.request().url());
        const query = (urlObj.searchParams.get("query") ?? urlObj.searchParams.get("q") ?? "").trim();
        if (!query) return jsonResponse(route, "guests-list");
        const fixture = JSON.parse(loadFixture("guests-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
          pagination: Record<string, unknown>;
        };
        const lower = query.toLowerCase();
        // A query that carries digits also matches on the phone's digits ("555123" finds +15551234567),
        // mirroring the service's name-or-phone lookup behind the guest-name combobox.
        const digits = query.replace(/\D/g, "");
        const filtered = fixture.data.filter((g) => {
          const name = String(g.name ?? "").toLowerCase();
          const email = String(g.email ?? "").toLowerCase();
          const phoneDigits = String(g.phone ?? "").replace(/\D/g, "");
          return (
            name.includes(lower) ||
            email.includes(lower) ||
            (digits.length > 0 && phoneDigits.includes(digits))
          );
        });
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            data: filtered,
            pagination: { ...fixture.pagination, total: filtered.length },
          }),
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/guests/segments*", (route) => jsonResponse(route, "guest-segments"));
      // The Home dashboard's lapsing-guests widget. Empty by default; specs that render the widget
      // mount their own route after mockApi (locale-sweep, visual).
      await page.route("**/api/v1/guests/lapsing?*", (route) => jsonOk(route, []));
      await page.route("**/api/v1/guests/find-or-create", (route) => {
        const guests = JSON.parse(loadFixture("guests-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, guests.data[0]);
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/guests?*", (route) => jsonResponse(route, "guests-list"));
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/guests\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        const method = route.request().method();
        const id = route.request().url().replace(/\?.*$/, "").split("/").pop() ?? "";
        const guests = JSON.parse(loadFixture("guests-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        };
        const guest = guests.data.find((g) => g.id === id) ?? guests.data[0];
        if (method === "PATCH" || method === "PUT") {
          return jsonOk(route, { ...guest, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        }
        return jsonOk(route, guest);
      });
    
      // Floor Plans
      // Stateful create sequence (#4762): POST /api/v1/floor-plans (bare, no
      // query, no id segment) creates the plan the wizard lands on. A single
      // `let` — one launch, one plan. Its GET-by-id handler below layers in
      // `tables` from the Tables section's createdTables list, so the editor
      // the wizard navigates to renders what Launch just created rather than
      // the static fixture's tables.
      let createdFloorPlan: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
      await page.route("**/api/v1/floor-plans", (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "POST") return route.fallback();
        const floorPlans = JSON.parse(loadFixture("floor-plans-list"));
        let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        try {
          const parsed = route.request().postDataJSON();
          if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object") {
            body = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
          }
        } catch {
          // no body — leave empty
        }
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        createdFloorPlan = {
          ...floorPlans.data[0],
          ...body,
          id: "fp_e2e_created",
          isActive: false,
          tables: [],
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 201,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: createdFloorPlan }),
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/floor-plans?*", (route) => {
        const floorPlans = JSON.parse(loadFixture("floor-plans-list")) as {
          data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
          pagination: Record<string, unknown>;
        };
        const allData = createdFloorPlan ? [...floorPlans.data, createdFloorPlan] : floorPlans.data;
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...floorPlans,
            data: allData,
            pagination: { ...floorPlans.pagination, total: allData.length },
          }),
        });
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/floor-plans\/tables\/positions$/, (route) => {
        const tables = JSON.parse(loadFixture("tables-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, tables.data);
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/floor-plans\/[^/?]+\/activate$/, (route) => {
        const id = route
          .request()
          .url()
          .replace(/\?.*$/, "")
          .replace(/\/activate$/, "")
          .split("/")
          .pop();
        if (createdFloorPlan && createdFloorPlan.id === id) {
          createdFloorPlan = { ...createdFloorPlan, isActive: true };
          return jsonOk(route, createdFloorPlan);
        }
        const floorPlans = JSON.parse(loadFixture("floor-plans-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, floorPlans.data[0]);
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/floor-plans\/[^/?]+\/clone$/, (route) => {
        const floorPlans = JSON.parse(loadFixture("floor-plans-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, { ...floorPlans.data[0], id: "fp_e2e_clone", name: "Main Floor (Copy)" });
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/floor-plans\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        const id = route.request().url().replace(/\?.*$/, "").split("/").pop();
        if (createdFloorPlan && createdFloorPlan.id === id) {
          // A PATCH has to be applied, not just echoed: applying a room template
          // (#7256) writes the zone rectangles into `layoutJson.sections` in a
          // PATCH that follows the section-row POSTs, so dropping the body would
          // leave the sections list and the plan's own layout disagreeing — rows
          // exist, no rectangle for any of them — which is exactly the state a
          // spec asserting the applied room would need to catch.
          if (route.request().method() === "PATCH") {
            createdFloorPlan = {
              ...createdFloorPlan,
              ...postBody(route),
              id,
              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
          }
          const planTables = createdTables.filter((table) => table.floorPlanId === id);
          return jsonOk(route, { ...createdFloorPlan, tables: planTables });
        }
        const floorPlans = JSON.parse(loadFixture("floor-plans-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, floorPlans.data[0]);
      });
    
      // Floor Plan Sections
      // A room template (#7256) creates one section row per named zone before it
      // writes their rectangles into the plan's layout, and the floor plan editor
      // lists them. Stateful so a relaunch after a failure sees what the first
      // attempt already created, which is exactly the resume path Launch relies on.
      const createdSections: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/floor-plan-sections(\?|$)/, (route) => {
        const method = route.request().method();
        if (method === "GET") return jsonOk(route, createdSections);
        if (method !== "POST") return route.fallback();
    
        const body = postBody(route);
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        const section = {
          id: `sec_e2e_${createdSections.length + 1}`,
          venueId: "venue_e2e",
          floorPlanId: body.floorPlanId ?? "fp_e2e_created",
          name: body.name ?? "Section",
          color: body.color ?? "#8b7355",
          displayOrder: body.displayOrder ?? createdSections.length,
          createdAt: now,
          updatedAt: now,
        };
        createdSections.push(section);
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 201,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: section }),
        });
      });
    
      // Launch assigns each template table to its section with
      // PUT /floor-plan-sections/:id/tables (exact membership). Unmocked, the
      // request is proxied to a dead API and the launch fails after the tables
      // stage, so neither Launch nor Retry could reach the floor plan editor.
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/floor-plan-sections\/[^/?]+\/tables(\?|$)/, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "PUT") return route.fallback();
        return jsonOk(route, []);
      });
    
      // Availability
      await page.route("**/api/v1/availability/*/dates*", (route) => {
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            data: [
              { date: "2026-05-17", hasAvailability: true, slotCount: 5 },
              { date: "2026-05-18", hasAvailability: true, slotCount: 8 },
              { date: "2026-05-19", hasAvailability: false, slotCount: 0 },
            ],
          }),
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/availability/*", slotsResponse);
      // Public (slug-scoped) availability — the booking widget's api client is
      // tokenless, so it fetches slots from `/public/v1/venues/:slug/availability`
      // (the staff route above 401s for guests). The `**/public/v1/venues/*`
      // config glob below never reaches it (`*` never crosses `/`).
      await page.route("**/public/v1/venues/*/availability*", slotsResponse);
      // Closed dates for the calendar. The glob above never reaches this path
      // (`*` does not cross `/`); no closures by default.
      await page.route("**/public/v1/venues/*/availability/dates*", (route) =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: [] }),
        })
      );
    
      // Holds
      await page.route("**/api/v1/holds/*/confirm", (route) => {
        const reservations = JSON.parse(loadFixture("reservations-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, reservations.data[0]);
      });
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/holds\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        const method = route.request().method();
        if (method === "DELETE") {
          return route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ success: true }),
          });
        }
        return jsonOk(route, {
          id: "hold_e2e_001",
          venueId: "ven_e2e_001",
          tableId: "tbl_e2e_001",
          date: "2026-05-17",
          startTime: "2026-05-17T18:00:00.000Z",
          endTime: "2026-05-17T19:30:00.000Z",
          partySize: 4,
          sessionId: "sess_e2e_001",
          expiresAt: "2026-05-17T18:10:00.000Z",
          createdAt: "2026-05-17T17:50:00.000Z",
        });
      });
      await page.route("**/api/v1/holds", (route) =>
        jsonOk(route, {
          id: "hold_e2e_001",
          venueId: "ven_e2e_001",
          tableId: "tbl_e2e_001",
          date: "2026-05-17",
          startTime: "2026-05-17T18:00:00.000Z",
          endTime: "2026-05-17T19:30:00.000Z",
          partySize: 4,
          sessionId: "sess_e2e_001",
          expiresAt: "2026-05-17T18:10:00.000Z",
          createdAt: "2026-05-17T17:50:00.000Z",
        })
      );
    
      // Public (slug-scoped) holds — #4487 put `requireAuth` on the staff hold
      // routes above and moved the booking widget onto
      // `/public/v1/venues/:slug/holds`. These are distinct paths, not aliases,
      // and the globs above do not reach them (`*` never crosses `/`) — without
      // these three the widget's hold create/confirm hit the real network and the
      // flow stalls before step 3 (`getByLabel("Name")` times out).
      await page.route("**/public/v1/venues/*/holds/*/confirm", (route) => {
        const reservations = JSON.parse(loadFixture("reservations-list"));
        return jsonOk(route, reservations.data[0]);
      });
      await page.route(/\/public\/v1\/venues\/[^/]+\/holds\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === "DELETE") {
          return route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ success: true }),
          });
        }
        return jsonOk(route, PUBLIC_HOLD);
      });
      await page.route("**/public/v1/venues/*/holds", (route) => jsonOk(route, PUBLIC_HOLD));
    
      // Guest risk — confirmReservation calls this whenever guestRiskMatters()
      // is true (venueSlug + stripePublishableKey present and the venue's own
      // deposit policy is disabled), which is now every confirm in the suite
      // outside deposit-enabled-config.spec.ts (#4111). Without a default here
      // the request falls through unmocked; on a real backend (e2e.yml) that's
      // harmless, but e2e-screenshots.yml has none, so the Vite proxy 502s and
      // the retry delay blows every other spec's assertion timeouts.
      await page.route("**/public/v1/venues/*/guest-risk*", (route) =>
        jsonOk(route, buildGuestRiskFixture())
      );
    
      // Intercept the SSE stream request so the app's SseClient (built on
      // @microsoft/fetch-event-source, which requires an Authorization header
      // EventSource cannot send) fires onopen (→ "Live") without ever erroring.
      // fetchEventSource treats a normal end-of-body as a clean close (no retry,
      // no onerror) — unlike the old EventSource-based stub, no timing hack is
      // needed here.
      //
      // Tests can pre-configure named events to dispatch immediately after the
      // "connected" event through the returned handle:
      //   const sse = await mockApi(page); sse.setEvents([{ type, data }]);
      // The config lives on the Node side and the handler never calls page.evaluate:
      // the app opens this stream on every load, so an in-page read raced
      // navigations ("Execution context was destroyed", #8164).
      const sseState: { events: readonly SseEventEntry[] } = { events: [] };
      await page.route("**/api/v1/events/stream**", async (route) => {
        const frames = [
          `event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ message: "Connected to event stream" })}\n\n`,
          ...sseState.events.map((evt) => `event: ${evt.type}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(evt.data)}\n\n`),
        ];
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          headers: { "content-type": "text/event-stream" },
          body: frames.join(""),
        });
      });
    
      // Public endpoints
      await page.route("**/public/v1/venues/*", (route) =>
        jsonOk(route, buildPublicVenueConfigFixture())
      );
    
      await mockMenus(page);
    
      return {
        setEvents: (events) => {
          sseState.events = [...events];
        },
      };
    }
    export function buildAvailabilityConfigFixture() {
      const service = (id: string, opensAt: number, lastSeatingAt: number, closesAt: number) => ({
        id: `ss-${id}`,
        scheduleId: "sch-regular",
        venueServiceId: `vs-${id}`,
        opensAt,
        lastSeatingAt,
        closesAt,
        seating: { version: 1, interval: 15 },
        bookingTypes: ["online", "phone"],
        weekdays: [],
        dayHours: { version: 1, sets: [] },
      });
      return {
        config: {
          schedules: [{ id: "sch-regular", name: "Regular", kind: "regular", isRegular: true }],
          venueServices: [
            { id: "vs-lunch", name: "Lunch", position: 0 },
            { id: "vs-dinner", name: "Dinner", position: 1 },
          ],
          scheduleServices: [service("lunch", 690, 840, 900), service("dinner", 1020, 1290, 1380)],
          assignments: [
            {
              id: "as-regular",
              scheduleId: "sch-regular",
              weekdays: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
              precedence: 0,
            },
          ],
          dateRules: [],
        },
        version: 1,
        source: "rows",
      };
    }
    export interface LiveEventBus {
      publish: (event: SseEventEntry) => void;
      /** Number of events published so far. */
      size: () => number;
      /** Resolves once more than `count` events have been published. */
      whenPast: (count: number) => Promise<void>;
      /** Events at index `from` and later. */
      since: (from: number) => readonly SseEventEntry[];
    }
    export function createLiveEventBus(): LiveEventBus {
      const log: SseEventEntry[] = [];
      const waiters = new Set<() => void>();
      return {
        publish: (event) => {
          log.push(event);
          for (const wake of [...waiters]) wake();
        },
        size: () => log.length,
        whenPast: (count) =>
          new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
            const check = (): void => {
              if (log.length > count) {
                waiters.delete(check);
                resolve();
              }
            };
            waiters.add(check);
            check();
          }),
        since: (from) => log.slice(from),
      };
    }
    export async function mockLiveEventStream(page: Page, bus: LiveEventBus): Promise<void> {
      let delivered = bus.size();
      await page.route("**/api/v1/events/stream**", async (route) => {
        await bus.whenPast(delivered);
        const events = bus.since(delivered);
        delivered += events.length;
        const frames = [
          `event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ message: "Connected to event stream" })}\n\n`,
          ...events.map((evt) => `event: ${evt.type}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(evt.data)}\n\n`),
        ];
        // The page may have gone away while the request was held.
        await route
          .fulfill({
            status: 200,
            headers: { "content-type": "text/event-stream" },
            body: frames.join(""),
          })
          .catch(() => undefined);
      });
    }
    export type NightOfSignal = { kind: "running-late"; minutes: 5 | 15 | 30 } | { kind: "arrived" };
    export interface NightOfReservation {
      id: string;
      startTime: string;
      endTime: string;
      partySize: number;
      guestName: string;
    }
    export interface NightOfMock {
      posted: readonly NightOfSignal[];
    }
    export async function mockNightOfManage(
      page: Page,
      bus: LiveEventBus,
      reservation: NightOfReservation
    ): Promise<NightOfMock> {
      const posted: NightOfSignal[] = [];
      const counts = { late: 0, arrived: 0 };
      const ianaTimezone = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
    
      await page.route(/\/public\/v1\/reservations\/manage(\?.*)?$/, (route) =>
        jsonOk(route, {
          reservation: {
            ...reservation,
            date: localDay(),
            guestEmail: null,
            status: "CONFIRMED",
            notes: null,
          },
          venue: { id: "ven_e2e_001", name: "E2E Test Bistro", slug: "e2e-test-bistro", ianaTimezone },
          guestSignals: { ...counts },
        })
      );
    
      await page.route("**/public/v1/reservations/manage/signal", (route) => {
        const signal = route.request().postDataJSON() as NightOfSignal;
        posted.push(signal);
        if (signal.kind === "arrived") counts.arrived += 1;
        else counts.late += 1;
        const data =
          signal.kind === "arrived"
            ? { reservationId: reservation.id, kind: signal.kind }
            : {
                reservationId: reservation.id,
                kind: signal.kind,
                minutes: signal.minutes,
                eta: new Date(
                  Date.parse(reservation.startTime) + signal.minutes * 60_000
                ).toISOString(),
              };
        bus.publish({
          type: "reservation:guest-signal",
          data: {
            type: "reservation:guest-signal",
            venueId: "ven_e2e_001",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            data,
          },
        });
        return jsonOk(route, signal);
      });
    
      return {
        get posted() {
          return posted;
        },
      };
    }

  <file path="e2e/auth-helpers.ts">
    export interface Auth0Config {
      domain: string;
      clientId: string;
      audience: string;
      email: string;
      password: string;
    }
    export function validateAuth0Config(
      env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env
    ): Auth0Config {
      const domain = env["E2E_AUTH0_DOMAIN"];
      const clientId = env["E2E_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"];
      const audience = env["E2E_AUTH0_AUDIENCE"];
      const email = env["E2E_AUTH_EMAIL"];
      const password = env["E2E_AUTH_PASSWORD"];
    
      const missing: string[] = [];
      if (!domain) missing.push("E2E_AUTH0_DOMAIN");
      if (!clientId) missing.push("E2E_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID");
      if (!audience) missing.push("E2E_AUTH0_AUDIENCE");
      if (!email) missing.push("E2E_AUTH_EMAIL");
      if (!password) missing.push("E2E_AUTH_PASSWORD");
    
      if (missing.length > 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Missing required E2E auth env vars: ${missing.join(", ")}\n\n` +
            "Required vars:\n" +
            "  E2E_AUTH0_DOMAIN      — Auth0 tenant domain (e.g. dev-xxx.us.auth0.com)\n" +
            "  E2E_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID   — Auth0 app client ID (ROPC-enabled)\n" +
            "  E2E_AUTH0_AUDIENCE    — API audience identifier\n" +
            "  E2E_AUTH_EMAIL        — Test user email\n" +
            "  E2E_AUTH_PASSWORD     — Test user password\n\n" +
            "The Auth0 app must have the Password grant type enabled and the test user must not have MFA."
        );
      }
    
      return {
        domain: domain!,
        clientId: clientId!,
        audience: audience!,
        email: email!,
        password: password!,
      };
    }
    function getAuth0Config(): Auth0Config {
      return validateAuth0Config(process.env);
    }
    export interface TokenResponse {
      access_token: string;
      id_token: string;
      token_type: string;
      expires_in: number;
    }
    type FetchFn = typeof fetch;
    async function fetchAuth0Tokens(
      config: Auth0Config,
      fetchFn: FetchFn = fetch
    ): Promise<TokenResponse> {
      const response = await fetchFn(`https://${config.domain}/oauth/token`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          grant_type: "http://auth0.com/oauth/grant-type/password-realm",
          username: config.email,
          password: config.password,
          audience: config.audience,
          client_id: config.clientId,
          scope: "openid profile email",
          realm: "Username-Password-Authentication",
        }),
      });
    
      if (!response.ok) {
        const body = await response.text();
        throw new Error(
          `Auth0 token request failed (${response.status}): ${body}\n` +
            "Verify: ROPC grant enabled, test user exists, no MFA, correct credentials."
        );
      }
    
      return response.json() as Promise<TokenResponse>;
    }
    export interface RetryOptions {
      /** Maximum number of attempts (default: 3). */
      maxAttempts?: number;
      /** Base delay in milliseconds for exponential backoff (default: 1000). */
      baseDelayMs?: number;
    }
    export async function fetchAuth0TokensWithRetry(
      config: Auth0Config,
      fetchFn: FetchFn = fetch,
      { maxAttempts = 3, baseDelayMs = 1000 }: RetryOptions = {}
    ): Promise<TokenResponse> {
      let lastError: Error | undefined;
    
      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
        try {
          return await fetchAuth0Tokens(config, fetchFn);
        } catch (err) {
          lastError = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
    
          if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
            const delayMs = baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
            await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
          }
        }
      }
    
      throw new Error(
        `Auth0 token request failed after ${maxAttempts} attempts. Last error: ${lastError?.message ?? "unknown"}`
      );
    }
    function decodeJwtPayload(token: string): Record<string, unknown> {
      const base64 = token.split(".")[1]!;
      const json = Buffer.from(base64, "base64url").toString("utf-8");
      return JSON.parse(json) as Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    export function buildOidcUserEntry(
      config: Auth0Config,
      tokens: TokenResponse,
      storageClientId: string = config.clientId
    ): { key: string; value: string } {
      const authority = `https://${config.domain}`;
      const idClaims = decodeJwtPayload(tokens.id_token);
    
      const oidcUser = {
        access_token: tokens.access_token,
        id_token: tokens.id_token,
        token_type: tokens.token_type,
        scope: "openid profile email",
        expires_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + tokens.expires_in,
        profile: {
          sub: idClaims.sub,
          email: idClaims.email,
          email_verified: idClaims.email_verified,
          name: idClaims.name,
          picture: idClaims.picture,
          iss: idClaims.iss,
          aud: idClaims.aud,
          iat: idClaims.iat,
          exp: idClaims.exp,
        },
      };
    
      return {
        key: `oidc.user:${authority}:${storageClientId}`,
        value: JSON.stringify(oidcUser),
      };
    }
    export async function injectAuth0Session(page: Page): Promise<void> {
      const config = getAuth0Config();
      const tokens = await fetchAuth0TokensWithRetry(config);
      const entry = buildOidcUserEntry(config, tokens);
    
      // Navigate to the app first so localStorage is on the correct origin.
      // Use localStorage (not sessionStorage) so Playwright's storageState captures
      // the OIDC session for downstream tests. The AuthProvider is configured with
      // userStore: new WebStorageStateStore({ store: localStorage }) to match.
      await page.goto("");
      await page.evaluate(({ key, value }) => {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }, entry);
    
      // Reload so AuthProvider picks up the injected session
      await page.reload();
    }

  <file path="e2e/availability-draft-mock.ts">
    export interface PutBody {
      expectedVersion: number;
      changes?: { upsert?: { dateRules?: Array<{ id: string; startsOn?: string }> } };
    }
    export interface PutRecord {
      expected: number;
      status: number;
    }
    export interface AvailabilityMock {
      version: number;
      configReads: number;
      /** Reads of the config answer 500 while this is set. */
      failReads: boolean;
      /** Reads of the config answer this version while it is set: a replica behind the writes. */
      readVersion: number | null;
      /** Reads of the config wait from here until `releaseReads`: a slow reload, without a race. */
      holdReads(): void;
      releaseReads(): void;
      /** Every save's body, in order. */
      readonly bodies: PutBody[];
      /** Every save, in order, with the version it was checked against and how it ended. */
      readonly puts: PutRecord[];
      /** Reverts (Undo) received. */
      reverts: number;
      /** The next save answers this instead of being applied. */
      nextPut: { status: number; code: string; extra?: object } | null;
      /** Someone else saves: the version moves on and the next save here is refused. */
      colleague(summary?: string): void;
    }
    function between(from: string, to: string): string[] {
      const out: string[] = [];
      for (
        let d = new Date(`${from}T00:00:00Z`);
        d <= new Date(`${to}T00:00:00Z`);
        d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1)
      ) {
        out.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      }
      return out;
    }
    function addDays(date: string, n: number): string {
      const d = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`);
      d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + n);
      return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
    export async function mockAvailability(
      page: Page,
      options: { weekdays?: number[]; rules?: unknown[] } = {}
    ): Promise<AvailabilityMock> {
      const venues = JSON.parse(loadFixture("venues-list")) as { data: Array<{ id: string }> };
      const base = `**/api/v1/venues/${String(venues.data[0]?.id)}`;
      const json = (data: unknown) => ({
        status: 200,
        contentType: "application/json",
        body: JSON.stringify({ data }),
      });
      const problem = (status: number, code: string, extra: object = {}) => ({
        status,
        contentType: "application/problem+json",
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: "about:blank",
          title: code,
          status,
          detail: "Server said no.",
          code,
          ...extra,
        }),
      });
      let winner = {
        id: "chg-0",
        actorId: "auth0|ana",
        at: new Date().toISOString(),
        kind: "config",
        summary: "Dinner closes at 10:00 PM",
      };
      /** Every change a colleague made, with the version it produced: what a 409 names. */
      const history: Array<{ version: number; change: typeof winner }> = [];
      let readsHeld: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
      let releaseHeld: () => void = () => undefined;
      const mock: AvailabilityMock = {
        version: 7,
        configReads: 0,
        failReads: false,
        readVersion: null,
        holdReads() {
          readsHeld = new Promise((resolve) => {
            releaseHeld = resolve;
          });
        },
        releaseReads() {
          releaseHeld();
          readsHeld = Promise.resolve();
        },
        bodies: [],
        puts: [],
        reverts: 0,
        nextPut: null,
        colleague(summary = "Dinner closes at 10:00 PM") {
          mock.version += 1;
          winner = { ...winner, id: `chg-${mock.version}`, summary };
          history.push({ version: mock.version, change: winner });
        },
      };
      let rules: unknown[] = options.rules ?? [];
    
      await page.route(`${base}/availability/config`, async (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === "PUT") {
          const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as PutBody;
          mock.bodies.push(body);
          const record: PutRecord = { expected: body.expectedVersion, status: 0 };
          mock.puts.push(record);
          if (mock.nextPut) {
            const refused = mock.nextPut;
            mock.nextPut = null;
            record.status = refused.status;
            return route.fulfill(problem(refused.status, refused.code, refused.extra));
          }
          if (body.expectedVersion !== mock.version) {
            record.status = 409;
            return route.fulfill(
              problem(409, "version-conflict", {
                winningChange: winner,
                currentVersion: mock.version,
                changesSince: {
                  total: mock.version - body.expectedVersion,
                  changes: history
                    .filter((h) => h.version > body.expectedVersion)
                    .map((h) => h.change)
                    .reverse(),
                },
              })
            );
          }
          const upserted = body.changes?.upsert?.dateRules ?? [];
          rules = [
            ...rules.filter((r) => !upserted.some((u) => u.id === (r as { id: string }).id)),
            ...upserted,
          ];
          mock.version += 1;
          record.status = 200;
          return route.fulfill(json({ version: mock.version, changeId: `chg-${mock.version}` }));
        }
        mock.configReads += 1;
        await readsHeld;
        if (mock.failReads) return route.fulfill(problem(500, "internal"));
        return route.fulfill(
          json({
            config: {
              schedules: [{ id: "regular", name: "Regular week", kind: "regular", isRegular: true }],
              venueServices: [{ id: "vs-dinner", name: "Dinner", position: 0 }],
              scheduleServices: [
                {
                  id: "ss-dinner",
                  scheduleId: "regular",
                  venueServiceId: "vs-dinner",
                  ...DINNER,
                  seating: { version: 1, interval: 15 },
                  bookingTypes: ["online", "phone"],
                  weekdays: [],
                  dayHours: { version: 1, sets: [] },
                },
              ],
              assignments: [
                {
                  id: "as",
                  scheduleId: "regular",
                  weekdays: options.weekdays ?? [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6],
                  precedence: 0,
                },
              ],
              dateRules: rules,
            },
            version: mock.readVersion ?? mock.version,
            source: "rows",
          })
        );
      });
      const open = options.weekdays ?? [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
      const isOpenOn = (serviceDate: string) =>
        open.includes(new Date(`${serviceDate}T00:00:00Z`).getUTCDay());
      /** The calendar cell `/availability/days` and the focus day of `/availability/preview` share. */
      const dayCell = (serviceDate: string) => {
        const isOpen = isOpenOn(serviceDate);
        return {
          serviceDate,
          label: isOpen ? "Regular week" : "Closed",
          scheduleId: isOpen ? "regular" : null,
          serviceCount: isOpen ? 1 : 0,
          closures: [],
          bookingOpen: { online: isOpen, phone: isOpen, waitlist: isOpen },
        };
      };
    
      await page.route(`${base}/availability/days*`, (route) => {
        const url = new URL(route.request().url());
        const days = between(url.searchParams.get("from")!, url.searchParams.get("to")!).map(dayCell);
        return route.fulfill(json(days));
      });
      // No test here drafts a change that moves added/removed times or strands a booking, so a
      // no-op diff over the current config is a fine stand-in for the real preview — unlike the
      // blind 500 this route used to answer, which `AvailabilityGuestPreview` renders for real
      // whenever the editor is open, and whose literal "Server said no." detail text is exactly
      // what Sentry read as a production reservations-service 500 (#8280). There was no such bug.
      await page.route(`${base}/availability/preview*`, (route) => {
        const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as { focusDate: string };
        const days = between(body.focusDate, addDays(body.focusDate, 29)).map((serviceDate) => ({
          serviceDate,
          added: [] as number[],
          removed: [] as number[],
        }));
        return route.fulfill(
          json({
            version: mock.version,
            days,
            focusDay: dayCell(body.focusDate),
            stranded: { total: 0, offset: 0, items: [] },
          })
        );
      });
      await page.route("**/availability/changes/*/revert", (route) => {
        mock.reverts += 1;
        mock.version += 1;
        return route.fulfill(json({ version: mock.version, changeId: `chg-${mock.version}` }));
      });
      return mock;
    }

    export function localDay(offsetDays = 0): string {
      const day = new Date();
      day.setDate(day.getDate() + offsetDays);
      return day.toLocaleDateString(LOCAL_DAY_LOCALE);
    }
    export function atLocal(time: string, day: string = localDay()): string {
      return new Date(`${day}T${time}`).toISOString();
    }

    export const MIN_LITERAL_LETTERS = 3;
    export function hasReadableLiteral(value: string): boolean {

  <file path="src/components/floor-plan/apply-room-template.ts">
    export interface RoomTemplateApi {
      readonly floorPlans: {
        create(data: CreateFloorPlanRequest): Promise<FloorPlan>;
        update(id: string, data: UpdateFloorPlanRequest): Promise<FloorPlan>;
      };
      readonly floorPlanSections: {
        create(venueId: string, data: CreateFloorPlanSectionRequest): Promise<FloorPlanSection>;
        assignTables(venueId: string, sectionId: string, tableIds: string[]): Promise<Table[]>;
      };
      readonly tables: {
        list(params: {
          venueId: string;
          page?: number;
          limit?: number;
        }): Promise<PaginatedResponse<Table>>;
        create(data: CreateTableRequest): Promise<Table>;
      };
    }
    async function listVenueTableNames(
      api: RoomTemplateApi,
      venueId: string
    ): Promise<ReadonlySet<string>> {
      const names = new Set<string>();
      for (let page = 1; ; page += 1) {
        const { data, pagination } = await api.tables.list({ venueId, page, limit: MAX_PAGE_SIZE });
        for (const table of data) names.add(table.name);
        if (data.length === 0 || names.size >= pagination.total || page >= pagination.totalPages) break;
      }
      return names;
    }
    function uniqueTableName(desired: string, taken: ReadonlySet<string>): string {
      if (!taken.has(desired)) return desired;
      // `taken` is finite, and among `desired-2 … desired-(size + 2)` there are
      // more candidates than `taken` has entries, so one of them is always free.
      for (let suffix = 2; suffix <= taken.size + 2; suffix += 1) {
        const candidate = `${desired}-${suffix}`;
        if (!taken.has(candidate)) return candidate;
      }
      /* c8 ignore next -- unreachable: the loop above exhausts a superset of `taken` */
      throw new Error(`Could not find an unused name for table "${desired}"`);
    }
    export interface CreateFromTemplateInput {
      readonly venueId: string;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly layout: RoomLayout;
    }
    export function templateLayoutJson(layout: RoomLayout): FloorPlanLayout {
      return {
        width: layout.width,
        height: layout.height,
        gridSize: GRID_SIZE,
        showGrid: true,
        ...(layout.walls.length > 0 ? { walls: [...layout.walls] } : {}),
      };
    }
    export function templateTableRequest(
      table: RoomTemplateTable,
      venueId: string,
      floorPlanId: string,
      name: string = table.name
    ): CreateTableRequest {
      return {
        name,
        capacity: table.capacity,
        minCovers: table.minCovers,
        venueId,
        floorPlanId,
        shapeMetadata: {
          shape: table.shape,
          x: table.x,
          y: table.y,
          width: table.width,
          height: table.height,
          rotation: table.rotation,
        },
      };
    }
    async function createSectionRows(
      api: RoomTemplateApi,
      venueId: string,
      floorPlanId: string,
      layout: RoomLayout
    ): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, FloorPlanSection>> {
      const rows = new Map<string, FloorPlanSection>();
      for (const [index, zone] of layout.sections.entries()) {
        const row = await api.floorPlanSections.create(venueId, {
          floorPlanId,
          name: zone.name,
          color: zone.color,
          displayOrder: index,
        });
        rows.set(zone.id, row);
      }
      return rows;
    }
    function sectionRectangles(
      layout: RoomLayout,
      rows: ReadonlyMap<string, FloorPlanSection>
    ): SectionLayout[] {
      return layout.sections.flatMap((zone) => {
        const row = rows.get(zone.id);
        return row
          ? [{ id: row.id, x: zone.x, y: zone.y, width: zone.width, height: zone.height }]
          : [];
      });
    }
    async function createTables(
      api: RoomTemplateApi,
      venueId: string,
      floorPlanId: string,
      layout: RoomLayout
    ): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>> {
      // Read the venue's existing names once, then grow the set as we go so the
      // template's own tables cannot collide with each other either.
      const taken = new Set(await listVenueTableNames(api, venueId));
      const bySection = new Map<string, string[]>();
      for (const table of layout.tables) {
        const name = uniqueTableName(table.name, taken);
        taken.add(name);
        const created = await api.tables.create(
          templateTableRequest(table, venueId, floorPlanId, name)
        );
        if (table.sectionId === null) continue;
        bySection.set(table.sectionId, [...(bySection.get(table.sectionId) ?? []), created.id]);
      }
      return bySection;
    }
    export async function createFloorPlanFromTemplate(
      api: RoomTemplateApi,
      { venueId, name, layout }: CreateFromTemplateInput
    ): Promise<FloorPlan> {
      const layoutJson = templateLayoutJson(layout);
      const plan = await api.floorPlans.create({ venueId, name, layoutJson });
    
      const rows = await createSectionRows(api, venueId, plan.id, layout);
      const withSections =
        rows.size > 0
          ? await api.floorPlans.update(plan.id, {
              layoutJson: { ...layoutJson, sections: sectionRectangles(layout, rows) },
            })
          : plan;
    
      const tablesBySection = await createTables(api, venueId, plan.id, layout);
    
      for (const [localSectionId, tableIds] of tablesBySection) {
        const row = rows.get(localSectionId);
        if (!row || tableIds.length === 0) continue;
        await api.floorPlanSections.assignTables(venueId, row.id, [...tableIds]);
      }
    
      return withSections;
    }
