  <file path="src/components/floor-plan/floor-plan-geometry.ts">
    export const CANVAS_WIDTH = 800;
    export const CANVAS_HEIGHT = 600;
    export const GRID_SIZE = 20;
    export const CANVAS_CENTER = {
      x: CANVAS_WIDTH / 2,
      y: CANVAS_HEIGHT / 2,
    } as const;
    export const SHAPE_DEFAULTS = {
      rectangle: { width: 80, height: 60 },
      square: { width: 60, height: 60 },
      circle: { width: 70, height: 70 },
    } as const;
    export interface PlacedRect {
      x: number;
      y: number;
      width: number;
      height: number;
    }
    export function placeNewTable(
      canvas: { width: number; height: number },
      size: { width: number; height: number },
      existing: readonly PlacedRect[]
    ): { x: number; y: number } {
      const centre = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
      const free = (x: number, y: number) =>
        existing.every(
          (t) =>
            Math.abs(x - t.x) >= (size.width + t.width) / 2 ||
            Math.abs(y - t.y) >= (size.height + t.height) / 2
        );
      const inside = (x: number, y: number) =>
        x >= size.width / 2 &&
        x <= canvas.width - size.width / 2 &&
        y >= size.height / 2 &&
        y <= canvas.height - size.height / 2;
      if (free(centre.x, centre.y)) return centre;
    
      const cx = snapToGrid(centre.x);
      const cy = snapToGrid(centre.y);
      const maxRing = Math.ceil(Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) / GRID_SIZE);
      for (let ring = 1; ring <= maxRing; ring++) {
        let best: { x: number; y: number; d: number } | null = null;
        for (let dx = -ring; dx <= ring; dx++) {
          for (let dy = -ring; dy <= ring; dy++) {
            if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) !== ring) continue;
            const x = cx + dx * GRID_SIZE;
            const y = cy + dy * GRID_SIZE;
            const d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            if (inside(x, y) && free(x, y) && (!best || d < best.d)) best = { x, y, d };
          }
        }
        if (best) return { x: best.x, y: best.y };
      }
      return centre;
    }
    export function snapToGrid(value: number, gridSize: number = GRID_SIZE): number {
      return Math.round(value / gridSize) * gridSize;
    }
    export const ENDPOINT_HIT_RADIUS = 12;
    export const MIN_WALL_THICKNESS = 2;
    export const MAX_WALL_THICKNESS = 40;
    export interface Point {
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
    }
    export type WallEnd = 1 | 2;
    export function snapPoint(p: Point, gridSize: number = GRID_SIZE): Point {
      return { x: snapToGrid(p.x, gridSize), y: snapToGrid(p.y, gridSize) };
    }
    export function hitTestEndpoint(
      walls: readonly WallLayout[],
      p: Point
    ): { wallId: string; end: WallEnd } | null {
      let best: { wallId: string; end: WallEnd; d: number } | null = null;
      for (const w of walls) {
        const ends: [WallEnd, number, number][] = [
          [1, w.x1, w.y1],
          [2, w.x2, w.y2],
        ];
        for (const [end, x, y] of ends) {
          const d = Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y);
          if (d <= ENDPOINT_HIT_RADIUS && (!best || d < best.d)) best = { wallId: w.id, end, d };
        }
      }
      return best && { wallId: best.wallId, end: best.end };
    }
    export function moveWallEndpoint(
      wall: WallLayout,
      end: WallEnd,
      p: Point,
      gridSize: number = GRID_SIZE,
      canvas: { width: number; height: number } = { width: CANVAS_WIDTH, height: CANVAS_HEIGHT }
    ): WallLayout {
      const snapped = snapPoint(p, gridSize);
      const x = clampTo(snapped.x, 0, canvas.width);
      const y = clampTo(snapped.y, 0, canvas.height);
      return end === 1 ? { ...wall, x1: x, y1: y } : { ...wall, x2: x, y2: y };
    }
    export function clampThickness(value: number): number {
      return clampTo(value, MIN_WALL_THICKNESS, MAX_WALL_THICKNESS);
    }
    export function createWall(kind: "wall" | "window", existing: readonly WallLayout[]): WallLayout {
      const ids = new Set(existing.map((w) => w.id));
      let n = existing.length + 1;
      while (ids.has(`${kind}-${n}`)) n += 1;
      const y = snapToGrid(CANVAS_CENTER.y);
      return {
        id: `${kind}-${n}`,
        x1: snapToGrid(CANVAS_CENTER.x - 100),
        y1: y,
        x2: snapToGrid(CANVAS_CENTER.x + 100),
        y2: y,
        thickness: DEFAULT_WALL_THICKNESS,
        wallType: kind,
      };
    }
    export type TableShapeName = keyof typeof SHAPE_DEFAULTS;
    export const SEAT_GAP = 7;
    export const MAX_RENDERED_SEATS = 20;
    export interface SeatPlacement {
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
      readonly rotation: number;
    }
    export interface SeatPlacementInput {
      readonly shape: TableShapeName;
      readonly capacity: number;
      /** Stored footprint; each falls back to the shape's `SHAPE_DEFAULTS` entry. */
      readonly width?: number;
      readonly height?: number;
      /** Clearance from the table edge; defaults to the canonical SEAT_GAP. */
      readonly gap?: number;
    }
    export interface SeatSize {
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
    }
    export function seatSize(capacity: number): SeatSize {
      const t = Math.min(
        1,
        Math.max(0, (capacity - SEAT_SHRINK_START) / (SEAT_SHRINK_END - SEAT_SHRINK_START))
      );
      const ease = (from: number, to: number) => Math.round((from + (to - from) * t) * 1000) / 1000;
      return {
        width: ease(SEAT_SIZE_FULL.width, SEAT_SIZE_SMALL.width),
        height: ease(SEAT_SIZE_FULL.height, SEAT_SIZE_SMALL.height),
      };
    }
    type RectangleSide = (typeof RECTANGLE_SIDES)[number];
    function usableSeatCount(capacity: number): number {
      if (!Number.isFinite(capacity) || capacity < 1) return 0;
      return Math.min(MAX_RENDERED_SEATS, Math.floor(capacity));
    }
    function roundCoord(value: number): number {
      return Math.round(value * 1000) / 1000;
    }
    function evenOffsets(count: number, length: number): readonly number[] {
      return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) =>
        roundCoord((length * (i + 1)) / (count + 1) - length / 2)
      );
    }
    function circleSeats(count: number, radius: number): readonly SeatPlacement[] {
      return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
        const degrees = -90 + (360 * i) / count;
        const radians = (degrees * Math.PI) / 180;
        return {
          x: roundCoord(radius * Math.cos(radians)),
          y: roundCoord(radius * Math.sin(radians)),
          rotation: (degrees + 270) % 360,
        };
      });
    }
    function rectangleSeats(
      count: number,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      gap: number
    ): readonly SeatPlacement[] {
      // Round-robin across the four sides so a 2-top faces across the table, a
      // 4-top takes one per side, and larger parties double up evenly.
      const perSide = RECTANGLE_SIDES.map(
        (_, sideIndex) => Math.floor(count / 4) + (count % 4 > sideIndex ? 1 : 0)
      );
    
      return RECTANGLE_SIDES.flatMap((side, sideIndex) => {
        const sideCount = perSide[sideIndex] ?? 0;
        const horizontal = side === "top" || side === "bottom";
        const offsets = evenOffsets(sideCount, horizontal ? width : height);
        const distance = (horizontal ? height : width) / 2 + gap;
        const sign = side === "top" || side === "left" ? -1 : 1;
    
        return offsets.map((offset) => ({
          x: horizontal ? offset : sign * distance,
          y: horizontal ? sign * distance : offset,
          rotation: SIDE_ROTATION[side],
        }));
      });
    }
    function minSeatSpacing(input: SeatPlacementInput, seats: readonly SeatPlacement[]): number {
      if (input.shape === "circle") {
        const diameter = input.width ?? SHAPE_DEFAULTS.circle.width;
        const gap = input.gap ?? SEAT_GAP;
        return seats.length > 1
          ? 2 * (diameter / 2 + gap) * Math.sin(Math.PI / seats.length)
          : Infinity;
      }
      const bySide = new Map<number, number[]>();
      for (const seat of seats) {
        const along = seat.rotation % 180 === 0 ? seat.x : seat.y;
        bySide.set(seat.rotation, [...(bySide.get(seat.rotation) ?? []), along]);
      }
      let min = Infinity;
      for (const positions of bySide.values()) {
        const sorted = [...positions].sort((a, b) => a - b);
        sorted.slice(1).forEach((p, i) => {
          min = Math.min(min, p - (sorted[i] ?? 0));
        });
      }
      return min;
    }
    export function fittedSeatSize(input: SeatPlacementInput): SeatSize {
      const base = seatSize(input.capacity);
      const spacing = minSeatSpacing(input, seatPlacements(input));
      return { ...base, width: Math.min(base.width, spacing - SEAT_SPACING_GAP) };
    }
    export function seatPlacements(input: SeatPlacementInput): readonly SeatPlacement[] {
      const gap = input.gap ?? SEAT_GAP;
      const count = usableSeatCount(input.capacity);
      if (count === 0) return [];
    
      const defaults = SHAPE_DEFAULTS[input.shape];
      const width = input.width ?? defaults.width;
      const height = input.height ?? defaults.height;
      return input.shape === "circle"
        ? circleSeats(count, width / 2 + gap)
        : rectangleSeats(count, width, height, gap);
    }
  </file>

    export const MIN_GRID_CELL_PX = 8;
    export function floorPlanGridStyle({
      readOnly,
      scale,
    }: {
      readOnly: boolean;
      scale: number;
    }): Pick<CSSProperties, "backgroundImage" | "backgroundSize"> | undefined {
      const cell = GRID_SIZE * scale;
      if (readOnly || cell < MIN_GRID_CELL_PX) return undefined;
      return { backgroundImage: GRID_PATTERN, backgroundSize: `${cell}px ${cell}px` };
    }

    export const FLOOR_TEXTURE_DIR = "floor-plan/textures";

  <file path="src/components/floor-plan/furniture-theme.ts">
    function readTheme(): FurnitureTheme {
      return document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
    }
    function subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
      listeners.add(listener);
      if (!observer) {
        observer = new MutationObserver(() => listeners.forEach((notify) => notify()));
        observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["data-theme"],
        });
      }
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
        if (listeners.size === 0) {
          observer?.disconnect();
          observer = null;
        }
      };
    }
    export function useFurnitureTheme(): FurnitureTheme {
      return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, readTheme, () => "light");
    }

  <file path="src/components/floor-plan/room-geometry.ts">
    export function tableBounds(table: {
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
      readonly rotation: number;
    }): { left: number; top: number; right: number; bottom: number } {
      const radians = (table.rotation * Math.PI) / 180;
      const cos = Math.abs(Math.cos(radians));
      const sin = Math.abs(Math.sin(radians));
      const halfWidth = (table.width * cos + table.height * sin) / 2;
      const halfHeight = (table.width * sin + table.height * cos) / 2;
    
      return {
        left: table.x - halfWidth,
        top: table.y - halfHeight,
        right: table.x + halfWidth,
        bottom: table.y + halfHeight,
      };
    }
    export type PerimeterSide = "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left";
    export interface PerimeterGap {
      readonly side: PerimeterSide;
      readonly from: number;
      readonly to: number;
    }
    interface SideDefinition {
      readonly side: PerimeterSide;
      /** True when both of a wall's endpoints lie on this side's line. */
      readonly onSide: (segment: WallLayout) => boolean;
      /** The segment's extent along the side, as [low, high]. */
      readonly span: (segment: WallLayout) => readonly [number, number];
      readonly length: number;
    }
    function sideDefinitions(layout: RoomLayout): readonly SideDefinition[] {
      const horizontal = (segment: WallLayout) =>
        [Math.min(segment.x1, segment.x2), Math.max(segment.x1, segment.x2)] as const;
      const vertical = (segment: WallLayout) =>
        [Math.min(segment.y1, segment.y2), Math.max(segment.y1, segment.y2)] as const;
    
      return [
        {
          side: "top",
          onSide: (s) => s.y1 === 0 && s.y2 === 0,
          span: horizontal,
          length: layout.width,
        },
        {
          side: "right",
          onSide: (s) => s.x1 === layout.width && s.x2 === layout.width,
          span: vertical,
          length: layout.height,
        },
        {
          side: "bottom",
          onSide: (s) => s.y1 === layout.height && s.y2 === layout.height,
          span: horizontal,
          length: layout.width,
        },
        {
          side: "left",
          onSide: (s) => s.x1 === 0 && s.x2 === 0,
          span: vertical,
          length: layout.height,
        },
      ];
    }
    function gapsOnSide(definition: SideDefinition, layout: RoomLayout): PerimeterGap[] {
      const covered = layout.walls
        .filter(definition.onSide)
        .map(definition.span)
        .filter(([low, high]) => high > low)
        .sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
    
      const gaps: PerimeterGap[] = [];
      let reached = 0;
      for (const [low, high] of covered) {
        if (low > reached) gaps.push({ side: definition.side, from: reached, to: low });
        reached = Math.max(reached, high);
      }
      if (reached < definition.length) {
        gaps.push({ side: definition.side, from: reached, to: definition.length });
      }
      return gaps;
    }
    export function perimeterGaps(layout: RoomLayout): readonly PerimeterGap[] {
      return sideDefinitions(layout).flatMap((definition) => gapsOnSide(definition, layout));
    }
  </file>

    export function layoutSummary(t: TFunction, layout: RoomLayout): string {
      if (layout.tables.length === 0 && layout.sections.length === 0) {
        return t("floorPlan.templates.summaryEmpty");
      }
      return t("floorPlan.templates.summary", {
        tables: t("floorPlan.templates.tableCount", { count: layout.tables.length }),
        sections: t("floorPlan.templates.sectionCount", { count: layout.sections.length }),
      });
    }

    export type RoomTemplateId =
      | "blank"
      | "fine-dining"
      | "casual-bistro"
      | "bar-lounge"
      | "cafe"
      | "banquet-hall"
      | "open-kitchen";
    export type RoomSizeId = "cozy" | "standard" | "spacious" | "grand";
    export interface RoomSize {
      readonly id: RoomSizeId;
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
    }
    export const ROOM_SIZES: readonly RoomSize[] = [
      { id: "cozy", width: CANVAS_WIDTH, height: CANVAS_HEIGHT },
      { id: "standard", width: 1200, height: 800 },
      { id: "spacious", width: 1600, height: 1000 },
      { id: "grand", width: 2000, height: 1200 },
    ] as const;
    export interface RoomTemplateTable {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly shape: TableShapeName;
      readonly capacity: number;
      readonly minCovers: number;
      /** Centre of the table, in canvas units — the origin Konva rotates about. */
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
      readonly rotation: number;
      /** Local section id, or null when the table sits outside every zone. */
      readonly sectionId: string | null;
    }
    export interface RoomTemplateSection {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly color: string;
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
    }
    export interface RoomLayout {
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
      readonly tables: readonly RoomTemplateTable[];
      readonly sections: readonly RoomTemplateSection[];
      readonly walls: readonly WallLayout[];
    }
    export interface RoomTemplate {
      readonly id: RoomTemplateId;
      /** The plan's name once created. Saved data, so it stays en-US in every locale. */
      readonly planName: string;
      /** Width of the one doorway this template leaves in its perimeter; null for Blank. */
      readonly doorWidth: number | null;
      readonly build: (width: number, height: number) => RoomLayout;
    }
    interface TableSpec {
      readonly name: string;
      readonly shape: TableShapeName;
      readonly capacity: number;
      readonly minCovers: number;
      /** Top-left of the unrotated footprint, matching the ported source's space. */
      readonly left: number;
      readonly top: number;
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
      readonly rotation: number;
    }
    interface SectionSpec {
      readonly name: string;
      readonly color: string;
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
    }
    type WallSpec = Omit<WallLayout, "id">;
    interface LayoutSpec {
      readonly tables: readonly TableSpec[];
      readonly sections: readonly SectionSpec[];
      readonly walls: readonly WallSpec[];
    }
    type DoorSide = "bottom" | "left";
    function perimeterWithDoor(
      w: number,
      h: number,
      side: DoorSide,
      position: number,
      gap: number
    ): WallSpec[] {
      const t = PERIMETER_THICKNESS;
      const p = Math.round(position);
    
      if (side === "bottom") {
        return [
          { x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: w, y2: 0, thickness: t },
          { x1: w, y1: 0, x2: w, y2: h, thickness: t },
          { x1: 0, y1: h, x2: p, y2: h, thickness: t },
          { x1: p + gap, y1: h, x2: w, y2: h, thickness: t },
          { x1: 0, y1: h, x2: 0, y2: 0, thickness: t },
        ];
      }
    
      return [
        { x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: w, y2: 0, thickness: t },
        { x1: w, y1: 0, x2: w, y2: h, thickness: t },
        { x1: w, y1: h, x2: 0, y2: h, thickness: t },
        { x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: p, thickness: t },
        { x1: 0, y1: p + gap, x2: 0, y2: h, thickness: t },
      ];
    }
    function slug(value: string): string {
      return value
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
        .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, "");
    }
    function containingSection(
      sections: readonly RoomTemplateSection[],
      x: number,
      y: number
    ): string | null {
      const found = sections.find(
        (zone) => x >= zone.x && x <= zone.x + zone.width && y >= zone.y && y <= zone.y + zone.height
      );
      return found ? found.id : null;
    }
    function toLayout(
      templateId: RoomTemplateId,
      width: number,
      height: number,
      spec: LayoutSpec
    ): RoomLayout {
      const sections: readonly RoomTemplateSection[] = spec.sections.map((zone) => ({
        ...zone,
        id: `${templateId}-${slug(zone.name)}`,
      }));
    
      const tables: readonly RoomTemplateTable[] = spec.tables.map((table) => {
        const x = table.left + table.width / 2;
        const y = table.top + table.height / 2;
        return {
          id: `${templateId}-${slug(table.name)}`,
          name: table.name,
          shape: table.shape,
          capacity: table.capacity,
          minCovers: table.minCovers,
          x,
          y,
          width: table.width,
          height: table.height,
          rotation: table.rotation,
          sectionId: containingSection(sections, x, y),
        };
      });
    
      const walls: readonly WallLayout[] = spec.walls.map((segment, index) => ({
        ...segment,
        id: `${templateId}-wall-${index + 1}`,
      }));
    
      return { width, height, tables, sections, walls };
    }
    export const ROOM_TEMPLATES: readonly RoomTemplate[] = [
      BLANK,
      FINE_DINING,
      CASUAL_BISTRO,
      BAR_LOUNGE,
      CAFE,
      BANQUET_HALL,
      OPEN_KITCHEN,
    ] as const;
    export function roomTemplateById(id: RoomTemplateId): RoomTemplate {
      const found = ROOM_TEMPLATES.find((template) => template.id === id);
      if (!found) throw new Error(`roomTemplateById: no template registered for id "${id}"`);
      return found;
    }
    export function roomSizeById(id: RoomSizeId): RoomSize {
      const found = ROOM_SIZES.find((size) => size.id === id);
      if (!found) throw new Error(`roomSizeById: no size registered for id "${id}"`);
      return found;
    }

  <file path="src/components/floor-plan/section-label-theme.ts">
    export interface SectionLabelTheme {
      /** Opaque plate behind the name. */
      plate: string;
      /** The name itself. */
      text: string;
    }
    export const SECTION_LABEL_TOKENS = {
      plate: "--rialto-surface",
      text: "--rialto-text-primary",
    } as const;
    export const SECTION_LABEL_FALLBACKS: Record<"light" | "dark", SectionLabelTheme> = {
      light: { plate: "#f8f6f3", text: "#1a1918" },
      dark: { plate: "#1e1c1a", text: "rgb(253 252 250 / 0.92)" },
    };
    function resolveSectionLabelTheme(): SectionLabelTheme {
      const theme: "light" | "dark" =
        document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
      const fallback = SECTION_LABEL_FALLBACKS[theme];
      const computed = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
      return {
        plate: computed.getPropertyValue(SECTION_LABEL_TOKENS.plate).trim() || fallback.plate,
        text: computed.getPropertyValue(SECTION_LABEL_TOKENS.text).trim() || fallback.text,
      };
    }
    export function useSectionLabelTheme(): SectionLabelTheme {
      const [theme, setTheme] = useState(resolveSectionLabelTheme);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(() => setTheme(resolveSectionLabelTheme()));
        observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ["data-theme"],
        });
        return () => observer.disconnect();
      }, []);
    
      return theme;
    }

    export const LABEL_MIN_SCREEN_PX = 10;
    export const LABEL_PADDING = 2;
    export const LABEL_LINE_HEIGHT = 1.15;
    export interface TableLabelInput {
      number: string;
      covers: string;
      shape: TableShapeName;
      capacity: number;
      /** The table footprint in canvas units (its own, unrotated frame). */
      width: number;
      height: number;
      /** The table group's rotation, in degrees clockwise. */
      rotation: number;
      /** The stage's scale (rendered px per canvas unit). */
      stageScale: number;
      /** Reserve room in the plate for a status glyph, sized from the font so it shrinks with it. */
      glyph?: boolean;
    }
    export interface TableLabelLayout {
      text: string;
      fontSize: number;
      /** Plate size in canvas units, including padding. */
      width: number;
      height: number;
      /** Status glyph edge in canvas units; 0 when the table wears no glyph. */
      glyphSize: number;
      /** Width the glyph takes at the plate's leading edge, gap included; 0 without a glyph. */
      glyphSlot: number;
      /** Always false: the number is never ellipsized; the font shrinks instead. */
      ellipsis: false;
    }
    export function counterRotation(rotation: number): number {
      return rotation === 0 ? 0 : -rotation;
    }
    interface Box {
      readonly cx: number;
      readonly cy: number;
      readonly halfW: number;
      readonly halfH: number;
    }
    function chairBoxes(input: TableLabelInput): readonly Box[] {
      const placementInput: SeatPlacementInput = {
        shape: input.shape,
        capacity: input.capacity,
        width: input.width,
        height: input.height,
      };
      const chair = fittedSeatSize(placementInput);
      const tableRad = toRadians(input.rotation);
      return seatPlacements(placementInput).map((seat) => {
        const total = toRadians(seat.rotation + input.rotation);
        return {
          cx: seat.x * Math.cos(tableRad) - seat.y * Math.sin(tableRad),
          cy: seat.x * Math.sin(tableRad) + seat.y * Math.cos(tableRad),
          halfW:
            (chair.width * Math.abs(Math.cos(total)) + chair.height * Math.abs(Math.sin(total))) / 2,
          halfH:
            (chair.width * Math.abs(Math.sin(total)) + chair.height * Math.abs(Math.cos(total))) / 2,
        };
      });
    }
    function footprintBox(input: TableLabelInput): Box {
      const rad = toRadians(input.rotation);
      return {
        cx: 0,
        cy: 0,
        halfW: (input.width * Math.abs(Math.cos(rad)) + input.height * Math.abs(Math.sin(rad))) / 2,
        halfH: (input.width * Math.abs(Math.sin(rad)) + input.height * Math.abs(Math.cos(rad))) / 2,
      };
    }
    function overlapsChair(chair: Box, plateHalfW: number, plateHalfH: number): boolean {
      const gapX = Math.max(0, Math.abs(chair.cx) - chair.halfW - CHAIR_CLEARANCE);
      const gapY = Math.max(0, Math.abs(chair.cy) - chair.halfH - CHAIR_CLEARANCE);
      return gapX < plateHalfW && gapY < plateHalfH;
    }
    interface Plate {
      text: string;
      fontSize: number;
      width: number;
      height: number;
      glyphSize: number;
      glyphSlot: number;
    }
    function plateFor(lines: readonly string[], fontSize: number, withGlyph: boolean): Plate {
      const longest = Math.max(...lines.map((line) => line.length), 1);
      const glyphSize = withGlyph ? fontSize * STATUS_GLYPH_EM : 0;
      const glyphSlot = withGlyph ? glyphSize + LABEL_PADDING : 0;
      return {
        text: lines.join("\n"),
        fontSize,
        width: longest * GLYPH_WIDTH_EM * fontSize + 2 * LABEL_PADDING + glyphSlot,
        height: lines.length * fontSize * LABEL_LINE_HEIGHT + 2 * LABEL_PADDING,
        glyphSize,
        glyphSlot,
      };
    }
    export function tableLabelLayout(input: TableLabelInput): TableLabelLayout {
      const withGlyph = input.glyph === true;
      const chairs = chairBoxes(input);
      const footprint = chairs.length === 0 ? footprintBox(input) : null;
      const clear = (plate: Plate) =>
        chairs.every((chair) => !overlapsChair(chair, plate.width / 2, plate.height / 2)) &&
        (footprint === null ||
          (plate.width / 2 <= footprint.halfW && plate.height / 2 <= footprint.halfH));
    
      const startFont = Math.max(LABEL_MIN_SCREEN_PX / input.stageScale, LABEL_MAX_FONT_SIZE);
      const full = plateFor([input.number, input.covers], startFont, withGlyph);
      if (clear(full)) return { ...full, ellipsis: false };
    
      let plate = plateFor([input.number], startFont, withGlyph);
      for (let step = 0; step < MAX_SHRINK_STEPS && !clear(plate); step += 1) {
        plate = plateFor([input.number], plate.fontSize * SHRINK_FACTOR, withGlyph);
      }
      return { ...plate, ellipsis: false };
    }
  </file>

    export const STATUS_LABEL_KEY = {

    export function glyphKeyFor(
      status: TableDisplayStatus | undefined,
      isActive: boolean
    ): StatusGlyphKey | null {
      if (status === undefined) return null;
      return isActive ? status : "inactive";
    }
    export function statusFillToken(key: StatusGlyphKey): string {

    }

  <file path="src/components/floor-plan/table-update.ts">
    export interface TableDetailsFormValues {
      name: string;
      tableNumber: string;
      capacity: string;
      minCovers: string;
      maxCovers: string;
      location: string;
      /** The section's id; an empty string means "No section". */
      sectionId: string;
      isActive: boolean;
    }
    export function tableToFormValues(table: Table): TableDetailsFormValues {
      return {
        name: table.name,
        tableNumber: table.tableNumber ?? "",
        capacity: String(table.capacity),
        minCovers: String(table.minCovers),
        // A numeric input needs a value, and `PATCH /api/v1/tables/:id` has no way
        // to express "clear the maximum" — `maxCovers` is `number | undefined` on
        // the wire, never null. Seeding an absent maximum from capacity keeps the
        // field meaningful without inventing a write: the delta below is computed
        // against these seeded values, so leaving the field alone sends nothing.
        maxCovers: String(table.maxCovers ?? table.capacity),
        location: table.location ?? "",
        sectionId: table.sectionId ?? "",
        isActive: table.isActive,
      };
    }
    export function buildTableUpdate(
      initial: TableDetailsFormValues,
      current: TableDetailsFormValues
    ): UpdateTableRequest {
      const changes: UpdateTableRequest = {};
    
      const name = current.name.trim();
      if (name !== initial.name.trim()) changes.name = name;
    
      const tableNumber = current.tableNumber.trim();
      if (tableNumber !== initial.tableNumber.trim()) changes.tableNumber = tableNumber;
    
      const location = current.location.trim();
      if (location !== initial.location.trim()) changes.location = location;
    
      if (current.sectionId !== initial.sectionId) changes.sectionId = current.sectionId || null;
    
      if (current.isActive !== initial.isActive) changes.isActive = current.isActive;
    
      const capacity = changedPositiveInt(initial.capacity, current.capacity);
      if (capacity !== null) changes.capacity = capacity;
    
      const minCovers = changedPositiveInt(initial.minCovers, current.minCovers);
      if (minCovers !== null) changes.minCovers = minCovers;
    
      const maxCovers = changedPositiveInt(initial.maxCovers, current.maxCovers);
      if (maxCovers !== null) changes.maxCovers = maxCovers;
    
      return changes;
    }
    function changedPositiveInt(initial: string, current: string): number | null {
      if (current.trim() === initial.trim()) return null;
      return parsePositiveInt(current);
    }
    export function parsePositiveInt(raw: string): number | null {
      const trimmed = raw.trim();
      if (!/^\d+$/.test(trimmed)) return null;
      const parsed = Number(trimmed);
      return parsed >= 1 ? parsed : null;
    }
  </file>

  <file path="e2e/helpers/close-mock.ts">
    export interface AvailabilityConfigResponse {
      readonly config: Record<string, unknown> & { readonly dateRules?: readonly unknown[] };
      readonly version: number;
      readonly source: string;
    }
    export interface CloseConnection {
      dropped: boolean;
    }
    export interface CloseMockOptions {
      /**
       * The one service date the Manager closes whole-venue in the scenario. The days answer shows the
       * "Closed" band on it once the POST lands, and `bookings` apply to it. Omit when the spec only
       * checks that a closure was saved.
       */
      readonly closeDate?: string;
      /** Bookings a whole-venue closure of `closeDate` would affect; 0 saves with no second step. */
      readonly bookings?: number;
      /** The config served before a closure lands; default is the Dinner-only venue below. */
      readonly config?: AvailabilityConfigResponse;
      readonly connection?: CloseConnection;
    }
    export type SavedClosure = { readonly rule: unknown } & Record<string, unknown>;
    export interface CloseMock {
      readonly venueId: string;
      /** The last accepted POST body, or null before any. */
      readonly saved: () => SavedClosure | null;
      /** Every POST attempt: its Idempotency-Key and the rule id. */
      readonly posts: () => ReadonlyArray<{ key: string | undefined; ruleId: string }>;
      /** Every notice-preview request body. */
      readonly notices: () => ReadonlyArray<{ action: string; message: string | null }>;
    }
    export const DINNER_ONLY_CONFIG: AvailabilityConfigResponse = {
      config: {
        schedules: [{ id: "regular", name: "Regular week", kind: "regular", isRegular: true }],
        venueServices: [{ id: "vs-dinner", name: "Dinner", position: 0 }],
        scheduleServices: [
          {
            id: "ss-dinner",
            scheduleId: "regular",
            venueServiceId: "vs-dinner",
            ...DINNER,
            seating: { version: 1, interval: 15 },
            bookingTypes: ["online", "phone"],
          },
        ],
        assignments: [
          { id: "as", scheduleId: "regular", weekdays: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6], precedence: 0 },
        ],
        dateRules: [],
      },
      version: 7,
      source: "rows",
    };
    export function datesBetween(from: string, to: string): string[] {
      const out: string[] = [];
      for (
        let d = new Date(`${from}T00:00:00Z`);
        d <= new Date(`${to}T00:00:00Z`);
        d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1)
      ) {
        out.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      }
      return out;
    }
    export async function mockClosures(page: Page, options: CloseMockOptions = {}): Promise<CloseMock> {
      const { closeDate, bookings = 0, config: base = DINNER_ONLY_CONFIG, connection } = options;
      const venues = JSON.parse(loadFixture("venues-list")) as { data: Array<{ id: string }> };
      const venueId = String(venues.data[0]?.id);
      const routeBase = `**/api/v1/venues/${venueId}`;
      let version = base.version;
      let saved: SavedClosure | null = null;
      const posts: Array<{ key: string | undefined; ruleId: string }> = [];
      const notices: Array<{ action: string; message: string | null }> = [];
      const json = (data: unknown) => ({
        status: 200,
        contentType: "application/json",
        body: JSON.stringify({ data }),
      });
      const guestCount = (i: number) => (i < 10 ? 4 : 3);
      const covers = Array.from({ length: bookings }, (_, i) => guestCount(i)).reduce(
        (a, b) => a + b,
        0
      );
      const deposits = Math.min(3, bookings);
    
      const configAnswer = () => ({
        ...base,
        config: {
          ...base.config,
          dateRules: [...(base.config.dateRules ?? []), ...(saved ? [saved.rule] : [])],
        },
        version,
      });
    
      await page.route(`${routeBase}/availability/config`, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.fallback();
        return route.fulfill(json(configAnswer()));
      });
      await page.route(`${routeBase}/availability/days*`, (route) => {
        const url = new URL(route.request().url());
        const days = datesBetween(url.searchParams.get("from")!, url.searchParams.get("to")!).map(
          (serviceDate) => {
            const closed = saved !== null && serviceDate === closeDate;
            return {
              serviceDate,
              label: closed ? "Closed" : "Regular week",
              scheduleId: closed ? null : "regular",
              serviceCount: closed ? 0 : 1,
              closures: closed ? [{ ruleId: "rule-1", targetKind: "venue", ...ALL_DAY_CLOSURE }] : [],
              bookingOpen: { online: !closed, phone: !closed, waitlist: !closed },
            };
          }
        );
        return route.fulfill(json(days));
      });
      await page.route(`${routeBase}/closures/impact`, (route) => {
        const rule = route.request().postDataJSON().rule as { startsOn: string; targetKind: string };
        const affected =
          closeDate !== undefined &&
          rule.startsOn === closeDate &&
          rule.targetKind === "venue" &&
          bookings > 0;
        const reservations = Array.from({ length: affected ? bookings : 0 }, (_, i) => ({
          id: `res-${i}`,
          startTime: `${closeDate}T${String(17 + (i % 5)).padStart(2, "0")}:30:00Z`,
          endTime: `${closeDate}T${String(19 + (i % 3)).padStart(2, "0")}:00:00Z`,
          partySize: guestCount(i),
          guestName: `Guest ${i + 1}`,
          deposit: i < 3 ? { amountCents: 4000, currency: "USD" } : null,
          runsIntoClosure: false,
        }));
        return route.fulfill(
          json({
            reservations: reservations.length,
            covers: affected ? covers : 0,
            depositsHeld: affected ? deposits : 0,
            groups: affected
              ? [
                  {
                    groupKey: `${closeDate}:closed`,
                    date: closeDate,
                    kind: "closed",
                    covers,
                    depositsHeld: deposits,
                    reservations,
                  },
                ]
              : [],
          })
        );
      });
      // The server renders the notice (closure-content.ts); the browser shows it as sent. This answer
      // stands in for that render and echoes the request, so the spec checks what the screen asks for.
      await page.route(`${routeBase}/closures/notice-preview`, (route) => {
        const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as { action: string; message: string | null };
        notices.push(body);
        return route.fulfill(
          json({
            email: {
              from: "Matt Butler Engineering <reservations@example.com>",
              subject: "Your reservation at Rivera Bistro is cancelled",
              text: `Rivera Bistro is closed.\n${body.message ?? ""}`,
            },
            sms: `Rivera Bistro is closed. ${body.message ?? ""} Rebook: https://example.com/m`,
          })
        );
      });
      await page.route(`${routeBase}/closures`, (route) => {
        // The Special dates tab lists closure outcomes; none exist in these flows.
        if (route.request().method() === "GET") return route.fulfill(json([]));
        const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as SavedClosure & { rule: { id: string } };
        posts.push({ key: route.request().headers()["idempotency-key"], ruleId: body.rule.id });
        // A known key answers with the stored result and changes nothing (closure-command.ts replayOf).
        if (saved === null) {
          saved = body;
          version += 1;
        }
        if (connection?.dropped) return route.abort("connectionreset");
        return route.fulfill(
          json({
            ruleId: "rule-1",
            version,
            changeId: "chg-close-1",
            outcomes: { cancel: bookings, move: 0, keep_notify: 0, keep_silent: 0 },
          })
        );
      });
    
      return {
        venueId,
        saved: () => saved,
        posts: () => posts,
        notices: () => notices,
      };
    }

    export function nextChristmasEve(): string {
      const today = localDay();
      const thisYear = `${today.slice(0, 4)}-12-24`;
      return today <= thisYear ? thisYear : `${Number(today.slice(0, 4)) + 1}-12-24`;
    }

    export const RESOURCE_TYPES = [
      "weeklyHours",
      "services",
      "specialDates",
      "booking",
      "floorPlan",
      "sections",
      "tables",
    ] as const;
    export type ResourceType = (typeof RESOURCE_TYPES)[number];
    export const EDITOR_SIGNATURES: Readonly<Record<ResourceType, (page: Page) => Locator>> = {
      weeklyHours: (page) => page.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Opens" }),
      services: (page) => page.getByRole("textbox", { name: /^Service name/ }),
      specialDates: (page) => page.getByRole("dialog", { name: /^Close / }),
      booking: (page) => page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Booking rules" }),
      floorPlan: (page) => page.getByRole("dialog", { name: /floor plan/i }),
      sections: (page) => page.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "Room template" }),
      tables: (page) => page.getByRole("button", { name: /Add Table/i }),
    };
    export async function editorsVisibleOn(page: Page): Promise<ResourceType[]> {
      const found: ResourceType[] = [];
      for (const type of RESOURCE_TYPES) {
        if (await EDITOR_SIGNATURES[type](page).first().isVisible()) found.push(type);
      }
      return found;
    }

  <file path="e2e/helpers/empty-venue-mock.ts">
    function changedWeekdays(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      after: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      from: string
    ): number[] {
      const services = (config: AvailabilityConfig, date: string) =>
        JSON.stringify(
          resolveDay({ timezone, config }, date).services.map((svc) => [
            svc.venueServiceId,
            svc.opensAt,
            svc.lastSeatingAt,
            svc.closesAt,
          ])
        );
      return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(from, i))
        .filter((date) => services(before, date) !== services(after, date))
        .map((date) => new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`).getUTCDay());
    }
    export async function mockEmptyVenue(
      page: Page,
      options: { derive?: boolean; config?: AvailabilityConfig } = {}
    ) {
      let saved: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
      let version = 3;
      let config: AvailabilityConfig = options.config ?? EMPTY_CONFIG;
      const hasRows = () => saved !== null || options.config !== undefined;
      const history: AvailabilityChangeEntry[] = [];
      const appliedConfig = (): AvailabilityConfig => config;
    
      const venues = JSON.parse(loadFixture("venues-list")) as {
        data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
        pagination: Record<string, unknown>;
      };
      const venueId = String(venues.data[0]?.id);
    
      await page.route("**/api/v1/venues?*", (route) => {
        const [venue] = venues.data;
        const data = [
          {
            ...venue,
            operatingHours: hasRows() ? { monday: { open: "17:00", close: "22:00" } } : null,
          },
        ];
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data, pagination: venues.pagination }),
        });
      });
      // No floor plan yet, so the hours step is the only one the save can complete.
      await page.route("**/api/v1/floor-plans?*", (route) =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            data: [],
            pagination: { page: 1, limit: 10, total: 0, totalPages: 0, hasNext: false, hasPrev: false },
          }),
        })
      );
      await page.route(`**/api/v1/venues/${venueId}/availability/config`, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === "PUT") {
          saved = route.request().postDataJSON() as Record<string, unknown>;
          const changes = saved.changes as AvailabilityConfigChanges;
          const before = config;
          const at = new Date().toISOString();
          config = applyChanges(before, changes, at);
          version += 1;
          const startsOn = changes.upsert.assignments?.find((a) => a.startsOn)?.startsOn ?? localDay();
          const weekdays = changedWeekdays(
            before,
            config,
            String(venues.data[0]?.ianaTimezone),
            startsOn
          );
          history.unshift({
            id: `change-${version}`,
            actorId: "auth0|local-e2e",
            at,
            kind: "config_saved",
            summary: "Regular week changed",
            detail: { code: "regular_week_changed", startsOn, weekdays },
            affectedFrom: null,
            affectedTo: null,
            notifiedGuests: false,
            revertedById: null,
            revertible: false,
            actorName: "E2E Manager",
          });
          return route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ data: { version, changeId: "change-1" } }),
          });
        }
        return route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            data: hasRows()
              ? {
                  config: appliedConfig(),
                  version,
                  source: "rows",
                }
              : { config: EMPTY_CONFIG, version, source: "empty" },
          }),
        });
      });
      await page.route(`**/api/v1/venues/${venueId}/availability/changes*`, (route) =>
        route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          contentType: "application/json",
          body: JSON.stringify({ data: { total: history.length, offset: 0, items: history } }),
        })
      );
      if (options.derive) {
        const timezone = String(venues.data[0]?.ianaTimezone);
        await serveDaysAndPreview(page, `**/api/v1/venues/${venueId}`, timezone, () => ({
          config: appliedConfig(),
          version,
        }));
      } else {
        await page.route(`**/api/v1/venues/${venueId}/availability/days*`, (route) =>
          route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            contentType: "application/json",
            body: JSON.stringify({ data: [] }),
          })
        );
      }
      return { savedBody: () => saved };
    }

    function isDayClosed(day: ResolvedDay): boolean {
      const closedAllDay = day.closures.some(
        (c) => c.targetKind === "venue" && c.from <= 0 && c.to >= WHOLE_DAY_MINUTES
      );
      return closedAllDay || day.services.length === 0;
    }
    function dayLabel(config: AvailabilityConfig, day: ResolvedDay): string {
      if (isDayClosed(day)) return "Closed";
      if (day.explanation.some((l) => l.kind === "special_hours")) return "Special hours";
      return config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === day.scheduleId)?.name ?? "Open";
    }
    function summarize(config: AvailabilityConfig, day: ResolvedDay): AvailabilityDaySummary {
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((s) => [s.id, s.name]));
      return {
        serviceDate: day.serviceDate,
        label: dayLabel(config, day),
        scheduleId: day.scheduleId,
        serviceCount: day.services.length,
        closures: [],
        bookingOpen: day.bookingOpen,
        services: isDayClosed(day)
          ? []
          : day.services.map((s) => ({
              venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
              name: names.get(s.venueServiceId) ?? s.name,
              opensAt: s.opensAt,
              lastSeatingAt: s.lastSeatingAt,
              closesAt: s.closesAt,
            })),
      };
    }
    function between(from: string, to: string): string[] {
      const out: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) out.push(d);
      return out;
    }
    export interface SavedConfig {
      config: AvailabilityConfig;
      version: number;
    }
    export async function serveDaysAndPreview(
      page: Page,
      venueBase: string,
      timezone: string,
      current: () => SavedConfig
    ) {
      await page.route(`${venueBase}/availability/days*`, (route) => {
        const url = new URL(route.request().url());
        const { config } = current();
        const days = between(url.searchParams.get("from")!, url.searchParams.get("to")!).map((date) =>
          summarize(config, resolveDay({ timezone, config }, date))
        );
        return route.fulfill(json(days));
      });
      await page.route(`${venueBase}/availability/preview*`, (route) => {
        const body = PreviewAvailabilityBodySchema.parse(route.request().postDataJSON());
        const { config, version } = current();
        const now = new Date();
        const after = applyChanges(config, body.draft.changes, now.toISOString());
        const structural = (c: AvailabilityConfig): BookingSnapshot => ({
          timezone,
          config: c,
          tables: [],
          reservations: [],
          holds: [],
          settings: null,
        });
        const dates = Array.from({ length: PREVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS }, (_, i) => addDays(body.focusDate, i));
        const result: PreviewResult = {
          version,
          days: diffDays(structural(config), structural(after), dates, {
            partySize: body.partySize,
            channel: "online",
            now,
          }),
          focusDay: summarize(after, resolveDay({ timezone, config: after }, body.focusDate)),
          stranded: { total: 0, offset: 0, items: [] },
        };
        return route.fulfill(json(result));
      });
    }

  <file path="e2e/helpers/first-paint.ts">
    export interface FirstPaintCount {
      readonly count: number;
      /** One "role: name" per counted control, in document order, for a readable failure. */
      readonly controls: readonly string[];
    }
    export async function countFirstPaintControls(
      page: Page,
      region: Locator | null
    ): Promise<FirstPaintCount> {
      const regionHandle = region ? await region.elementHandle() : null;
      return page.evaluate(
        ({ selector, shell, outside }) => {
          const main = document.querySelector("main#main-content");
          if (!main) throw new Error("first paint: no <main id=main-content> on the page");
          const seen = new Set<Element>();
          const controls: string[] = [];
          for (const el of main.querySelectorAll(selector)) {
            if (outside?.contains(el)) continue;
            if (el.closest("[aria-hidden=true], [inert]")) continue;
            // The shell's own row inside <main>: breadcrumb, system health badge, paused pill.
            if (el.closest(shell)) continue;
            if (el.matches(":disabled")) continue;
            const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (rect.width <= 1 || rect.height <= 1) continue;
            const style = getComputedStyle(el);
            if (style.visibility === "hidden" || style.display === "none") continue;
            if (seen.has(el)) continue;
            seen.add(el);
            const name =
              el.getAttribute("aria-label") ?? (el.textContent ?? "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
            controls.push(`${el.getAttribute("role") ?? el.tagName.toLowerCase()}: ${name}`);
          }
          return { count: controls.length, controls };
        },
        { selector: ACTIONABLE, shell: SHELL_ROW, outside: regionHandle }
      );
    }
    export function weekPanel(page: Page): Locator {
      return page.getByTestId("week-panel");
    }

  <file path="e2e/helpers/interaction-counter.ts">
    export interface InteractionCounter {
      /** Use this in place of the test's `page`. */
      readonly page: Page;
      /** Interactions counted so far. */
      readonly count: () => number;
    }
    export function countInteractions(page: Page): InteractionCounter {
      let interactions = 0;
    
      const wrap = <T extends Page | Locator>(target: T): T =>
        new Proxy(target, {
          get(_, prop) {
            const member: unknown = Reflect.get(target, prop, target);
            if (typeof member !== "function" || typeof prop !== "string") return member;
            return (...args: unknown[]) => {
              if (COUNTED_ACTIONS.has(prop)) interactions += 1;
              const result: unknown = member.apply(target, args);
              return LOCATOR_RETURNING.has(prop) ? wrap(result as Locator) : result;
            };
          },
        });
    
      return { page: wrap(page), count: () => interactions };
    }

    export interface CapturedConfigPuts {

    export async function captureConfigPuts(page: Page): Promise<CapturedConfigPuts> {
      const bodies: ConfigPutBody[] = [];
      await page.route(/\/api\/v1\/venues\/[^/?]+\/availability\/config$/, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === "PUT") bodies.push(route.request().postDataJSON());
        return route.fallback();
      });
      return {
        bodies: () => bodies,
        last: () => {
          const body = bodies.at(-1);
          if (!body) throw new Error("no PUT of the availability config was sent");
          return body;
        },
      };
    }

  <file path="e2e/helpers/shared-config-mock.ts">
    export interface DecisionCall {
      readonly method: "PUT" | "DELETE";
      readonly date: string;
      readonly body: unknown;
    }
    export interface ConfigPut {
      readonly expectedVersion: number;
      readonly changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges;
    }
    export interface SharedConfigStore {
      config: AvailabilityConfig;
      version: number;
      /** `serviceDate` to the instant it was decided. */
      readonly decisions: Map<string, string>;
      readonly decisionCalls: DecisionCall[];
      readonly configPuts: ConfigPut[];
      /** The bodies `POST …/closures/batch` carried. */
      readonly batches: Array<{ items: Array<{ rule: DateRule }> }>;
      /** The next this many `PUT` decisions answer 404, as a server without the routes would. */
      failDecisionPuts: number;
      /** Reads of the decision list, to show a page asked once. */
      decisionReads: number;
    }
    export function createSharedConfig(config: AvailabilityConfig, version = 7): SharedConfigStore {
      return {
        config,
        version,
        decisions: new Map(),
        decisionCalls: [],
        configPuts: [],
        batches: [],
        failDecisionPuts: 0,
        decisionReads: 0,
      };
    }
    export async function serveSharedConfig(page: Page, store: SharedConfigStore): Promise<void> {
      const venues = JSON.parse(loadFixture("venues-list")) as {
        data: Array<{ id: string; ianaTimezone: string }>;
      };
      const venueId = String(venues.data[0]?.id);
      const timezone = String(venues.data[0]?.ianaTimezone);
      const base = `**/api/v1/venues/${venueId}`;
    
      await page.route(`${base}/availability/config`, (route) => {
        if (route.request().method() === "PUT") {
          const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as ConfigPut;
          store.configPuts.push(body);
          store.config = applyChanges(store.config, body.changes, new Date().toISOString());
          store.version += 1;
          return route.fulfill(json({ version: store.version, changeId: `change-${store.version}` }));
        }
        return route.fulfill(json({ config: store.config, version: store.version, source: "rows" }));
      });
      await serveDaysAndPreview(page, base, timezone, () => ({
        config: store.config,
        version: store.version,
      }));
      await page.route(`${base}/availability/changes*`, (route) =>
        route.fulfill(json({ total: 0, offset: 0, items: [], undoable: null }))
      );
    
      await page.route(`${base}/closures/impact`, (route) =>
        route.fulfill(json({ reservations: 0, covers: 0, depositsHeld: 0, groups: [] }))
      );
      await page.route(`${base}/closures/batch`, (route) => {
        const body = route.request().postDataJSON() as { items: Array<{ rule: DateRule }> };
        store.batches.push(body);
        store.config = {
          ...store.config,
          dateRules: [...store.config.dateRules, ...body.items.map((item) => item.rule)],
        };
        store.version += 1;
        return route.fulfill(
          json({
            version: store.version,
            results: body.items.map((item) => ({
              ruleId: item.rule.id,
              version: store.version,
              changeId: `change-${store.version}`,
              outcomes: { cancel: 0, move: 0, keep_notify: 0, keep_silent: 0 },
            })),
          })
        );
      });
    
      await page.route(
        new RegExp(
          `/api/v1/venues/${venueId}/availability/holiday-decisions(?:/(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}))?(?:\\?.*)?$`
        ),
        (route) => {
          const request = route.request();
          const date = /holiday-decisions\/(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/.exec(request.url())?.[1];
          if (request.method() === "GET") {
            store.decisionReads += 1;
            const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url());
            const from = searchParams.get("from") ?? "0000-00-00";
            const to = searchParams.get("to") ?? addDays(from, 400);
            const rows = [...store.decisions]
              .filter(([d]) => d >= from && d <= to)
              .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
              .map(([serviceDate, createdAt]) => ({
                serviceDate,
                decision: "open_as_usual",
                createdAt,
              }));
            return route.fulfill(json(rows));
          }
          if (date === undefined) return route.fallback();
          const method = request.method() === "DELETE" ? "DELETE" : "PUT";
          store.decisionCalls.push({
            method,
            date,
            body: method === "PUT" ? request.postDataJSON() : null,
          });
          if (method === "DELETE") {
            store.decisions.delete(date);
            return route.fulfill({ status: 204 });
          }
          if (store.failDecisionPuts > 0) {
            store.failDecisionPuts -= 1;
            return route.fulfill({
              status: 404,
              contentType: "application/problem+json",
              body: JSON.stringify({ type: "about:blank", title: "Not Found", status: 404 }),
            });
          }
          const createdAt = store.decisions.get(date) ?? new Date().toISOString();
          store.decisions.set(date, createdAt);
          return route.fulfill(json({ serviceDate: date, decision: "open_as_usual", createdAt }));
        }
      );
    }

    export const WEEKDAYS = [
      "Monday",
      "Tuesday",
      "Wednesday",
      "Thursday",
      "Friday",
      "Saturday",
      "Sunday",
    ];
    function utc(iso: string): Date {
      return new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`);
    }
    export function plusDays(iso: string, days: number): string {
      const d = utc(iso);
      d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + days);
      return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
    export function nextMonday(today: string): string {
      const sinceMonday = (utc(today).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
      return plusDays(today, 7 - sinceMonday);
    }
    export async function serviceLines(scope: Locator): Promise<string[]> {
      const text = await scope.innerText();
      return text
        .split("\n")
        .map((line) => line.trim())
        .filter((line) => SERVICE_LINE.test(line));
    }
    export async function calendarWeek(page: Page, monday: string): Promise<Record<string, string[]>> {
      const week: Record<string, string[]> = {};
      for (const [offset, day] of WEEKDAYS.entries()) {
        const cell = page.locator(`[data-date="${plusDays(monday, offset)}"]`);
        await expect
          .poll(
            async () => (await serviceLines(cell)).length > 0 || /Closed/.test(await cell.innerText()),
            {
              message: `calendar, ${day}`,
            }
          )
          .toBe(true);
        week[day] = await serviceLines(cell);
      }
      return week;
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/create-mutation-hook.ts">
    export interface CreateMutationHookOptions<TVariables, TData = unknown> {
      /** One or more static query keys to invalidate on successful mutation */
      invalidateKeys: string | readonly string[];
      /** Mutation function — receives api client and variables, returns a promise */
      mutationFn: (api: ReturnType<typeof useApiClient>, variables: TVariables) => Promise<TData>;
      /**
       * Optional dynamic invalidation callback, called after the static
       * invalidateKeys are invalidated. Use when invalidation keys depend on
       * the mutation's variables or returned data.
       */
      onSuccess?: (queryClient: QueryClient, data: TData, variables: TVariables) => void;
    }
    export interface MutationHookResult<TVariables, TData = unknown> {
      mutate: (variables: TVariables) => void;
      mutateAsync: (variables: TVariables) => Promise<TData>;
      isPending: boolean;
      isSuccess: boolean;
      isError: boolean;
      error: Error | null;
    }
    export function createMutationHook<TVariables, TData = unknown>(
      options: CreateMutationHookOptions<TVariables, TData>
    ): () => MutationHookResult<TVariables, TData> {
      const { invalidateKeys, mutationFn, onSuccess } = options;
    
      return function useMutationHook(): MutationHookResult<TVariables, TData> {
        const api = useApiClient();
        const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    
        const mutation = useMutation<TData, Error, TVariables>({
          mutationFn: (variables) => mutationFn(api, variables),
          onSuccess: (data, variables) => {
            const keys = Array.isArray(invalidateKeys) ? invalidateKeys : [invalidateKeys];
            for (const key of keys) {
              queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [key] });
            }
            onSuccess?.(queryClient, data, variables);
          },
        });
    
        return {
          mutate: mutation.mutate,
          mutateAsync: mutation.mutateAsync,
          isPending: mutation.isPending,
          isSuccess: mutation.isSuccess,
          isError: mutation.isError,
          error: mutation.error ?? null,
        };
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/hooks/create-query-hook.ts">
    export interface QueryHookResult<TData> {
      data: TData | undefined;
      isLoading: boolean;
      error: Error | null;
      /** Resolves when the refetch settles; `error` is null on success (so a Retry handler can speak). */
      refetch: () => Promise<{ error: Error | null }>;
    }
    export interface CreateQueryHookOptions<TData, TParams = undefined, TResult = TData> {
      /** Base query key string */
      key: string;
      /** Fetcher function — receives params and api client, returns TData */
      fetcher: (params: TParams | undefined, api: ReturnType<typeof useApiClient>) => Promise<TData>;
      /**
       * Optional predicate to derive the `enabled` flag from params.
       * When omitted, the hook is always enabled unless params.enabled === false.
       */
      getEnabled?: (params: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined) => boolean;
      /**
       * Optional transform applied to query.data before returning.
       * Use this to coalesce undefined → null, or extract a nested field.
       */
      select?: (data: TData | undefined) => TResult;
    }
    export function createQueryHook<TData, TParams = undefined, TResult = TData>(
      options: CreateQueryHookOptions<TData, TParams, TResult>
    ): (params?: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined) => QueryHookResult<TResult> {
      const { key, fetcher, getEnabled, select } = options;
    
      return function useQueryHook(
        params?: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined
      ): QueryHookResult<TResult> {
        const api = useApiClient();
    
        const enabled = resolveEnabled(params, getEnabled);
        const queryParams = stripEnabled(params);
    
        const query = useQuery({
          queryKey: buildQueryKey(key, params),
          queryFn: () => fetcher(queryParams as TParams | undefined, api),
          enabled,
        });
    
        const data = select !== undefined ? select(query.data) : (query.data as unknown as TResult);
    
        return {
          data,
          isLoading: query.isLoading,
          error: query.error ?? null,
          refetch: query.refetch,
        };
      };
    }
    export function buildQueryKey<TParams>(
      key: string,
      params?: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined
    ): readonly unknown[] {
      const queryParams = stripEnabled(params);
      return queryParams !== undefined ? [key, queryParams] : [key];
    }
    function resolveEnabled<TParams>(
      params: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined,
      getEnabled: ((p: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined) => boolean) | undefined
    ): boolean {
      if (getEnabled !== undefined) {
        // Custom predicate takes priority — but still respect explicit enabled: false
        if (params !== null && typeof params === "object" && "enabled" in params) {
          const explicit = (params as { enabled?: boolean }).enabled;
          if (explicit === false) return false;
        }
        return getEnabled(params);
      }
      if (params !== null && typeof params === "object" && "enabled" in params) {
        const explicit = (params as { enabled?: boolean }).enabled;
        if (explicit === false) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }
    function stripEnabled<TParams>(
      params: (TParams & { enabled?: boolean }) | undefined
    ): TParams | undefined {
      if (params === undefined || params === null) return undefined;
      if (typeof params !== "object") return params as unknown as TParams;
      const { enabled: _enabled, ...rest } = params as Record<string, unknown> & {
        enabled?: boolean;
      };
      // If rest is empty (only key was 'enabled'), return undefined so key stays [key]
      if (Object.keys(rest).length === 0) return undefined;
      return rest as unknown as TParams;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/hooks/floor-plan-draft-reducer.ts">
    export interface Position {
      readonly x: number;
      readonly y: number;
    }
    export type PositionMap = ReadonlyMap<string, Position>;
    export interface DraftState {
      readonly base: readonly Table[];
      readonly edits: PositionMap;
      readonly inFlight: PositionMap | null;
      /** Wrapped so a thrown `null`/`undefined` is still distinguishable from "no failure". */
      readonly saveFailure: { readonly error: unknown } | null;
    }
    export type DraftAction =
      | { readonly type: "synced"; readonly tables: readonly Table[] }
      | { readonly type: "moved"; readonly tableId: string; readonly x: number; readonly y: number }
      | { readonly type: "tableAdded"; readonly table: Table }
      | { readonly type: "tableRemoved"; readonly tableId: string }
      | { readonly type: "saveStarted" }
      | { readonly type: "saveSucceeded" }
      | { readonly type: "saveFailed"; readonly error: unknown };
    export const INITIAL_DRAFT: DraftState = {
      base: [],
      edits: new Map(),
      inFlight: null,
      saveFailure: null,
    };
    function withPosition(table: Table, pos: Position): Table {
      const existing = table.shapeMetadata ?? {
        ...SHAPE_DEFAULTS.rectangle,
        shape: "rectangle" as const,
      };
      return { ...table, shapeMetadata: { ...existing, x: pos.x, y: pos.y } };
    }
    function applyPositions(tables: readonly Table[], positions: PositionMap | null): Table[] {
      if (!positions || positions.size === 0) return [...tables];
      return tables.map((t) => {
        const pos = positions.get(t.id);
        return pos ? withPosition(t, pos) : t;
      });
    }
    export function selectTables(state: DraftState): Table[] {
      return applyPositions(applyPositions(state.base, state.inFlight), state.edits);
    }
    export function selectDirty(state: DraftState): boolean {
      return state.edits.size > 0 || state.inFlight !== null;
    }
    function without(map: PositionMap, id: string): PositionMap {
      if (!map.has(id)) return map;
      const next = new Map(map);
      next.delete(id);
      return next;
    }
    export function draftReducer(state: DraftState, action: DraftAction): DraftState {
      switch (action.type) {
        case "synced":
          // Server data replaces base only; unsaved edits and in-flight moves stay layered on top.
          return { ...state, base: action.tables };
        case "moved":
          return {
            ...state,
            edits: new Map(state.edits).set(action.tableId, { x: action.x, y: action.y }),
          };
        case "tableAdded":
          return { ...state, base: [...state.base, action.table] };
        case "tableRemoved":
          return {
            ...state,
            base: state.base.filter((t) => t.id !== action.tableId),
            edits: without(state.edits, action.tableId),
            inFlight: state.inFlight && without(state.inFlight, action.tableId),
          };
        case "saveStarted":
          if (state.inFlight !== null || state.edits.size === 0) return state;
          return { ...state, inFlight: state.edits, edits: new Map(), saveFailure: null };
        case "saveSucceeded":
          if (state.inFlight === null) return state;
          return { ...state, base: applyPositions(state.base, state.inFlight), inFlight: null };
        case "saveFailed":
          // Rollback: drop the failed moves so positions revert to base. Moves made while the
          // save was in flight are newer and stay as edits.
          return { ...state, inFlight: null, saveFailure: { error: action.error } };
      }
    }

    export type LiveToastEvent = "reservation:created" | "reservation:cancelled";
    export function liveReservationToast(
      type: LiveToastEvent,

    ): { title: string; description: string } {

          description: t("reservations.live.createdDescription", {

        description: t("reservations.live.cancelledDescription", { name }),
      };
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/use-command-palette.ts">
    interface UseCommandPaletteOptions {
      sections: readonly NavSection[];
      runAction: (action: NavAction) => void;
      toggleTheme: () => void;
    }
    interface UseCommandPaletteResult {
      readonly open: boolean;
      readonly setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
      readonly items: CommandItem[];
      readonly groups: string[];
    }
    function sectionGroupName(section: NavSection): string {
      return section.label ?? "Navigation";
    }
    function buildNavItems(
      sections: readonly NavSection[],
      runAction: (action: NavAction) => void
    ): CommandItem[] {
      return sections.flatMap((section) => {
        const group = sectionGroupName(section);
        return section.items.map((item) => ({
          id: item.id,
          label: item.label,
          group,
          onSelect: () => runAction(item.action),
        }));
      });
    }
    function buildActionItems(
      runAction: (action: NavAction) => void,
      toggleTheme: () => void
    ): CommandItem[] {
      return [
        {
          id: "action-new-reservation",
          label: "New Reservation",
          group: "Actions",
          // Carries the intent the Reservations page reads on arrival (architecture § Amendment
          // 2026-09-04) — landing on the Timeline left the operator to find the button themselves.
          onSelect: () => runAction({ type: "route", path: "/reservations?new=true" }),
        },
        {
          id: "action-walkin",
          label: "Walk-in guest",
          group: "Actions",
          onSelect: () => runAction({ type: "route", path: "/timeline?walkin=true" }),
        },
        {
          id: "action-new-floor-plan",
          label: "New Floor Plan",
          group: "Actions",
          onSelect: () => runAction({ type: "route", path: "/floor-plans" }),
        },
        {
          id: "action-toggle-theme",
          label: "Toggle Theme",
          group: "Actions",
          onSelect: toggleTheme,
        },
      ];
    }
    function buildGroups(sections: readonly NavSection[]): string[] {
      const sectionNames = sections.map(sectionGroupName);
      // "Actions" leads: on an empty query the palette opens on what a Host does, not where they go
      // (ux.md Flow 5). Section names follow, deduplicated in nav order.
      const unique = Array.from(new Set(sectionNames));
      return ["Actions", ...unique];
    }
    export function useCommandPalette({
      sections,
      runAction,
      toggleTheme,
    }: UseCommandPaletteOptions): UseCommandPaletteResult {
      const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    
      // A resize can change what the page mounts under the palette, and what mounts takes focus from
      // it, so keys typed into the palette would act there (#8029). The palette closes instead.
      const viewport = useViewport();
      const [openedAt, setOpenedAt] = useState(viewport);
      if (viewport !== openedAt) {
        setOpenedAt(viewport);
        setOpen(false);
      }
    
      const items = useMemo(
        () => [...buildNavItems(sections, runAction), ...buildActionItems(runAction, toggleTheme)],
        [sections, runAction, toggleTheme]
      );
    
      const groups = useMemo(() => buildGroups(sections), [sections]);
    
      const stableSetOpen = useCallback((next: boolean) => {
        setOpen(next);
      }, []);
    
      return { open, setOpen: stableSetOpen, items, groups };
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/use-form-state.ts">
    export interface UseFormStateResult<T extends Record<string, unknown>> {
      fields: T;
      setField: <K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]) => void;
      isPending: boolean;
      error: string | null;
      isDirty: boolean;
      handleSubmit: () => Promise<void>;
      reset: () => void;
    }
    export function useFormState<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
      initialData: T,
      onSubmit: (data: T) => Promise<void>,
      schema: ZodSchema<T>
    ): UseFormStateResult<T> {
      const [fields, setFields] = useState<T>(initialData);
      const [isPending, setIsPending] = useState(false);
      const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    
      const setField = useCallback(<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]) => {
        setFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
      }, []);
    
      const reset = useCallback(() => {
        setFields(initialData);
        setError(null);
      }, [initialData]);
    
      const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
        if (isPending) return;
        const parsed = schema.safeParse(fields);
        if (!parsed.success) {
          setError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Validation failed");
          return;
        }
    
        setIsPending(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
          await onSubmit(parsed.data);
        } catch (err) {
          // 422/409 keep the server's own detail (written for the person); everything else is a house sentence.
          setError(describeApiError(err).detail);
        } finally {
          setIsPending(false);
        }
      }, [fields, onSubmit, schema, isPending]);
    
      const isDirty = useMemo(
        () => Object.keys(initialData).some((key) => fields[key] !== initialData[key]),
        [initialData, fields]
      );
    
      return { fields, setField, isPending, error, isDirty, handleSubmit, reset };
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/use-theme.ts">
    function hasStoredThemePreference(): boolean {
      try {
        return localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) !== null;
      } catch {
        // Storage unavailable — treat as "has one" so we never overwrite silently.
        return true;
      }
    }
    export interface ThemeContextValue {
      /** The stored preference (`"system"` included). */
      readonly theme: ThemePreference;
      /** The preference resolved to light/dark; follows the OS live while `theme` is `"system"`. */
      readonly resolvedTheme: "light" | "dark";
      readonly setTheme: (theme: ThemePreference) => void;
    }
    export const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue>({
      theme: "system",
      resolvedTheme: "light",
      setTheme: () => {},
    });
    export function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {
      return useContext(ThemeContext);
    }
    export function useThemeState(): ThemeContextValue {
      const { preference, theme: resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useRialtoTheme();
    
      return useMemo(
        () => ({
          theme: preference,
          resolvedTheme,
          setTheme,
        }),
        [preference, resolvedTheme, setTheme]
      );
    }
    export function useThemeServerHydration(serverTheme: ThemePreference | undefined): void {
      const { setTheme } = useTheme();
      const hydratedRef = useRef(false);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        if (hydratedRef.current) return;
        if (hasStoredThemePreference()) {
          hydratedRef.current = true;
          return;
        }
        if (!serverTheme) return;
        hydratedRef.current = true;
        setTheme(serverTheme);
      }, [serverTheme, setTheme]);
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/use-url-params.ts">
    type SchemaOutput<S extends ZodObject<ZodRawShape>> = z.infer<S>;
    export interface UseUrlParamsResult<S extends ZodObject<ZodRawShape>> {
      params: SchemaOutput<S>;
      setParam: <K extends keyof SchemaOutput<S>>(key: K, value: SchemaOutput<S>[K]) => void;
    }
    export function useUrlParams<S extends ZodObject<ZodRawShape>>(
      schema: S,
      defaults: SchemaOutput<S>
    ): UseUrlParamsResult<S> {
      const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
    
      const params = useMemo((): SchemaOutput<S> => {
        const shape = schema.shape;
        const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    
        for (const key of Object.keys(shape)) {
          const rawValue = searchParams.get(key);
          if (rawValue === null) {
            result[key] = defaults[key];
            continue;
          }
          const fieldSchema = shape[key] as ZodType;
          const parsed = fieldSchema.safeParse(rawValue);
          result[key] = parsed.success ? parsed.data : defaults[key];
        }
    
        return result as SchemaOutput<S>;
      }, [searchParams, schema, defaults]);
    
      const setParam = <K extends keyof SchemaOutput<S>>(key: K, value: SchemaOutput<S>[K]): void => {
        setSearchParams((prev) => {
          const next = new URLSearchParams(prev);
          next.set(key as string, String(value));
          return next;
        });
      };
    
      return { params, setParam };
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/useApiClient.ts">
    export function useApiClient() {
      const { accessToken, signInSilent } = useAuth();
    
      return useMemo(
        () =>
          createApiClient({
            baseUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? "",
            getAccessToken: () => accessToken,
            // A 401 mid-session (expired token, #8258) refreshes once via a silent
            // sign-in, which always fetches a new token. A failed refresh resolves
            // null, and react-oidc-context records it as a silent error that
            // DashboardLayout's "sign in again" banner already surfaces.
            refreshAccessToken: async () => (await signInSilent())?.access_token ?? null,
            onError: reportApiError,
          }),
        [accessToken, signInSilent]
      );
    }
