    export interface TodayLineState {
      readonly status: "loading" | "error" | "ready";
      /** `null` until `status` is `ready`. */
      readonly model: TodayLineModel | null;
      readonly retry: () => void;
    }
    export function useTodayLine(
      venueId: string | null | undefined,
      bannerShowsOnline: boolean
    ): TodayLineState {
      const { serviceDate, config, rules, summary, readStatus, refetch } = useStaffTonight(venueId);
      const sections = useVenueFloorPlanSections({ venueId: venueId ?? null });
      const now = useNow();
      const model = useMemo(() => {
        if (!summary || !serviceDate) return null;
        return todayLine({
          serviceDate,
          summary,
          rules,
          now,
          serviceNames: new Map((config?.venueServices ?? []).map((v) => [v.id, v.name])),
          sectionNames: new Map((sections.data ?? []).map((s) => [s.id, s.name])),
          bannerShowsOnline,
        });
      }, [serviceDate, summary, rules, now, config, sections.data, bannerShowsOnline]);
      return {
        status: model ? "ready" : readStatus === "error" ? "error" : "loading",
        model,
        retry: refetch,
      };
    }

    export interface VenueFormatSource {
      readonly ianaTimezone: string;
      readonly currencyCode: string;
    }
    export interface VenueFormat {
      readonly locale: string;
      readonly timeZone: string;
      readonly currency: string;
      /** Venue-clock time from an ISO instant. */
      formatTime(isoString: string): string;
      /** Cents in the venue's currency. */
      formatMoney(amountCents: number): string;
      formatLongDate(dateStr: string): string;
      formatLongDateWithYear(dateStr: string): string;
      formatServiceDate(dateStr: string): string;
      formatShortDate(dateStr: string): string;
      /** Any instant with caller-chosen `Intl` fields, on the venue clock. */
      formatInstant(value: string | number | Date, options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string;
      /** A calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) with caller-chosen fields, never zone-shifted. */
      formatCalendarDate(dateStr: string, options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string;
      /** Venue-local "HH:MM" wall-clock string (an opening hour, not an instant). */
      formatLocalTime(hhmm: string): string;
    }
    export function useVenueFormat(venue?: VenueFormatSource | null): VenueFormat {
      const { i18n } = useTranslation();
      const selected = useOptionalVenue()?.selectedVenue;
      const locale = i18n.language;
      const { ianaTimezone: timeZone, currencyCode: currency } = venue ?? selected ?? NO_VENUE;
    
      return useMemo(
        () => ({
          locale,
          timeZone,
          currency,
          formatTime: (iso) => formatTimeIn(iso, timeZone, locale),
          formatMoney: (cents) => formatCurrencyFromCents(cents, currency, locale),
          formatLongDate: (d) => formatLongDate(d, locale),
          formatLongDateWithYear: (d) => formatLongDateWithYear(d, locale),
          formatServiceDate: (d) => formatServiceDate(d, locale),
          formatShortDate: (d) => formatShortDate(d, locale),
          formatInstant: (value, options) => formatInstant(value, options, locale, timeZone),
          formatCalendarDate: (dateStr, options) => formatCalendarDate(dateStr, options, locale),
          formatLocalTime: (hhmm) => formatLocalTime(hhmm, locale),
        }),
        [locale, timeZone, currency]
      );
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/useVenuePolicy.ts">
    export function useVenuePolicy(slug: string | undefined): {
      policy: CancellationPolicy | null;
      isLoading: boolean;
    } {
      const api = useApiClient();
    
      const query = useQuery({
        queryKey: [VENUE_POLICY_QUERY_KEY, slug],
        queryFn: async (): Promise<CancellationPolicy | null> => {
          if (!slug) return null;
          try {
            const { deposit } = await api.venues.getPublicConfig(slug);
            if (!deposit.enabled || deposit.amountCents == null) return null;
            return {
              depositAmountCents: deposit.amountCents,
              freeCancellationHours: deposit.freeCancellationHours,
              lateCancellationFeePercent: deposit.lateCancellationFeePercent,
              noShowFeePercent: deposit.noShowFeePercent,
            };
          } catch {
            return null;
          }
        },
        enabled: !!slug,
        staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes — policy rarely changes during a shift
      });
    
      return {
        policy: query.data ?? null,
        isLoading: query.isLoading,
      };
    }

  <file path="src/hooks/useVenueReadiness.ts">
    export type SetupStep = "onboarding" | "operating-hours" | "floor-plan";
    export interface VenueReadiness {
      status: "loading" | "no-venue" | "setup" | "operational";
      completedSteps: readonly SetupStep[];
      nextStep: SetupStep | null;
      progress: number; // 0–100
    }
    export function computeReadiness(
      venue: Venue | null,
      floorPlans: readonly FloorPlan[],
      isError = false
    ): VenueReadiness {
      if (!venue) {
        return { status: "no-venue", completedSteps: [], nextStep: null, progress: 0 };
      }
    
      if (isError) {
        return LOADING;
      }
    
      const completed: SetupStep[] = [];
    
      // Gate 1: Onboarding — venue exists with name, timezone, currency
      if (venue.name && venue.ianaTimezone && venue.currencyCode) {
        completed.push("onboarding");
      }
    
      // Gate 2: Operating hours — at least one day that's not closed
      if (venue.operatingHours) {
        const days = Object.values(venue.operatingHours);
        const hasOpenDay = days.some((day) => day !== undefined && day.closed !== true);
        if (hasOpenDay) {
          completed.push("operating-hours");
        }
      }
    
      // Gate 3: Floor plan with at least one table
      const hasFloorPlanWithTables = floorPlans.some((fp) => fp.tables && fp.tables.length > 0);
      if (hasFloorPlanWithTables) {
        completed.push("floor-plan");
      }
    
      const progress = (completed.length / STEP_ORDER.length) * 100;
    
      if (completed.length === STEP_ORDER.length) {
        return { status: "operational", completedSteps: completed, nextStep: null, progress };
      }
    
      const nextStep = STEP_ORDER.find((step) => !completed.includes(step)) ?? null;
      return { status: "setup", completedSteps: completed, nextStep, progress };
    }
    export function useVenueReadiness(): VenueReadiness {
      const { selectedVenue, selectedVenueId, isLoading } = useVenue();
      const { accessToken } = useAuth();
      const enabled = !!selectedVenueId && !!accessToken;
    
      // Compose the shared react-query floor-plans hook instead of a bespoke effect.
      // The query is keyed by venueId, so switching venues fetches fresh data and
      // in-flight requests for stale venues are ignored by react-query.
      const { data: floorPlans, error } = useFloorPlans({
        venueId: selectedVenueId,
        limit: 10,
        enabled,
      });
    
      const isError = error !== null;
    
      const readiness = useMemo(
        () => computeReadiness(selectedVenue, floorPlans ?? [], isError),
        [selectedVenue, floorPlans, isError]
      );
    
      if (isLoading) {
        return LOADING;
      }
    
      // Venue is resolved, but its floor plans are still loading (and haven't
      // errored) — we cannot yet distinguish "setup" from "operational", so stay in
      // the indeterminate loading state instead of flapping to "setup" and
      // triggering a spurious /setup -> /timeline redirect. (See #1968 cluster A.)
      const awaitingFloorPlans = enabled && floorPlans === undefined && !isError;
      if (awaitingFloorPlans) {
        return LOADING;
      }
    
      return readiness;
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/hooks/useViewport.ts">
    export type Viewport = "phone" | "tablet" | "desktop";
    function readViewport(): Viewport {
      if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") return "desktop";
      if (window.matchMedia(PHONE_QUERY).matches) return "phone";
      if (window.matchMedia(TABLET_QUERY).matches) return "tablet";
      return "desktop";
    }
    export function useViewport(): Viewport {
      const [viewport, setViewport] = useState<Viewport>(readViewport);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") return;
        const lists = [window.matchMedia(PHONE_QUERY), window.matchMedia(TABLET_QUERY)];
        const handleChange = () => setViewport(readViewport());
        for (const list of lists) list.addEventListener("change", handleChange);
        return () => {
          for (const list of lists) list.removeEventListener("change", handleChange);
        };
      }, []);
    
      return viewport;
    }
  </file>

    export const WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY = "waitlist" as const;
    export interface UseWaitlistParams {

    }
    export const useWaitlist = createQueryHook<WaitlistEntry[], UseWaitlistParams>({
      key: WAITLIST_QUERY_KEY,
      fetcher: async (params, api) => {

    });

  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/date-answer.ts">
    export type DateAnswerRule =
      | {
          readonly kind: "regular" | "seasonal";
          readonly scheduleId: string;
          /** The schedule's name as stored. */
          readonly name: string;
        }
      | {
          readonly kind: "useHours" | "special" | "closure" | "tonight";
          /** The date rule's id. */
          readonly ruleId: string;
        };
    export type DateAnswerHubRow = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
    export interface DateAnswerBand {
      readonly from: number;
      readonly to: number;
    }
    export interface DateAnswer {
      readonly date: string;
      /** The services that run, in opening order; empty means closed. */
      readonly services: readonly {
        readonly name: string;
        readonly opensAt: number;
        readonly closesAt: number;
        /**
         * The parts of its hours a closure of this service alone takes, in order; absent when there
         * are none. The venue-wide bands are not repeated here.
         */
        readonly closed?: readonly DateAnswerBand[];
      }[];
      /**
       * The band the whole venue is closed for, in service-day minutes: the one the deciding rule is
       * part of, else the earliest. Closures that overlap or meet are one band.
       */
      readonly closedBand: DateAnswerBand | null;
      /** Every other venue-wide band on the date, in order; absent when there are none. */
      readonly otherClosedBands?: readonly DateAnswerBand[];
      /** `null` when no rule covers the date. */
      readonly deciding: DateAnswerRule | null;
      readonly beneath: DateAnswerRule | null;
      readonly hubRow: DateAnswerHubRow | null;
    }
    function isRealDate(value: string): boolean {
      if (!CIVIL_DATE.test(value)) return false;
      const parsed = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
      return !Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) && parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value;
    }
    function setsHours(layer: Layer): boolean {
      return (
        layer.kind === "schedule" || layer.kind === "use_schedule" || layer.kind === "special_hours"
      );
    }
    function scheduleIdOf(config: AvailabilityConfig, layer: Layer): string | undefined {
      return config.assignments.find((a) => a.id === layer.id)?.scheduleId;
    }
    function ruleOf(config: AvailabilityConfig, layer: Layer): DateAnswerRule | null {
      switch (layer.kind) {
        case "schedule": {
          const scheduleId = scheduleIdOf(config, layer);
          // A schedule layer's id is always one of the config's assignments.
          if (scheduleId === undefined) return null;
          return {
            kind: layer.regularWeek ? "regular" : "seasonal",
            scheduleId,
            name: layer.scheduleName ?? layer.label,
          };
        }
        case "use_schedule":
          return { kind: "useHours", ruleId: layer.id };
        case "special_hours":
          return { kind: "special", ruleId: layer.id };
        case "closure":
          return { kind: "closure", ruleId: layer.id };
        case "tonight":
          return { kind: "tonight", ruleId: layer.id };
        case "skip":
          return null;
      }
    }
    function scheduleBeneath(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      date: string,
      layer: Layer
    ): DateAnswerRule | null {
      const scheduleId = scheduleIdOf(config, layer);
      const without = {
        ...config,
        assignments: config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId !== scheduleId),
      };
      const lower = resolveDay({ timezone, config: without }, date).explanation.find(
        (l) => l.kind === "schedule"
      );
      return lower ? ruleOf(without, lower) : null;
    }
    function venueBandsOf(day: ResolvedDaySummary): ResolvedClosure[] {
      return day.closures.filter((c) => c.targetKind === "venue");
    }
    interface Span {
      readonly from: number;
      readonly to: number;
    }
    function mergedSpans(spans: readonly Span[]): Span[] {
      return spans
        .map(({ from, to }) => ({ from, to }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from)
        .reduce<Span[]>((merged, span) => {
          const last = merged.at(-1);
          return last && span.from <= last.to
            ? [...merged.slice(0, -1), { from: last.from, to: Math.max(last.to, span.to) }]
            : [...merged, span];
        }, []);
    }
    function closedSpansOf(day: ResolvedDaySummary): Span[] {
      return mergedSpans(venueBandsOf(day));
    }
    function openSpans(open: Span, closed: readonly Span[]): Span[] {
      return closed.reduce<Span[]>(
        (left, band) =>
          left.flatMap((span) =>
            [
              { from: span.from, to: Math.min(span.to, band.from) },
              { from: Math.max(span.from, band.to), to: span.to },
            ].filter((piece) => piece.from < piece.to)
          ),
        open.from < open.to ? [open] : []
      );
    }
    interface ServiceReport {
      readonly name: string;
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
      /** The minutes it is open, outside every band that closes it. */
      readonly open: readonly Span[];
      /** The minutes of its hours closed for this service alone, outside the venue-wide bands. */
      readonly closed: readonly Span[];
    }
    function serviceReports(day: ResolvedDaySummary): ServiceReport[] {
      const venue = closedSpansOf(day);
      return day.services.map((service) => {
        const { name, opensAt, closesAt } = service;
        const own = mergedSpans(
          day.closures.filter(
            (c) => c.targetKind === "service" && c.venueServiceId === service.venueServiceId
          )
        );
        return {
          name,
          opensAt,
          closesAt,
          open: openSpans({ from: opensAt, to: closesAt }, mergedSpans([...venue, ...own])),
          closed: own.flatMap((band) =>
            openSpans({ from: Math.max(band.from, opensAt), to: Math.min(band.to, closesAt) }, venue)
          ),
        };
      });
    }
    function reportKey(day: ResolvedDaySummary): string {
      const services = serviceReports(day)
        .map((s) => [s.name, s.open] as const)
        .filter(([, open]) => open.length > 0);
      return JSON.stringify([closedSpansOf(day), services]);
    }
    function servicesOf(day: ResolvedDaySummary): DateAnswer["services"] {
      return serviceReports(day)
        .filter((s) => s.closed.length === 0 || s.open.length > 0)
        .map(({ name, opensAt, closesAt, closed }) => ({
          name,
          opensAt,
          closesAt,
          ...(closed.length > 0 ? { closed } : {}),
        }));
    }
    function decidingOverlays(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      day: ResolvedDay,
      overlays: readonly Layer[]
    ): Layer[] {
      return overlays.reduce(
        (state, layer) => {
          const without = {
            ...state.config,
            dateRules: state.config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.id !== layer.id),
          };
          const key = reportKey(resolveDay({ timezone, config: without }, day.serviceDate));
          return {
            config: without,
            key,
            found: key === state.key ? state.found : [...state.found, layer],
          };
        },
        { config, key: reportKey(day), found: [] as Layer[] }
      ).found;
    }
    function closedBandsOf(day: ResolvedDay, top: Layer | undefined): Span[] {
      const spans = closedSpansOf(day);
      const own = venueBandsOf(day).find((c) => c.ruleId === top?.id);
      const first = (own && spans.find((s) => s.from <= own.from && own.to <= s.to)) ?? spans[0];
      return first ? [first, ...spans.filter((s) => s !== first)] : [];
    }
    export function dateAnswer(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      date: string
    ): DateAnswer | null {
      if (!isRealDate(date)) return null;
      const day = resolveDay({ timezone, config }, date);
      // Top first. A skip is never named: the engine has already removed the rule it skips.
      const layers = day.explanation.filter((l) => l.kind !== "skip").reverse();
      const overlays = layers.filter((l) => !setsHours(l));
      // The rules that could be named, top first: the hours layers always can.
      const candidates = [
        ...decidingOverlays(config, timezone, day, overlays),
        ...layers.filter(setsHours),
      ];
      const top = candidates.at(0);
      const deciding = top ? ruleOf(config, top) : null;
      const lower = top ? candidates.slice(1).find((l) => l.kind !== top.kind) : undefined;
      const beneath =
        top?.kind === "schedule"
          ? scheduleBeneath(config, timezone, date, top)
          : lower
            ? ruleOf(config, lower)
            : null;
      const [closedBand, ...otherClosedBands] = closedBandsOf(day, top);
      return {
        date,
        services: servicesOf(day),
        closedBand: closedBand ?? null,
        ...(otherClosedBands.length > 0 ? { otherClosedBands } : {}),
        deciding,
        beneath,
        hubRow: deciding ? HUB_ROW[deciding.kind] : null,
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/date-sentence.ts">
    function sentenceDate(date: string, { format }: HubTextContext): string {
      return format.formatCalendarDate(date, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
    }
    function ruleText(rule: DateAnswerRule, { t }: HubTextContext): string {
      switch (rule.kind) {
        case "regular":
          return t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.rule.regular");
        case "seasonal":
          return scheduleNameText(rule.name, t);
        // "Same as another day" is a choice made on a special date.
        case "useHours":
        case "special":
          return t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.rule.special");
        case "closure":
          return t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.rule.closure");
        case "tonight":
          return t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.rule.tonight");
      }
    }
    type Service = DateAnswer["services"][number];
    function serviceClosedTexts(service: Service, { t, format }: HubTextContext): string[] {
      const time = (minute: number) => minuteText(minute, t, format);
      return (service.closed ?? []).map((band) =>
        band.to >= service.closesAt
          ? t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.serviceClosedFrom", {
              name: service.name,
              time: time(band.from),
            })
          : t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.serviceClosedBetween", {
              name: service.name,
              from: time(band.from),
              to: time(band.to),
            })
      );
    }
    function whatHappens(answer: DateAnswer, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      const { services } = answer;
      const bands = [
        ...(answer.closedBand ? [answer.closedBand] : []),
        ...(answer.otherClosedBands ?? []),
      ];
      const closed = t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.closed");
      if (services.length === 0) return closed;
      const opens = Math.min(...services.map((s) => s.opensAt));
      const closes = Math.max(...services.map((s) => s.closesAt));
      if (bands.some((band) => band.from <= opens && band.to >= closes)) return closed;
      const time = (minute: number) => minuteText(minute, t, format);
      const hours = services.map((s) =>
        t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.service", {
          name: s.name,
          hours: t("availability.serviceHours.range", {
            open: time(s.opensAt),
            close: time(s.closesAt),
          }),
        })
      );
      const venueClosed = bands
        // A band outside the open hours changes nothing a guest can book, so it is not said.
        .filter((band) => band.from < closes && band.to > opens)
        .sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from)
        .map((band) =>
          band.to >= closes
            ? t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.closedFrom", { time: time(band.from) })
            : t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.closedBetween", {
                from: time(band.from),
                to: time(band.to),
              })
        );
      return new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "unit" }).format([
        ...hours,
        ...services.flatMap((s) => serviceClosedTexts(s, ctx)),
        ...venueClosed,
      ]);
    }
    export function dateSentence(answer: DateAnswer, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const { t } = ctx;
      const date = sentenceDate(answer.date, ctx);
      if (answer.deciding === null) return t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.uncovered", { date });
      // The sentence puts its own period after what happens, so a time such as "10:00 p.m." gives up its own.
      const what = whatHappens(answer, ctx).replace(/\.$/, "");
      const values = { date, what, rule: ruleText(answer.deciding, ctx) };
      return answer.beneath
        ? t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.sentenceOver", {
            ...values,
            beneath: ruleText(answer.beneath, ctx),
          })
        : t("availabilityHub.dateCheck.sentence", values);
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/hub-actions.ts">
    export interface HubAction {
      readonly kind: "edit" | "add" | "view";
      readonly to: string;
    }
    export function hubActions(
      rows: HubRowModels,
      isManager: boolean
    ): readonly [HubAction | null, HubAction | null, HubAction, HubAction, HubAction | null] {
      const view = (to: string): HubAction => ({ kind: "view", to });
      const edit = (to: string): HubAction | null => (isManager ? { kind: "edit", to } : null);
      const specialDates = availabilityPath({ view: "specialDates" });
      const seasonal: HubAction | null = !isManager
        ? null
        : rows[1].sets.length === 0
          ? { kind: "add", to: availabilityPath({ view: "seasonal", screen: "new" }) }
          : { kind: "edit", to: availabilityPath({ view: "seasonal" }) };
      return [
        edit(availabilityPath({ view: "hours" })),
        seasonal,
        edit(specialDates) ?? view(specialDates),
        view(availabilityPath({ view: "closures" })),
        edit(availabilityPath({ view: "bookingRules" })),
      ];
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/hub-closures-text.ts">
    function pauseText(pause: HubOnlinePause, today: string, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      if (!pause.inForce && pause.fromMinute !== null) {
        return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.pauseWaiting", {
          time: minuteText(pause.fromMinute, t, format),
        });
      }
      // A pause for part of the day is over at its own time, whatever date it runs to.
      if (pause.untilMinute !== null) {
        return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.pauseUntilTime", {
          time: minuteText(pause.untilMinute, t, format),
        });
      }
      if (pause.endsOn === null) return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.pauseUntilResumed");
      return pause.endsOn === today
        ? t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.pauseTonight")
        : t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.pauseUntil", { date: shortDate(pause.endsOn, ctx) });
    }
    function tonightText(change: HubTonightChange, { t, format }: HubTextContext): string {
      if (change.closeAt !== null) {
        return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.closingEarly", {
          time: minuteText(change.closeAt, t, format),
        });
      }
      // A change is a close-early or a stop, so a stop always has its window.
      const { from, to } = change.window ?? { from: 0, to: END_OF_SERVICE_DAY };
      return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.stopTonight", {
        from: minuteText(from, t, format),
        to: closureEndText(to, t, format),
      });
    }
    function whatText(target: HubClosureTarget, { t, format }: HubTextContext): string {
      switch (target.kind) {
        case "venue":
          return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.venue");
        case "service":
          return target.name === null
            ? t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.service")
            : t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.named", { name: target.name });
        case "section":
          return target.name === null
            ? t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.section")
            : t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.named", { name: target.name });
        case "tables":
          return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.tables", { count: target.count });
        case "booking": {
          if (target.channels.length === 0) return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.bookingAll");
          const channels = new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(
            target.channels.map((channel) => t(`setup.hub.channelLabel.${channel}`))
          );
          return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.what.booking", { channels });
        }
      }
    }
    interface Reading {
      readonly inForce: boolean;
      readonly today: string;
    }
    function whenText(closure: HubClosure, reading: Reading, ctx: HubTextContext): string | null {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      if (closure.weekdays !== null) {
        const days = weekdaySummary(closure.weekdays, format, t);
        return closure.endsOn === null
          ? t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.when.repeatingOpen", { days })
          : t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.when.repeating", {
              days,
              date: shortDate(closure.endsOn, ctx),
            });
      }
      if (closure.endsOn === null) return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.when.untilReopened");
      if (closure.endsOn === closure.startsOn) {
        if (!reading.inForce) return null;
        if (!sinceLastNight(closure, reading)) return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.when.today");
        return closure.window === null ? t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.sinceYesterday") : null;
      }
      return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.when.until", { date: shortDate(closure.endsOn, ctx) });
    }
    function windowText(closure: HubClosure, reading: Reading, ctx: HubTextContext): string | null {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      const { window } = closure;
      if (window === null) return null;
      if (sinceLastNight(closure, reading)) {
        return t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.sinceLastNight", {
          time: minuteText(window.from, t, format),
        });
      }
      return window.to >= END_OF_SERVICE_DAY
        ? t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.windowFrom", { time: minuteText(window.from, t, format) })
        : t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.windowBetween", {
            from: minuteText(window.from, t, format),
            to: minuteText(window.to, t, format),
          });
    }
    function detailText(closure: HubClosure, reading: Reading, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      return [whenText(closure, reading, ctx), windowText(closure, reading, ctx)]
        .filter((part): part is string => part !== null)
        .join(", ");
    }
    function nowText(closure: HubClosure, today: string, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const what = whatText(closure.target, ctx);
      const detail = detailText(closure, { inForce: true, today }, ctx);
      return detail ? ctx.t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.now", { what, detail }) : what;
    }
    function nextText(closure: HubClosure, today: string, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const values = { date: shortDate(closure.nextOn, ctx), what: whatText(closure.target, ctx) };
      const detail = detailText(closure, { inForce: false, today }, ctx);
      return detail
        ? ctx.t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.nextDetail", { ...values, detail })
        : ctx.t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.next", values);
    }
    export interface ClosuresLine {
      readonly text: string;
      readonly ruleId?: string;
    }
    export function closuresLines(
      row: ClosuresRow,
      today: string,
      ctx: HubTextContext
    ): ClosuresLine[] {
      const { pause, next } = row;
      const lines = [
        ...(pause ? [{ ruleId: pause.ruleId, text: pauseText(pause, today, ctx) }] : []),
        ...row.tonight.map((change) => ({ ruleId: change.ruleId, text: tonightText(change, ctx) })),
        ...row.now.map((closure) => ({ ruleId: closure.ruleId, text: nowText(closure, today, ctx) })),
        ...(next ? [{ ruleId: next.ruleId, text: nextText(next, today, ctx) }] : []),
      ];
      return lines.length > 0 ? lines : [{ text: ctx.t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.empty") }];
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/hub-closures.ts">
    type BookingChannel = NonNullable<DateRule["bookingTypes"]>[number];
    export type HubClosureTarget =
      | { readonly kind: "venue" }
      | { readonly kind: "service"; readonly venueServiceId: string; readonly name: string | null }
      | { readonly kind: "section"; readonly sectionId: string; readonly name: string | null }
      | { readonly kind: "tables"; readonly count: number }
      | { readonly kind: "booking"; readonly channels: readonly BookingChannel[] };
    export interface HubClosure {
      readonly ruleId: string;
      readonly target: HubClosureTarget;
      /**
       * In `now`, the service date it is in force on: today, or yesterday while that service runs past
       * midnight. In `next`, the first date it closes: a skipped or replaced date is passed over.
       */
      readonly nextOn: string;
      readonly startsOn: string;
      /** `null` for a closure that lasts until it is reopened. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      /** The weekdays a repeating closure covers (0 = Sunday); `null` when it does not repeat. */
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[] | null;
      /** The part of each day it closes, in service-day minutes; `null` for the whole day. */
      readonly window: { readonly from: number; readonly to: number } | null;
    }
    export interface HubOnlinePause {
      readonly ruleId: string;
      /** The kind of rule it is, which decides where it is removed. */
      readonly source: "closure" | "tonight";
      /** `false` while it waits for `fromMinute`. */
      readonly inForce: boolean;
      /** The minute of each day it starts at; `null` when it covers the whole day. */
      readonly fromMinute: number | null;
      /** The minute of the day it ends at; `null` when it runs to the end of the service day. */
      readonly untilMinute: number | null;
      /** Its last date; `null` for a pause that lasts until it is resumed. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
    }
    export interface HubTonightChange {
      readonly ruleId: string;
      /** The minute tonight closes at; `null` for a stop. */
      readonly closeAt: number | null;
      /** The minutes a stop covers; `null` for a close-early. */
      readonly window: { readonly from: number; readonly to: number } | null;
    }
    export interface ClosuresRow {
      readonly row: 4;
      /** The pause in force, else the soonest waiting. Any other pause is among the closures. */
      readonly pause: HubOnlinePause | null;
      readonly tonight: readonly HubTonightChange[];
      /** The closures in force at this minute, soonest started first. */
      readonly now: readonly HubClosure[];
      /** The closure that starts soonest among those not in force. */
      readonly next: HubClosure | null;
    }
    export interface ClosuresRowInput {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      /** Section id to name; empty while sections load. */
      readonly sectionNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
      readonly timezone: string;
      readonly today: string;
      readonly nowMinute: number;
    }
    export type ClosureRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "closure" }>;
    export interface Clock extends ClosuresRowInput {
      readonly rules: readonly DateRule[];
      readonly yesterday: string;
      /** This minute on yesterday's service day, while that service still runs; else `null`. */
      readonly lateMinute: number | null;
    }
    export function clockOf(input: ClosuresRowInput): Clock {
      const { config, timezone, today, nowMinute } = input;
      const yesterday = addDays(today, -1);
      const lastClose = Math.max(
        0,
        ...resolveDay({ timezone, config }, yesterday).services.map((s) => s.closesAt)
      );
      const late = nowMinute + MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      return {
        ...input,
        rules: config.dateRules,
        yesterday,
        lateMinute: late < lastClose ? late : null,
      };
    }
    export const isClosure = (rule: DateRule): rule is ClosureRule => rule.kind === "closure";
    export function isOnlinePause(rule: DateRule): rule is ClosureRule {
      const channels = rule.bookingTypes ?? [];
      return (
        isClosure(rule) &&
        rule.targetKind === "booking" &&
        channels.length === 1 &&
        channels[0] === "online" &&
        rule.repeat == null
      );
    }
    function closurePauses(clock: Clock): HubOnlinePause[] {
      const { config, rules, timezone, today, nowMinute } = clock;
      return rules
        .filter(isOnlinePause)
        .filter((r) => coversOn(r, rules, today))
        .filter((r) => r.window == null || nowMinute < r.window.to)
        .map((r): HubOnlinePause => ({
          ruleId: r.id,
          source: "closure",
          inForce: isPauseInForce(r, config, timezone, today, nowMinute),
          fromMinute: r.window?.from ?? null,
          untilMinute: endMinute(r.window?.to),
          endsOn: r.endsOn ?? null,
        }))
        .sort(soonestFirst);
    }
    function tonightMinute(rule: DateRule, clock: Clock): number | null {
      if (rule.startsOn === clock.today) return clock.nowMinute;
      return rule.startsOn === clock.yesterday ? clock.lateMinute : null;
    }
    function tonightPauses(clock: Clock): HubOnlinePause[] {
      const { rules, today } = clock;
      return rules
        .flatMap((rule) => {
          const minute = rule.kind === "tonight" ? tonightMinute(rule, clock) : null;
          if (rule.kind !== "tonight" || minute === null) return [];
          if (rule.targetKind !== "booking" || !(rule.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("online")) return [];
          if (!("stop" in rule.payload)) return [];
          const { from, to } = rule.payload.stop;
          if (to <= minute) return [];
          const pause: HubOnlinePause = {
            ruleId: rule.id,
            source: "tonight",
            inForce: from <= minute,
            fromMinute: from,
            untilMinute: endMinute(to),
            // One still running from last night ends with the night in progress, which reads "tonight".
            endsOn: today,
          };
          return [{ pause, lastNight: rule.startsOn !== today }];
        })
        .sort(
          // Today's own stop is named before one still running from last night.
          (a, b) => Number(a.lastNight) - Number(b.lastNight) || soonestFirst(a.pause, b.pause)
        )
        .map(({ pause }) => pause);
    }
    export function onlinePause(clock: Clock): HubOnlinePause | null {
      const pauses = [...closurePauses(clock), ...tonightPauses(clock)];
      return pauses.find((p) => p.inForce) ?? [...pauses].sort(soonestFirst)[0] ?? null;
    }
    function tonightChanges(clock: Clock): HubTonightChange[] {
      return clock.rules.flatMap((rule): HubTonightChange[] => {
        const minute = rule.kind === "tonight" ? tonightMinute(rule, clock) : null;
        if (rule.kind !== "tonight" || minute === null) return [];
        const lastNight = rule.startsOn !== clock.today;
        const { payload } = rule;
        if ("closeAt" in payload) {
          const over = lastNight && payload.closeAt <= minute;
          return over ? [] : [{ ruleId: rule.id, closeAt: payload.closeAt, window: null }];
        }
        if (!("stop" in payload) || rule.targetKind === "booking" || rule.targetKind === "tables") {
          return [];
        }
        if (lastNight && payload.stop.to <= minute) return [];
        return [
          { ruleId: rule.id, closeAt: null, window: { from: payload.stop.from, to: payload.stop.to } },
        ];
      });
    }
    export function inForceOn(rule: ClosureRule, clock: Clock): string | null {
      const { rules, today, yesterday, nowMinute, lateMinute } = clock;
      const from = rule.window?.from ?? 0;
      const to = rule.window?.to ?? END_OF_SERVICE_DAY;
      if (coversOn(rule, rules, today) && from <= nowMinute && nowMinute < to) return today;
      const runsLate =
        lateMinute !== null &&
        coversOn(rule, rules, yesterday) &&
        from <= lateMinute &&
        lateMinute < to;
      return runsLate ? yesterday : null;
    }
    export function waitingOn(rule: ClosureRule, clock: Clock): string | null {
      const { rules, today, nowMinute } = clock;
      const first = nextDateOn(rule, rules, today);
      const passedToday = first === today && rule.window != null && rule.window.to <= nowMinute;
      return passedToday ? nextDateOn(rule, rules, addDays(today, 1)) : first;
    }
    export function targetOf(rule: ClosureRule, clock: Clock): HubClosureTarget {
      if (rule.targetKind === "service" && rule.venueServiceId) {
        const { venueServiceId } = rule;
        const service = clock.config.venueServices.find((s) => s.id === venueServiceId);
        return { kind: "service", venueServiceId, name: service?.name ?? null };
      }
      if (rule.targetKind === "booking") return { kind: "booking", channels: rule.bookingTypes ?? [] };
      if (rule.targetKind === "tables") {
        return rule.sectionId
          ? {
              kind: "section",
              sectionId: rule.sectionId,
              name: clock.sectionNames.get(rule.sectionId) ?? null,
            }
          : { kind: "tables", count: rule.tableIds?.length ?? 0 };
      }
      return { kind: "venue" };
    }
    function closureOf(rule: ClosureRule, nextOn: string, clock: Clock): HubClosure {
      return {
        ruleId: rule.id,
        target: targetOf(rule, clock),
        nextOn,
        startsOn: rule.startsOn,
        endsOn: rule.endsOn ?? null,
        weekdays: rule.repeat?.weekdays ?? null,
        window: rule.window ? { from: rule.window.from, to: rule.window.to } : null,
      };
    }
    export function closuresRow(input: ClosuresRowInput): ClosuresRow {
      const clock = clockOf(input);
      const pause = onlinePause(clock);
      // From yesterday on, so a closure that ended yesterday can still be running past midnight.
      const closures = upcomingRules(clock.rules, clock.yesterday)
        .filter(isClosure)
        .filter((rule) => rule.id !== pause?.ruleId)
        .map((rule) => ({ rule, inForce: inForceOn(rule, clock) }));
      const waiting = closures
        .flatMap(({ rule, inForce }) => {
          const on = inForce === null ? waitingOn(rule, clock) : null;
          return on === null ? [] : [closureOf(rule, on, clock)];
        })
        .sort(
          (a, b) => a.nextOn.localeCompare(b.nextOn) || (a.window?.from ?? 0) - (b.window?.from ?? 0)
        );
      return {
        row: 4,
        pause,
        tonight: tonightChanges(clock),
        now: closures.flatMap(({ rule, inForce }) =>
          inForce === null ? [] : [closureOf(rule, inForce, clock)]
        ),
        next: waiting[0] ?? null,
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/hub-row-text.ts">
    export interface HubLine {
      readonly text: string;
      /** Row 1 only: the service this line is about, so a Manager's line can open it. */
      readonly venueServiceId?: string;
      /** Row 4 only: the rule this line reads, which tells apart two lines that read the same. */
      readonly ruleId?: string;
    }
    export interface HubRowText {
      readonly row: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;
      readonly title: string;
      /** Never empty. */
      readonly lines: readonly HubLine[];
    }
    function serviceText(service: RegularWeekLineService, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      const days = (weekdays: readonly number[]) => weekdaySummary(weekdays, format, t);
      const base = {
        name: service.name,
        hours: serviceHoursText(service, ctx),
        days: days(service.days),
      };
      if (service.changes.length === 0) return t("availability.regularWeekLine.service", base);
      const changes = service.changes
        .map((change) =>
          // Same opening: only the close or last seating moved, so say only that.
          change.opensAt === service.opensAt
            ? serviceCloseChangeText(days(change.weekdays), change, ctx)
            : t("availability.regularWeekLine.different", {
                days: days(change.weekdays),
                hours: serviceHoursText(change, ctx),
              })
        )
        .join(", ");
      return t("availability.regularWeekLine.serviceWith", { ...base, changes });
    }
    function regularHoursLines(row: RegularHoursRow, ctx: HubTextContext): HubLine[] {
      const { t } = ctx;
      if (row.services.length === 0) return [line(t("availabilityHub.hub.regular.empty"))];
      const services = row.services.map((service) => ({
        text: serviceText(service, ctx),
        venueServiceId: service.venueServiceId,
      }));
      const { upcoming } = row;
      const later = upcoming?.services.map((service) => serviceText(service, ctx)).join(" · ");
      const now = services.map((service) => service.text).join(" · ");
      // A change saved for a later date reads here before it takes over, unless it reads the same.
      if (!upcoming || !later || later === now) return services;
      return [
        ...services,
        line(
          upcoming.endsOn
            ? t("availability.regularWeekLine.upcomingPeriod", {
                from: shortDate(upcoming.startsOn, ctx),
                to: shortDate(upcoming.endsOn, ctx),
                services: later,
              })
            : t("availability.regularWeekLine.upcoming", {
                date: shortDate(upcoming.startsOn, ctx),
                services: later,
              })
        ),
      ];
    }
    function usageText(usage: ScheduleUsage, ctx: HubTextContext): string {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      if (usage.kind === "unused") return t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.unused");
      if (usage.kind === "rules") {
        return t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.byDates", { count: usage.count });
      }
      return usage.periods
        .map((period) => {
          const days = weekdaySummary(period.weekdays, format, t);
          const from = period.startsOn && shortDate(period.startsOn, ctx);
          const to = period.endsOn && shortDate(period.endsOn, ctx);
          if (from && to) return t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.range", { from, to, days });
          if (from) return t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.from", { from, days });
          if (to) return t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.until", { to, days });
          return t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.noDates", { days });
        })
        .join("; ");
    }
    function seasonalHoursLines(row: SeasonalHoursRow, ctx: HubTextContext): HubLine[] {
      const { t } = ctx;
      if (row.sets.length === 0) return [line(t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.empty"))];
      return [
        ...row.sets.map((set) =>
          line(
            t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.set", {
              name: scheduleNameText(set.name, t),
              usage: usageText(set.usage, ctx),
            })
          )
        ),
        ...(row.more > 0 ? [line(t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.more", { count: row.more }))] : []),
      ];
    }
    function specialDatesLines(row: SpecialDatesRow, ctx: HubTextContext): HubLine[] {
      const { t, format } = ctx;
      const dates = row.next.map((item) =>
        t("availabilityHub.hub.special.item", {
          date: shortDate(item.nextOn, ctx),
          kind: t(`availabilityHub.hub.special.kind.${item.kind}`),
        })
      );
      const holidays =
        row.holidaysNotPlanned > 0
          ? [line(t("availabilityHub.hub.special.holidays", { count: row.holidaysNotPlanned }))]
          : [];
      const first =
        dates.length === 0
          ? t("availabilityHub.hub.special.empty")
          : t("availabilityHub.hub.special.next", {
              dates: new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "unit" }).format(dates),
            });
      return [line(first), ...holidays];
    }
    function bookingRulesLines(row: BookingRulesRow, { t }: HubTextContext): HubLine[] {
      return [
        line(row.rules ? bookingRulesText(row.rules, t) : t("availabilityHub.hub.booking.empty")),
      ];
    }
    export function hubRowTexts(
      rows: HubRowModels,
      today: string,
      ctx: HubTextContext
    ): readonly HubRowText[] {
      const { t } = ctx;
      const [regular, seasonal, special, closures, booking] = rows;
      return [
        {
          row: 1,
          title: t("availabilityHub.hub.regular.title"),
          lines: regularHoursLines(regular, ctx),
        },
        {
          row: 2,
          title: t("availabilityHub.hub.seasonal.title"),
          lines: seasonalHoursLines(seasonal, ctx),
        },
        {
          row: 3,
          title: t("availabilityHub.hub.special.title"),
          lines: specialDatesLines(special, ctx),
        },
        {
          row: 4,
          title: t("availabilityHub.hub.closures.title"),
          lines: closuresLines(closures, today, ctx),
        },
        {
          row: 5,
          title: t("availabilityHub.hub.booking.title"),
          lines: bookingRulesLines(booking, ctx),
        },
      ];
    }

    export const TEXT: HubTextContext = {

        locale: "en-US",

          formatCalendarDate(date, options, "en-US"),

    export const EVERY_DAY = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
    export const TODAY = "2026-11-12";
    type Schedule = AvailabilityConfig["schedules"][number];
    type ScheduleService = AvailabilityConfig["scheduleServices"][number];
    type Assignment = AvailabilityConfig["assignments"][number];
    export const dinnerRow = (scheduleId: string, closesAt = 1320): ScheduleService => ({
      id: `ss-${scheduleId}`,
      scheduleId,
      venueServiceId: "vs-dinner",
      opensAt: 1020,
      lastSeatingAt: closesAt - 60,
      closesAt,
      seating: SEATING,
      bookingTypes: BOOKING_TYPES,
      weekdays: [],

    });
    export function seasonal(id: string, name: string, ...uses: Partial<Assignment>[]) {
      return {
        schedules: [{ id, name, kind: "alternate", isRegular: false } satisfies Schedule],
        scheduleServices: [dinnerRow(id, 1380)],
        assignments: uses.map((use, index): Assignment => ({
          id: `as-${id}-${index}`,
          scheduleId: id,
          weekdays: EVERY_DAY,
          precedence: 1,
          ...use,
        })),
      };
    }
    interface Parts {
      readonly schedules?: readonly Schedule[];
      readonly scheduleServices?: readonly ScheduleService[];
      readonly assignments?: readonly Assignment[];
      /** When regular Dinner closes; 10:00 PM unless given. */
      readonly regularClosesAt?: number;
    }
    export function valid(config: AvailabilityConfig): AvailabilityConfig {
      expect(validateConfig(config)).toEqual([]);
      return config;
    }
    export function venue(dateRules: DateRule[] = [], ...added: Parts[]): AvailabilityConfig {
      const closesAt = added.find((p) => p.regularClosesAt !== undefined)?.regularClosesAt;
      return valid({
        schedules: [REGULAR, ...added.flatMap((p) => p.schedules ?? [])],
        venueServices: [{ id: "vs-dinner", name: "Dinner", position: 0 }],
        scheduleServices: [
          dinnerRow("regular", closesAt),
          ...added.flatMap((p) => p.scheduleServices ?? []),
        ],
        assignments: [REGULAR_ASSIGNMENT, ...added.flatMap((p) => p.assignments ?? [])],
        dateRules,
      });
    }
    export function lunchAndDinner(dateRules: DateRule[] = []): AvailabilityConfig {
      return valid({
        schedules: [REGULAR],
        venueServices: [
          { id: "vs-lunch", name: "Lunch", position: 0 },
          { id: "vs-dinner", name: "Dinner", position: 1 },
        ],
        scheduleServices: [
          {
            ...dinnerRow("regular"),
            id: "ss-regular-lunch",
            venueServiceId: "vs-lunch",
            opensAt: 690,
            lastSeatingAt: 840,
            closesAt: 900,
          },
          dinnerRow("regular"),
        ],
        assignments: [REGULAR_ASSIGNMENT],
        dateRules,
      });
    }
    export function input(config: AvailabilityConfig, rest: Partial<HubRowsInput> = {}): HubRowsInput {
      return {
        state: { config, source: "rows" },
        settings: null,
        holidays: [],
        sectionNames: new Map([["sec-patio", "Patio"]]),
        timezone: TIMEZONE,
        today: TODAY,
        nowMinute: NOW,
        ...rest,
      };
    }
    export function rowsOf(config: AvailabilityConfig, rest: Partial<HubRowsInput> = {}) {
      const result = hubRows(input(config, rest));
      if (result.kind !== "rows") throw new Error("expected rows");
      return result.rows;
    }
    export const rule = (id: string, rest: Partial<DateRule> = {}): DateRule =>
      ({
        id,
        kind: "closure",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: TODAY,
        endsOn: TODAY,
        ...rest,
      }) as DateRule;
    export const specialHours = (id: string, date: string, rest: Partial<DateRule> = {}): DateRule =>
      rule(id, {
        kind: "special_hours",
        startsOn: date,

              lastSeatingAt: 1140,
              closesAt: 1200,
              seating: SEATING,
              bookingTypes: BOOKING_TYPES,
            },
          ],
        },
        ...rest,
      } as Partial<DateRule>);
    export const window = (from: number, to = 2880) => ({ version: 1 as const, from, to });
    export const THURSDAYS: Partial<DateRule> = {

      endsOn: "2027-02-28",
      repeat: { version: 1, weekdays: [4] },

    export interface HubRowsInput {
      readonly state: Pick<AvailabilityConfigState, "config" | "source">;
      readonly settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined;
      /** The upcoming holidays with what the venue decided (`holidayStates`). */
      readonly holidays: readonly { readonly state: HolidayState }[];
      /** Section id to name; empty while sections load. */
      readonly sectionNames: ReadonlyMap<string, string>;
      readonly timezone: string;
      /** The venue's civil date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. */
      readonly today: string;
      /** The venue's minute of the day. */
      readonly nowMinute: number;
    }
    export interface RegularHoursRow {
      readonly row: 1;
      /** The hours in force today, one entry per service; empty when none is set. */
      readonly services: readonly RegularWeekLineService[];
      /** The next dated change, as the row will read on its first day. */
      readonly upcoming: {
        readonly startsOn: string;
        /** `null` when the change has no end. */
        readonly endsOn: string | null;
        readonly services: readonly RegularWeekLineService[];
      } | null;
    }
    export interface SeasonalHoursSet {
      readonly scheduleId: string;
      /** The name as stored. */
      readonly name: string;
      readonly usage: ScheduleUsage;
    }
    export interface SeasonalHoursRow {
      readonly row: 2;
      /** At most three, in config order. */
      readonly sets: readonly SeasonalHoursSet[];
      /** How many sets are not listed. */
      readonly more: number;
    }
    export interface BookingRulesRow {
      readonly row: 5;
      /** `null` when none of the three is set. */
      readonly rules: BookingRulesValues | null;
    }
    type HubRowNumber = DateAnswerHubRow | 5;
    type Numbered<N extends HubRowNumber, Row extends { readonly row: N }> = Row;
    export type HubRowModels = readonly [
      Numbered<1, RegularHoursRow>,
      Numbered<2, SeasonalHoursRow>,
      Numbered<3, SpecialDatesRow>,
      Numbered<4, ClosuresRow>,
      Numbered<5, BookingRulesRow>,
    ];
    export type HubRows =
      { readonly kind: "emptyVenue" } | { readonly kind: "rows"; readonly rows: HubRowModels };
    function regularHoursRow(config: AvailabilityConfig, today: string): RegularHoursRow {
      const upcoming = upcomingRegularWeek(config, today);
      return {
        row: 1,
        services: regularWeekLine(config, today).services,
        upcoming: upcoming && {
          startsOn: upcoming.startsOn,
          endsOn: upcoming.endsOn,
          services: upcoming.line.services,
        },
      };
    }
    function seasonalHoursRow(config: AvailabilityConfig): SeasonalHoursRow {
      const sets = config.schedules
        .filter((s) => s.kind !== "regular" && !s.archivedAt)
        .map((s) => ({ scheduleId: s.id, name: s.name, usage: scheduleUsage(config, s.id) }));
      return {
        row: 2,
        sets: sets.slice(0, SEASONAL_SETS_SHOWN),
        more: Math.max(0, sets.length - SEASONAL_SETS_SHOWN),
      };
    }
    function bookingRulesRow(settings: HubRowsInput["settings"]): BookingRulesRow {
      const rules = bookingRulesOf(settings);
      const anySet = Object.values(rules).some((value) => value !== null);
      return { row: 5, rules: anySet ? rules : null };
    }
    export function hubRows(input: HubRowsInput): HubRows {
      const { config, source } = input.state;
      if (source === "empty") return { kind: "emptyVenue" };
      const { sectionNames, timezone, today, nowMinute } = input;
      return {
        kind: "rows",
        rows: [
          regularHoursRow(config, today),
          seasonalHoursRow(config),
          specialDatesRow(config.dateRules, today, input.holidays),
          closuresRow({ config, sectionNames, timezone, today, nowMinute }),
          bookingRulesRow(input.settings),
        ],
      };
    }

    export interface HubSpecialDate {
      readonly ruleId: string;
      /** What the Add special dates sheet calls it: Closed, Special hours, Same as another day. */
      readonly kind: "closed" | "specialHours" | "useHours";
      /** The first date from today on the rule applies on: a skipped or replaced date is passed over. */
      readonly nextOn: string;
      readonly startsOn: string;
      /** `null` when the rule has no end. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      /** The weekdays a repeating rule covers (0 = Sunday); `null` when it does not repeat. */
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[] | null;
    }
    export interface SpecialDatesRow {
      readonly row: 3;
      /** At most two, soonest `nextOn` first. A rule with no date left is not listed. */
      readonly next: readonly HubSpecialDate[];
      readonly holidaysNotPlanned: number;
    }
    function specialDateKind(rule: DateRule): HubSpecialDate["kind"] | null {
      if (rule.kind === "special_hours") return "specialHours";
      if (rule.kind === "use_schedule") return "useHours";
      // Only the whole venue closed for the whole day is a date's "Closed"; any other closure is row 4's.
      return rule.kind === "closure" && rule.targetKind === "venue" && rule.window == null
        ? "closed"
        : null;
    }
    export function specialDatesRow(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      today: string,
      holidays: readonly { readonly state: HolidayState }[]
    ): SpecialDatesRow {
      const next = rules
        .flatMap((rule): HubSpecialDate[] => {
          const kind = specialDateKind(rule);
          const nextOn = kind === null ? null : nextDateOn(rule, rules, today);
          if (kind === null || nextOn === null) return [];
          return [
            {
              ruleId: rule.id,
              kind,
              nextOn,
              startsOn: rule.startsOn,
              endsOn: rule.endsOn ?? null,
              weekdays: rule.repeat?.weekdays ?? null,
            },
          ];
        })
        .sort((a, b) => a.nextOn.localeCompare(b.nextOn) || a.ruleId.localeCompare(b.ruleId));
      return {
        row: 3,
        next: next.slice(0, SPECIAL_DATES_SHOWN),
        holidaysNotPlanned: holidays.filter((h) => h.state.kind === "undecided").length,
      };
    }

    export type HubTextContext = ServiceHoursContext;
    export function shortDate(date: string, { format }: HubTextContext): string {
      return format.formatCalendarDate(date, { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/hub/rule-dates.ts">
    function reaches(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.startsOn <= date &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || date <= rule.endsOn) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    function replacesOn(override: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return override.startsOn <= date && date <= (override.endsOn ?? override.startsOn);
    }
    function overridesOf(rule: DateRule, rules: readonly DateRule[]): readonly DateRule[] {
      return rules.filter((r) => r.seriesId === rule.id);
    }
    export function coversOn(rule: DateRule, rules: readonly DateRule[], date: string): boolean {
      return reaches(rule, date) && !overridesOf(rule, rules).some((o) => replacesOn(o, date));
    }
    export function nextDateOn(
      rule: DateRule,
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      from: string
    ): string | null {
      const overrides = overridesOf(rule, rules);
      const start = from > rule.startsOn ? from : rule.startsOn;
      for (let i = 0; i < LOOKAHEAD_DAYS; i += 1) {
        const date = addDays(start, i);
        if (rule.endsOn != null && date > rule.endsOn) return null;
        if (reaches(rule, date) && !overrides.some((o) => replacesOn(o, date))) return date;
      }
      return null;
    }
  </file>
  </section>

    type Catalog = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    export type GlossaryCatalogs = Readonly<Record<"en-US" | "es-MX" | "fr-CA" | "en-GB", Catalog>>;
    interface GlossaryEntry {
      readonly concept: string;
      /** The one en-US label for the concept. */
      readonly term: string;
      /**
       * en-US words this label replaces. Matched as whole words, whatever the case; a space also
       * matches a hyphen ("regular-week").
       */
      readonly retired: readonly string[];
    }
    export const AVAILABILITY_GLOSSARY: readonly GlossaryEntry[] = [

    ]);
    interface GlossaryProblem {
      readonly kind: "retired-word" | "missing-key" | "stale-legacy-key";
      readonly locale: keyof GlossaryCatalogs;
      readonly key: string;
      /** The retired word found, as the glossary spells it; empty for the other kinds. */
      readonly detail: string;
    }
    function leaves(node: unknown, path: string): readonly (readonly [string, string])[] {
      if (typeof node === "string") return [[path, node]];
      if (node === null || typeof node !== "object") return [];
      return Object.entries(node).flatMap(([k, v]) => leaves(v, `${path}.${k}`));
    }
    function scoped(catalog: Catalog): readonly (readonly [string, string])[] {
      return AVAILABILITY_NAMESPACES.flatMap((namespace) => leaves(catalog[namespace], namespace));
    }
    function retiredPattern(word: string): RegExp {
      const parts = word.split(/\s+/).map((part) => part.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"));
      return new RegExp(`\\b${parts.join("[\\s-]+")}\\b`, "i");
    }
    function retiredWordIn(value: string): string | undefined {
      const shown = value.replace(/\{\{[^}]*\}\}/g, " ");
      return RETIRED.find(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(shown))?.[0];
    }
    function retiredWordProblems(
      locale: keyof GlossaryCatalogs,
      catalog: Catalog,
      legacyKeys: ReadonlySet<string>
    ): readonly GlossaryProblem[] {
      return scoped(catalog).flatMap(([key, value]) => {
        const word = legacyKeys.has(key) ? undefined : retiredWordIn(value);
        return word === undefined ? [] : [{ kind: "retired-word", locale, key, detail: word }];
      });
    }
    export function checkAvailabilityGlossary(
      catalogs: GlossaryCatalogs,
      legacyKeys: ReadonlySet<string>
    ): readonly GlossaryProblem[] {
      const source = scoped(catalogs["en-US"]);
    
      const missing = (["es-MX", "fr-CA"] as const).flatMap((locale) => {
        const present = new Set(scoped(catalogs[locale]).map(([key]) => key));
        return source
          .filter(([key]) => !present.has(key))
          .map(([key]): GlossaryProblem => ({ kind: "missing-key", locale, key, detail: "" }));
      });
    
      const stillRetired = new Set(
        source.filter(([, value]) => retiredWordIn(value) !== undefined).map(([key]) => key)
      );
      const stale = [...legacyKeys]
        .filter((key) => !stillRetired.has(key))
        .map((key): GlossaryProblem => ({
          kind: "stale-legacy-key",
          locale: "en-US",
          key,
          detail: "",
        }));
    
      return [
        ...retiredWordProblems("en-US", catalogs["en-US"], legacyKeys),
        ...missing,
        ...retiredWordProblems("en-GB", catalogs["en-GB"], legacyKeys),
        ...stale,
      ];
    }

  <file path="src/i18n/locales.ts">
    export type LocaleTag = "en-US" | "en-GB" | "es-MX" | "fr-CA";
    export interface SupportedLocale {
      readonly tag: LocaleTag;
      /** The locale's name in its own language — what the picker shows. */
      readonly endonym: string;
      /** Text was machine-generated; the picker discloses this. */
      readonly machineTranslated: boolean;
    }
    export const DEFAULT_LOCALE: LocaleTag = "en-US";
    export const SUPPORTED_LOCALES: readonly SupportedLocale[] = [
      { tag: "en-US", endonym: "English (US)", machineTranslated: false },
      { tag: "en-GB", endonym: "English (UK)", machineTranslated: false },
      { tag: "es-MX", endonym: "Español (México)", machineTranslated: true },
      { tag: "fr-CA", endonym: "Français (Canada)", machineTranslated: true },
    ];
    function parse(tag: string): Intl.Locale | null {
      try {
        return new Intl.Locale(tag);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    function exactMatch(tag: string): LocaleTag | null {
      const locale = parse(tag);
      if (!locale) return null;
      const normalized = `${locale.language}-${locale.region ?? ""}`;
      return SUPPORTED_LOCALES.find((l) => l.tag === normalized)?.tag ?? null;
    }
    function matchOne(tag: string): LocaleTag | null {
      const exact = exactMatch(tag);
      if (exact) return exact;
      const language = parse(tag)?.language;
      return language ? (LANGUAGE_FALLBACK[language] ?? null) : null;
    }
    export function resolveLocale({
      stored,
      browser,
    }: {
      stored: string | null;
      browser: readonly string[];
    }): LocaleTag {
      const fromStorage = stored ? exactMatch(stored) : null;
      if (fromStorage) return fromStorage;
      for (const tag of browser) {
        const match = matchOne(tag);
        if (match) return match;
      }
      return DEFAULT_LOCALE;
    }
  </file>

    type OrdinalCategory = "one" | "two" | "few" | "other";
    function ordinalCategory(language: string, n: number): OrdinalCategory {
      const category = new Intl.PluralRules(language, { type: "ordinal" }).select(n);
      return category === "one" || category === "two" || category === "few" ? category : "other";
    }
    export function ordinalVisitLabel(t: TFunction, language: string, n: number): string {
      return t(`reservations.visitOrdinal.${ordinalCategory(language, n)}`, { count: n });
    }

    export const SYNTHETIC_VENUE_PREFIX = "synthetic-journey-";
    interface VenueSummary {
      id: string;
      name: string;
    }
    export async function authenticateAgainstLiveSite(page: Page): Promise<string> {
      const config = validateAuth0Config();
      const tokens = await fetchAuth0TokensWithRetry(config);
      const storageClientId = process.env["JOURNEY_OIDC_CLIENT_ID"] || config.clientId;
      const entry = buildOidcUserEntry(config, tokens, storageClientId);
    
      await page.goto("");
      await page.evaluate(({ key, value }) => {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }, entry);
      await page.reload();
    
      return tokens.access_token;
    }
    export const NON_ADMIN_AUTH_ENV_VARS = [
      "E2E_NONADMIN_AUTH_EMAIL",
      "E2E_NONADMIN_AUTH_PASSWORD",
    ] as const;
    export function resolveNonAdminAuthEnv(
      env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env
    ): Record<string, string | undefined> {
      const email = env["E2E_NONADMIN_AUTH_EMAIL"];
      const password = env["E2E_NONADMIN_AUTH_PASSWORD"];
      const missing = NON_ADMIN_AUTH_ENV_VARS.filter((name) => !env[name]);
    
      if (missing.length > 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Missing required non-admin journey env vars: ${missing.join(", ")}\n\n` +
            "  E2E_NONADMIN_AUTH_EMAIL     — an Auth0 user WITHOUT the admin role\n" +
            "  E2E_NONADMIN_AUTH_PASSWORD  — that user's password\n\n" +
            "They are deliberately not defaulted to the admin credentials: the " +
            "first-venue bootstrap case only exists for non-admins, so an admin " +
            "fallback would make this journey pass without exercising it."
        );
      }
    
      return { ...env, E2E_AUTH_EMAIL: email, E2E_AUTH_PASSWORD: password };
    }
    export function readTokenPermissions(accessToken: string): string[] {
      const segments = accessToken.split(".");
      if (segments.length !== 3 || !segments[1]) {
        throw new Error(
          "Access token is not a well-formed JWT (expected three dot-separated segments)"
        );
      }
    
      const claims: unknown = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(segments[1], "base64url").toString("utf8"));
      if (typeof claims !== "object" || claims === null) {
        throw new Error("Access token payload did not decode to an object");
      }
    
      const permissions = (claims as { permissions?: unknown }).permissions;
      if (permissions === undefined) return [];
      if (!Array.isArray(permissions)) {
        throw new Error("Access token `permissions` claim is present but not an array");
      }
      return permissions.map(String);
    }
    export async function authenticateNonAdmin(): Promise<{
      accessToken: string;
      permissions: string[];
    }> {
      const config = validateAuth0Config(resolveNonAdminAuthEnv());
      const tokens = await fetchAuth0TokensWithRetry(config);
      return {
        accessToken: tokens.access_token,
        permissions: readTokenPermissions(tokens.access_token),
      };
    }
    export async function createVenueAs(
      accessToken: string,
      name: string
    ): Promise<{ status: number; id?: string }> {
      const response = await apiRequest(accessToken, "/api/v1/venues", "POST", {
        name,
        slug: name,
        ianaTimezone: "America/Los_Angeles",
      });
    
      if (!response.ok) return { status: response.status };
    
      const body = (await response.json()) as { data?: { id?: string } };
      return { status: response.status, id: body.data?.id };
    }
    async function apiRequest(
      accessToken: string,
      path: string,
      method: string,
      body?: unknown
    ): Promise<Response> {
      const headers: Record<string, string> = { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` };
      if (body !== undefined) headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
    
      const send = (): Promise<Response> =>
        fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
          method,
          headers,
          body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        });
    
      // A single dropped connection ("fetch failed") must not fail the daily
      // journey (#7921). Only idempotent methods are retried, so a POST can never
      // create a venue twice.
      if (method !== "GET" && method !== "DELETE") return send();
      try {
        return await send();
      } catch {
        return send();
      }
    }
    export async function listSyntheticVenues(accessToken: string): Promise<VenueSummary[]> {
      const response = await apiRequest(accessToken, "/api/v1/venues?limit=100", "GET");
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Listing venues failed (HTTP ${response.status})`);
      }
    
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { data?: VenueSummary[] };
      return (payload.data ?? []).filter((venue) => venue.name?.startsWith(SYNTHETIC_VENUE_PREFIX));
    }
    export interface DeleteVenueResult {
      ok: boolean;
      status: number;
    }
    async function deleteVenueFloorPlans(accessToken: string, venueId: string): Promise<void> {
      const response = await apiRequest(
        accessToken,
        `/api/v1/floor-plans?venueId=${venueId}&limit=100`,
        "GET"
      );
      if (!response.ok) return; // best-effort — the retried delete below surfaces the real status either way
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { data?: { id: string }[] };
      for (const floorPlan of payload.data ?? []) {
        await apiRequest(accessToken, `/api/v1/floor-plans/${floorPlan.id}`, "DELETE");
      }
    }
    export async function deleteVenue(
      accessToken: string,
      venueId: string
    ): Promise<DeleteVenueResult> {
      let response = await apiRequest(accessToken, `/api/v1/venues/${venueId}`, "DELETE");
      if (response.status === 409) {
        await deleteVenueFloorPlans(accessToken, venueId);
        response = await apiRequest(accessToken, `/api/v1/venues/${venueId}`, "DELETE");
      }
      const status = response.status;
      return { ok: status === 204 || status === 404, status };
    }
    export async function sweepSyntheticVenues(accessToken: string): Promise<string[]> {
      const leftovers = await listSyntheticVenues(accessToken);
      const undeleted: string[] = [];
    
      for (const venue of leftovers) {
        const result = await deleteVenue(accessToken, venue.id);
        if (!result.ok) undeleted.push(`${venue.name} (HTTP ${result.status})`);
      }
    
      return undeleted;
    }

  <file path="e2e/journeys/journey-recorder.ts">
    export type JourneyStepStatus = "passed" | "failed" | "blocked" | "skipped";
    export interface JourneyStepResult {
      name: string;
      status: JourneyStepStatus;
      durationMs: number;
      error?: string;
      /** Visible `[role="alert"]` text when the step failed — see capturePageError. */
      pageError?: string;
      /** On a `blocked` step: the env vars that were unset. */
      missingCredentials?: string[];
    }
    export interface JourneyStepRequirements {
      requiredEnv?: string[];
      env?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
    }
    export interface JourneyReport {
      runId: string;
      runUrl: string;
      startedAt: string;
      venueName: string;
      steps: JourneyStepResult[];
      consoleErrors: string[];
    }
    async function capturePageError(page: Page): Promise<string | undefined> {
      try {
        const alert = page.locator('[role="alert"]:visible').first();
        if ((await alert.count()) === 0) return undefined;
        const text = await alert.innerText({ timeout: ALERT_READ_TIMEOUT_MS });
        return redactSecrets(text).trim() || undefined;
      } catch {
        return undefined;
      }
    }
    function slugify(name: string): string {
      return name
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
        .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
    }
    export function resolveRunContext(): { runId: string; runUrl: string } {
      const runId = process.env["GITHUB_RUN_ID"] ?? `local-${Date.now()}`;
      const server = process.env["GITHUB_SERVER_URL"] ?? "https://github.com";
      const repo = process.env["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"];
      return { runId, runUrl: repo ? `${server}/${repo}/actions/runs/${runId}` : "(local run)" };
    }
    export function createJourneyRecorder(page: Page, venueName: string) {
      const steps: JourneyStepResult[] = [];
      const consoleErrors: string[] = [];
      const { runId, runUrl } = resolveRunContext();
      const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    
      page.on("console", (message) => {
        if (message.type() === "error") consoleErrors.push(message.text());
      });
      page.on("pageerror", (error) => consoleErrors.push(error.message));
    
      const hasFailed = () => steps.some((step) => step.status === "failed");
    
      /**
       * Thin wrapper over `classifyJourneyStepOutcome`, which owns every
       * passed/failed/blocked decision. Consulted twice, and both calls are the
       * same question asked at the two moments it can be answered: may this body
       * run at all, and — once it has — how did it end.
       */
      async function runTimed(
        name: string,
        fn: () => Promise<void>,
        { requiredEnv, env }: JourneyStepRequirements = {}
      ): Promise<void> {
        const gate = classifyJourneyStepOutcome({ requiredEnv, env });
        if (gate.state === "blocked") {
          steps.push({
            name,
            status: "blocked",
            durationMs: 0,
            error: gate.reason,
            missingCredentials: gate.missingCredentials,
          });
          return;
        }
    
        const startedMs = Date.now();
        try {
          await fn();
          steps.push({ name, status: "passed", durationMs: Date.now() - startedMs });
        } catch (err) {
          const error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
          // Same classifier, its second question: the body ran, so how did it end?
          const outcome = classifyJourneyStepOutcome({ error });
          const pageError = await capturePageError(page);
          steps.push({
            name,
            status: outcome.state,
            durationMs: Date.now() - startedMs,
            error,
            ...(pageError ? { pageError } : {}),
          });
          await page
            .screenshot({ path: join(ARTIFACT_DIR, `journey-${slugify(name)}.png`), fullPage: true })
            .catch(() => undefined);
        }
      }
    
      return {
        /**
         * Runs a journey step, or records it as skipped once the journey broke.
         *
         * `requirements.requiredEnv` names credentials the step cannot run
         * without: when any is unset the body is never invoked and the step is
         * recorded `blocked` rather than `failed` (#4527).
         */
        async step(
          name: string,
          fn: () => Promise<void>,
          requirements?: JourneyStepRequirements
        ): Promise<void> {
          if (hasFailed()) {
            steps.push({ name, status: "skipped", durationMs: 0 });
            return;
          }
          await runTimed(name, fn, requirements);
        },
    
        /** Runs a step even after a failure — used for cleanup, which must happen. */
        async cleanupStep(name: string, fn: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
          await runTimed(name, fn);
        },
    
        /** Adds a note that is friction, not failure (e.g. an undeletable leftover). */
        note(message: string): void {
          consoleErrors.push(message);
        },
    
        report(): JourneyReport {
          return { runId, runUrl, startedAt, venueName, steps: [...steps], consoleErrors };
        },
    
        write(): void {
          mkdirSync(dirname(REPORT_PATH), { recursive: true });
          writeFileSync(REPORT_PATH, `${JSON.stringify(this.report(), null, 2)}\n`);
        },
    
        /**
         * Fails the Playwright test when any step failed — or was blocked.
         *
         * A blocked step fails the journey CLOSED: it was never verified, so the
         * run cannot be called green. The point of the separate state is that the
         * verdict is legible (blocked on a named, unset credential, not a product
         * regression), never that the check is weaker.
         */
        assertGreen(): void {
          const failed = steps.find((step) => step.status === "failed");
          if (failed) throw new Error(`Journey failed at "${failed.name}": ${failed.error}`);
    
          const blocked = steps.find((step) => step.status === "blocked");
          if (blocked) throw new Error(`Journey blocked at "${blocked.name}": ${blocked.error}`);
        },
      };
    }
  </file>

    export const DEMO_AUTH_ENV = {

    }
