  <file path="src/lib/arrival-chime.ts">
    export const ARRIVAL_CHIME_MUTED_KEY = "mbe-hospitality-arrival-chime-muted";
    export function isArrivalChimeMuted(): boolean {
      try {
        return localStorage.getItem(ARRIVAL_CHIME_MUTED_KEY) === "true";
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }
    function persistMuted(muted: boolean): boolean {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(ARRIVAL_CHIME_MUTED_KEY, String(muted));
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }
    export function setArrivalChimeMuted(muted: boolean): boolean {
      const persisted = persistMuted(muted);
      for (const listener of listeners) listener();
      return persisted;
    }
    export function subscribeArrivalChimeMuted(listener: () => void): () => void {
      listeners.add(listener);
      const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
        if (event.key === ARRIVAL_CHIME_MUTED_KEY || event.key === null) listener();
      };
      window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
        window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
      };
    }
    function getAudioContext(): AudioContext | null {
      if (audioContext) return audioContext;
      const Ctor: typeof AudioContext | undefined =
        typeof AudioContext === "undefined" ? undefined : AudioContext;
      if (!Ctor) return null;
      audioContext = new Ctor();
      return audioContext;
    }
    export function resetArrivalChimeAudioForTests(): void {
      audioContext = null;
    }
    export function playArrivalChime(): boolean {
      try {
        const ctx = getAudioContext();
        if (!ctx) return false;
        if (ctx.state === "suspended") {
          ctx.resume().catch(() => undefined);
        }
        const start = ctx.currentTime;
        for (const { hz, offset } of NOTES) {
          const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = ctx.createGain();
          osc.type = "sine";
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(hz, start + offset);
          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start + offset);
          gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(PEAK_GAIN, start + offset + 0.02);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + offset + NOTE_SECONDS);
          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(ctx.destination);
          osc.start(start + offset);
          osc.stop(start + offset + NOTE_SECONDS);
        }
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false; // blocked or unsupported audio must never break the SSE handler
      }
    }

  <file path="src/lib/describe-api-error.ts">
    export type ApiErrorCategory = ErrorCategory | "network" | "timeout";
    export type ErrorRecovery = "retry" | "edit" | "sign-in" | "refresh" | "none";
    export interface ApiErrorDescription {
      readonly category: ApiErrorCategory;
      /** The sentence shown to a person — never a request line, never `undefined`, never a bare code. */
      readonly detail: string;
      readonly retryable: boolean;
      readonly recovery: ErrorRecovery;
      /** The original message (`error.message`, or `String(error)`), for the details block only. */
      readonly raw: string;
    }
    type CopyRow = Pick<ApiErrorDescription, "detail" | "retryable" | "recovery">;
    export const ERROR_COPY: Readonly<Record<ApiErrorCategory, CopyRow>> = Object.fromEntries(
      (Object.keys(COPY_BEHAVIOUR) as ApiErrorCategory[]).map((category) => [
        category,
        { detail: enUS.apiError[category], ...COPY_BEHAVIOUR[category] },
      ])
    ) as Record<ApiErrorCategory, CopyRow>;
    interface ApiClientErrorLike {
      readonly category: ErrorCategory;
      readonly problemDetails: { readonly detail?: unknown };
    }
    function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
      return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
    }
    function isApiClientError(error: unknown): error is ApiClientErrorLike {
      return (
        isRecord(error) &&
        typeof error.category === "string" &&
        API_CATEGORIES.has(error.category) &&
        isRecord(error.problemDetails)
      );
    }
    function isTimeout(error: unknown): boolean {
      return isRecord(error) && (error.name === "TimeoutError" || error.name === "AbortError");
    }
    function rawMessage(error: unknown): string {
      if (isRecord(error) && typeof error.message === "string") return error.message;
      return String(error);
    }
    function humanProblemDetail(problemDetails: ApiClientErrorLike["problemDetails"]): string | null {
      const detail = typeof problemDetails.detail === "string" ? problemDetails.detail.trim() : "";
      if (detail === "" || detail === "undefined" || /^\d{3}$/.test(detail)) return null;
      return detail;
    }
    function describe(
      category: ApiErrorCategory,
      raw: string,
      t: TFunction,
      detail?: string
    ): ApiErrorDescription {
      return {
        category,
        ...COPY_BEHAVIOUR[category],
        detail: detail ?? t(`apiError.${category}`),
        raw,
      };
    }
    export function describeApiError(error: unknown, t: TFunction = defaultT): ApiErrorDescription {
      const raw = rawMessage(error);
    
      if (isApiClientError(error)) {
        const shown = SHOWS_PROBLEM_DETAIL.has(error.category)
          ? humanProblemDetail(error.problemDetails)
          : null;
        return describe(error.category, raw, t, shown ?? undefined);
      }
      if (isTimeout(error)) return describe("timeout", raw, t);
      if (error instanceof TypeError) return describe("network", raw, t);
      return describe("unknown", raw, t);
    }

    export interface AuthErrorDescription {
      /** Short, human headline for the error screen. */
      readonly title: string;
      /** One-sentence explanation in user language. */
      readonly body: string;
      /** Whether offering a retry action makes sense for this category. */
      readonly canRetry: boolean;
    }
    function oidcErrorCode(error: Error): string {
      const code = (error as Error & { error?: unknown }).error;
      return typeof code === "string" ? code : "";
    }
    export function describeAuthError(
      error: Error,
      t: TFunction = localeRuntime.i18n.t
    ): AuthErrorDescription {
      const haystack = `${oidcErrorCode(error)} ${error.message}`;
    
      if (ACCESS_DENIED_PATTERN.test(haystack)) {
        return {
          title: t("auth.error.accessDenied.title"),
          body: t("auth.error.accessDenied.body"),
          canRetry: false,
        };
      }
    
      if (EXPIRED_FLOW_PATTERN.test(haystack)) {
        return {
          title: t("auth.error.expiredLink.title"),
          body: t("auth.error.expiredLink.body"),
          canRetry: true,
        };
      }
    
      if (NETWORK_PATTERN.test(haystack)) {
        return {
          title: t("auth.error.network.title"),
          body: t("auth.error.network.body"),
          canRetry: true,
        };
      }
    
      return {
        title: t("auth.error.generic.title"),
        body: t("auth.error.generic.body"),
        canRetry: true,
      };
    }

  <file path="src/lib/logo-palette-canvas.ts">
    export const ACCEPTED_LOGO_TYPES = ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp"] as const;
    export const MAX_LOGO_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
    export type LogoPaletteFailure = "unsupported-type" | "too-large" | "decode-failed";
    export type LogoPaletteResult =
      | { readonly ok: true; readonly palette: readonly string[] }
      | { readonly ok: false; readonly reason: LogoPaletteFailure };
    export function classifyLogoFile(file: Pick<File, "type" | "size">): LogoPaletteFailure | null {
      if (!ACCEPTED_LOGO_TYPES.some((type) => type === file.type)) return "unsupported-type";
      if (file.size > MAX_LOGO_BYTES) return "too-large";
      return null;
    }
    export async function readLogoPalette(
      file: File,
      maxColors = DEFAULT_MAX_COLORS
    ): Promise<LogoPaletteResult> {
      const invalid = classifyLogoFile(file);
      if (invalid !== null) return { ok: false, reason: invalid };
    
      try {
        const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(file);
        try {
          const { width, height } = fitWithin(bitmap.width, bitmap.height);
          const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;
          const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
          if (context === null) return { ok: false, reason: "decode-failed" };
          context.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0, width, height);
          const { data } = context.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
          return { ok: true, palette: extractDominantColors(data, maxColors) };
        } finally {
          bitmap.close();
        }
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, reason: "decode-failed" };
      }
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/lib/logo-palette.ts">
    export interface RgbPixel {
      readonly r: number;
      readonly g: number;
      readonly b: number;
    }
    interface Centroid extends RgbPixel {
      readonly count: number;
    }
    export type RgbaBytes = Uint8Array | Uint8ClampedArray;
    export const DEFAULT_MAX_COLORS = 5;
    export const PIXEL_STRIDE = 10;
    export function fitWithin(
      width: number,
      height: number,
      maxEdge = MAX_SAMPLE_EDGE
    ): { readonly width: number; readonly height: number } {
      const longest = Math.max(width, height);
      if (longest <= maxEdge) return { width, height };
      const scale = maxEdge / longest;
      return {
        width: Math.max(1, Math.floor(width * scale)),
        height: Math.max(1, Math.floor(height * scale)),
      };
    }
    export function samplePixels(rgba: RgbaBytes): readonly RgbPixel[] {
      const pixels: RgbPixel[] = [];
      const pixelCount = Math.floor(rgba.length / 4);
    
      for (let i = 0; i < pixelCount; i += PIXEL_STRIDE) {
        const offset = i * 4;
        const r = rgba[offset] ?? 0;
        const g = rgba[offset + 1] ?? 0;
        const b = rgba[offset + 2] ?? 0;
        const a = rgba[offset + 3] ?? 0;
    
        if (a < ALPHA_THRESHOLD) continue;
        if (r > NEAR_WHITE_THRESHOLD && g > NEAR_WHITE_THRESHOLD && b > NEAR_WHITE_THRESHOLD) continue;
        if (r < NEAR_BLACK_THRESHOLD && g < NEAR_BLACK_THRESHOLD && b < NEAR_BLACK_THRESHOLD) continue;
    
        pixels.push({ r, g, b });
      }
    
      return pixels;
    }
    function distance(a: RgbPixel, b: RgbPixel): number {
      const dr = a.r - b.r;
      const dg = a.g - b.g;
      const db = a.b - b.b;
      return dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db;
    }
    function initCentroids(pixels: readonly RgbPixel[], k: number): readonly RgbPixel[] {
      const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(pixels.length / k));
      return Array.from(
        { length: k },
        (_, i) => pixels[Math.min(i * step, pixels.length - 1)] as RgbPixel
      );
    }
    function nearestCentroid(pixel: RgbPixel, centroids: readonly RgbPixel[]): number {
      let minDist = Infinity;
      let nearest = 0;
      for (let ci = 0; ci < centroids.length; ci++) {
        const d = distance(pixel, centroids[ci] as RgbPixel);
        if (d < minDist) {
          minDist = d;
          nearest = ci;
        }
      }
      return nearest;
    }
    function meanOf(cluster: readonly RgbPixel[]): RgbPixel {
      const sum = cluster.reduce((acc, p) => ({ r: acc.r + p.r, g: acc.g + p.g, b: acc.b + p.b }), {
        r: 0,
        g: 0,
        b: 0,
      });
      return {
        r: Math.round(sum.r / cluster.length),
        g: Math.round(sum.g / cluster.length),
        b: Math.round(sum.b / cluster.length),
      };
    }
    function runKMeans(pixels: readonly RgbPixel[], k: number): readonly Centroid[] {
      if (pixels.length === 0) return [];
    
      const clampedK = Math.min(k, pixels.length);
      let centroids = initCentroids(pixels, clampedK);
    
      for (let iter = 0; iter < KMEANS_ITERATIONS; iter++) {
        const clusters: RgbPixel[][] = Array.from({ length: clampedK }, () => []);
        for (const pixel of pixels) {
          (clusters[nearestCentroid(pixel, centroids)] as RgbPixel[]).push(pixel);
        }
        // An empty cluster keeps its previous centroid rather than drifting.
        centroids = clusters.map((cluster, ci) =>
          cluster.length === 0 ? (centroids[ci] as RgbPixel) : meanOf(cluster)
        );
      }
    
      const clusterSizes: number[] = Array<number>(clampedK).fill(0);
      for (const pixel of pixels) {
        const nearest = nearestCentroid(pixel, centroids);
        clusterSizes[nearest] = (clusterSizes[nearest] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
    
      return centroids.map((c, i) => ({ ...c, count: clusterSizes[i] ?? 0 }));
    }
    function toHex(n: number): string {
      return n.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    }
    function centroidToHex(c: RgbPixel): string {
      return `#${toHex(c.r)}${toHex(c.g)}${toHex(c.b)}`;
    }
    export function extractDominantColors(
      rgba: RgbaBytes,
      maxColors = DEFAULT_MAX_COLORS
    ): readonly string[] {
      const pixels = samplePixels(rgba);
      if (pixels.length === 0) return [];
    
      const ranked = runKMeans(pixels, maxColors).filter((c) => c.count > 0);
      return [...ranked].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count).map(centroidToHex);
    }
  </file>

    export type FloorPlanSnapshot = TableStatusDelta[];
    interface ReservationsCacheEntry {
      venueId: string;
      date: string;
      reservations: Reservation[];
      /** Epoch ms this entry was written — surfaced to callers as the
       * "last synced" timestamp for the offline/stale-data banner. */
      cachedAt: number;
    }
    export interface CachedReservations {
      reservations: Reservation[];
      cachedAt: number;
    }
    interface FloorPlanCacheEntry {
      venueId: string;
      date: string;
      snapshot: FloorPlanSnapshot;
    }
    interface OfflineCacheSchema extends DBSchema {
      reservations: {
        key: string;
        value: ReservationsCacheEntry;
      };
      floorPlanSnapshots: {
        key: string;
        value: FloorPlanCacheEntry;
      };
    }
    export const DB_NAME = "mbe-hospitality-offline";
    function getDb(): Promise<IDBPDatabase<OfflineCacheSchema>> {
      dbPromise ??= openDB<OfflineCacheSchema>(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION, {
        upgrade(db) {
          db.createObjectStore(RESERVATIONS_STORE);
          db.createObjectStore(FLOOR_PLAN_SNAPSHOTS_STORE);
        },
      });
      return dbPromise;
    }
    function reservationsKey(venueId: string, date: string): string {
      return `${venueId}::${date}`;
    }
    function todayDateKey(): string {
      return deviceDate(new Date());
    }
    export async function getCachedReservations(
      venueId: string,
      date: string
    ): Promise<CachedReservations | null> {
      const db = await getDb();
      const entry = await db.get(RESERVATIONS_STORE, reservationsKey(venueId, date));
      if (entry === undefined) return null;
      return { reservations: entry.reservations, cachedAt: entry.cachedAt };
    }
    export async function setCachedReservations(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      reservations: Reservation[]
    ): Promise<void> {
      const db = await getDb();
      const entry: ReservationsCacheEntry = { venueId, date, reservations, cachedAt: Date.now() };
      await db.put(RESERVATIONS_STORE, entry, reservationsKey(venueId, date));
    }
    export async function getCachedFloorPlanSnapshot(
      venueId: string
    ): Promise<FloorPlanSnapshot | null> {
      const db = await getDb();
      const entry = await db.get(FLOOR_PLAN_SNAPSHOTS_STORE, venueId);
      return entry?.snapshot ?? null;
    }
    export async function setCachedFloorPlanSnapshot(
      venueId: string,
      snapshot: FloorPlanSnapshot
    ): Promise<void> {
      const db = await getDb();
      const entry: FloorPlanCacheEntry = {
        venueId,
        date: todayDateKey(),
        snapshot,
      };
      await db.put(FLOOR_PLAN_SNAPSHOTS_STORE, entry, venueId);
    }
    export async function evictStaleEntries(today: string): Promise<void> {
      const db = await getDb();
      await Promise.all([
        evictStaleFromStore(db, RESERVATIONS_STORE, today),
        evictStaleFromStore(db, FLOOR_PLAN_SNAPSHOTS_STORE, today),
      ]);
    }
    async function evictStaleFromStore(
      db: IDBPDatabase<OfflineCacheSchema>,
      storeName: "reservations" | "floorPlanSnapshots",
      today: string
    ): Promise<void> {
      const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
      let cursor = await tx.store.openCursor();
      while (cursor) {
        if (cursor.value.date !== today) {
          await cursor.delete();
        }
        cursor = await cursor.continue();
      }
      await tx.done;
    }

  <file path="src/lib/sse-client.ts">
    export type FetchEventSourceFn = typeof fetchEventSource;
    export interface SseClientOptions {
      /** Base URL for the SSE stream (query params appended by SseClient). */
      url: string;
      /** Named event types to listen for (e.g. "reservation:created"). */
      eventTypes: readonly string[];
      /** Called with a parsed event payload on each successfully parsed message. */
      onEvent: (type: string, payload: unknown) => void;
      /** Called when a parse error occurs or the connection errors. */
      onError: (error: Error) => void;
      /** Called when the stream opens successfully. */
      onConnected?: () => void;
      /** Called when the connection closes due to an error. */
      onDisconnected?: () => void;
      /** Returns the current bearer token for the Authorization header, or null/undefined for none. */
      getAccessToken?: () => string | null | undefined;
      /** Injectable fetchEventSource implementation — defaults to the real one. */
      fetchEventSourceImpl?: FetchEventSourceFn;
    }
    class ConnectionClosed extends Error {}
    export class SseClient {
      private readonly options: Required<
        Pick<SseClientOptions, "onConnected" | "onDisconnected" | "fetchEventSourceImpl">
      > &
        SseClientOptions;
      private abortController: AbortController | null = null;
      private reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      private reconnectAttempts = 0;
      private lastEventId: string | null = null;
    
      constructor(options: SseClientOptions) {
        this.options = {
          onConnected: () => undefined,
          onDisconnected: () => undefined,
          fetchEventSourceImpl: fetchEventSource,
          ...options,
        };
      }
    
      /** Open the SSE connection. No-op if already connected. */
      connect(): void {
        if (this.abortController !== null) return;
        this.openConnection();
      }
    
      /** Close the connection and cancel any pending reconnect. */
      disconnect(): void {
        this.clearReconnectTimer();
        this.closeConnection();
      }
    
      private openConnection(): void {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        this.abortController = controller;
    
        const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
        const token = this.options.getAccessToken?.();
        if (token) {
          headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
        }
    
        void this.options
          .fetchEventSourceImpl(this.buildUrl(), {
            headers,
            signal: controller.signal,
            openWhenHidden: true,
            onopen: async (response: Response) => {
              const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type");
              if (!response.ok || !contentType?.startsWith("text/event-stream")) {
                throw new Error(`SSE connection failed: ${response.status}`);
              }
              this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
              this.options.onConnected();
            },
            onmessage: (ev: { event: string; data: string; id: string }) => {
              if (ev.id) {
                this.lastEventId = ev.id;
              }
              if (!this.options.eventTypes.includes(ev.event)) return;
              this.handleRawEvent(ev.event, ev.data);
            },
            onerror: (err: unknown) => {
              this.abortController = null;
              this.options.onError(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error("SSE connection error"));
              this.options.onDisconnected();
              this.scheduleReconnect();
              throw new ConnectionClosed();
            },
          })
          .catch((err: unknown) => {
            if (!(err instanceof ConnectionClosed)) throw err;
          });
      }
    
      private handleRawEvent(type: string, rawData: string): void {
        let payload: unknown;
        try {
          payload = JSON.parse(rawData);
        } catch (err) {
          this.options.onError(
            err instanceof Error
              ? err
              : new Error(`Failed to parse SSE event "${type}": ${String(err)}`)
          );
          return;
        }
        this.options.onEvent(type, payload);
      }
    
      private scheduleReconnect(): void {
        const attempts = this.reconnectAttempts;
        const delay =
          attempts >= MAX_BACKOFF_ATTEMPTS
            ? RATE_LIMIT_COOLDOWN_MS
            : Math.min(INITIAL_BACKOFF_MS * Math.pow(2, attempts), MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
        this.reconnectAttempts = attempts + 1;
    
        this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.reconnectTimer = null;
          this.openConnection();
        }, delay);
      }
    
      private clearReconnectTimer(): void {
        if (this.reconnectTimer !== null) {
          clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
          this.reconnectTimer = null;
        }
      }
    
      private closeConnection(): void {
        if (this.abortController !== null) {
          this.abortController.abort();
          this.abortController = null;
        }
      }
    
      private buildUrl(): string {
        const url = new URL(this.options.url);
        if (this.lastEventId !== null) {
          url.searchParams.set("lastEventId", this.lastEventId);
        }
        return url.toString();
      }
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/lib/venue-theme.ts">
    function expandHex(hex: string): string {
      const h = hex.slice(1);
      return h.length === 3 ? [...h].map((c) => c + c).join("") : h;
    }
    function luminance(hex: string): number {
      const h = expandHex(hex);
      const [r, g, b] = [0, 2, 4].map((i) => {
        const c = parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
        return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
      }) as [number, number, number];
      return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
    }
    export function contrastRatio(a: string, b: string): number {
      const [hi, lo] = [luminance(a), luminance(b)].sort((x, y) => y - x) as [number, number];
      return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05);
    }
    export function onAccentColor(accent: string): string {
      return contrastRatio(accent, LIGHT_ON_ACCENT) >= contrastRatio(accent, DARK_ON_ACCENT)
        ? LIGHT_ON_ACCENT
        : DARK_ON_ACCENT;
    }
    function channel(hex: string, index: number): number {
      return parseInt(expandHex(hex).slice(index, index + 2), 16);
    }
    function toHexByte(value: number): string {
      return Math.round(value).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    }
    export function deriveAccentHover(accent: string): string {
      const toward = onAccentColor(accent);
      const shifted = [0, 2, 4].map((i) => {
        const from = channel(accent, i);
        return from + (channel(toward, i) - from) * HOVER_SHIFT;
      });
      return `#${shifted.map(toHexByte).join("")}`;
    }
    export function paletteToTheme(palette: readonly string[]): VenueTheme | null {
      const [accent] = palette;
      if (accent === undefined) return null;
      return { accent, accentHover: deriveAccentHover(accent), source: "extracted" };
    }
    export type ThemeContrastFailure = "accent-text" | "accent-surface" | "text-surface";
    export interface ThemeContrastResult {
      ok: boolean;
      failures: ThemeContrastFailure[];
    }
    export function checkThemeContrast(theme: VenueTheme): ThemeContrastResult {
      const failures: ThemeContrastFailure[] = [];
      const surface = theme.surface ?? STOCK_SURFACE;
      if (contrastRatio(theme.accent, onAccentColor(theme.accent)) < 4.5) failures.push("accent-text");
      if (contrastRatio(theme.accent, surface) < 3) failures.push("accent-surface");
      const text = theme.textPrimary ?? STOCK_TEXT;
      const surfaces = [surface, theme.surfaceElevated].filter((s): s is string => !!s);
      if (surfaces.some((s) => contrastRatio(text, s) < 4.5)) failures.push("text-surface");
      return { ok: failures.length === 0, failures };
    }
    export function parseVenueTheme(settings: object | null | undefined): VenueTheme | null {
      const parsed = VenueThemeSchema.safeParse(
        (settings as { theme?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.theme
      );
      if (!parsed.success || !checkThemeContrast(parsed.data).ok) return null;
      return parsed.data;
    }
    export function themeToCssVars(theme: VenueTheme): Record<string, string> {
      const vars: Record<string, string> = {
        "--rialto-accent": theme.accent,
        "--rialto-accent-hover": theme.accentHover,
        "--rialto-text-on-accent": onAccentColor(theme.accent),
      };
      if (theme.surface) vars["--rialto-surface"] = theme.surface;
      if (theme.surfaceElevated) vars["--rialto-surface-elevated"] = theme.surfaceElevated;
      if (theme.textPrimary) vars["--rialto-text-primary"] = theme.textPrimary;
      return vars;
    }
  </file>
  </section>

  <file path="src/components/menus/price.ts">
    export function parsePriceToCents(text: string): number | null {
      const match = PRICE_PATTERN.exec(text.trim());
      if (!match) return null;
      const [, whole = "", fraction = ""] = match;
      return Number(whole) * 100 + Number(fraction.padEnd(2, "0"));
    }
    export function formatCentsForInput(cents: number): string {
      return (cents / 100).toFixed(2);
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/menus/reorder.ts">
    export function moveId(ids: readonly string[], id: string, toIndex: number): string[] {
      const from = ids.indexOf(id);
      if (from === -1) return [...ids];
      const rest = ids.filter((other) => other !== id);
      rest.splice(Math.min(Math.max(toIndex, 0), rest.length), 0, id);
      return rest;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/menus/useDragReorder.ts">
    export function useDragReorder(ids: readonly string[], onReorder: (ids: string[]) => void) {
      const draggedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    
      return {
        handleProps: (id: string) => ({
          draggable: true as const,
          onDragStart: (event: DragEvent) => {
            draggedRef.current = id;
            if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
          },
        }),
        rowProps: (id: string) => ({
          onDragOver: (event: DragEvent) => {
            if (draggedRef.current) event.preventDefault();
          },
          onDrop: (event: DragEvent) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            const from = draggedRef.current;
            draggedRef.current = null;
            if (from && from !== id) onReorder(moveId(ids, from, ids.indexOf(id)));
          },
        }),
      };
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/pages/timeline-focus.ts">
    export const DETAILS_SURFACE_TEST_ID = "reservation-details-surface";
    export const DETAILS_SIDEBAR_TEST_ID = "reservation-detail-sidebar";
    export function blockTarget(reservationId: string): FocusTarget {
      return { kind: "testId", testId: `reservation-block-${reservationId}` };
    }
    export interface SurfaceState {
      /** The reservation the surface is showing, whichever form it takes. */
      readonly openId: string | null;
      /** Phone and tablet show it as a modal Drawer, so what is behind it is out of reach. */
      readonly modal: boolean;
      /** A dialog held the surface in its old form, and the one its buttons are in is about to go. */
      readonly changingForm: boolean;
      /**
       * Counts the times the dialogs were closed because their party left the surface. Nothing else can
       * close a dialog mid-save, so a send that sees this change has lost the dialog that would show its
       * failure, even if the same party is back on the surface.
       */
      readonly dialogEpoch: number;
    }
    function insideSurface(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
      return (
        document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${DETAILS_SURFACE_TEST_ID}"]`)?.contains(element) ?? false
      );
    }
    export function returnFocusTarget(
      surface: SurfaceState,
      opener: HTMLElement | null,
      fallback: FocusTarget | null
    ): FocusTarget | null {
      const usable =
        opener?.isConnected && !surface.changingForm && (!surface.modal || insideSurface(opener));
      if (opener && usable) return { kind: "element", element: opener };
      return surface.modal ? SURFACE_TARGET : fallback;
    }
    export function walkInFocusTarget(viewport: Viewport, reservationId: string): FocusTarget {
      return viewport === "desktop" ? blockTarget(reservationId) : SURFACE_TARGET;
    }
    export function captureOpener(clicked?: HTMLElement): HTMLElement | null {
      if (clicked) return clicked;
      const active = document.activeElement;
      return active instanceof HTMLElement && active !== document.body ? active : null;
    }
    export function seatedFocusTarget(
      surface: SurfaceState,
      reservationId: string
    ): FocusTarget | null {
      if (surface.openId !== null && surface.openId !== reservationId) return null;
      if (!focusIsLoose() && !focusIsInSurface()) return null;
      const onModal = surface.openId !== null && surface.modal;
      const testId = onModal ? RESERVATION_EDIT_TEST_ID : `reservation-block-${reservationId}`;
      return byTestId(testId) ? { kind: "testId", testId } : null;
    }
    export function useCloseHoldingFocus(): (close: () => void) => void {
      const heldRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
      useEffect(() => {
        const held = heldRef.current;
        if (!held) return;
        heldRef.current = null;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => held.focus());
      });
      return (close) => {
        const active = document.activeElement;
        heldRef.current =
          active instanceof HTMLElement &&
          active.closest('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"], [role="alertdialog"][aria-modal="true"]')
            ? active
            : null;
        close();
      };
    }
    export function useBlockAfterRestore(): (reservationId: string) => void {
      const requestedRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
      useEffect(() => {
        const id = requestedRef.current;
        if (!id) return;
        requestedRef.current = null;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          const active = document.activeElement;
          const stale =
            !active ||
            active === document.body ||
            (active.getAttribute("data-testid")?.startsWith(BLOCK_TEST_ID_PREFIX) === true &&
              active.getAttribute("data-testid") !== `${BLOCK_TEST_ID_PREFIX}${id}`);
          if (stale) (byTestId(`${BLOCK_TEST_ID_PREFIX}${id}`) as HTMLElement | null)?.focus();
        });
      });
      return (reservationId) => {
        requestedRef.current = reservationId;
      };
    }
    export function useOnChange<T>(value: T, onChange: () => void): void {
      const [seen, setSeen] = useState(value);
      if (value !== seen) {
        setSeen(value);
        onChange();
      }
    }
    interface DetailsSurfaceInput {
      readonly viewport: Viewport;
      readonly selectedId: string | null;
      readonly selectedReservation: Reservation | null;
      readonly dialogOpen: boolean;
      readonly dialogEpoch: number;
    }
    interface DetailsSurface {
      /** Which form the surface takes. */
      readonly surfaceViewport: Viewport;
      /** What the tablet sheet renders, including closed across a Seat now's selection gap. */
      readonly sheetReservation: Reservation | null;
      /** For use after an `await`: the surface when the response arrived, not when it was sent. */
      readonly surfaceRef: RefObject<SurfaceState>;
    }
    export function useDetailsSurface({
      viewport,
      selectedId,
      selectedReservation,
      dialogOpen,
      dialogEpoch,
    }: DetailsSurfaceInput): DetailsSurface {
      // It follows the viewport, except while a dialog is open: a sheet mounting under a dialog takes
      // focus and the Escape layer from it. A frame late, so a closing overlay's own focus restore has
      // run before a new surface takes focus.
      const [surfaceViewport, setSurfaceViewport] = useState(viewport);
      useEffect(() => {
        if (dialogOpen || surfaceViewport === viewport) return;
        const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => setSurfaceViewport(viewport));
        return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      }, [dialogOpen, surfaceViewport, viewport]);
    
      // Seat now selects a reservation the refetch has yet to bring. The sheet stays mounted, closed,
      // across that gap: unmounting it would schedule a focus restore that could land on the old party's
      // block behind the new sheet, and only the same Drawer reopening can cancel it.
      const [heldReservation, setHeldReservation] = useState<Reservation | null>(null);
      const sheetReservation = selectedReservation ?? (selectedId ? heldReservation : null);
      if (sheetReservation !== heldReservation) setHeldReservation(sheetReservation);
    
      const surfaceRef = useRef<SurfaceState>({
        openId: null,
        modal: false,
        changingForm: false,
        dialogEpoch: 0,
      });
      useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const open = selectedReservation !== null;
        surfaceRef.current = {
          openId: selectedReservation?.id ?? null,
          modal: viewport !== "desktop" && open,
          changingForm: open && surfaceViewport !== viewport,
          dialogEpoch,
        };
      });
    
      return { surfaceViewport, sheetReservation, surfaceRef };
    }

    export function walkInSentence(
      created: Reservation,
      tableName: string | undefined,
      t: TFunction
    ): string {
      const who = created.guestName ? created.guestName : t("timeline.announce.aWalkIn");
      const size = created.partySize;
      return tableName
        ? t("timeline.announce.walkInSeatedAt", { who, size, table: tableName })
        : t("timeline.announce.walkInSeated", { who, size });
    }
    export function seatedSentence(
      reservation: Reservation,
      tableName: string | undefined,
      t: TFunction
    ): string {
      const guest = reservation.guestName || t("timeline.announce.theGuest");
      return tableName
        ? t("timeline.announce.seatedAt", { guest, table: tableName })
        : t("timeline.announce.seated", { guest });
    }
    export function cancelledSentence(reservation: Reservation, t: TFunction): string {
      return reservation.guestName
        ? t("timeline.announce.cancelledNamed", { name: reservation.guestName })
        : t("timeline.announce.cancelled");
    }
    export function noShowSentence(reservation: Reservation, t: TFunction): string {
      return reservation.guestName
        ? t("timeline.announce.noShowNamed", { name: reservation.guestName })
        : t("timeline.announce.noShow");
    }
    export function seatNotFinishedSentence(reservation: Reservation, t: TFunction): string {
      return reservation.guestName
        ? t("timeline.announce.seatNotFinishedNamed", { name: reservation.guestName })
        : t("timeline.announce.seatNotFinished");
    }
    export function notAppliedSentence(reservation: Reservation, t: TFunction): string {
      return reservation.guestName
        ? t("timeline.announce.changeFailedNamed", { name: reservation.guestName })
        : t("timeline.announce.changeFailed");
    }
    export function savedSentence(reservation: Reservation, t: TFunction): string {
      return reservation.guestName
        ? t("timeline.announce.savedNamed", { name: reservation.guestName })
        : t("timeline.announce.saved");
    }
    export function loadedSentence(
      date: string,
      todayStr: string,
      locale: string,
      t: TFunction
    ): string {
      return date === todayStr
        ? t("timeline.announce.loadedTonight")
        : t("timeline.announce.loadedDate", { date: formatServiceDate(date, locale) });
    }

  <section priority="medium" role="rehearsal">
  <file path="src/components/rehearsal/rehearsal-state.ts">
    export interface RehearsalWaiting {
      reservationId: string;
      partySize: number;
      /** Minutes since midnight at which the walk-in started waiting. */
      since: number;
    }
    export interface RehearsalMetrics {
      coversServed: number;
      averageTurnMinutes: number;
      /** Hour of day with the most seatings so far, or null before anyone sat. */
      peakHour: number | null;
      /** Of `tableIds` (or every table in the events), those no party has sat at yet. */
      tablesNeverSat: number;
      longestWalkInWaitMinutes: number;
    }
    export interface RehearsalState {
      reservations: Reservation[];
      tableStatuses: ReadonlyMap<string, TableDisplayStatus>;
      seatedIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
      waiting: RehearsalWaiting[];
      metrics: RehearsalMetrics;
    }
    export interface RehearsalStateOptions {
      /** Service day (YYYY-MM-DD) stamped on the synthesized reservations. */
      date?: string;
      /** Every table in the room, so `tablesNeverSat` can count tables no event mentions. */
      tableIds?: readonly string[];
    }
    function isoAt(date: string, minutes: number): string {
      const hh = String(Math.floor(minutes / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${date}T${hh}:${mm}:00.000Z`;
    }
    function makeReservation(
      id: string,
      date: string,
      startMinutes: number,
      partySize: number,
      tableId: string
    ): Reservation {
      return {
        id,
        date,
        startTime: isoAt(date, startMinutes),
        endTime: isoAt(date, startMinutes + DEFAULT_STAY_MINUTES),
        partySize,
        status: "CONFIRMED",
        notes: null,
        cancellationReason: null,
        cancellationNote: null,
        guestName: null,
        guestEmail: null,
        guestPhone: null,
        guestId: null,
        userId: null,
        occasion: null,
        seatingPreference: null,
        tableId,
        venueId: null,
        createdAt: isoAt(date, startMinutes),
        updatedAt: isoAt(date, startMinutes),
      };
    }
    export function rehearsalStateAt(
      events: readonly RehearsalEvent[],
      t: number,
      { date = DEFAULT_DATE, tableIds }: RehearsalStateOptions = {}
    ): RehearsalState {
      const reservations = new Map<string, Reservation>();
      const tableBase = new Map<string, TableDisplayStatus>();
      const pendingArrival = new Map<string, { tableId: string; arrivesAt: number }>();
      const seatedAt = new Map<string, number>();
      const seatedIds = new Set<string>();
      const waitingSince = new Map<string, RehearsalWaiting>();
      const seatHours = new Map<string, number>();
      const tablesSat = new Set<string>();
      const seenTables = new Set<string>();
      const turns: number[] = [];
      let coversServed = 0;
      let longestWait = 0;
    
      const setStatus = (id: string, status: Reservation["status"]) => {
        const r = reservations.get(id);
        if (r) reservations.set(id, { ...r, status });
      };
    
      for (const e of events) {
        if (e.at > t) break;
        if ("tableId" in e) seenTables.add(e.tableId);
        switch (e.type) {
          case "booked":
            reservations.set(
              e.reservationId,
              makeReservation(e.reservationId, date, e.arrivesAt, e.partySize, e.tableId)
            );
            pendingArrival.set(e.reservationId, { tableId: e.tableId, arrivesAt: e.arrivesAt });
            break;
          case "walk-in-waiting":
            waitingSince.set(e.reservationId, {
              reservationId: e.reservationId,
              partySize: e.partySize,
              since: e.at,
            });
            break;
          case "seated": {
            const wait = waitingSince.get(e.reservationId);
            if (wait) longestWait = Math.max(longestWait, e.at - wait.since);
            waitingSince.delete(e.reservationId);
            pendingArrival.delete(e.reservationId);
            if (!reservations.has(e.reservationId)) {
              reservations.set(
                e.reservationId,
                makeReservation(e.reservationId, date, e.at, e.partySize, e.tableId)
              );
            }
            seatedIds.add(e.reservationId);
            seatedAt.set(e.reservationId, e.at);
            coversServed += e.partySize;
            tablesSat.add(e.tableId);
            const hour = Math.floor(e.at / 60);
            seatHours.set(String(hour), (seatHours.get(String(hour)) ?? 0) + 1);
            break;
          }
          case "status-change":
            tableBase.set(e.tableId, STATUS_FOR_TABLE_EVENT[e.status]);
            break;
          case "no-show":
            pendingArrival.delete(e.reservationId);
            setStatus(e.reservationId, "NO_SHOW");
            break;
          case "departed": {
            seatedIds.delete(e.reservationId);
            setStatus(e.reservationId, "COMPLETED");
            const start = seatedAt.get(e.reservationId);
            if (start !== undefined) turns.push(e.at - start);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    
      const tableStatuses = new Map(tableBase);
      for (const { tableId, arrivesAt } of pendingArrival.values()) {
        const base = tableStatuses.get(tableId);
        if (
          (base === undefined || base === "available") &&
          arrivesAt - t <= RESERVED_SOON_WINDOW_MINUTES
        ) {
          tableStatuses.set(tableId, "reserved-soon");
        }
      }
    
      const waiting = [...waitingSince.values()];
      for (const w of waiting) longestWait = Math.max(longestWait, t - w.since);
    
      let peakHour: number | null = null;
      let peakCount = 0;
      for (const [hour, count] of seatHours) {
        if (count > peakCount) {
          peakCount = count;
          peakHour = Number(hour);
        }
      }
    
      const universe = new Set(tableIds ?? seenTables);
    
      return {
        reservations: [...reservations.values()],
        tableStatuses,
        seatedIds,
        waiting,
        metrics: {
          coversServed,
          averageTurnMinutes: turns.length
            ? Math.round(turns.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / turns.length)
            : 0,
          peakHour,
          tablesNeverSat: [...universe].filter((id) => !tablesSat.has(id)).length,
          longestWalkInWaitMinutes: longestWait,
        },
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/rehearsal/simulate-service.ts">
    interface ProfileShape {
      /** Turns of the whole room across the service. */
      turns: number;
      /** Peak arrival as minutes since midnight, before clamping into service hours. */
      peakMinutes: number;
      spreadMinutes: number;
      walkInShare: number;
      noShowShare: number;
    }
    function createRandom(seed: number): () => number {
      let a = seed >>> 0;
      return () => {
        a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
        let t = a;
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      };
    }
    function gaussian(random: () => number): number {
      const u = Math.max(random(), Number.EPSILON);
      return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * random());
    }
    function pickPartySize(random: () => number, maxSize: number): number {
      const usable = PARTY_SIZE_WEIGHTS.filter(([size]) => size <= maxSize);
      const total = usable.reduce((sum, [, weight]) => sum + weight, 0);
      let roll = random() * total;
      for (const [size, weight] of usable) {
        roll -= weight;
        if (roll <= 0) return size;
      }
      return usable[usable.length - 1]![0];
    }
    function turnMinutes(random: () => number, size: number): number {
      const base = size <= 2 ? 75 : size <= 4 ? 90 : size <= 6 ? 120 : 135;
      return base + Math.round((random() * 20 - 10) / 5) * 5;
    }
    function fits(table: RehearsalTable, size: number): boolean {
      return size >= table.minCovers && size <= table.capacity;
    }
    export function simulateService({
      tables,
      openHour,
      closeHour,
      profile,
      seed,
    }: SimulateServiceInput): RehearsalEvent[] {
      const random = createRandom(seed);
      const shape = PROFILES[profile];
      const open = openHour * 60;
      const close = closeHour * 60;
      const lastArrival = close - LAST_SEATING_BEFORE_CLOSE_MINUTES;
      if (tables.length === 0 || lastArrival <= open) return [];
    
      const maxCapacity = Math.max(...tables.map((t) => t.capacity));
      const totalSeats = tables.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.capacity, 0);
      const partyCount = Math.round((totalSeats / 3) * shape.turns);
      const peak = Math.min(Math.max(shape.peakMinutes, open + 60), lastArrival);
    
      const parties = Array.from({ length: partyCount }, () => {
        const arrival = peak + gaussian(random) * shape.spreadMinutes;
        return {
          arrival: Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(arrival, open), lastArrival) / 5) * 5,
          size: pickPartySize(random, maxCapacity),
          walkIn: random() < shape.walkInShare,
          noShow: random() < shape.noShowShare,
          turn: 0,
        };
      }).sort((a, b) => a.arrival - b.arrival);
      for (const party of parties) party.turn = turnMinutes(random, party.size);
    
      const freeAt = new Map(tables.map((t) => [t.id, open]));
      const log: RehearsalEvent[] = [];
      let walkIns = 0;
      let bookings = 0;
    
      for (const party of parties) {
        const candidates = tables
          .filter((t) => fits(t, party.size))
          .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);
        if (candidates.length === 0) continue;
    
        const free = candidates.find((t) => freeAt.get(t.id)! <= party.arrival);
    
        if (!party.walkIn) {
          if (!free || party.arrival + party.turn + RESET_MINUTES + BUS_MINUTES > close) continue;
          const reservationId = `rehearsal-res-${++bookings}`;
          log.push({
            at: Math.max(open, party.arrival - BOOKING_LEAD_MINUTES),
            type: "booked",
            reservationId,
            partySize: party.size,
            tableId: free.id,
            arrivesAt: party.arrival,
          });
          if (party.noShow) {
            const releasedAt = party.arrival + NO_SHOW_GRACE_MINUTES;
            log.push({ at: releasedAt, type: "no-show", reservationId, tableId: free.id });
            freeAt.set(free.id, releasedAt);
            continue;
          }
          seat(free, reservationId, party.arrival, party.size, party.turn);
          continue;
        }
    
        const earliest = candidates.reduce((best, t) =>
          freeAt.get(t.id)! < freeAt.get(best.id)! ? t : best
        );
        const table = free ?? earliest;
        const seatAt = Math.max(party.arrival, freeAt.get(table.id)!);
        if (seatAt - party.arrival > MAX_WALK_IN_WAIT_MINUTES) continue;
        if (seatAt + party.turn + RESET_MINUTES + BUS_MINUTES > close) continue;
        const reservationId = `rehearsal-walk-in-${++walkIns}`;
        if (seatAt > party.arrival) {
          log.push({
            at: party.arrival,
            type: "walk-in-waiting",
            reservationId,
            partySize: party.size,
          });
        }
        seat(table, reservationId, seatAt, party.size, party.turn);
      }
    
      function seat(
        table: RehearsalTable,
        reservationId: string,
        at: number,
        size: number,
        turn: number
      ) {
        const departAt = at + turn;
        log.push(
          { at, type: "seated", reservationId, partySize: size, tableId: table.id },
          { at, type: "status-change", tableId: table.id, status: "OCCUPIED" },
          { at: departAt, type: "departed", reservationId, tableId: table.id },
          { at: departAt, type: "status-change", tableId: table.id, status: "DIRTY" },
          { at: departAt + BUS_MINUTES, type: "status-change", tableId: table.id, status: "READY" },
          {
            at: departAt + BUS_MINUTES + RESET_MINUTES,
            type: "status-change",
            tableId: table.id,
            status: "AVAILABLE",
          }
        );
        freeAt.set(table.id, departAt + BUS_MINUTES + RESET_MINUTES);
      }
    
      return log
        .map((event, index) => ({ event, index }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.event.at - b.event.at || a.index - b.index)
        .map(({ event }) => event);
    }

  <file path="src/components/rehearsal/use-rehearsal-playback.ts">
    export type RehearsalSpeed = 15 | 60 | 240;
    function subscribeReducedMotion(onChange: () => void): () => void {
      if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") return () => {};
      const query = window.matchMedia(REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY);
      query.addEventListener("change", onChange);
      return () => query.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
    }
    function reducedMotionSnapshot(): boolean {
      return (
        typeof window !== "undefined" &&
        typeof window.matchMedia === "function" &&
        window.matchMedia(REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY).matches
      );
    }
    export interface RehearsalPlayback {
      /** Simulated time, minutes since midnight. */
      time: number;
      /** First and last event times; the clock never leaves this window. */
      start: number;
      end: number;
      playing: boolean;
      speed: RehearsalSpeed;
      /** True under prefers-reduced-motion: `play` is inert, use `step`. */
      reducedMotion: boolean;
      state: RehearsalState;
      play: () => void;
      pause: () => void;
      setSpeed: (speed: RehearsalSpeed) => void;
      scrub: (time: number) => void;
      /** Jump to the next event time (the only way to move under reduced motion). */
      step: () => void;
    }
    export function useRehearsalPlayback(
      events: readonly RehearsalEvent[],
      options: RehearsalStateOptions = {}
    ): RehearsalPlayback {
      const start = events.length ? events[0]!.at : 0;
      const end = events.length ? events[events.length - 1]!.at : 0;
      const reducedMotion = useSyncExternalStore(
        subscribeReducedMotion,
        reducedMotionSnapshot,
        () => false
      );
    
      const [time, setTime] = useState(start);
      const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
      const [speed, setSpeed] = useState<RehearsalSpeed>(DEFAULT_SPEED);
      const timeRef = useRef(time);
    
      const clamp = useCallback((t: number) => Math.min(end, Math.max(start, t)), [start, end]);
      const moveTo = useCallback(
        (t: number) => {
          timeRef.current = clamp(t);
          setTime(timeRef.current);
        },
        [clamp]
      );
    
      const running = playing && !reducedMotion;
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!running) return;
        let last: number | null = null;
        let frame = requestAnimationFrame(function tick(now) {
          if (last !== null) moveTo(timeRef.current + ((now - last) / 1000) * (speed / 60));
          last = now;
          if (timeRef.current >= end) {
            setPlaying(false);
            return;
          }
          frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        });
        return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      }, [running, speed, end, moveTo]);
    
      const step = useCallback(() => {
        const next = events.find((e) => e.at > timeRef.current);
        moveTo(next ? next.at : end);
      }, [events, end, moveTo]);
    
      const minute = Math.floor(time);
      const { date, tableIds } = options;
      const state = useMemo(
        () => rehearsalStateAt(events, minute, { date, tableIds }),
        [events, minute, date, tableIds]
      );
    
      return {
        time,
        start,
        end,
        playing: running,
        speed,
        reducedMotion,
        state,
        play: useCallback(() => setPlaying(true), []),
        pause: useCallback(() => setPlaying(false), []),
        setSpeed,
        scrub: moveTo,
        step,
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/service-fields/service-times.ts">
    export interface LinkedTimes {
      readonly opens: string | null;
      readonly lastSeating: string | null;
      readonly closes: string | null;
      /** While true, last seating follows close minus {@link LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES}. */
      readonly lastSeatingLinked: boolean;
    }
    export type TimeField = "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes";
    export function toMinutes(hhmm: string): number {
      const [h = 0, m = 0] = hhmm.split(":").map(Number);
      return h * 60 + m;
    }
    export function toClock(minutes: number): string {
      const wrapped = ((minutes % MINUTES_PER_DAY) + MINUTES_PER_DAY) % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }
    export function autoLastSeating(closes: string, opens: string | null = null): string {
      const lead = toMinutes(closes) - LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES;
      if (opens === null) return toClock(lead);
      const opensAt = toMinutes(opens);
      const closesAfter = toMinutes(closes) <= opensAt ? MINUTES_PER_DAY : 0;
      return toClock(Math.max(lead + closesAfter, opensAt));
    }
    export function setServiceTime<T extends LinkedTimes>(
      service: T,
      field: TimeField,
      value: string | null
    ): T {
      if (field === "lastSeating") return { ...service, lastSeating: value, lastSeatingLinked: false };
      const next = { ...service, [field]: value };
      // Both ends bound a linked last seating, so moving either one keeps it in step.
      if (!service.lastSeatingLinked) return next;
      return {
        ...next,
        lastSeating: next.closes === null ? null : autoLastSeating(next.closes, next.opens),
      };
    }

    export type NavAction =
      | { readonly type: "route"; readonly path: string }
      | { readonly type: "chat" }
      | { readonly type: "signout" };
    export interface NavActionHandlers {
      navigate: (path: string) => void;
      toggleChat: () => void;
      signOut: () => void;
    }
    export function runNavAction(action: NavAction, handlers: NavActionHandlers): void {
      switch (action.type) {
        case "route":
          handlers.navigate(action.path);
          return;
        case "chat":
          handlers.toggleChat();
          return;
        case "signout":

      }

        items: [

            action: { type: "route", path: SETUP_PATH },

              total: SETUP_STEP_COUNT,
            }),

    }
    function buildOperationalSections(isAdmin: boolean, t: TFunction): readonly NavSection[] {
      const route = (id: string, label: string, path: string): NavItem => ({
        id,
        label,
        action: { type: "route", path },
      });

        items: [
          route("briefing", t("nav.items.tonightsService"), "/briefing"),
          route("timeline", t("nav.items.timeline"), "/timeline"),
          route("reservations", t("nav.items.reservations"), "/reservations"),

        ],
      };

        id: "Manage",
        label: t("nav.sections.manage"),
        items: [
          route(SETUP_ITEM_ID, t("nav.items.venueSetup"), SETUP_PATH),
          route("availability", t("nav.items.availability"), availabilityPath({ view: "hub" })),
          route("menus", t("nav.items.menus"), "/menus"),
          route("booking-widget", t("nav.items.bookingWidget"), "/booking-widget"),
        ],
      };
    
      const account = buildAccount(t);
      return isAdmin ? [PRIMARY, MANAGE, account, buildAdmin(t)] : [PRIMARY, MANAGE, account];
    }
    export function buildNavSections(
      readiness: VenueReadiness,
      isAdmin: boolean,
      t: TFunction = defaultT()
    ): readonly NavSection[] {
      if (readiness.status !== "operational") {
        return buildSetupSections(readiness, isAdmin, t);
      }
      return buildOperationalSections(isAdmin, t);
    }

  <file path="src/test/png-luminance.ts">
    export interface DecodedPng {
      readonly width: number;
      readonly height: number;
      /** Row-major RGBA bytes, `width * height * 4` long. */
      readonly data: Uint8Array;
    }
    function unfilterRow(
      filterType: number,
      row: Uint8Array,
      previous: Uint8Array,
      out: Uint8Array
    ): void {
      for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
        const left = i >= RGBA_CHANNELS ? out[i - RGBA_CHANNELS]! : 0;
        const up = previous[i]!;
        const upLeft = i >= RGBA_CHANNELS ? previous[i - RGBA_CHANNELS]! : 0;
        let value: number;
        switch (filterType) {
          case 0:
            value = row[i]!;
            break;
          case 1:
            value = row[i]! + left;
            break;
          case 2:
            value = row[i]! + up;
            break;
          case 3:
            value = row[i]! + ((left + up) >> 1);
            break;
          case 4: {
            const predictor = left + up - upLeft;
            const dLeft = Math.abs(predictor - left);
            const dUp = Math.abs(predictor - up);
            const dUpLeft = Math.abs(predictor - upLeft);
            const paeth = dLeft <= dUp && dLeft <= dUpLeft ? left : dUp <= dUpLeft ? up : upLeft;
            value = row[i]! + paeth;
            break;
          }
          default:
            throw new Error(`Unsupported PNG filter type ${filterType}`);
        }
        out[i] = value & 0xff;
      }
    }
    export function decodePng(bytes: Buffer): DecodedPng {
      if (!bytes.subarray(0, PNG_SIGNATURE.length).equals(PNG_SIGNATURE)) {
        throw new Error("Not a PNG");
      }
      const width = bytes.readUInt32BE(16);
      const height = bytes.readUInt32BE(20);
      const bitDepth = bytes[24];
      const colorType = bytes[25];
      const interlace = bytes[28];
      if (bitDepth !== EIGHT_BIT || colorType !== COLOR_TYPE_RGBA || interlace !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `Unsupported PNG: bitDepth=${bitDepth} colorType=${colorType} interlace=${interlace}`
        );
      }
    
      const idat: Buffer[] = [];
      let offset = PNG_SIGNATURE.length;
      while (offset + 8 <= bytes.length) {
        const length = bytes.readUInt32BE(offset);
        if (bytes.toString("ascii", offset + 4, offset + 8) === "IDAT") {
          idat.push(bytes.subarray(offset + 8, offset + 8 + length));
        }
        offset += 12 + length;
      }
    
      const raw = inflateSync(Buffer.concat(idat));
      const stride = width * RGBA_CHANNELS;
      const data = new Uint8Array(height * stride);
      let previous = new Uint8Array(stride);
      for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        const start = y * (stride + 1);
        const out = new Uint8Array(stride);
        unfilterRow(raw[start]!, raw.subarray(start + 1, start + 1 + stride), previous, out);
        data.set(out, y * stride);
        previous = out;
      }
      return { width, height, data };
    }
    export function relativeLuminance(r: number, g: number, b: number): number {
      const channel = (value: number): number => {
        const s = value / 255;
        return s <= 0.04045 ? s / 12.92 : ((s + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
      };
      return 0.2126 * channel(r) + 0.7152 * channel(g) + 0.0722 * channel(b);
    }
    export function contrastRatio(a: number, b: number): number {
      return (Math.max(a, b) + 0.05) / (Math.min(a, b) + 0.05);
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/components/timeline/guest-signal-badge.ts">
    export interface GuestSignalBadge {
      /** How late the guest said they would be. */
      minutes: number;
      /** The expected arrival: the reservation start + `minutes`, as a UTC ISO instant. */
      eta: string;
      /**
       * The table is held for the party: true until the ETA. A late signal can be sent up to 45
       * minutes after the start, so its ETA may already be past on arrival; the plan does not define
       * that case, so it is handled as "held = false": the guest told us they are coming (the badge
       * stays, announced as past ETA) but nothing says the table is still reserved for them.
       */
      held: boolean;
    }
    export type GuestSignals = ReadonlyMap<string, GuestSignalEventData>;
    export function reduceGuestSignals(signals: GuestSignals, event: SseEvent): GuestSignals {
      if (event.type === "reservation:guest-signal") {
        const next = new Map(signals);
        next.set(event.data.reservationId, event.data);
        return next;
      }
      if (CLEARING_EVENTS.has(event.type)) {
        const id = (event.data as Partial<Pick<Reservation, "id">> | null)?.id;
        if (id === undefined || !signals.has(id)) return signals;
        const next = new Map(signals);
        next.delete(id);
        return next;
      }
      return signals;
    }
    export interface GuestSignalBadgeInput {
      signal: GuestSignalEventData | undefined;
      reservation: Pick<Reservation, "status" | "startTime">;
      /** The party is on its table now. */
      seated: boolean;
      now: Date;
    }
    export function deriveGuestSignalBadge({
      signal,
      reservation,
      seated,
      now,
    }: GuestSignalBadgeInput): GuestSignalBadge | null {
      if (!signal || signal.kind !== "running-late" || seated) return null;
      if (reservation.status !== "CONFIRMED") return null;
      const { minutes, eta } = signal;
      if (minutes === undefined || eta === undefined) return null;
      const etaMs = new Date(eta).getTime();
      const startMs = new Date(reservation.startTime).getTime();
      if (Number.isNaN(etaMs) || Number.isNaN(startMs)) return null;
      if (startMs + minutes * 60_000 !== etaMs) return null;
      return { minutes, eta, held: now.getTime() < etaMs };
    }
    export function badgesByTableId(
      reservations: readonly Pick<Reservation, "id" | "tableId">[],
      badges: ReadonlyMap<string, GuestSignalBadge>
    ): ReadonlyMap<string, GuestSignalBadge> {
      const byTable = new Map<string, GuestSignalBadge>();
      for (const reservation of reservations) {
        const badge = badges.get(reservation.id);
        if (!badge) continue;
        const existing = byTable.get(reservation.tableId);
        if (!existing || badge.eta < existing.eta) byTable.set(reservation.tableId, badge);
      }
      return byTable;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/timeline/reservationLayout.ts">
    export interface ReservationLayoutParams {
      startHour: number;
      hourWidth: number;
      isMobile: boolean;
      /** The service day the grid shows (ADR-029: a reservation's `date`). */
      serviceDate: string;
      /** The venue's IANA zone; positions are venue wall-clock. Omitted: the device clock. */
      timeZone?: string;
    }
    export interface ReservationLayoutResult {
      left: number;
      width: number;
    }
    export function serviceDayMinute(instant: Date, serviceDate: string, timeZone?: string): number {
      const minute = minutesOfDayIn(instant, timeZone);
      const day = venueDate(instant, timeZone);
      if (day === addDays(serviceDate, 1)) return MINUTES_PER_DAY + minute;
      if (day === addDays(serviceDate, -1)) return minute - MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      return minute;
    }
    export function computeReservationLayout(
      startTime: string,
      endTime: string,
      { startHour, hourWidth, isMobile, serviceDate, timeZone }: ReservationLayoutParams
    ): ReservationLayoutResult {
      const startMinutes = serviceDayMinute(new Date(startTime), serviceDate, timeZone);
      const endMinutes = serviceDayMinute(new Date(endTime), serviceDate, timeZone);
      const startOffset = startMinutes - startHour * 60;
      const duration = endMinutes - startMinutes;
    
      const left = (startOffset / 60) * hourWidth;
      const width = Math.max((duration / 60) * hourWidth - 4, isMobile ? 30 : 40);
    
      return { left, width };
    }

  <file path="src/components/timeline/seat-guest.ts">
    export const RESERVATION_EDIT_TEST_ID = "reservation-edit";
    export function findReservationTable(
      reservation: Reservation,
      tables: readonly Table[]
    ): Table | undefined {
      return tables.find((table) => table.id === reservation.tableId);
    }
    export function statusWord(reservation: Reservation, seated: boolean, t: TFunction): string {
      return t(seated ? "timeline.status.seated" : RESERVATION_STATUS_KEYS[reservation.status]);
    }
    function isOccupiedByThisReservation(reservation: Reservation, now: Date): boolean {
      if (reservation.status !== "CONFIRMED") return false;
      const start = new Date(reservation.startTime).getTime();
      const at = now.getTime();
      if (Number.isNaN(start) || Number.isNaN(at)) return false;
      return at >= start - SEATED_EARLY_WINDOW_MS;
    }
    export function occupiedCaption(
      reservation: Reservation,
      table: Table | undefined,
      now: Date,
      t: TFunction
    ): string | null {
      if (!isSeatableStatus(reservation) || table?.status !== "OCCUPIED") return null;
      if (isOccupiedByThisReservation(reservation, now)) return null;
      return t("timeline.details.occupied", { table: table.name });
    }
    export interface SeatGuestState {
      /** True while `onSeat` is pending — Seat Guest reads "Seating…" and the other actions rest. */
      readonly seating: boolean;
      /** The last rejection, rendered as "Guest not seated." until the next attempt. */
      readonly failure: ApiErrorDescription | null;
      /** Attach to the Seat Guest button so focus can return to it after a failure. */
      readonly seatRef: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
      readonly seat: () => Promise<void>;
    }
    export interface SeatFlights {
      /** True while a seat for this reservation is pending. */
      readonly seating: (reservationId: string) => boolean;
      /** The last rejection for this reservation, while it is the current one. */
      readonly failure: (reservationId: string) => ApiErrorDescription | null;
      /** Sends unless a seat for this reservation is already pending. Rejections become `failure`. */
      readonly run: (reservationId: string, send: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void>;
    }
    export function useSeatFlights(currentId: string | null): SeatFlights {
      const [seatingIds, setSeatingIds] = useState<readonly string[]>([]);
      const [failed, setFailed] = useState<{
        readonly id: string;
        readonly description: ApiErrorDescription;
      } | null>(null);
      if (failed && failed.id !== currentId) setFailed(null);
    
      const inFlightRef = useRef<readonly string[]>([]);
      const currentRef = useRef(currentId);
      useLayoutEffect(() => {
        currentRef.current = currentId;
      });
    
      const run = useCallback(async (id: string, send: () => Promise<void>) => {
        if (inFlightRef.current.includes(id)) return;
        inFlightRef.current = [...inFlightRef.current, id];
        setSeatingIds(inFlightRef.current);
        setFailed(null);
        try {
          await send();
        } catch (err) {
          if (currentRef.current === id) setFailed({ id, description: describeApiError(err) });
        } finally {
          inFlightRef.current = inFlightRef.current.filter((other) => other !== id);
          setSeatingIds(inFlightRef.current);
        }
      }, []);
    
      return {
        seating: (id) => seatingIds.includes(id),
        failure: (id) => (failed?.id === id ? failed.description : null),
        run,
      };
    }
    export interface SeatGuestState {
      /** True while this reservation's seat is pending: Seat Guest reads "Seating…", the rest rest. */
      readonly seating: boolean;
      /** This reservation's last rejection, rendered as "Guest not seated." until the next attempt. */
      readonly failure: ApiErrorDescription | null;
      /** Attach to the Seat Guest button so focus can return to it after a failure. */
      readonly seatRef: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
      readonly seat: () => Promise<void>;
    }
    export function useSeatGuest(
      reservationId: string,
      onSeat: () => Promise<void>,
      shared?: SeatFlights
    ): SeatGuestState {
      const own = useSeatFlights(reservationId);
      const flights = shared ?? own;
      const failure = flights.failure(reservationId);
      const seatRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
      const { focusAfter } = useFocusAfter();
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const element = seatRef.current;
        if (failure && element) focusAfter({ kind: "element", element }, UNLESS_COVERED);
      }, [failure, focusAfter]);
    
      return {
        seating: flights.seating(reservationId),
        failure,
        seatRef,
        seat: () => flights.run(reservationId, onSeat),
      };
    }

    export interface TableStatusMenuItem {
      id: TableStatus;
      label: string;
    }
    export function tableStatusWord(status: TableStatus, t: TFunction): string {
      if (status in TABLE_STATUS_KEYS) return t(TABLE_STATUS_KEYS[status]);
      // A status this build does not know (an API ahead of it): title-case the raw value.
      const lower = status.toLowerCase();
      return lower.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + lower.slice(1);
    }
    export function tableStatusInline(status: TableStatus, t: TFunction, locale: string): string {
      return tableStatusWord(status, t).toLocaleLowerCase(locale);
    }
    export function tableStatusMenuItems(
      status: TableStatus,
      t: TFunction,
      locale: string
    ): TableStatusMenuItem[] {
      if (!(status in TABLE_VALID_TRANSITIONS)) return [];
      return TABLE_VALID_TRANSITIONS[status].map((next) => ({
        id: next,
        label: t("timeline.tableMenu.mark", { status: tableStatusInline(next, t, locale) }),
      }));
    }

  <file path="src/components/timeline/useGridFocus.ts">
    export interface GridCoordinate {
      row: number;
      col: number;
    }
    export interface UseGridFocusParams {
      rowCount: number;
      colCount: number;
      initial?: GridCoordinate;
    }
    export interface UseGridFocusResult {
      active: GridCoordinate;
      setActive: (coord: GridCoordinate) => void;
      moveUp: () => void;
      moveDown: () => void;
      moveLeft: () => void;
      moveRight: () => void;
      handleKeyDown: (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => void;
    }
    function clamp(value: number, count: number): number {
      if (count <= 0) return 0;
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(value, count - 1));
    }
    export function useGridFocus({
      rowCount,
      colCount,
      initial = { row: 0, col: 0 },
    }: UseGridFocusParams): UseGridFocusResult {
      const [active, setActive] = useState<GridCoordinate>(initial);
    
      const move = useCallback(
        (deltaRow: number, deltaCol: number) => {
          if (rowCount <= 0 || colCount <= 0) return;
          setActive((current) => ({
            row: clamp(current.row + deltaRow, rowCount),
            col: clamp(current.col + deltaCol, colCount),
          }));
        },
        [rowCount, colCount]
      );
    
      const moveUp = useCallback(() => move(-1, 0), [move]);
      const moveDown = useCallback(() => move(1, 0), [move]);
      const moveLeft = useCallback(() => move(0, -1), [move]);
      const moveRight = useCallback(() => move(0, 1), [move]);
    
      const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
        (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
          switch (e.key) {
            case "ArrowUp":
              e.preventDefault();
              moveUp();
              break;
            case "ArrowDown":
              e.preventDefault();
              moveDown();
              break;
            case "ArrowLeft":
              e.preventDefault();
              moveLeft();
              break;
            case "ArrowRight":
              e.preventDefault();
              moveRight();
              break;
          }
        },
        [moveUp, moveDown, moveLeft, moveRight]
      );
    
      return { active, setActive, moveUp, moveDown, moveLeft, moveRight, handleKeyDown };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/timeline/useScrollToNow.ts">
    export const NOW_LINE_VIEWPORT_FRACTION = 0.25;
    export function useScrollToNow(
      scrollRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
      currentTimeOffset: number | null,
      tableColumnWidth: number
    ): void {
      const { precision } = useMotionPreset();
      const behavior: ScrollBehavior = precision.duration === 0 ? "instant" : "smooth";
      const hasNowLine = currentTimeOffset !== null;
    
      // The scroll effect keys on hasNowLine alone; it reads the rest here so the
      // minute tick (a new offset every minute) never re-scrolls the host.
      const latestRef = useRef({ currentTimeOffset, tableColumnWidth, behavior });
      useEffect(() => {
        latestRef.current = { currentTimeOffset, tableColumnWidth, behavior };
      });
    
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!hasNowLine) return;
        const element = scrollRef.current;
        const {
          currentTimeOffset: offset,
          tableColumnWidth: column,
          behavior: how,
        } = latestRef.current;
        if (!element || offset === null) return;
    
        const left = Math.max(0, column + offset - element.clientWidth * NOW_LINE_VIEWPORT_FRACTION);
        if (typeof element.scrollTo === "function") {
          element.scrollTo({ left, behavior: how });
        } else {
          // jsdom has no Element.scrollTo; the instant path is a plain assignment.
          element.scrollLeft = left;
        }
      }, [hasNowLine, scrollRef]);
    }
  </file>

    export function visitLabel(visitCount: number, t: TFunction, locale: string): string {
      const category = new Intl.PluralRules(locale, { type: "ordinal" }).select(visitCount);
      switch (category) {
        case "one":
          return t("timeline.visitOrdinalOne", { count: visitCount });
        case "two":
          return t("timeline.visitOrdinalTwo", { count: visitCount });
        case "few":
          return t("timeline.visitOrdinalFew", { count: visitCount });
        default:
          return t("timeline.visitOrdinalOther", { count: visitCount });
      }
    }

  <file path="src/utils/calendarLinks.ts">
    export interface BuildCalendarLinkOptions {
      /** Guest-facing cancellation/manage-reservation link, included in the event description. */
      cancellationUrl?: string;
    }
    function buildEventTitle(venue: IcsVenue): string {
      return `${venue.name} Reservation`;
    }
    function buildEventDescription(reservation: IcsReservation, cancellationUrl?: string): string {
      const partyLine = `Party of ${reservation.partySize}.`;
      return cancellationUrl ? `${partyLine} Cancel or modify: ${cancellationUrl}` : partyLine;
    }
    export function buildGoogleCalendarUrl(
      reservation: IcsReservation,
      venue: IcsVenue,
      opts: BuildCalendarLinkOptions = {}
    ): string {
      const start = formatIcsLocalDateTime(reservation.startTime, venue.ianaTimezone);
      const end = formatIcsLocalDateTime(reservation.endTime, venue.ianaTimezone);
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        action: "TEMPLATE",
        text: buildEventTitle(venue),
        dates: `${start}/${end}`,
        details: buildEventDescription(reservation, opts.cancellationUrl),
        location: venue.name,
        ctz: venue.ianaTimezone,
      });
      return `https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?${params.toString()}`;
    }
    function pad2(value: number): string {
      return String(value).padStart(2, "0");
    }
    function formatUtcOffset(offsetMinutes: number): string {
      const sign = offsetMinutes < 0 ? "-" : "+";
      const abs = Math.abs(offsetMinutes);
      return `${sign}${pad2(Math.floor(abs / 60))}:${pad2(abs % 60)}`;
    }
    function formatIsoWithOffset(isoInstant: string, timeZone: string): string {
      const local = formatIcsLocalDateTime(isoInstant, timeZone); // YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS
      const year = local.slice(0, 4);
      const month = local.slice(4, 6);
      const day = local.slice(6, 8);
      const hour = local.slice(9, 11);
      const minute = local.slice(11, 13);
      const second = local.slice(13, 15);
      const localAsUtcMs = Date.UTC(
        Number(year),
        Number(month) - 1,
        Number(day),
        Number(hour),
        Number(minute),
        Number(second)
      );
      const offsetMinutes = Math.round((localAsUtcMs - new Date(isoInstant).getTime()) / 60_000);
      return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hour}:${minute}:${second}${formatUtcOffset(offsetMinutes)}`;
    }
    export function buildOutlookCalendarUrl(
      reservation: IcsReservation,
      venue: IcsVenue,
      opts: BuildCalendarLinkOptions = {}
    ): string {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        path: "/calendar/action/compose",
        rru: "addevent",
        subject: buildEventTitle(venue),
        startdt: formatIsoWithOffset(reservation.startTime, venue.ianaTimezone),
        enddt: formatIsoWithOffset(reservation.endTime, venue.ianaTimezone),
        body: buildEventDescription(reservation, opts.cancellationUrl),
        location: venue.name,
      });
      return `https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/deeplink/compose?${params.toString()}`;
    }

    export function clockHour(minute: number): number {
      return Math.floor((minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY) / 60) % 12 || 12;
    }
    export function clockHourOfInstant(
      at: string | number | Date,
      format: Pick<VenueFormat, "formatInstant">
    ): number {
      const hour = Number.parseInt(format.formatInstant(at, { hour: "numeric", hourCycle: "h23" }), 10);
      return hour % 12 || 12;
    }
    export function clockHourOfClock(hhmm: string): number {
      return Number.parseInt(hhmm.slice(0, 2), 10) % 12 || 12;
    }

  <file path="src/utils/current-service-date.ts">
    export function currentServiceDate(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timeZone: string,
      now: Date
    ): string {
      const local = localDateTimeOf(now, timeZone);
      const isOpen = (date: string, minute: number): boolean =>
        resolveDay({ timezone: timeZone, config }, date).services.some(
          (s) => s.opensAt <= minute && minute < s.closesAt
        );
      if (isOpen(local.date, local.minute)) return local.date;
      const yesterday = addDays(local.date, -1);
      return isOpen(yesterday, local.minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY) ? yesterday : local.date;
    }
