    export function buildDirectionsUrl(
      venueName: string,
      address: ManagedVenueAddress | undefined
    ): string {
      const parts = address
        ? [
            venueName,
            address.line1,
            address.line2,
            address.city,
            `${address.region} ${address.postalCode}`,
            address.country,
          ]
        : [venueName];
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        api: "1",
        query: parts.filter((part): part is string => Boolean(part)).join(", "),
      });
      return `${MAPS_SEARCH_URL}?${params.toString()}`;
    }

  <file path="src/utils/format.ts">
    function defaultReport(timeZone: string): void {
      console.warn(`Invalid IANA time zone "${timeZone}"; falling back to the device zone.`);
    }
    export function resolveTimeZone(
      timeZone: string | undefined,
      report: (timeZone: string) => void = defaultReport
    ): string | undefined {
      if (!timeZone) return undefined;
      try {
        new Intl.DateTimeFormat(LOCALE, { timeZone });
        return timeZone;
      } catch {
        if (!warnedZones.has(timeZone)) {
          warnedZones.add(timeZone);
          report(timeZone);
        }
        return undefined;
      }
    }
    export function resetTimeZoneReports(): void {
      warnedZones.clear();
    }
    export function formatLongDate(dateStr: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString(locale, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
      });
    }
    export function formatLongDateWithYear(dateStr: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString(locale, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
        year: "numeric",
      });
    }
    export function formatServiceDate(dateStr: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString(locale, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "short",
        day: "numeric",
      });
    }
    export function formatInstant(
      value: string | number | Date,
      options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions,
      locale: string = LOCALE,
      timeZone?: string
    ): string {
      const date = new Date(value);
      // `Intl` throws on an invalid date where `toLocale*String` printed "Invalid Date"; a
      // malformed SSE/API timestamp must degrade to a bad label, not crash the handler.
      if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Invalid Date";
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
        ...options,
        timeZone: resolveTimeZone(timeZone),
      }).format(date);
    }
    export function formatCalendarDate(
      dateStr: string,
      options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions,
      locale: string = LOCALE
    ): string {
      return formatInstant(`${dateStr.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`, options, locale, "UTC");
    }
    export function formatTime(isoString: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Date(isoString).toLocaleTimeString(locale, {
        hour: "numeric",
        minute: "2-digit",
      });
    }
    export function formatTimeIn(isoString: string, timeZone: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Date(isoString).toLocaleTimeString(locale, {
        hour: "numeric",
        minute: "2-digit",
        timeZone: resolveTimeZone(timeZone),
      });
    }
    export function getHourIn(isoString: string, timeZone: string): number {
      const hour = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        timeZone: resolveTimeZone(timeZone),
        hour: "2-digit",
        hourCycle: "h23",
      })
        .formatToParts(new Date(isoString))
        .find((part) => part.type === "hour")?.value;
      return hour ? Number(hour) : 0;
    }
    export function formatLocalTime(hhmm: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      const [hours = 0, minutes = 0] = hhmm.split(":").map(Number);
      return new Date(Date.UTC(1970, 0, 1, hours, minutes)).toLocaleTimeString(locale, {
        hour: "numeric",
        minute: "2-digit",
        timeZone: "UTC",
      });
    }
    export function formatWallHour(hour24: number, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { hour: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(
        new Date(Date.UTC(1970, 0, 1, hour24))
      );
    }
    export function formatWallHourRange(
      fromHour24: number,
      toHour24: number,
      locale: string = LOCALE
    ): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { hour: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).formatRange(
        new Date(Date.UTC(1970, 0, 1, fromHour24)),
        new Date(Date.UTC(1970, 0, 1, toHour24))
      );
    }
    export function currencyMinorUnits(currency: string): number {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat(LOCALE, {
        style: "currency",
        currency: currency.toUpperCase(),
      }).resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits as number;
    }
    export function currencySymbol(currency: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      const parts = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
        style: "currency",
        currency: currency.toUpperCase(),
        currencyDisplay: "narrowSymbol",
      }).formatToParts(0);
      return parts.find((part) => part.type === "currency")?.value ?? currency.toUpperCase();
    }
    export function majorToMinorUnits(amount: number, currency: string): number {
      return Math.round(amount * 10 ** currencyMinorUnits(currency));
    }
    export function formatCurrencyFromCents(
      amountMinor: number,
      currency: string,
      locale: string = LOCALE
    ): string {
      return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
        style: "currency",
        currency: currency.toUpperCase(),
      }).format(amountMinor / 10 ** currencyMinorUnits(currency));
    }
    export function formatCurrencyName(currency: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      const code = currency.toUpperCase();
      return new Intl.DisplayNames(locale, { type: "currency" }).of(code) ?? code;
    }
    export function formatShortDate(dateStr: string, locale: string = LOCALE): string {
      return new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString(locale, {
        year: "numeric",
        month: "2-digit",
        day: "2-digit",
      });
    }
    export function formatHourLabel(hour: number, locale: string, compact: boolean): string {
      const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { hour: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
      const instant = new Date(Date.UTC(1970, 0, 1, hour));
      if (!compact) return formatter.format(instant);
      return formatter.formatToParts(instant).find((part) => part.type === "hour")?.value ?? "";
    }
    export function deviceTimeZone(): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone ?? "";
    }
    export function formatTimeZoneName(at: Date, timeZone: string, locale: string): string {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
        timeZone,
        timeZoneName: "longGeneric",
      }).formatToParts(at);
      return parts.find((part) => part.type === "timeZoneName")?.value ?? timeZone;
    }
    function canonicalTimeZone(timeZone: string): string {
      try {
        return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { timeZone }).resolvedOptions().timeZone;
      } catch {
        return timeZone;
      }
    }
    export function sameTimeZone(a: string, b: string): boolean {
      return canonicalTimeZone(a) === canonicalTimeZone(b);
    }
    export function formatDurationLabel(ms: number, locale: string): string {
      const totalMinutes = Math.floor(Math.abs(ms) / MINUTE_MS);
      const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
      const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
      const unit = (value: number, name: "hour" | "minute"): string =>
        new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "unit", unit: name, unitDisplay: "short" }).format(
          value
        );
      const parts = [
        ...(hours > 0 ? [unit(hours, "hour")] : []),
        ...(minutes > 0 || hours === 0 ? [unit(minutes, "minute")] : []),
      ];
      return new Intl.ListFormat(locale, { type: "unit", style: "narrow" }).format(parts);
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/utils/guest-signal.ts">
    export const MAX_LATE_SIGNALS = 3;
    export const MAX_ARRIVED_SIGNALS = 1;
    export interface GuestSignalAvailabilityInput {
      status: string;
      /** Reservation start instant (ISO string). */
      startTime: string;
      /** Venue IANA timezone; "today" is decided in it. */
      timezone: string;
      now: Date;
      priorSignals: { late: number; arrived: number };
    }
    export interface GuestSignalAvailability {
      readonly lateAllowed: boolean;
      readonly arrivedAllowed: boolean;
      /** Why neither can be sent (a cap only disables its own button); null when the booking and clock allow signals. */
      readonly reason: "not-confirmed" | "outside-window" | null;
    }
    export function guestSignalAvailability(
      input: GuestSignalAvailabilityInput
    ): GuestSignalAvailability {
      if (input.status !== "CONFIRMED") {
        return { lateAllowed: false, arrivedAllowed: false, reason: "not-confirmed" };
      }
      const start = new Date(input.startTime);
      const delta = input.now.getTime() - start.getTime();
      const inWindow =
        delta >= -SIGNAL_WINDOW_BEFORE_MS &&
        delta <= SIGNAL_WINDOW_AFTER_MS &&
        venueDate(input.now, input.timezone) === venueDate(start, input.timezone);
      if (!inWindow) return { lateAllowed: false, arrivedAllowed: false, reason: "outside-window" };
      return {
        lateAllowed: input.priorSignals.late < MAX_LATE_SIGNALS,
        arrivedAllowed: input.priorSignals.arrived < MAX_ARRIVED_SIGNALS,
        reason: null,
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/utils/ics.ts">
    export type IcsReservation = Pick<Reservation, "id" | "startTime" | "endTime" | "partySize">;
    export type IcsVenue = Pick<PublicVenueConfig, "name" | "ianaTimezone">;
    export interface BuildReservationIcsOptions {
      /** Guest-facing cancellation/manage-reservation link, included in DESCRIPTION. */
      cancellationUrl?: string;
      /** Clock used for DTSTAMP. Defaults to `new Date()`. Pass explicitly for deterministic output. */
      now?: Date;
      /** Calendar UID. Defaults to `${reservation.id}@mattbutlerengineering.com`. */
      uid?: string;
    }
    function escapeIcsText(value: string): string {
      return value
        .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")
        .replace(/;/g, "\\;")
        .replace(/,/g, "\\,")
        .replace(/\r\n|\r|\n/g, "\\n");
    }
    function isContinuationByte(byte: number): boolean {
      return (byte & 0xc0) === 0x80;
    }
    function foldLine(line: string): string {
      const bytes = textEncoder.encode(line);
      if (bytes.length <= MAX_LINE_OCTETS) {
        return line;
      }
    
      const segments: string[] = [];
      let start = 0;
      let limit = MAX_LINE_OCTETS;
      while (start < bytes.length) {
        let end = Math.min(start + limit, bytes.length);
        while (end > start && end < bytes.length && isContinuationByte(bytes[end] as number)) {
          end -= 1;
        }
        segments.push(textDecoder.decode(bytes.subarray(start, end)));
        start = end;
        // Continuation lines carry a 1-octet leading space, so they get 1 fewer content octet.
        limit = MAX_LINE_OCTETS - 1;
      }
      return segments.join(CRLF + " ");
    }
    function formatIcsUtcTimestamp(date: Date): string {
      const iso = date.toISOString(); // e.g. 2026-01-10T12:00:00.000Z
      return `${iso.slice(0, 4)}${iso.slice(5, 7)}${iso.slice(8, 10)}T${iso.slice(11, 13)}${iso.slice(14, 16)}${iso.slice(17, 19)}Z`;
    }
    export function formatIcsLocalDateTime(isoInstant: string, timeZone: string): string {
      const date = new Date(isoInstant);
      const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        timeZone,
        year: "numeric",
        month: "2-digit",
        day: "2-digit",
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        second: "2-digit",
        hourCycle: "h23",
      });
      const parts = formatter.formatToParts(date);
      const get = (type: string): string => parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? "00";
      return `${get("year")}${get("month")}${get("day")}T${get("hour")}${get("minute")}${get("second")}`;
    }
    function buildDescription(reservation: IcsReservation, cancellationUrl?: string): string {
      const partyLine = `Party of ${reservation.partySize}.`;
      return cancellationUrl ? `${partyLine} Cancel or modify: ${cancellationUrl}` : partyLine;
    }
    export function buildReservationIcs(
      reservation: IcsReservation,
      venue: IcsVenue,
      opts: BuildReservationIcsOptions = {}
    ): string {
      const now = opts.now ?? new Date();
      const uid = opts.uid ?? `${reservation.id}@mattbutlerengineering.com`;
      const tzid = venue.ianaTimezone;
    
      const properties = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//mattbutlerengineering//hospitality//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        `UID:${escapeIcsText(uid)}`,
        `DTSTAMP:${formatIcsUtcTimestamp(now)}`,
        `DTSTART;TZID=${tzid}:${formatIcsLocalDateTime(reservation.startTime, tzid)}`,
        `DTEND;TZID=${tzid}:${formatIcsLocalDateTime(reservation.endTime, tzid)}`,
        `SUMMARY:${escapeIcsText(`${venue.name} Reservation`)}`,
        `DESCRIPTION:${escapeIcsText(buildDescription(reservation, opts.cancellationUrl))}`,
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
      ];
    
      return properties.map(foldLine).join(CRLF);
    }
    export function downloadIcsFile(icsContent: string, filename: string): void {
      const blob = new Blob([icsContent], { type: "text/calendar;charset=utf-8" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const anchor = document.createElement("a");
      anchor.href = url;
      anchor.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(anchor);
      anchor.click();
      document.body.removeChild(anchor);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
  </file>

    export function ordinalVisit(n: number): string {
      const suffix = ["th", "st", "nd", "rd"];
      const v = n % 100;
      return `${n}${suffix[(v - 20) % 10] ?? suffix[v] ?? suffix[0]} visit`;
    }

  <file path="src/utils/seated.ts">
    export const SEATED_EARLY_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60_000;
    type SeatedReservation = Pick<Reservation, "status" | "startTime" | "endTime">;
    export function isSeated(
      reservation: SeatedReservation,
      tableStatus: TableStatus | undefined,
      now: Date
    ): boolean {
      if (reservation.status !== "CONFIRMED" || tableStatus !== "OCCUPIED") return false;
      const start = new Date(reservation.startTime).getTime();
      const end = new Date(reservation.endTime).getTime();
      const at = now.getTime();
      if (Number.isNaN(start) || Number.isNaN(end) || Number.isNaN(at)) return false;
      return at >= start - SEATED_EARLY_WINDOW_MS && at <= end;
    }
    export function seatedReservationIds(
      reservations: readonly (SeatedReservation & Pick<Reservation, "id" | "tableId">)[],
      tables: readonly Pick<Table, "id" | "status">[],
      now: Date
    ): ReadonlySet<string> {
      const statusByTableId = new Map(tables.map((table) => [table.id, table.status]));
      return new Set(
        reservations
          .filter((reservation) => isSeated(reservation, statusByTableId.get(reservation.tableId), now))
          .map((reservation) => reservation.id)
      );
    }

    function tableAcceptsParty(table: Pick<Table, "status">): boolean {
      return TABLE_VALID_TRANSITIONS[table.status].includes("OCCUPIED");
    }
    export function isSeatableStatus(reservation: Pick<Reservation, "status">): boolean {
      return reservation.status === "PENDING" || reservation.status === "CONFIRMED";
    }
    export function canSeat(
      reservation: Pick<Reservation, "status">,
      table: Pick<Table, "status"> | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return isSeatableStatus(reservation) && (table === undefined || tableAcceptsParty(table));
    }
    export function tablesThatFit<
      T extends Pick<Table, "status" | "capacity" | "minCovers" | "maxCovers">,
    >(tables: readonly T[], partySize: number): T[] {
      return tables
        .filter((table) => tableAcceptsParty(table) && partyFitsTable(table, partySize))
        .sort((a, b) => a.capacity - b.capacity);
    }

  <file path="src/utils/service-day-start.ts">
    export function serviceDayCalendarDate(
      config: AvailabilityConfig | null | undefined,
      timeZone: string,
      serviceDate: string,
      hhmm: string
    ): string {
      const match = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(hhmm);
      if (!config || !match) return serviceDate;
      const minute = Number(match[1]) * 60 + Number(match[2]);
      // The planned day (closures and Tonight changes stripped), as the engine's `judge` owns it.
      const planned: AvailabilityConfig = {
        ...config,
        dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind !== "closure" && r.kind !== "tonight"),
      };
      const { services } = resolveDay({ timezone: timeZone, config: planned }, serviceDate);
      const isOpen = (at: number): boolean => services.some((s) => s.opensAt <= at && at < s.closesAt);
      return !isOpen(minute) && isOpen(minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY)
        ? addDays(serviceDate, 1)
        : serviceDate;
    }
    export function serviceDayStartInstant(
      config: AvailabilityConfig | null | undefined,
      timeZone: string,
      serviceDate: string,
      hhmm: string
    ): Date {
      const calendarDate = serviceDayCalendarDate(config, timeZone, serviceDate, hhmm);
      return venueWallTimeToInstant(calendarDate, hhmm, timeZone);
    }

  <file path="src/utils/service-day.ts">
    export function deviceDate(now: Date): string {
      return Number.isNaN(now.getTime()) ? "" : now.toLocaleDateString(DAY_LOCALE);
    }
    export function deviceHour(now: Date): number {
      return now.getHours();
    }
    export function isDeviceToday(date: string, now: Date): boolean {
      const today = deviceDate(now);
      return today !== "" && date === today;
    }
    export function venueDate(now: Date, timeZone?: string): string {
      if (!timeZone) return deviceDate(now);
      try {
        return now.toLocaleDateString(DAY_LOCALE, { timeZone });
      } catch {
        return deviceDate(now);
      }
    }
    export function addDays(date: string, days: number): string {
      const shifted = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`);
      if (Number.isNaN(shifted.getTime())) return "";
      shifted.setUTCDate(shifted.getUTCDate() + days);
      return shifted.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
    export interface VenueWallClock {
      /** Lower-case English weekday name, e.g. `"monday"`. */
      readonly weekday: string;
      /** Minutes since venue-local midnight. */
      readonly nowMin: number;
    }
    export function minutesOfDayIn(instant: Date, timeZone?: string): number {
      const clock = timeZone ? venueWallClock(timeZone, instant) : null;
      return clock ? clock.nowMin : instant.getHours() * 60 + instant.getMinutes();
    }
    export function serviceMinuteOf(instant: Date, timeZone: string, serviceDate: string): number {
      return (
        minutesOfDayIn(instant, timeZone) + (venueDate(instant, timeZone) > serviceDate ? 1440 : 0)
      );
    }
    export function venueWallClock(timeZone: string, now: Date): VenueWallClock | null {
      try {
        const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
          timeZone,
          weekday: "long",
          hour: "2-digit",
          minute: "2-digit",
          hourCycle: "h23",
        }).formatToParts(now);
        const get = (type: string): string | undefined =>
          parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value;
        const weekday = get("weekday")?.toLowerCase();
        const hour = Number(get("hour"));
        const minute = Number(get("minute"));
        if (!weekday || !Number.isFinite(hour) || !Number.isFinite(minute)) return null;
        return { weekday, nowMin: hour * 60 + minute };
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }

    export const SELECTED_PARAM = "selected";
    export const REHEARSAL_PARAM = "rehearsal";
    export interface TimelineIntent {
      /** Exactly `walkin=true` — any other spelling is no intent. */
      readonly walkIn: boolean;
      /** `selected=<id>`, trimmed; blank or absent is `null`. */
      readonly selectedId: string | null;
    }
    export function parseTimelineIntent(params: URLSearchParams): TimelineIntent {
      const selected = params.get(SELECTED_PARAM)?.trim() ?? "";
      return {
        walkIn: params.get(WALK_IN_PARAM) === "true",
        selectedId: selected === "" ? null : selected,
      };
    }
    export function stripTimelineIntent(params: URLSearchParams): URLSearchParams {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
      next.delete(WALK_IN_PARAM);
      next.delete(SELECTED_PARAM);
      return next;
    }
    export interface ReservationsIntent {
      /** Exactly `new=true` — any other spelling is no intent. */
      readonly newReservation: boolean;
    }
    export function parseReservationsIntent(params: URLSearchParams): ReservationsIntent {
      return { newReservation: params.get(NEW_RESERVATION_PARAM) === "true" };
    }
    export function stripReservationsIntent(params: URLSearchParams): URLSearchParams {
      const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
      next.delete(NEW_RESERVATION_PARAM);
      return next;
    }

  <file path="src/utils/tonight-blocks.ts">
    export function bookingMinuteOnServiceDay(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timeZone: string,
      serviceDate: string,
      date: string,
      time: string
    ): number | null {
      const match = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(time);
      if (!match || !date) return null;
      const minute = Number(match[1]) * 60 + Number(match[2]);
      const planned: AvailabilityConfig = {
        ...config,
        dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind !== "closure" && r.kind !== "tonight"),
      };
      const isOpen = (day: string, at: number): boolean =>
        resolveDay({ timezone: timeZone, config: planned }, day).services.some(
          (s) => s.opensAt <= at && at < s.closesAt
        );
      const owner =
        [
          { day: date, at: minute },
          { day: addDays(date, -1), at: minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY },
        ].find((c) => isOpen(c.day, c.at)) ?? null;
      return owner && owner.day === serviceDate ? owner.at : null;
    }
    export function blockedTableIds(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      serviceDate: string,
      startMinute: number | null
    ): ReadonlySet<string> {
      const blocked = new Set<string>();
      if (startMinute === null) return blocked;
      for (const rule of rules) {
        if (rule.kind !== "tonight" || rule.targetKind !== "tables" || rule.startsOn !== serviceDate) {
          continue;
        }
        if (!("stop" in rule.payload)) continue;
        const { from, to } = rule.payload.stop;
        if (from <= startMinute && startMinute < to) {
          for (const id of rule.tableIds ?? []) blocked.add(id);
        }
      }
      return blocked;
    }
    export function waitlistClosingRule(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      serviceDate: string
    ): DateRule | null {
      return (
        activeRules(rules, serviceDate).find(
          (rule) =>
            rule.kind === "closure" &&
            rule.targetKind === "booking" &&
            !rule.window &&
            (rule.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("waitlist")
        ) ?? null
      );
    }
    export function isTonightOnlyWaitlistClosure(rule: DateRule): boolean {
      const types = rule.bookingTypes ?? [];
      return (
        types.length === 1 && types[0] === "waitlist" && !rule.repeat && rule.endsOn === rule.startsOn
      );
    }

  <file path="src/utils/venue-wall-time.ts">
    function zoneOffsetMs(instantMs: number, timeZone: string): number {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        timeZone,
        year: "numeric",
        month: "numeric",
        day: "numeric",
        hour: "numeric",
        minute: "numeric",
        second: "numeric",
        hourCycle: "h23",
      }).formatToParts(new Date(instantMs));
      const get = (type: string): number => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value);
      const wallAsUtc = Date.UTC(
        get("year"),
        get("month") - 1,
        get("day"),
        get("hour"),
        get("minute"),
        get("second")
      );
      return wallAsUtc - Math.floor(instantMs / 1000) * 1000;
    }
    export function venueWallTimeToInstant(date: string, hhmm: string, timeZone?: string): Date {
      const zone = resolveTimeZone(timeZone);
      if (!zone) return new Date(`${date}T${hhmm}:00`);
      const wallAsUtc = Date.parse(`${date}T${hhmm}:00Z`);
      // One pass lands within an hour of the answer; the second corrects across a DST edge.
      const first = wallAsUtc - zoneOffsetMs(wallAsUtc, zone);
      return new Date(wallAsUtc - zoneOffsetMs(first, zone));
    }
    export function wallTimeInputValue(isoString: string, timeZone?: string): string {
      const minutes = minutesOfDayIn(new Date(isoString), resolveTimeZone(timeZone));
      const hh = String(Math.floor(minutes / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }

  <file path="src/utils/venueOpenLabel.ts">
    export function formatVenueOpenLabel(
      s: VenueOpenState,
      formatClock: (hhmm: string) => string = formatLocalTime,
      t: TFunction = defaultT
    ): string {
      switch (s.state) {
        case "open":
          return t("home.openSign.open", {
            time: formatClock(s.closesAt),
            count: clockHourOfClock(s.closesAt),
          });
        case "opening-soon":
          return t("home.openSign.openingSoon", {
            time: formatClock(s.opensAt),
            count: clockHourOfClock(s.opensAt),
          });
        case "closed":
          return s.opensOn === null
            ? t("home.openSign.closedToday", {
                time: formatClock(s.opensAt),
                count: clockHourOfClock(s.opensAt),
              })
            : t("home.openSign.closedOn", {
                weekday: t(`home.openSign.weekdays.${s.opensOn}`),
                time: formatClock(s.opensAt),
                count: clockHourOfClock(s.opensAt),
              });
        case "unset":
          return t("home.openSign.unset");
      }
    }

  <file path="src/utils/venueOpenState.ts">
    export type Weekday = keyof OperatingHours;
    export type LocalTime = string;
    export type VenueOpenState =
      | { readonly state: "open"; readonly closesAt: LocalTime }
      | { readonly state: "opening-soon"; readonly opensAt: LocalTime }
      | {
          readonly state: "closed";
          readonly opensAt: LocalTime;
          /** `null` = later today. */
          readonly opensOn: Weekday | null;
        }
      | { readonly state: "unset" };
    export interface DeriveVenueOpenStateInput {
      readonly operatingHours: OperatingHours | null | undefined;
      readonly ianaTimezone: string | null | undefined;
      readonly now: Date;
      /** Lead window for `opening-soon`, inclusive. @default 60 */
      readonly openingSoonMinutes?: number;
    }
    interface DayWindow {
      readonly open: number;
      readonly close: number;
      readonly overnight: boolean;
      readonly opensAt: LocalTime;
      readonly closesAt: LocalTime;
    }
    interface VenueDay {
      readonly weekday: Weekday;
      readonly window: DayWindow | null;
    }
    interface VenueClock {
      /** Index into `WEEKDAYS`. */
      readonly day: number;
      /** Minutes since venue-local midnight. */
      readonly nowMin: number;
    }
    function readVenueClock(timeZone: string, now: Date): VenueClock | null {
      const clock = venueWallClock(timeZone, now);
      if (!clock) return null;
      const day = WEEKDAYS.indexOf(clock.weekday as Weekday);
      return day < 0 ? null : { day, nowMin: clock.nowMin };
    }
    function toMinutes(hhmm: string): number | null {
      if (!LOCAL_TIME_PATTERN.test(hhmm)) return null;
      const [hours = 0, minutes = 0] = hhmm.split(":").map(Number);
      return hours * 60 + minutes;
    }
    function toWindow(schedule: DaySchedule | undefined): DayWindow | null {
      if (schedule == null || schedule.closed === true) return null;
      const open = toMinutes(schedule.open);
      const close = toMinutes(schedule.close);
      if (open === null || close === null || open === close) return null;
      return { open, close, overnight: close < open, opensAt: schedule.open, closesAt: schedule.close };
    }
    export function deriveVenueOpenState(input: DeriveVenueOpenStateInput): VenueOpenState | null {
      const {
        operatingHours,
        ianaTimezone,
        now,
        openingSoonMinutes = DEFAULT_OPENING_SOON_MINUTES,
      } = input;
    
      // `Intl` silently falls back to the machine zone for `undefined` — gate first.
      if (typeof ianaTimezone !== "string" || ianaTimezone.length === 0) return null;
      const clock = readVenueClock(ianaTimezone, now);
      if (clock === null) return null;
    
      if (!hasOperatingHours(operatingHours)) return UNSET;
    
      const days: readonly VenueDay[] = WEEKDAYS.map((weekday) => ({
        weekday,
        window: toWindow(operatingHours?.[weekday]),
      }));
      if (days.every(({ window }) => window === null)) return UNSET;
    
      const { day, nowMin } = clock;
      const today = days[day]?.window ?? null;
      if (today !== null) {
        const inDaytimeWindow = !today.overnight && today.open <= nowMin && nowMin < today.close;
        const inOvernightEvening = today.overnight && nowMin >= today.open;
        if (inDaytimeWindow || inOvernightEvening) return { state: "open", closesAt: today.closesAt };
      }
    
      const yesterday = days[(day + DAYS_PER_WEEK - 1) % DAYS_PER_WEEK]?.window ?? null;
      if (yesterday !== null && yesterday.overnight && nowMin < yesterday.close) {
        return { state: "open", closesAt: yesterday.closesAt };
      }
    
      for (let offset = 0; offset <= DAYS_PER_WEEK; offset += 1) {
        const candidate = days[(day + offset) % DAYS_PER_WEEK];
        if (candidate === undefined || candidate.window === null) continue;
        if (offset === 0 && candidate.window.open <= nowMin) continue;
        const lead = offset * MINUTES_PER_DAY + candidate.window.open - nowMin;
        if (lead <= openingSoonMinutes) {
          return { state: "opening-soon", opensAt: candidate.window.opensAt };
        }
        return {
          state: "closed",
          opensAt: candidate.window.opensAt,
          opensOn: offset === 0 ? null : candidate.weekday,
        };
      }
    
      // Invariant: at least one window exists (checked above), so the loop always
      // returns within one week. This line is unreachable.
      return UNSET;
    }
  </file>
  </section>

    export function layoutCounts(

    ): { tables: string; seats: string } {

      return {

        seats: t("onboarding.floorPlan.seatCount", { count: seats }),
      };
    }

    export type DraftTableShape = TableShapeMetadata["shape"];
    export interface DraftTable {
      /** Draft-only stable identifier. NEVER sent to the server. */
      localId: string;
      name: string;
      capacity: number;
      minCovers: number;
      shape: DraftTableShape;
      /** Centre coordinates. A table the manager adds is always a multiple of GRID_SIZE. */
      x: number;
      y: number;
      /**
       * Footprint, where a room template gave this table one of its own — a long
       * table is 140 wide against a shape default of 80. Absent on a table the
       * manager added, which keeps using SHAPE_DEFAULTS.
       */
      width?: number;
      height?: number;
      rotation?: number;

       * The room template's **local** section id, or null outside every zone.

    }
    export function draftTableSize(table: DraftTable): { width: number; height: number } {

      return { width: table.width ?? defaults.width, height: table.height ?? defaults.height };
    }

    export function draftToCanvasTables(draft: FloorPlanDraft): Table[] {
      return draft.tables.map((table) => {
        const shapeMetadata: TableShapeMetadata = {
          shape: table.shape,
          x: table.x,
          y: table.y,
          ...draftTableSize(table),
          ...(table.rotation === undefined ? {} : { rotation: table.rotation }),
        };
    
        return {
          id: table.localId,
          name: table.name,
          tableNumber: null,
          capacity: table.capacity,
          minCovers: table.minCovers,
          maxCovers: null,
          location: null,
          isActive: true,
          priority: 0,
          status: "AVAILABLE",
          venueId: null,
          floorPlanId: null,
          sectionId: table.sectionId ?? null,
          shapeMetadata,
          createdAt: DRAFT_TIMESTAMP,
          updatedAt: DRAFT_TIMESTAMP,
        };
      });
    }
    export function draftToCanvasFloorPlan(draft: FloorPlanDraft): FloorPlan {
      return {
        id: DRAFT_ID,
        venueId: DRAFT_ID,
        name: draft.planName,
        isActive: false,
        layoutJson: draftLayoutJson(draft),
        createdAt: DRAFT_TIMESTAMP,
        updatedAt: DRAFT_TIMESTAMP,
      };
    }
    export function draftTableFromCreateRequest(
      request: CreateTableRequest,
      localId: string
    ): DraftTable {
      const shapeMetadata = request.shapeMetadata;
      // Invariant: AddTableDialog always populates shapeMetadata (shape/x/y are
      // required for a table to render on the canvas at all).
      if (!shapeMetadata) {
        throw new Error("draftTableFromCreateRequest: request.shapeMetadata is required");
      }
    
      return {
        localId,
        name: request.name,
        capacity: request.capacity,
        minCovers: request.minCovers ?? 1,
        shape: shapeMetadata.shape,
        x: shapeMetadata.x,
        y: shapeMetadata.y,
      };
    }
    export function draftTableToCreateRequest(
      table: DraftTable,
      venueId: string,
      floorPlanId: string
    ): CreateTableRequest {
      const dims = draftTableSize(table);
    
      return {
        name: table.name,
        capacity: table.capacity,
        minCovers: table.minCovers,
        venueId,
        floorPlanId,
        shapeMetadata: {
          shape: table.shape,
          x: table.x,
          y: table.y,
          width: dims.width,
          height: dims.height,
          ...(table.rotation === undefined ? {} : { rotation: table.rotation }),
        },
      };
    }
    export function findDuplicateName(
      tables: readonly DraftTable[],
      name: string,
      ignoreLocalId?: string
    ): boolean {
      const trimmed = name.trim();
      return tables.some((table) => table.localId !== ignoreLocalId && table.name.trim() === trimmed);
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/floor-plan-templates.ts">
    export type TemplateId = RoomTemplateId;
    export const FLOOR_PLAN_TEMPLATES: readonly RoomTemplate[] = ROOM_TEMPLATES;
    export function templateById(id: TemplateId): RoomTemplate {
      return roomTemplateById(id);
    }
    export function layoutForDraft(draft: FloorPlanDraft): RoomLayout | null {
      if (draft.templateId === null) return null;
      const size = roomSizeById(draft.sizeId);
      return {
        width: draft.width || size.width,
        height: draft.height || size.height,
        tables: draft.tables.map(previewTable),
        sections: draft.sections,
        walls: draft.walls,
      };
    }
    function previewTable(table: DraftTable): RoomLayout["tables"][number] {
      const { width, height } = draftTableSize(table);
      return {
        id: table.localId,
        name: table.name,
        shape: table.shape,
        capacity: table.capacity,
        minCovers: table.minCovers,
        x: table.x,
        y: table.y,
        width,
        height,
        rotation: table.rotation ?? 0,
        sectionId: table.sectionId ?? null,
      };
    }
    function draftTableFor(table: RoomLayout["tables"][number]): DraftTable {
      return {
        localId: table.name,
        name: table.name,
        capacity: table.capacity,
        minCovers: table.minCovers,
        shape: table.shape,
        x: table.x,
        y: table.y,
        width: table.width,
        height: table.height,
        rotation: table.rotation,
        sectionId: table.sectionId,
      };
    }
    export function draftFromTemplate(templateId: TemplateId, sizeId: RoomSizeId): FloorPlanDraft {
      const template = roomTemplateById(templateId);
      const size = roomSizeById(sizeId);
      const layout = template.build(size.width, size.height);
    
      return {
        templateId,
        sizeId,
        planName: template.planName,
        tables: layout.tables.map(draftTableFor),
        sections: layout.sections,
        walls: layout.walls,
        width: layout.width,
        height: layout.height,
        pristine: true,
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/generate-slug.ts">
    export function generateSlug(name: string): string {
      return name
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, "")
        .replace(/[\s]+/g, "-")
        .replace(/-+/g, "-")
        .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
    }

  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/launch-hours.ts">
    export function launchHoursChanges(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      derived: AvailabilityConfig,
      newId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const changes = draftToChanges(draft, derived, newId);
      const named = new Set((changes.upsert.scheduleServices ?? []).map((s) => s.venueServiceId));
      const unused = derived.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt && !named.has(s.id));
      if (unused.length === 0) return changes;
      return {
        ...changes,
        remove: { ...changes.remove, venueServices: unused.map((s) => s.id) },
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/launch-sequence.ts">
    export type LaunchStageId = "venue" | "hours" | "floorPlan" | "tables" | "activate";
    export type LaunchStageState = "pending" | "in-flight" | "done" | "failed";
    export interface LaunchProgress {
      venueId: string | null;
      /**
       * True once the hours step's services are the venue's regular week. Absent means not yet: the
       * venue still serves the one-window projection it was created with.
       */
      hoursSaved?: boolean;
      floorPlanId: string | null;
      /**
       * True once the plan's section rows exist and their zone rectangles are in
       * its layout — or immediately, for a draft that names no zones. The plan and
       * its zones are two writes inside one stage, so `floorPlanId` alone cannot
       * say whether the stage finished: without this, a failure between them would
       * mark floorPlan done and Retry would skip the zones for good.
       */
      sectionsDone: boolean;
      /** Names, not ids — the name is the server's unique key and therefore the resume key. */
      createdTableNames: readonly string[];
      /**
       * True once every table that a template placed in a zone has been assigned
       * to its section. Tables and membership are two writes inside one stage, so
       * `createdTableNames` alone cannot say whether the stage finished. Absent
       * means not yet; it only matters for a draft with tables in zones.
       */
      membershipDone?: boolean;
      activated: boolean;
      inFlightStage: LaunchStageId | null;
      failedStage: LaunchStageId | null;
      errorMessage: string | null;
    }
    export const INITIAL_LAUNCH_PROGRESS: LaunchProgress = {
      venueId: null,
      floorPlanId: null,
      sectionsDone: false,
      createdTableNames: [],
      activated: false,
      inFlightStage: null,
      failedStage: null,
      errorMessage: null,
    };
    export const DEFAULT_LAYOUT: FloorPlanLayout = {
      width: CANVAS_WIDTH,
      height: CANVAS_HEIGHT,
      gridSize: GRID_SIZE,
      showGrid: true,
    };
    export function stagesFor(draft: FloorPlanDraft): readonly LaunchStageId[] {
      if (draft.tables.length === 0) {
        return ALL_STAGES.filter((stage) => stage !== "tables");
      }
      return ALL_STAGES;
    }
    function isStageDone(
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      stage: LaunchStageId,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft
    ): boolean {
      switch (stage) {
        case "venue":
          return progress.venueId !== null;
        case "hours":
          return progress.hoursSaved === true;
        case "floorPlan":
          return progress.floorPlanId !== null && progress.sectionsDone;
        case "tables":
          return (
            draft.tables.every((table) => progress.createdTableNames.includes(table.name)) &&
            (!needsMembership(draft) || progress.membershipDone === true)
          );
        case "activate":
          return progress.activated;
      }
    }
    function needsMembership(draft: FloorPlanDraft): boolean {
      return (
        draft.sections.length > 0 && draft.tables.some((table) => (table.sectionId ?? null) !== null)
      );
    }
    export function nextStage(progress: LaunchProgress, draft: FloorPlanDraft): LaunchStageId | null {
      for (const stage of stagesFor(draft)) {
        if (!isStageDone(progress, stage, draft)) {
          return stage;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    function isDoneWithoutDraft(progress: LaunchProgress, stage: LaunchStageId): boolean {
      switch (stage) {
        case "venue":
          return progress.venueId !== null;
        case "hours":
          return progress.hoursSaved === true;
        case "floorPlan":
          return progress.floorPlanId !== null && progress.sectionsDone;
        case "tables":
          return progress.createdTableNames.length > 0;
        case "activate":
          return progress.activated;
      }
    }
    export function stageStateOf(progress: LaunchProgress, stage: LaunchStageId): LaunchStageState {
      if (progress.inFlightStage === stage) return "in-flight";
      if (progress.failedStage === stage) return "failed";
      return isDoneWithoutDraft(progress, stage) ? "done" : "pending";
    }
    export function tablesDoneCount(progress: LaunchProgress): number {
      return progress.createdTableNames.length;
    }
    export function isAlreadyCreatedError(err: unknown): boolean {
      return (
        err instanceof ApiClientError &&
        err.problemDetails.status === 400 &&
        err.problemDetails.detail === DUPLICATE_TABLE_NAME_MESSAGE
      );
    }
    export interface LaunchApi {
      venues: { create(data: CreateVenueRequest): Promise<Venue> };
      availability: {
        getConfig(venueId: string): Promise<AvailabilityConfigState>;
        saveConfig(
          venueId: string,
          body: Pick<PutAvailabilityConfigBody, "expectedVersion" | "changes">
        ): Promise<AvailabilityConfigSaveResult>;
      };
      floorPlans: {
        create(data: CreateFloorPlanRequest): Promise<FloorPlan>;
        update(id: string, data: UpdateFloorPlanRequest): Promise<FloorPlan>;
        setActive(id: string): Promise<FloorPlan>;
      };
      floorPlanSections: {
        list(venueId: string, floorPlanId?: string): Promise<FloorPlanSection[]>;
        create(venueId: string, data: CreateFloorPlanSectionRequest): Promise<FloorPlanSection>;
        assignTables(venueId: string, sectionId: string, tableIds: string[]): Promise<Table[]>;
      };
      tables: {
        create(data: CreateTableRequest): Promise<Table>;
        list(params: {
          venueId: string;
          page?: number;
          limit?: number;
        }): Promise<PaginatedResponse<Table>>;
      };
    }
    function withFallback(err: unknown, fallback: string): Error {
      return err instanceof Error && err.message ? err : new Error(fallback);
    }
    async function runVenueStage(
      api: LaunchApi,
      venuePayload: CreateVenueRequest,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      let venue: Venue;
      try {
        venue = await api.venues.create(venuePayload);
      } catch (err) {
        throw withFallback(err, localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.stagePanel.venueFailed"));
      }
      const next: LaunchProgress = { ...progress, venueId: venue.id, inFlightStage: null };
      onProgress(next);
      return next;
    }
    async function runHoursStage(
      api: LaunchApi,
      hours: QuickSetupDraft,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      const venueId = progress.venueId;
      // Invariant: nextStage only selects "hours" once "venue" is done (stagesFor's order is fixed).
      if (venueId === null) {
        throw new Error("runLaunchSequence: hours stage reached without a venueId");
      }
    
      try {
        const state = await api.availability.getConfig(venueId);
        await api.availability.saveConfig(venueId, {
          expectedVersion: state.version,
          changes: launchHoursChanges(hours, state.config, () => crypto.randomUUID()),
        });
      } catch (err) {
        throw withFallback(err, localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.stagePanel.hoursFailed"));
      }
      const next: LaunchProgress = { ...progress, hoursSaved: true, inFlightStage: null };
      onProgress(next);
      return next;
    }
    async function createSectionsFor(
      api: LaunchApi,
      venueId: string,
      floorPlanId: string,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft
    ): Promise<void> {
      if (draft.sections.length === 0) return;
    
      const existing = await api.floorPlanSections.list(venueId, floorPlanId);
      const byName = new Map(existing.map((row) => [row.name, row]));
    
      for (const [index, zone] of draft.sections.entries()) {
        if (byName.has(zone.name)) continue;
        const row = await api.floorPlanSections.create(venueId, {
          floorPlanId,
          name: zone.name,
          color: zone.color,
          displayOrder: index,
        });
        byName.set(zone.name, row);
      }
    
      // A zone's rectangle is keyed by its row id, so the layout can only be
      // written once the rows exist.
      const sections = draft.sections.flatMap((zone) => {
        const row = byName.get(zone.name);
        return row
          ? [{ id: row.id, x: zone.x, y: zone.y, width: zone.width, height: zone.height }]
          : [];
      });
    
      await api.floorPlans.update(floorPlanId, {
        layoutJson: { ...draftLayoutJson(draft), sections },
      });
    }
    async function runFloorPlanStage(
      api: LaunchApi,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      const venueId = progress.venueId;
      // Invariant: nextStage only selects "floorPlan" once "venue" is done
      // (stagesFor's order is fixed), so venueId is always set here.
      if (venueId === null) {
        throw new Error("runLaunchSequence: floorPlan stage reached without a venueId");
      }
    
      // A retry after the zones failed re-enters this stage with the plan already
      // created; creating it again would leave the venue with two plans.
      let floorPlanId = progress.floorPlanId;
      if (floorPlanId === null) {
        try {
          const floorPlan = await api.floorPlans.create({
            venueId,
            name: draft.planName,
            layoutJson: draft.templateId === null ? DEFAULT_LAYOUT : draftLayoutJson(draft),
          });
          floorPlanId = floorPlan.id;
        } catch (err) {
          throw withFallback(err, localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.stagePanel.planFailed"));
        }
      }
    
      const withPlan: LaunchProgress = { ...progress, floorPlanId, inFlightStage: null };
      try {
        await createSectionsFor(api, venueId, floorPlanId, draft);
      } catch (err) {
        // Carry the plan's id out with the failure so Retry resumes at the zones
        // (which are idempotent by name) instead of creating a second plan.
        throw new LaunchStageError(
          withFallback(err, localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.stagePanel.planFailed")).message,
          withPlan
        );
      }
    
      const next: LaunchProgress = { ...withPlan, sectionsDone: true };
      onProgress(next);
      return next;
    }
    class LaunchStageError extends Error {
      readonly partialProgress: LaunchProgress;
    
      constructor(message: string, partialProgress: LaunchProgress) {
        super(message);
        this.partialProgress = partialProgress;
      }
    }
    async function assignTablesToSections(
      api: LaunchApi,
      venueId: string,
      floorPlanId: string,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft
    ): Promise<void> {
      const idByTableName = new Map<string, string>();
      for (let page = 1; ; page += 1) {
        const { data, pagination } = await api.tables.list({ venueId, page, limit: MAX_PAGE_SIZE });
        for (const table of data) idByTableName.set(table.name, table.id);
        if (data.length === 0 || page >= pagination.totalPages) break;
      }
    
      const rows = await api.floorPlanSections.list(venueId, floorPlanId);
      const rowByName = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row]));
    
      for (const zone of draft.sections) {
        const row = rowByName.get(zone.name);
        if (!row) continue;
        const tableIds = draft.tables.flatMap((table) => {
          const id = idByTableName.get(table.name);
          return table.sectionId === zone.id && id !== undefined ? [id] : [];
        });
        if (tableIds.length === 0) continue;
        await api.floorPlanSections.assignTables(venueId, row.id, tableIds);
      }
    }
    async function runTablesStage(
      api: LaunchApi,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      const venueId = progress.venueId;
      const floorPlanId = progress.floorPlanId;
      // Invariant: nextStage only selects "tables" once "venue" and
      // "floorPlan" are done (stagesFor's order is fixed).
      if (venueId === null || floorPlanId === null) {
        throw new Error("runLaunchSequence: tables stage reached without venueId/floorPlanId");
      }
    
      let current = progress;
      const total = draft.tables.length;
    
      for (const [index, table] of draft.tables.entries()) {
        if (current.createdTableNames.includes(table.name)) {
          // Already created in a prior attempt — resume starts at the next one.
          continue;
        }
    
        try {
          await api.tables.create(draftTableToCreateRequest(table, venueId, floorPlanId));
        } catch (err) {
          if (!isAlreadyCreatedError(err)) {
            const fallback = localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.errors.stoppedAtTable", {
              index: index + 1,
              total,
            });
            throw new LaunchStageError(withFallback(err, fallback).message, current);
          }
          // A duplicate-name rejection means the table already exists —
          // counts as done, loop continues to the next table.
        }
    
        current = { ...current, createdTableNames: [...current.createdTableNames, table.name] };
        onProgress(current);
      }
    
      if (needsMembership(draft)) {
        try {
          await assignTablesToSections(api, venueId, floorPlanId, draft);
        } catch (err) {
          const fallback = localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.errors.generic");
          throw new LaunchStageError(withFallback(err, fallback).message, current);
        }
        current = { ...current, membershipDone: true };
      }
    
      current = { ...current, inFlightStage: null };
      onProgress(current);
      return current;
    }
    async function runActivateStage(
      api: LaunchApi,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      const floorPlanId = progress.floorPlanId;
      // Invariant: nextStage only selects "activate" once "floorPlan" is done
      // (stagesFor's order is fixed).
      if (floorPlanId === null) {
        throw new Error("runLaunchSequence: activate stage reached without a floorPlanId");
      }
    
      try {
        await api.floorPlans.setActive(floorPlanId);
      } catch (err) {
        throw withFallback(err, localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.stagePanel.activateFailed"));
      }
      const next: LaunchProgress = { ...progress, activated: true, inFlightStage: null };
      onProgress(next);
      return next;
    }
    async function runStage(
      api: LaunchApi,
      stage: LaunchStageId,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft,
      venuePayload: CreateVenueRequest,
      hours: QuickSetupDraft,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      switch (stage) {
        case "venue":
          return runVenueStage(api, venuePayload, progress, onProgress);
        case "hours":
          return runHoursStage(api, hours, progress, onProgress);
        case "floorPlan":
          return runFloorPlanStage(api, draft, progress, onProgress);
        case "tables":
          return runTablesStage(api, draft, progress, onProgress);
        case "activate":
          return runActivateStage(api, progress, onProgress);
      }
    }
    export async function runLaunchSequence(
      api: LaunchApi,
      draft: FloorPlanDraft,
      venuePayload: CreateVenueRequest,
      progress: LaunchProgress,
      onProgress: (next: LaunchProgress) => void,
      hours: QuickSetupDraft
    ): Promise<LaunchProgress> {
      let current = progress;
    
      while (true) {
        const stage = nextStage(current, draft);
        if (stage === null) {
          return current;
        }
    
        current = { ...current, inFlightStage: stage, failedStage: null, errorMessage: null };
        // Emit before awaiting the stage — otherwise venue/hours/floorPlan/activate
        // (which call onProgress only once, on completion) never surface an
        // in-flight value, and stageStateOf can never read "in-flight" for them.
        onProgress(current);
    
        try {
          current = await runStage(api, stage, draft, venuePayload, hours, current, onProgress);
        } catch (err) {
          // A LaunchStageError carries whatever progress accumulated before
          // the failure (e.g. tables created before the one that rejected) —
          // use it instead of the pre-stage `current` so that work isn't lost.
          const base = err instanceof LaunchStageError ? err.partialProgress : current;
          current = {
            ...base,
            inFlightStage: null,
            failedStage: stage,
            errorMessage:
              err instanceof Error ? err.message : localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.errors.generic"),
          };
          onProgress(current);
          return current;
        }
      }
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/onboarding-steps.ts">
    export type OnboardingStepId =
      "welcome" | "location" | "hours" | "settings" | "floorPlan" | "launch";
    export interface OnboardingStep {
      readonly id: OnboardingStepId;
    }
    export const ONBOARDING_STEPS: readonly OnboardingStep[] = [
      { id: "welcome" },
      { id: "location" },
      { id: "hours" },
      { id: "settings" },
      { id: "floorPlan" },
      { id: "launch" },
    ];
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/settings-defaults.ts">

      defaultReservationDuration: 90,
      maxPartySize: UNSET_LARGEST_PARTY,
    } as const;
