  <file path="src/components/venue-onboarding/useOnboardingWizard.ts">
    export const TOTAL_STEPS = 6;
    export interface OnboardingWizardData {
      basicInfo: BasicInfoData;
      locationTime: LocationTimeData;
      operatingHours: OperatingHours;
      settings: SettingsData;
      floorPlan: FloorPlanDraft;
      /**
       * The hours step's own form. Legacy `operatingHours` has no service name, so the step
       * reads this draft back after Back/Next instead of rebuilding from the open/close map.
       */
      hoursDraft: QuickSetupDraft;
    }
    export interface OnboardingWizardErrors {
      basicInfo: Partial<Record<keyof BasicInfoData, string>>;
      locationTime: Partial<Record<keyof LocationTimeData, string>>;
      operatingHours: OperatingHoursValidationErrors | null;
      settings: Partial<Record<keyof SettingsData, string>>;
      floorPlan: string | null;
    }
    interface OnboardingWizardState {
      step: number;
      data: OnboardingWizardData;
      errors: OnboardingWizardErrors;
      highestStepReached: number;
      slugStatus: SlugStatus;
      launch: LaunchProgress;
    }
    type OnboardingWizardAction =
      | { type: "SET_STEP_DATA"; step: "basicInfo"; data: BasicInfoData }
      | { type: "SET_STEP_DATA"; step: "locationTime"; data: LocationTimeData }
      | { type: "SET_STEP_DATA"; step: "operatingHours"; data: OperatingHours }
      | { type: "SET_STEP_DATA"; step: "hoursDraft"; data: QuickSetupDraft }
      | { type: "SET_STEP_DATA"; step: "settings"; data: SettingsData }
      | { type: "NEXT" }
      | { type: "BACK" }
      | { type: "GO_TO_STEP"; step: number }
      | { type: "VALIDATE" }
      | { type: "SLUG_CHECK_START" }
      | { type: "SLUG_CHECK_RESULT"; status: "taken" | "available" }
      | { type: "SET_TEMPLATE"; templateId: TemplateId }
      | { type: "SET_ROOM_SIZE"; sizeId: RoomSizeId }
      | { type: "ADD_DRAFT_TABLE"; request: CreateTableRequest }
      | { type: "MOVE_DRAFT_TABLE"; localId: string; x: number; y: number }
      | { type: "REMOVE_DRAFT_TABLE"; localId: string }
      | { type: "SET_LAUNCH_PROGRESS"; progress: LaunchProgress };
    function hoursFromDraft(draft: QuickSetupDraft): OperatingHours {
      return validateDraft(draft, { legacyReader: true }).length === 0 ? draftToLegacyHours(draft) : {};
    }
    function runStepValidation(state: OnboardingWizardState): {
      state: OnboardingWizardState;
      valid: boolean;
    } {
      switch (state.step) {
        case 1: {
          const errors = validateBasicInfo(state.data.basicInfo, state.slugStatus);
          return {
            state: { ...state, errors: { ...state.errors, basicInfo: errors } },
            valid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
          };
        }
        case 2: {
          const errors = validateLocationTime(state.data.locationTime);
          return {
            state: { ...state, errors: { ...state.errors, locationTime: errors } },
            valid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
          };
        }
        case 3: {
          const errors = validateQuickSetupHours(state.data.operatingHours);
          return {
            state: { ...state, errors: { ...state.errors, operatingHours: errors } },
            valid: errors === null,
          };
        }
        case 4: {
          const errors = validateSettings(state.data.settings);
          return {
            state: { ...state, errors: { ...state.errors, settings: errors } },
            valid: Object.keys(errors).length === 0,
          };
        }
        case 5: {
          const valid = state.data.floorPlan.templateId !== null;
          return {
            state: {
              ...state,
              errors: {
                ...state.errors,
                floorPlan: valid ? null : localeRuntime.i18n.t("onboarding.floorPlan.required"),
              },
            },
            valid,
          };
        }
        default:
          return { state, valid: true };
      }
    }
    function reducer(
      state: OnboardingWizardState,
      action: OnboardingWizardAction
    ): OnboardingWizardState {
      switch (action.type) {
        case "SET_STEP_DATA":
          switch (action.step) {
            case "basicInfo": {
              const slugChanged = action.data.slug !== state.data.basicInfo.slug;
              return {
                ...state,
                data: { ...state.data, basicInfo: action.data },
                slugStatus: slugChanged ? "idle" : state.slugStatus,
              };
            }
            case "locationTime":
              return { ...state, data: { ...state.data, locationTime: action.data } };
            case "operatingHours":
              return {
                ...state,
                data: { ...state.data, operatingHours: action.data },
                errors: { ...state.errors, operatingHours: null },
              };
            case "hoursDraft":
              return {
                ...state,
                data: {
                  ...state.data,
                  hoursDraft: action.data,
                  operatingHours: hoursFromDraft(action.data),
                },
                errors: { ...state.errors, operatingHours: null },
              };
            case "settings":
              return { ...state, data: { ...state.data, settings: action.data } };
            default:
              return state;
          }
    
        case "NEXT": {
          const { state: validated, valid } = runStepValidation(state);
          if (!valid) return validated;
          const nextStep = Math.min(validated.step + 1, TOTAL_STEPS);
          return {
            ...validated,
            step: nextStep,
            highestStepReached: Math.max(validated.highestStepReached, nextStep),
          };
        }
    
        case "VALIDATE":
          // Recompute the current step's errors without advancing — restores the
          // on-blur field validation the step inputs wire to onValidate.
          return runStepValidation(state).state;
    
        case "BACK": {
          const floor = state.launch.venueId !== null ? 5 : 1;
          return { ...state, step: Math.max(state.step - 1, floor) };
        }
    
        case "GO_TO_STEP": {
          const floor = state.launch.venueId !== null ? 5 : 1;
          if (action.step >= floor && action.step <= state.highestStepReached) {
            return { ...state, step: action.step };
          }
          return state;
        }
    
        case "SLUG_CHECK_START":
          return { ...state, slugStatus: "checking" };
    
        case "SLUG_CHECK_RESULT": {
          if (action.status === "taken") {
            return {
              ...state,
              slugStatus: "taken",
              errors: {
                ...state.errors,
                basicInfo: {
                  ...state.errors.basicInfo,
                  slug: "A venue with this slug already exists",
                },
              },
            };
          }
          const { slug: _removed, ...rest } = state.errors.basicInfo;
          return { ...state, slugStatus: "available", errors: { ...state.errors, basicInfo: rest } };
        }
    
        case "SET_TEMPLATE":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              floorPlan: draftFromTemplate(action.templateId, state.data.floorPlan.sizeId),
            },
            errors: { ...state.errors, floorPlan: null },
          };
    
        case "SET_ROOM_SIZE": {
          const { templateId } = state.data.floorPlan;
          // Resizing is only meaningful once a room is chosen; until then the step
          // just remembers the size so the chosen room is built at it.
          const floorPlan =
            templateId === null
              ? { ...state.data.floorPlan, sizeId: action.sizeId }
              : draftFromTemplate(templateId, action.sizeId);
          return { ...state, data: { ...state.data, floorPlan } };
        }
    
        case "ADD_DRAFT_TABLE": {
          const table = draftTableFromCreateRequest(action.request, action.request.name);
          return {
            ...state,
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              floorPlan: {
                ...state.data.floorPlan,
                tables: [...state.data.floorPlan.tables, table],
                pristine: false,
              },
            },
          };
        }
    
        case "MOVE_DRAFT_TABLE":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              floorPlan: {
                ...state.data.floorPlan,
                tables: state.data.floorPlan.tables.map((table) =>
                  table.localId === action.localId ? { ...table, x: action.x, y: action.y } : table
                ),
                pristine: false,
              },
            },
          };
    
        case "REMOVE_DRAFT_TABLE":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              floorPlan: {
                ...state.data.floorPlan,
                tables: state.data.floorPlan.tables.filter((table) => table.localId !== action.localId),
                pristine: false,
              },
            },
          };
    
        case "SET_LAUNCH_PROGRESS":
          return { ...state, launch: action.progress };
    
        default:
          return state;
      }
    }
    export interface OnboardingWizardActions {
      setStepData: <K extends keyof OnboardingWizardData>(
        step: K,
        data: OnboardingWizardData[K]
      ) => void;
      next: () => void;
      back: () => void;
      goToStep: (step: number) => void;
      validateStep: () => void;
      checkSlugAvailability: (checkPromise: Promise<unknown>) => Promise<void>;
      setTemplate: (templateId: TemplateId) => void;
      setRoomSize: (sizeId: RoomSizeId) => void;
      addDraftTable: (request: CreateTableRequest) => void;
      moveDraftTable: (localId: string, x: number, y: number) => void;
      removeDraftTable: (localId: string) => void;
      setLaunchProgress: (progress: LaunchProgress) => void;
    }
    export interface OnboardingWizardResult {
      step: number;
      data: OnboardingWizardData;
      errors: OnboardingWizardErrors;
      highestStepReached: number;
      slugStatus: SlugStatus;
      launch: LaunchProgress;
      actions: OnboardingWizardActions;
    }
    export function useOnboardingWizard(): OnboardingWizardResult {
      const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, INITIAL_STATE);
    
      const setStepData = useCallback(
        <K extends keyof OnboardingWizardData>(step: K, data: OnboardingWizardData[K]) => {
          switch (step) {
            case "basicInfo":
              dispatch({ type: "SET_STEP_DATA", step: "basicInfo", data: data as BasicInfoData });
              return;
            case "locationTime":
              dispatch({
                type: "SET_STEP_DATA",
                step: "locationTime",
                data: data as LocationTimeData,
              });
              return;
            case "operatingHours":
              dispatch({
                type: "SET_STEP_DATA",
                step: "operatingHours",
                data: data as OperatingHours,
              });
              return;
            case "hoursDraft":
              dispatch({
                type: "SET_STEP_DATA",
                step: "hoursDraft",
                data: data as QuickSetupDraft,
              });
              return;
            case "settings":
              dispatch({ type: "SET_STEP_DATA", step: "settings", data: data as SettingsData });
              return;
          }
        },
        []
      );
    
      const next = useCallback(() => dispatch({ type: "NEXT" }), []);
      const back = useCallback(() => dispatch({ type: "BACK" }), []);
      const goToStep = useCallback((step: number) => dispatch({ type: "GO_TO_STEP", step }), []);
      const validateStep = useCallback(() => dispatch({ type: "VALIDATE" }), []);
    
      const checkSlugAvailability = useCallback(
        async (checkPromise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> => {
          dispatch({ type: "SLUG_CHECK_START" });
          try {
            await checkPromise;
            dispatch({ type: "SLUG_CHECK_RESULT", status: "taken" });
          } catch {
            dispatch({ type: "SLUG_CHECK_RESULT", status: "available" });
          }
        },
        []
      );
    
      const setRoomSize = useCallback(
        (sizeId: RoomSizeId) => dispatch({ type: "SET_ROOM_SIZE", sizeId }),
        []
      );
    
      const setTemplate = useCallback(
        (templateId: TemplateId) => dispatch({ type: "SET_TEMPLATE", templateId }),
        []
      );
      const addDraftTable = useCallback(
        (request: CreateTableRequest) => dispatch({ type: "ADD_DRAFT_TABLE", request }),
        []
      );
      const moveDraftTable = useCallback(
        (localId: string, x: number, y: number) =>
          dispatch({ type: "MOVE_DRAFT_TABLE", localId, x, y }),
        []
      );
      const removeDraftTable = useCallback(
        (localId: string) => dispatch({ type: "REMOVE_DRAFT_TABLE", localId }),
        []
      );
      const setLaunchProgress = useCallback(
        (progress: LaunchProgress) => dispatch({ type: "SET_LAUNCH_PROGRESS", progress }),
        []
      );
    
      // Stabilise the actions object identity across renders. Each callback is
      // already memoized, so this object never changes — consumers can safely list
      // `actions` in effect dependency arrays without re-running every render.
      const actions = useMemo<OnboardingWizardActions>(
        () => ({
          setStepData,
          next,
          back,
          goToStep,
          validateStep,
          checkSlugAvailability,
          setTemplate,
          setRoomSize,
          addDraftTable,
          moveDraftTable,
          removeDraftTable,
          setLaunchProgress,
        }),
        [
          setStepData,
          next,
          back,
          goToStep,
          validateStep,
          checkSlugAvailability,
          setTemplate,
          setRoomSize,
          addDraftTable,
          moveDraftTable,
          removeDraftTable,
          setLaunchProgress,
        ]
      );
    
      return {
        step: state.step,
        data: state.data,
        errors: state.errors,
        highestStepReached: state.highestStepReached,
        slugStatus: state.slugStatus,
        launch: state.launch,
        actions,
      };
    }
    export function buildOnboardingPayload(data: OnboardingWizardData): CreateVenueRequest {
      const payload: CreateVenueRequest = {
        name: data.basicInfo.name.trim(),
        slug: data.basicInfo.slug.trim(),
        ianaTimezone: data.locationTime.ianaTimezone,
        currencyCode: data.locationTime.currencyCode,
      };
    
      if (data.basicInfo.venueGroupId) {
        payload.venueGroupId = data.basicInfo.venueGroupId;
      }
    
      if (Object.keys(data.operatingHours).length > 0) {
        payload.operatingHours = data.operatingHours;
      }
    
      const venueSettings: VenueSettings = {};
      if (data.settings.defaultReservationDuration !== "") {
        venueSettings.defaultReservationDuration = Number(data.settings.defaultReservationDuration);
      }
      if (data.settings.maxPartySize !== "") {
        venueSettings.maxPartySize = Number(data.settings.maxPartySize);
      }
      if (data.settings.advanceBookingDays !== "") {
        venueSettings.maxAdvanceBooking = Number(data.settings.advanceBookingDays);
      }
    
      if (Object.keys(venueSettings).length > 0) {
        payload.settings = venueSettings;
      }
    
      return payload;
    }
  </file>
  </section>
  <section priority="medium" role="venue-profile">
  <file path="src/components/venue-profile/venue-profile-form.ts">
    export interface VenueProfileForm {
      readonly type: string;
      readonly cuisines: string;
      readonly line1: string;
      readonly line2: string;
      readonly city: string;
      readonly region: string;
      readonly postalCode: string;
      readonly country: string;
      readonly website: string;
      readonly description: string;
    }
    export const EMPTY_VENUE_PROFILE_FORM: VenueProfileForm = {
      type: "",
      cuisines: "",
      line1: "",
      line2: "",
      city: "",
      region: "",
      postalCode: "",
      country: "",
      website: "",
      description: "",
    };
    export type VenueProfileFieldError = "required" | "invalid" | "tooLong";
    export type VenueProfileFormErrors = Partial<
      Record<keyof VenueProfileForm, VenueProfileFieldError>
    >;
    export type VenueProfileFormResult =
      | { readonly ok: true; readonly profile: VenueProfile }
      | { readonly ok: false; readonly errors: VenueProfileFormErrors };
    export function toVenueProfileForm(profile: VenueProfile | undefined): VenueProfileForm {
      return {
        type: profile?.type ?? "",
        cuisines: (profile?.cuisines ?? []).join(", "),
        line1: profile?.address?.line1 ?? "",
        line2: profile?.address?.line2 ?? "",
        city: profile?.address?.city ?? "",
        region: profile?.address?.region ?? "",
        postalCode: profile?.address?.postalCode ?? "",
        country: profile?.address?.country ?? "",
        website: profile?.website ?? "",
        description: profile?.description ?? "",
      };
    }
    function splitCuisines(raw: string): string[] {
      return raw
        .split(",")
        .map((entry) => entry.trim())
        .filter((entry) => entry.length > 0);
    }
    function addressFrom(form: VenueProfileForm): Record<string, string> | undefined {
      const touched = ADDRESS_FIELDS.some((field) => form[field].trim().length > 0);
      if (!touched) return undefined;
    
      const line2 = form.line2.trim();
      return {
        line1: form.line1.trim(),
        ...(line2 ? { line2 } : {}),
        city: form.city.trim(),
        region: form.region.trim(),
        postalCode: form.postalCode.trim(),
        country: form.country.trim(),
      };
    }
    function candidateFrom(form: VenueProfileForm): Record<string, unknown> {
      const cuisines = splitCuisines(form.cuisines);
      const website = form.website.trim();
      const description = form.description.trim();
      const address = addressFrom(form);
    
      return {
        ...(form.type ? { type: form.type } : {}),
        ...(cuisines.length > 0 ? { cuisines } : {}),
        ...(address ? { address } : {}),
        ...(website ? { website } : {}),
        ...(description ? { description } : {}),
      };
    }
    function errorCodeFor(code: string, value: string): VenueProfileFieldError {
      if (code === "too_big") return "tooLong";
      if (value.trim().length === 0) return "required";
      return "invalid";
    }
    export function parseVenueProfileForm(form: VenueProfileForm): VenueProfileFormResult {
      const parsed = VenueProfileSchema.safeParse(candidateFrom(form));
      if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, profile: parsed.data };
    
      const errors: VenueProfileFormErrors = {};
      for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
        const field = issue.path.at(-1);
        if (typeof field !== "string" || !(field in EMPTY_VENUE_PROFILE_FORM)) continue;
        const key = field as keyof VenueProfileForm;
        errors[key] = errorCodeFor(issue.code, form[key]);
      }
      return { ok: false, errors };
    }
  </file>
  </section>
  <section priority="medium" role="venue-setup">
  <file path="src/components/venue-setup/setup-tree.ts">
    export type Channel = (typeof CHANNELS)[number];
    export type SetupNodeKind =
      | "schedules"
      | "schedule"
      | "service"
      | "specialDates"
      | "specialDate"
      | "booking"
      | "channel"
      | "floorPlan"
      | "section"
      | "noSection"
      | "table";
    export type ClosureTarget =
      | { readonly kind: "venue" }
      | { readonly kind: "service"; readonly name: string | null }
      | { readonly kind: "section"; readonly name: string | null }
      | { readonly kind: "booking"; readonly bookingTypes: readonly Channel[] }
      | { readonly kind: "tables"; readonly count: number };
    export type NodeState =
      | { readonly kind: "unset" }
      | { readonly kind: "count"; readonly count: number }
      | { readonly kind: "week"; readonly weekdays: readonly number[] }
      | {
          readonly kind: "period";
          readonly startsOn: string | null;
          readonly endsOn: string | null;
          readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
        }
      | {
          readonly kind: "service";
          readonly opensAt: number;
          readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
          readonly closesAt: number;
          readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
          /** Days whose hours differ from the base: opening, last seating or closing. */
          readonly changes: readonly {
            readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
            readonly opensAt: number;
            readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
            readonly closesAt: number;
          }[];
        }
      | {
          readonly kind: "rules";
          readonly daysAhead: number | null;
          readonly noticeHours: number | null;
          readonly largestParty: number | null;
        }
      | {
          readonly kind: "closure";
          readonly what: "closed" | "specialHours";
          readonly startsOn: string;
          readonly endsOn: string | null;
          readonly target: ClosureTarget;
        }
      | { readonly kind: "floorPlan"; readonly sections: number; readonly tables: number }
      | { readonly kind: "tables"; readonly count: number }
      | { readonly kind: "seats"; readonly seats: number };
    export type SetupActionId =
      | "setUpRegularWeek"
      | "changeRegularWeek"
      | "editSchedule"
      | "compareServices"
      | "createSchedule"
      | "openCalendar"
      | "openSpecialDates"
      | "bookingRules"
      | "openFloorPlan"
      | "addFloorPlan"
      | "closeSection"
      | "moveToSection";
    export type SetupActionTarget = { readonly kind: "link"; readonly to: string };
    export interface SetupAction {
      readonly id: SetupActionId;
      readonly target: SetupActionTarget;
      /** The button the Manager is steered to next, before launch. */
      readonly primary: boolean;
      /** The resource the action names, for its accessible name ("Close Bar for a date…"). */
      readonly subject?: string;
    }
    export interface SetupNode {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly kind: SetupNodeKind;
      /** The resource's own name; null when the kind's label is the name ("Special dates"). */
      readonly name: string | null;
      readonly state: NodeState;
      readonly actions: readonly SetupAction[];
      readonly children: readonly SetupNode[];
    }
    export type GroupLoad<T> =
      | { readonly status: "loading" }
      | { readonly status: "error"; readonly error: unknown }
      | { readonly status: "ready"; readonly data: T };
    export interface OpenData {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined;
    }
    export interface SitData {
      readonly floorPlans: readonly FloorPlan[];
      readonly sections: readonly FloorPlanSection[];
      readonly tables: readonly Table[];
    }
    export interface SetupTreeInput {
      readonly venueName: string;
      readonly isManager: boolean;
      /** `setup` marks the first unset launch step as the primary action. */
      readonly readiness: "setup" | "operational";
      /** The venue's today, `YYYY-MM-DD`. */
      readonly today: string;
      /**
       * The venue's current service date (it trails `today` after midnight on an overnight venue): a
       * regular week replaced before it is neither counted nor listed (#8688).
       */
      readonly serviceDate: string;
      readonly open: GroupLoad<OpenData>;
      readonly sit: GroupLoad<SitData>;
    }
    export type GroupState =
      | { readonly status: "loading" }
      | { readonly status: "error"; readonly error: unknown }
      | { readonly status: "ready" };
    export interface SetupGroup {
      readonly id: "open" | "sit";
      readonly load: GroupState;
      readonly nodes: readonly SetupNode[];
    }
    export interface SetupTree {
      readonly venueName: string;
      readonly groups: readonly [SetupGroup, SetupGroup];
    }
    type Link = { readonly kind: "link"; readonly to: string };
    function scheduleNode(
      schedule: Schedule,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      services: ReadonlyMap<string, { readonly name: string; readonly position: number }>,
      manager: boolean
    ): SetupNode {
      const assignments = config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === schedule.id);
      const covered =
        assignments.length > 0 ? sortedUnique(assignments.flatMap((a) => a.weekdays)) : ALL_WEEKDAYS;
      const rows = config.scheduleServices
        .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === schedule.id && services.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .sort(
          (a, b) =>
            (services.get(a.venueServiceId)?.position ?? 0) -
            (services.get(b.venueServiceId)?.position ?? 0)
        );
      const children: SetupNode[] = rows.map((row) => {
        const sets = row.dayHours.sets;
        const setDays = sets.flatMap((set) => set.weekdays);
        const baseDays = row.weekdays.length > 0 ? row.weekdays : covered;
        return {
          id: `service:${schedule.id}:${row.venueServiceId}`,
          kind: "service",
          name: services.get(row.venueServiceId)?.name ?? null,
          state: {
            kind: "service",
            opensAt: row.opensAt,
            lastSeatingAt: row.lastSeatingAt,
            closesAt: row.closesAt,
            weekdays: sortedUnique([...baseDays, ...setDays]),
            changes: sets
              .filter(
                (set) =>
                  set.opensAt !== row.opensAt ||
                  set.lastSeatingAt !== row.lastSeatingAt ||
                  set.closesAt !== row.closesAt
              )
              .map((set) => ({
                weekdays: sortedUnique(set.weekdays),
                opensAt: set.opensAt,
                lastSeatingAt: set.lastSeatingAt,
                closesAt: set.closesAt,
              })),
          },
          actions: [],
          children: [],
        };
      });
      const weekdays = sortedUnique(
        children.flatMap((c) => (c.state.kind === "service" ? c.state.weekdays : []))
      );
      const dated = assignments.filter((a) => a.startsOn || a.endsOn);
      const starts = dated.map((a) => a.startsOn).filter((d): d is string => !!d);
      const ends = dated.map((a) => a.endsOn);
      const state: NodeState =
        !schedule.isRegular && dated.length > 0
          ? {
              kind: "period",
              startsOn: starts.length > 0 ? starts.reduce((a, b) => (a < b ? a : b)) : null,
              endsOn: ends.some((d) => !d) ? null : latest(ends),
              weekdays: covered.slice(),
            }
          : { kind: "week", weekdays };
      const actions: SetupAction[] = !manager
        ? []
        : schedule.isRegular
          ? [
              action("changeRegularWeek", link(SETUP_HOURS)),
              action("editSchedule", link(SETUP_HOURS), schedule.name),
            ]
          : [action("editSchedule", link(SETUP_SCHEDULES), schedule.name)];
      return {
        id: `schedule:${schedule.id}`,
        kind: "schedule",
        name: schedule.name,
        state,
        actions,
        children,
      };
    }
    function schedulesNode(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      serviceDate: string,
      manager: boolean
    ): SetupNode {
      const services = new Map(
        active(config.venueServices).map((s) => [s.id, { name: s.name, position: s.position }])
      );
      const visible = visibleSchedules(config, serviceDate);
      const schedules = visible.map((s) => scheduleNode(s, config, services, manager));
      const regular = visible.find((s) => s.isRegular);
      const regularSet =
        regular !== undefined &&
        schedules.some((n) => n.id === `schedule:${regular.id}` && n.children.length > 0);
      if (!regularSet) {
        return {
          id: "schedules",
          kind: "schedules",
          name: null,
          state: UNSET,
          actions: manager ? [action("setUpRegularWeek", link(SETUP_CALENDAR))] : [],
          children: [],
        };
      }
      return {
        id: "schedules",
        kind: "schedules",
        name: null,
        state: { kind: "count", count: schedules.length },
        actions: manager
          ? [
              action("compareServices", link(SETUP_SCHEDULES)),
              action("createSchedule", link(SETUP_ADD_SCHEDULE)),
            ]
          : [],
        children: schedules,
      };
    }
    function targetOf(
      rule: DateRule,
      services: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
      sections: ReadonlyMap<string, string> | null
    ): ClosureTarget {
      switch (rule.targetKind) {
        case "service":
          return { kind: "service", name: services.get(rule.venueServiceId ?? "") ?? null };
        case "booking":
          return {
            kind: "booking",
            bookingTypes: (rule.bookingTypes ?? []).filter((b): b is Channel => CHANNELS.includes(b)),
          };
        case "tables":
          return rule.sectionId
            ? { kind: "section", name: sections?.get(rule.sectionId) ?? null }
            : { kind: "tables", count: rule.tableIds?.length ?? 0 };
        default:
          return { kind: "venue" };
      }
    }
    function specialDatesNode(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      today: string,
      sections: ReadonlyMap<string, string> | null,
      manager: boolean
    ): SetupNode {
      const upcoming = upcomingRules(config.dateRules, today);
      const services = new Map(config.venueServices.map((s) => [s.id, s.name]));
      const children: SetupNode[] = upcoming.slice(0, SPECIAL_DATES_SHOWN).map((rule) => ({
        id: `special-date:${rule.id}`,
        kind: "specialDate",
        name: null,
        state: {
          kind: "closure",
          what: rule.kind === "closure" ? "closed" : "specialHours",
          startsOn: rule.startsOn,
          endsOn: rule.endsOn ?? null,
          target: targetOf(rule, services, sections),
        },
        actions: [],
        children: [],
      }));
      return {
        id: "special-dates",
        kind: "specialDates",
        name: null,
        state: upcoming.length === 0 ? UNSET : { kind: "count", count: upcoming.length },
        actions: manager
          ? [
              action("openCalendar", link(SETUP_CALENDAR_TAB)),
              action("openSpecialDates", link(SETUP_SPECIAL)),
            ]
          : [],
        children,
      };
    }
    function bookingNode(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined,
      today: string,
      manager: boolean
    ): SetupNode {
      const daysAhead = numberOrNull(settings?.maxAdvanceBooking);
      const noticeHours = numberOrNull(settings?.minAdvanceBooking);
      const largestParty = numberOrNull(settings?.maxPartySize);
      const anySet = daysAhead !== null || noticeHours !== null || largestParty !== null;
      const closures = upcomingRules(config.dateRules, today).filter(
        (r) => r.kind === "closure" && r.targetKind === "booking"
      );
      return {
        id: "booking",
        kind: "booking",
        name: null,
        state: anySet ? { kind: "rules", daysAhead, noticeHours, largestParty } : UNSET,
        actions: manager ? [action("bookingRules", link(SETUP_BOOKING_RULES))] : [],
        children: CHANNELS.map((channel) => ({
          id: `channel:${channel}`,
          kind: "channel",
          name: channel,
          state: {
            kind: "count",
            count: closures.filter((r) => r.bookingTypes?.includes(channel)).length,
          },
          actions: [],
          children: [],
        })),
      };
    }
    function openNodes(
      data: OpenData,
      dates: { readonly today: string; readonly serviceDate: string },
      sections: ReadonlyMap<string, string> | null,
      manager: boolean
    ): SetupNode[] {
      const { today, serviceDate } = dates;
      return [
        schedulesNode(data.config, serviceDate, manager),
        specialDatesNode(data.config, today, sections, manager),
        bookingNode(data.config, data.settings, today, manager),
      ];
    }
    function tableNode(table: Table): SetupNode {
      return {
        id: `table:${table.id}`,
        kind: "table",
        name: table.name,
        state: { kind: "seats", seats: table.capacity },
        actions: [],
        children: [],
      };
    }
    function floorPlanNode(
      plan: FloorPlan,
      data: SitData,
      manager: boolean,
      hasTables: boolean
    ): SetupNode {
      const tables = data.tables.filter((t) => t.isActive && t.floorPlanId === plan.id);
      const sections = data.sections
        .filter((s) => s.floorPlanId === plan.id)
        .sort((a, b) => a.displayOrder - b.displayOrder);
      const sectionIds = new Set(sections.map((s) => s.id));
      const sectionNodes: SetupNode[] = sections.map((section) => {
        const own = tables.filter((t) => t.sectionId === section.id);
        return {
          id: `section:${section.id}`,
          kind: "section",
          name: section.name,
          state: { kind: "tables", count: own.length },
          actions: manager
            ? [
                action(
                  "closeSection",
                  link(
                    availabilityPath({
                      view: "hub",
                      close: { kind: "section", sectionId: section.id },
                      from: "setup",
                    })
                  ),
                  section.name
                ),
              ]
            : [],
          children: own.map(tableNode),
        };
      });
      const loose = tables.filter((t) => !t.sectionId || !sectionIds.has(t.sectionId));
      const planPath = `/floor-plans/${plan.id}`;
      const noSection: SetupNode[] =
        loose.length === 0
          ? []
          : [
              {
                id: `no-section:${plan.id}`,
                kind: "noSection",
                name: null,
                state: { kind: "tables", count: loose.length },
                actions: manager ? [action("moveToSection", link(planPath))] : [],
                children: loose.map(tableNode),
              },
            ];
      return {
        id: `floor-plan:${plan.id}`,
        kind: "floorPlan",
        name: plan.name,
        // Readiness counts the floor plan step done once any plan has an active table.
        state: hasTables
          ? { kind: "floorPlan", sections: sections.length, tables: tables.length }
          : UNSET,
        actions: manager
          ? [
              action("openFloorPlan", link(planPath), plan.name),
              action("addFloorPlan", link("/floor-plans")),
            ]
          : [],
        children: [...sectionNodes, ...noSection],
      };
    }
    function sitNodes(data: SitData, manager: boolean): SetupNode[] {
      const planIds = new Set(data.floorPlans.map((p) => p.id));
      const hasTables = data.tables.some(
        (t) => t.isActive && !!t.floorPlanId && planIds.has(t.floorPlanId)
      );
      if (data.floorPlans.length === 0) {
        return [
          {
            id: "floor-plan-empty",
            kind: "floorPlan",
            name: null,
            state: UNSET,
            actions: manager ? [action("addFloorPlan", link("/floor-plans"))] : [],
            children: [],
          },
        ];
      }
      return data.floorPlans.map((plan) => floorPlanNode(plan, data, manager, hasTables));
    }
    function withPrimary(nodes: readonly SetupNode[], targetId: string | null): SetupNode[] {
      return nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === targetId
          ? {
              ...node,
              actions: node.actions.map((a, i) => (i === 0 ? { ...a, primary: true } : a)),
            }
          : node
      );
    }
    export function buildSetupTree(input: SetupTreeInput): SetupTree {
      const { isManager, today, serviceDate } = input;
      const sectionNames =
        input.sit.status === "ready"
          ? new Map(input.sit.data.sections.map((s) => [s.id, s.name]))
          : null;
      let open: readonly SetupNode[] =
        input.open.status === "ready"
          ? openNodes(input.open.data, { today, serviceDate }, sectionNames, isManager)
          : [];
      let sit: readonly SetupNode[] =
        input.sit.status === "ready" ? sitNodes(input.sit.data, isManager) : [];
    
      if (
        isManager &&
        input.readiness === "setup" &&
        input.open.status === "ready" &&
        input.sit.status === "ready"
      ) {
        const first = [...open, ...sit].find((n) => isLaunchGate(n) && n.state.kind === "unset");
        open = withPrimary(open, first?.id ?? null);
        sit = withPrimary(sit, first?.id ?? null);
      }
    
      return {
        venueName: input.venueName,
        groups: [
          { id: "open", load: input.open.status === "ready" ? ready : input.open, nodes: open },
          { id: "sit", load: input.sit.status === "ready" ? ready : input.sit, nodes: sit },
        ],
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/venue-setup/useSetupNodeText.ts">
    export interface SetupNodeText {
      /** The kind's word ("Schedule", "Section"), for nodes that carry a name. */
      readonly caption: (node: SetupNode) => string | null;
      readonly label: (node: SetupNode) => string;
      /** One line on what the resource is, on the top-level nodes. */
      readonly whatIs: (node: SetupNode) => string | null;
      readonly state: (node: SetupNode) => string;
      readonly actionLabel: (action: SetupAction, node: SetupNode) => string;
      /** The target an action names, read after its visible label ("Close for a date… Bar"). */
      readonly actionSubject: (action: SetupAction) => string | undefined;
    }
    export function useSetupNodeText(): SetupNodeText {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const format = useVenueFormat();
      const summarize = useWeekdaySummary();
    
      const day = (date: string) =>
        format.formatCalendarDate(date, { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" });
      const shortDay = (date: string) =>
        format.formatCalendarDate(date, { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
    
      const target = (value: ClosureTarget): string => {
        switch (value.kind) {
          case "venue":
            return t("setup.hub.target.venue");
          case "service":
            return value.name ?? t("setup.hub.target.service");
          case "section":
            return value.name ?? t("setup.hub.target.section");
          case "booking":
            return new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(
              value.bookingTypes.map((b) => t(`setup.hub.channel.${b}`))
            );
          case "tables":
            return t("setup.hub.target.tables", { count: value.count });
        }
      };
    
      const when = (startsOn: string, endsOn: string | null): string => {
        if (endsOn === startsOn) return day(startsOn);
        if (endsOn === null) return t("setup.hub.from", { date: day(startsOn) });
        return t("setup.hub.range", { from: shortDay(startsOn), to: shortDay(endsOn) });
      };
    
      const state = (node: SetupNode): string => {
        const value: NodeState = node.state;
        switch (value.kind) {
          case "unset":
            return t("setup.hub.notSetUp");
          case "count":
            switch (node.kind) {
              case "schedules":
                return t("setup.hub.count.schedules", { count: value.count });
              case "specialDates":
                return t("setup.hub.count.specialDates", { count: value.count });
              default:
                return t("setup.hub.count.channel", { count: value.count });
            }
          case "week":
            return t("setup.hub.open", { days: summarize(value.weekdays) });
          case "period":
            return t("setup.hub.period", {
              range:
                value.startsOn === null
                  ? t("setup.hub.until", { date: shortDay(value.endsOn ?? "") })
                  : when(value.startsOn, value.endsOn),
              days: summarize(value.weekdays),
            });
          case "service": {
            const ctx = { t, format };
            const base = t("setup.hub.serviceLine", {
              hours: serviceHoursText(value, ctx),
              days: summarize(value.weekdays),
            });
            const changes = value.changes.map((c) =>
              c.opensAt === value.opensAt
                ? serviceCloseChangeText(summarize(c.weekdays), c, ctx)
                : t("availability.regularWeekLine.different", {
                    days: summarize(c.weekdays),
                    hours: serviceHoursText(c, ctx),
                  })
            );
            return [base, ...changes].join(" · ");
          }
          case "rules":
            return bookingRulesText(value, t);
          case "closure": {
            const what = t(
              value.what === "closed" ? "setup.hub.closedRow" : "setup.hub.specialHoursRow",
              {
                target: target(value.target),
              }
            );
            return `${when(value.startsOn, value.endsOn)} · ${what}`;
          }
          case "floorPlan":
            return `${t("setup.hub.sections", { count: value.sections })} · ${t("setup.hub.tables", { count: value.tables })}`;
          case "tables":
            return t("setup.hub.tables", { count: value.count });
          case "seats":
            return t("setup.hub.seats", { count: value.seats });
        }
      };
    
      return {
        caption: (node) => {
          if (node.name === null) return null;
          switch (node.kind) {
            case "schedule":
              return t("setup.hub.caption.schedule");
            case "service":
              return t("setup.hub.caption.service");
            case "section":
              return t("setup.hub.caption.section");
            case "table":
              return t("setup.hub.caption.table");
            case "floorPlan":
              return t("setup.hub.caption.floorPlan");
            default:
              return null;
          }
        },
        label: (node) => {
          if (node.kind === "channel")
            return t(
              `setup.hub.channelLabel.${node.name === "phone" || node.name === "waitlist" ? node.name : "online"}`
            );
          if (node.name !== null) return node.name;
          switch (node.kind) {
            case "schedules":
              return node.state.kind === "unset"
                ? t("setup.hub.regularWeek")
                : t("setup.hub.label.schedules");
            case "specialDates":
              return t("setup.hub.label.specialDates");
            case "booking":
              return t("setup.hub.label.booking");
            case "noSection":
              return t("setup.hub.label.noSection");
            default:
              return t("setup.hub.label.floorPlan");
          }
        },
        whatIs: (node) => {
          const unset = node.state.kind === "unset";
          switch (node.kind) {
            case "schedules":
              return t(unset ? "setup.hub.what.regularWeek" : "setup.hub.what.schedules");
            case "specialDates":
              return t("setup.hub.what.specialDates");
            case "booking":
              return t(unset ? "setup.hub.what.bookingUnset" : "setup.hub.what.booking");
            case "floorPlan":
              return unset ? t("setup.hub.what.floorPlan") : null;
            default:
              return null;
          }
        },
        state,
        actionLabel: (action, node) =>
          action.id === "addFloorPlan" && node.state.kind !== "unset"
            ? t("setup.hub.actions.addAnotherFloorPlan")
            : t(`setup.hub.actions.${action.id}`),
        actionSubject: (action) => action.subject,
      };
    }
  </file>
  </section>
  <section priority="medium" role="vite.manualChunks.ts">
  <file path="vite.manualChunks.ts">
    export function manualChunks(id: string): string | undefined {
      if (id.includes("node_modules")) {
        // React core — stable, cached long-term. Anchored on the resolved
        // node_modules package segment (not a bare "/react/" substring) so a
        // scoped package merely *named* react (@sentry/react, @json-render/react)
        // can't collide with the actual react/react-dom npm packages (#5730).
        if (id.includes("/node_modules/react-dom/") || id.includes("/node_modules/react/")) {
          return "react-vendor";
        }
        // Routing — separate from page code
        if (id.includes("/node_modules/react-router")) {
          return "router-vendor";
        }
        // Canvas library for floor plan editor (heavy, only needed on one page)
        if (id.includes("/node_modules/konva/") || id.includes("/node_modules/react-konva/")) {
          return "canvas-vendor";
        }
        // JSON Render — used for spec rendering
        if (id.includes("/node_modules/@json-render/")) {
          return "json-render-vendor";
        }
      }
      // Rialto design system — large shared UI, loaded once
      if (id.includes("/packages/rialto/")) {
        return "rialto-vendor";
      }
      // Auth package — shared auth layer
      if (id.includes("/packages/auth/")) {
        return "auth-vendor";
      }
      // Sentry — error reporting
      if (id.includes("/packages/sentry/") || id.includes("/@sentry/")) {
        return "sentry-vendor";
      }
      return undefined;
    }
  </file>
